content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 10 del curso A2** (*Module 1 Review*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Repaso Módulo 1 A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-10-repaso-modulo-1)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 10 — Module 1 Review](/curso-a2/unit-10)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Module 1 review](/blog/curso-a2/unit-10/a2-unit10-module1-review.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: repaso mixto](#leccion-1--gramatica-repaso-mixto)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: repaso](#leccion-2--vocabulario-repaso)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Anna](#leccion-3--reading-anna)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: My last week](#leccion-4--listening-my-last-week)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My weekend](#leccion-5--writing-my-weekend)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: repaso mixto

**Objetivo:** Past Simple, comparativos/superlativos, adverbios y preposiciones.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Yesterday I ____ to the museum. → *went / go / goed*
2. What ____ you do last weekend? → *did / do / does*
3. My brother is ____ than me. → *taller / tallest / more tall*
4. She is ____ tallest in our family. → *the / a / more*
5. She speaks English ____. → *fluently / fluent / fluents*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **went** · 2. **did** · 3. **taller** · 4. **the** · 5. **fluently**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I get up ____ 7 o'clock ____ the morning. → *at / in · on / at · in / on*
7. I work ____ Monday. → *on / at / in*
8. I went ____ the entrance and walked ____ the rooms. → *into / through · across / out of · at / on*
9. I walked ____ the bridge. → *across / into / out of*
10. It was ____ most interesting film. → *the / a / more*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **at** · **in** · 7. **on** · 8. **into** · **through** · 9. **across** · 10. **the**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I walk yesterday.*
12. *What did you went?*
13. *She is more tall than me.*
14. *He speaks English fluent.*
15. *I wake up on 7 o'clock.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **walked** yesterday.
12. What did you **go**? / What did you **do**?
13. She is **taller** than me.
14. He speaks English **fluently**.
15. I wake up **at** 7 o'clock.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: repaso

**Objetivo:** formas clave del Módulo 1.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. go →
2. see →
3. good (comparative) →
4. good (superlative) →
5. careful →

a) carefully · b) better · c) went · d) the best · e) saw

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **e** · 3 → **b** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **a**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. through = por el ____ → *interior / mes / adjetivo*
7. across = de un ____ al otro → *lado / verbo / año*
8. at noon = ____ → *mediodía / agosto / fluently*
9. hometown = ____ → *ciudad natal / puente / adverbio*
10. fastest = el más ____ → *rápido / interesante / carefully*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **interior** · 7. **lado** · 8. **mediodía** · 9. **ciudad natal** · 10. **rápido**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Ever seen* often with ____. → a) superlatives · b) only *at* · c) only *did you*
12. *Practise every day* helps you speak ____. → a) fluently · b) the tallest · c) into
13. *Meeting at noon* uses ____. → a) *at* · b) *on* · c) *into*
14. *Walked across the bridge* uses ____. → a) *across* · b) *through* only · c) *the most*
15. Module 1 mixes past + comparisons + how + where/when = ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only B1

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) superlatives** · 12. **a) fluently** · 13. **a) *at*** · 14. **a) *across*** · 15. **a) yes**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Anna

**Objetivo:** leer un texto que integra el Módulo 1.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-10/reading-review.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Anna"></audio>

> My name is Anna and I have a busy life. I get up at 7 o'clock in the morning on weekdays. Last weekend I went to the museum. I went into the main entrance and walked through several rooms. My sister is the tallest in our family and she speaks English very fluently. She saw a beautiful film last night and said it was the most interesting film she has ever seen. On Saturday morning I walked across the bridge to get to the other side of the river. I really enjoyed the weekend!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When does Anna get up on weekdays? → a) At 7 in the morning · b) At noon · c) In August
2. Where did she go last weekend? → a) The museum · b) London only · c) Work
3. Who is the tallest? → a) Her sister · b) Anna · c) Nobody
4. What film opinion? → a) The most interesting she has ever seen · b) The worst · c) No film
5. What did she do on Saturday morning? → a) Walked across the bridge · b) Slept only · c) Worked

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At 7 in the morning** · 2. **a) The museum** · 3. **a) Her sister** · 4. **a) The most interesting she has ever seen** · 5. **a) Walked across the bridge**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Movement: ____. → a) into / through / across · b) only *at* · c) only *-ly*
7. Time: ____. → a) at / in / on · b) only *into* · c) only *the most*
8. Superlatives: ____. → a) the tallest / the most interesting · b) only taller · c) only well
9. Adverb: ____. → a) fluently · b) biggest · c) across
10. Past irregulars: ____. → a) went / saw · b) walked only · c) am only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) into / through / across** · 7. **a) at / in / on** · 8. **a) the tallest / the most interesting** · 9. **a) fluently** · 10. **a) went / saw**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *On weekdays* + *at 7* + *in the morning* shows ____. → a) mixed time prepositions · b) only movement · c) only adjectives
12. *Went into* / *walked through* = ____. → a) movement · b) comparative · c) *will*
13. *The tallest in our family* uses ____. → a) *in* + group place · b) *of* only wrong here · c) *at*
14. *Speaks… fluently* = manner adverb · a) true · b) false · c) past only
15. Integrated Module 1 text = ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 1

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) mixed time prepositions** · 12. **a) movement** · 13. **a) *in* + group place** · 14. **a) true** · 15. **a) yes**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: My last week

**Objetivo:** escuchar un relato de repaso.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-10/listening-review.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: My last week"></audio>

> Hi! I want to tell you about my last week. On Monday I had a meeting at noon. On Tuesday I went to the cinema and saw a film. It was the most interesting film I have ever seen. On Wednesday I walked through the park and went into a cafe. I speak English fluently now because I practise every day. My brother is taller than me but I am the fastest runner in the family!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Monday: ____. → a) Meeting at noon · b) Cinema · c) Bridge only
2. Tuesday: ____. → a) Cinema / saw a film · b) Only sleep · c) Work forever
3. Film opinion: ____. → a) Most interesting ever seen · b) Worst · c) No opinion
4. Wednesday: ____. → a) Through the park / into a cafe · b) Only *at* · c) Nothing
5. Who is faster? → a) The speaker · b) The brother · c) Nobody

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Meeting at noon** · 2. **a) Cinema / saw a film** · 3. **a) Most interesting ever seen** · 4. **a) Through the park / into a cafe** · 5. **a) The speaker**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Brother comparison: ____. → a) taller than me · b) the tallest only · c) fluently
7. Speaker superlative: ____. → a) the fastest runner · b) the worst · c) across
8. Why fluent? → a) Practise every day · b) Never study · c) Only *into*
9. Past forms: ____. → a) had / went / saw / walked · b) only *am* · c) only *will*
10. Review listening mixes ____. → a) time + past + comparisons + adverb + movement · b) only Unit 1 · c) only B2

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) taller than me** · 7. **a) the fastest runner** · 8. **a) Practise every day** · 9. **a) had / went / saw / walked** · 10. **a) time + past + comparisons + adverb + movement**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *On Monday… at noon* = ____. → a) *on* + *at* · b) *in* + *into* · c) only *-ly*
12. *The most interesting* = ____. → a) long-adj superlative · b) short *-er* · c) Wh-question
13. *Walked through / went into* = ____. → a) movement · b) *the best* · c) *as… as*
14. *Taller than* vs *the fastest* = ____. → a) comparative vs superlative · b) same · c) only past
15. *Fluently* describes ____. → a) how they speak · b) where · c) when only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) *on* + *at*** · 12. **a) long-adj superlative** · 13. **a) movement** · 14. **a) comparative vs superlative** · 15. **a) how they speak**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My weekend

**Objetivo:** escribir un párrafo que mezcle el Módulo 1.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Last weekend I ____ to the park. → *went / go / goed*
2. I walked ____ the park. → *through / into / at*
3. My sister is ____ than me. → *taller / tallest / more tall*
4. She speaks ____. → *fluently / fluent / fluents*
5. I got up ____ 8 o'clock ____ Saturday. → *at / on · on / at · in / in*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **went** · 2. **through** · 3. **taller** · 4. **fluently** · 5. **at** · **on**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. What / did / you / do / last weekend?
7. It / was / the / most / interesting / film.
8. I / went / into / a cafe.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. What did you do last weekend?
7. It was the most interesting film.
8. I went into a cafe.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Past irregular: fuiste y viste algo.
10. Wh-question + respuesta.
11. Comparativo + superlativo.
12. Un adverbio de modo.
13. *at/on/in* en dos frases.
14. *into/through/across* en dos frases.
15. Párrafo (8–10 frases) tipo Anna / last week.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I went to the cinema and saw a film.
10. What did you do last weekend? I went to the museum.
11. My brother is taller than me. I am the fastest runner in the family.
12. I speak English fluently.
13. I get up at 7 o'clock. I work on Monday. I was born in 1995.
14. I went into a cafe. I walked through the park. I walked across the bridge.
15. Last weekend I went to the museum. I went into the entrance and walked through the rooms. On Saturday I walked across the bridge. My sister is the tallest in our family and she speaks English fluently. I really enjoyed the weekend!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Past | *went / saw / had / walked* |
| Wh | *What did you do?* |
| Compare | *taller than* / *the tallest* |
| Adverb | *fluently / well* |
| Time | *at / on / in* |
| Move | *into / out of / through / across* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

Continúa con la [**Unidad 11 — Present Perfect**](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-11-present-perfect-introduccion): *I have been to…*

Antes de pasar de módulo, graba 60 segundos sobre *last weekend* mezclando todo.

Guías relacionadas:

- [Repaso Módulo 1 A2 (teoría)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-10-repaso-modulo-1)

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 11 del curso A2** (*Present Perfect: Introduction*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Present Perfect intro A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-11-present-perfect-introduccion)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 11 — Present Perfect: Introducción](/curso-a2/unit-11)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Present Perfect: Introduction](/blog/curso-a2/unit-11/a2-unit11-present-perfect.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Laura's travels](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Tom's travels](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** have/has + past participle; been vs gone.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ been to France. → *have / has / had*
2. She ____ seen that film. → *has / have / is*
3. They ____ eaten lunch. → *have / has / are*
4. He ____ gone to the shop. → *has / have / is*
5. ____ you been to Italy? → *Have / Has / Did*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** · 2. **has** · 3. **have** · 4. **has** · 5. **Have**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Form = ____. → a) have/has + past participle · b) did + -ed · c) am + -ing only
7. *been to* = ____. → a) went and came back · b) still there · c) never travelled
8. *gone to* = ____. → a) still there / not back · b) returned · c) future only
9. Past of *eat* (PP) = ____. → a) eaten · b) ate · c) eated
10. *Last year I went* is ____. → a) Past Simple (time given) · b) Present Perfect · c) wrong

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) have/has + past participle** · 7. **a) went and came back** · 8. **a) still there / not back** · 9. **a) eaten** · 10. **a) Past Simple (time given)**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I has been to Spain.*
12. *She have seen Madrid.*
13. *They have ate paella.*
14. *He have gone to London.*
15. *Did you been to Italy?*

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ____ to Italy. → *been / being / be*
2. She has ____ that film. → *seen / saw / see*
3. Have you ever ____ sushi? → *eaten / ate / eat*
4. I haven't finished ____. → *yet / already / ago*
5. I have ____ arrived. → *just / yesterday / last*

<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **been** · 2. **seen** · 3. **eaten** · 4. **yet** · 5. **just**

</details>

6. I / have / been / to / Spain.
7. Have / you / ever / tried / sushi?
8. She / has / just / finished / her exam.

<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I have been to Spain.
7. Have you ever tried sushi?
8. She has just finished her exam.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una experiencia con *have been to*.
10. Una pregunta con *Have you ever…?*
11. Una frase con *never*.
12. Una frase con *already* o *yet*.
13. Una frase con *just*.
14. Una frase Past Simple con *last year / ago*.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I have been to Spain.
10. Have you ever eaten sushi?
11. I have never ridden a horse.
12. I have already finished / I haven't called her yet.
13. I have just arrived home.
14. Last year I went to Japan. / Two months ago I travelled to Italy.
15. I have been to many countries. I have never been to Australia. Last year I went to Japan. I have already booked my next trip. I am excited!

</details>

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **have/has + PP** | I **have been** / She **has seen** |
| **been to** | experience + returned |
| **gone to** | still there |
| **eaten** | past participle of eat |

Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 12 del curso A2** (*Present Perfect: Ever & Never*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 12 — Present Perfect: Ever & Never](/curso-a2/unit-12)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Present Perfect: Ever & Never](/blog/curso-a2/unit-12/a2-unit12-ever-never.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Classmates survey](#leccion-3--reading)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** Have you ever…? / never; Yes, I have / No, I haven't.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. ____ you ever been to Japan? → *Have / Has / Did*
2. I have ____ eaten sushi. → *never / ever / yet*
3. Yes, I ____. → *have / has / am*
4. No, I ____. → *haven't / hasn't / didn't*
5. Have you ever ____ a horse? → *ridden / rode / ride*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Have** · 2. **never** · 3. **have** · 4. **haven't** · 5. **ridden**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Ever* usually appears in ____. → a) questions · b) only negatives · c) only Past Simple
7. *Never* means ____. → a) not at any time · b) already · c) yesterday
8. Short answer affirmative = ____. → a) Yes, I have · b) Yes, I did always · c) Yes, I am
9. Short answer negative = ____. → a) No, I haven't · b) No, I don't never · c) No, I wasn't
10. *Have you ever flown…?* uses ____. → a) past participle · b) Past Simple only · c) *-ing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) questions** · 7. **a) not at any time** · 8. **a) Yes, I have** · 9. **a) No, I haven't** · 10. **a) past participle**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *Did you ever been to Japan?*
12. *I have ever eaten sushi.* (negativa de experiencia)
13. *Yes, I has.*
14. *No, I haven't never.*
15. *Have you ever ate sushi?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **Have** you ever **been** to Japan?
12. I have **never** eaten sushi.
13. Yes, I **have**.
14. No, I **haven't**. / I have **never**…
15. Have you ever **eaten** sushi?

</details>

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 13 del curso A2** (*Present Perfect: Already & Yet*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Present Perfect already/yet A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-13-present-perfect-already-yet)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 13 — Present Perfect: Already & Yet](/curso-a2/unit-13)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Present Perfect: Already & Yet](/blog/curso-a2/unit-13/a2-unit13-already-yet.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Sofia's tasks](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Lucas's busy week](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** already (afirmativa) / yet (negativa y preguntas).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ____ finished my homework. → *already / yet / ever*
2. I haven't paid the bill ____. → *yet / already / never*
3. ____ she cleaned her room yet? → *Has / Have / Did*
4. He has already ____ breakfast. → *eaten / ate / eat*
5. They haven't ____ the emails yet. → *sent / send / sending*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **already** · 2. **yet** · 3. **Has** · 4. **eaten** · 5. **sent**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Already* is common in ____. → a) affirmative · b) only questions · c) only Past Simple time
7. *Yet* is common in ____. → a) negatives and questions · b) only affirmative · c) only *ago*
8. Position: *already* often goes ____. → a) before past participle · b) only at the end forever · c) after *did*
9. *Have you… yet?* expects ____. → a) completion check · b) *never* only · c) future *will*
10. *I must do it today* shows something ____. → a) not done yet · b) already done · c) never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) affirmative** · 7. **a) negatives and questions** · 8. **a) before past participle** · 9. **a) completion check** · 10. **a) not done yet**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I have finished already my homework.* (posición típica)
12. *I haven't yet paid the bill already.*
13. *Have you already cleaned yet your room?*
14. *She have already done the washing.*
15. *I didn't call her yet.* (Present Perfect)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I have **already finished** my homework.
12. I haven't paid the bill **yet**.
13. Have you cleaned your room **yet**? / Have you **already** cleaned…?
14. She **has** already done the washing.
15. I **haven't called** her **yet**.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** formas y palabras de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. past participle of *see* → ____ → *seen / saw / see*
2. past participle of *eat* → ____ → *eaten / ate / eated*
3. past participle of *go* (with *have*) often → ____ → *been/gone / went / going*
4. *experience* ≈ ____ → *something you have done · a clock time · a month name*
5. *twice* = ____ → *two times · never · yesterday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **seen** · 2. **eaten** · 3. **been/gone** · 4. **something you have done** · 5. **two times**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I have ____ to Spain. → *been / being / be*
7. She has ____ that film. → *seen / saw / see*
8. Have you ____ sushi? → *eaten / ate / eat*
9. He has ____ to London today. → *gone / went / go*
10. We have ____ lunch. → *eaten / ate / eated*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **been** · 7. **seen** · 8. **eaten** · 9. **gone** · 10. **eaten**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Present Perfect needs ____. → a) have/has + PP · b) only *-ed* without have · c) *did* + PP
12. Time words like *yesterday/ago* usually take ____. → a) Past Simple · b) Present Perfect always · c) *will*
13. *Have you ever…?* asks about ____. → a) life experience · b) only tomorrow · c) exact clock yesterday
14. *Already/yet/just* typically go with ____. → a) Present Perfect · b) only Future · c) only *to be*
15. A2 travel verbs often: ____. → a) been, seen, eaten, gone · b) only *am* · c) only *-est*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) have/has + PP** · 12. **a) Past Simple** · 13. **a) life experience** · 14. **a) Present Perfect** · 15. **a) been, seen, eaten, gone**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Sofia's tasks

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-13/reading-already.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Sofia's tasks"></audio>

> My name is Sofia. I have many tasks every day. This morning I have already cleaned my room and done the washing. I have already finished my homework too. But I haven't paid the electricity bill yet. I must do it today. I also haven't called my grandmother yet. She is waiting for my call. I feel good because I have already completed most of my obligations today.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What has Sofia already cleaned? → a) Her room · b) The car · c) Nothing
2. Has she finished homework? → a) Yes, already · b) Not yet · c) Never
3. What hasn't she paid yet? → a) Electricity bill · b) Rent only · c) Nothing pending
4. Who hasn't she called yet? → a) Grandmother · b) Boss · c) Tom
5. How does she feel? → a) Good · b) Angry · c) Lost

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Her room** · 2. **a) Yes, already** · 3. **a) Electricity bill** · 4. **a) Grandmother** · 5. **a) Good**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) already (afirmativa) / yet (negativa y preguntas) · b) only *at/on/in* · c) only comparatives
7. Past participles appear ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only adjectives
8. Present Perfect forms use ____. → a) have/has · b) only *did* · c) only *will*
9. The main topic fits unit 13: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 1
10. Reading + audio helps you ____. → a) notice form in context · b) skip grammar · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) already (afirmativa) / yet (negativa y preguntas)** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) have/has** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) notice form in context**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Have/has* agrees with ____. → a) the subject · b) the object only · c) never
12. After *have/has* we use ____. → a) past participle · b) base always · c) *-ing* only
13. Negatives often use ____. → a) haven't/hasn't · b) don't been · c) didn't have been
14. Questions invert ____. → a) Have/Has + subject · b) Subject + Have always · c) Did + have + been wrong mix
15. Mixing PP with a Past Simple time phrase is often ____. → a) a common error · b) required · c) the only correct style

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) the subject** · 12. **a) past participle** · 13. **a) haven't/hasn't** · 14. **a) Have/Has + subject** · 15. **a) a common error**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Lucas's busy week

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-13/listening-already.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Lucas's busy week"></audio>

> Hi! I am Lucas. I have a busy week. Today I have already done my chores and finished the shopping. I have already cleaned the kitchen too. But I haven't sent the emails yet. I must do that before dinner. I also haven't called my boss yet. He is waiting for my call. I feel relaxed because I have already completed most of my tasks for today.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What has Lucas already done? → a) Chores and shopping · b) Only emails · c) Nothing
2. Has he cleaned the kitchen? → a) Yes, already · b) Not yet · c) Never
3. What hasn't he sent yet? → a) Emails · b) Postcards · c) Money
4. Who hasn't he called yet? → a) His boss · b) Grandmother · c) Emma
5. How does he feel? → a) Relaxed · b) Angry · c) Bored

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Chores and shopping** · 2. **a) Yes, already** · 3. **a) Emails** · 4. **a) His boss** · 5. **a) Relaxed**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) comprehension of PP forms · b) only spelling of *-est* · c) only *into*
7. Key verbs you hear include past participles: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only future
8. The speaker talks about ____. → a) experiences / recent actions · b) only weather maps · c) only Module 6 food
9. Short answers / already-yet-just / contrast appear as relevant: ____. → a) according to unit · b) never · c) only A1
10. The listening practices unit 13: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) comprehension of PP forms** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) experiences / recent actions** · 9. **a) according to unit** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. You can notice *have/has* + ____. → a) PP · b) only infinitive · c) *-est*
12. Time markers help choose PP vs Past Simple: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. *Been/gone/seen/eaten* are ____. → a) past participles · b) present continuous · c) adjectives only
14. Fluency tip: repeat the audio and ____. → a) shadow the forms · b) ignore verbs · c) translate only titles
15. After listening, write 3 sentences with the unit focus: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) only for teachers

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) PP** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) past participles** · 14. **a) shadow the forms** · 15. **a) good practice**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ____ to Italy. → *been / being / be*
2. She has ____ that film. → *seen / saw / see*
3. Have you ever ____ sushi? → *eaten / ate / eat*
4. I haven't finished ____. → *yet / already / ago*
5. I have ____ arrived. → *just / yesterday / last*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **been** · 2. **seen** · 3. **eaten** · 4. **yet** · 5. **just**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / have / been / to / Spain.
7. Have / you / ever / tried / sushi?
8. She / has / just / finished / her exam.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I have been to Spain.
7. Have you ever tried sushi?
8. She has just finished her exam.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una experiencia con *have been to*.
10. Una pregunta con *Have you ever…?*
11. Una frase con *never*.
12. Una frase con *already* o *yet*.
13. Una frase con *just*.
14. Una frase Past Simple con *last year / ago*.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) mezclando el foco de la Unidad 13.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I have been to Spain.
10. Have you ever eaten sushi?
11. I have never ridden a horse.
12. I have already finished / I haven't called her yet.
13. I have just arrived home.
14. Last year I went to Japan. / Two months ago I travelled to Italy.
15. I have been to many countries. I have never been to Australia. Last year I went to Japan. I have already booked my next trip. I am excited!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **already** | I have **already** finished. |
| **yet** (−) | I haven't finished **yet**. |
| **yet** (?) | Have you finished **yet**? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

Continúa con la [**Unidad 14 — Just**](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-14-present-perfect-just).

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** have/has just + past participle (muy reciente).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ____ arrived home. → *just / yet / never*
2. She has just ____ her exam. → *finished / finish / finishing*
3. They have just ____. → *left / leave / leaving*
4. He has just ____ up. → *woken / wake / woke* (PP)
5. I have just ____ a message. → *received / receive / receiving*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **just** · 2. **finished** · 3. **left** · 4. **woken** · 5. **received**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Just* means ____. → a) a very short time ago · b) never · c) last year
7. Form = ____. → a) have/has just + PP · b) did just + base only · c) am just
8. *I have just arrived* focuses on ____. → a) recent result/now · b) distant past date · c) future
9. *Just* usually goes ____. → a) before the past participle · b) only after *ago* · c) after *did*
10. Present Perfect + *just* is ____ with a present feeling. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only B2

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) a very short time ago** · 7. **a) have/has just + PP** · 8. **a) recent result/now** · 9. **a) before the past participle** · 10. **a) natural**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I just have arrived home.*
12. *She has just finish her exam.*
13. *They just left.* (quieres Present Perfect)
14. *He have just woken up.*
15. *I have just saw him.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I have **just arrived** home.
12. She has just **finished** her exam.
13. They have **just left**.
14. He **has** just woken up.
15. I have just **seen** him.

</details>

14. Fluency tip: repeat the audio and ____. → a) shadow the forms · b) ignore verbs · c) translate only titles
15. After listening, write 3 sentences with the unit focus: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) only for teachers

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) PP** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) past participles** · 14. **a) shadow the forms** · 15. **a) good practice**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ____ to Italy. → *been / being / be*
2. She has ____ that film. → *seen / saw / see*
3. Have you ever ____ sushi? → *eaten / ate / eat*
4. I haven't finished ____. → *yet / already / ago*
5. I have ____ arrived. → *just / yesterday / last*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **been** · 2. **seen** · 3. **eaten** · 4. **yet** · 5. **just**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / have / been / to / Spain.
7. Have / you / ever / tried / sushi?
8. She / has / just / finished / her exam.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I have been to Spain.
7. Have you ever tried sushi?
8. She has just finished her exam.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una experiencia con *have been to*.
10. Una pregunta con *Have you ever…?*
11. Una frase con *never*.
12. Una frase con *already* o *yet*.
13. Una frase con *just*.
14. Una frase Past Simple con *last year / ago*.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) mezclando el foco de la Unidad 14.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I have been to Spain.
10. Have you ever eaten sushi?
11. I have never ridden a horse.
12. I have already finished / I haven't called her yet.
13. I have just arrived home.
14. Last year I went to Japan. / Two months ago I travelled to Italy.
15. I have been to many countries. I have never been to Australia. Last year I went to Japan. I have already booked my next trip. I am excited!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **just** | I have **just** arrived. |
| Significado | hace un momento |
| Posición | have/has **just** + PP |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 15 del curso A2** (*Present Perfect vs Past Simple*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Present Perfect vs Past Simple A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-15-present-perfect-vs-past-simple)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 15 — Present Perfect vs Past Simple](/curso-a2/unit-15)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Present Perfect vs Past Simple](/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/a2-unit15-pp-vs-ps.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Jake's travels](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Nina's books](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** experiencia (PP) vs tiempo concreto (Past Simple).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ been to many countries. → *have / went / did*
2. Last year I ____ to Japan. → *went / have gone / go*
3. I have ____ been to Australia. → *never / ago / last*
4. Two months ago I ____ to Italy. → *travelled / have travelled / travel*
5. I have already ____ my next trip. → *booked / book / booking*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** · 2. **went** · 3. **never** · 4. **travelled** · 5. **booked**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Experience without time → ____. → a) Present Perfect · b) Past Simple only · c) *will*
7. Finished time (*last year, ago*) → ____. → a) Past Simple · b) Present Perfect only · c) *just* always
8. *I have been to Japan* = ____. → a) experience · b) exact date required · c) still in Japan always
9. *Last year I went to Japan* = ____. → a) specific past time · b) no time · c) future
10. Mixing both in one story is ____. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only B2

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present Perfect** · 7. **a) Past Simple** · 8. **a) experience** · 9. **a) specific past time** · 10. **a) natural**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I have gone to Japan last year.*
12. *I went to many countries in my life.* (experiencia general)
13. *Two months ago I have travelled to Italy.*
14. *I have never went to Australia.*
15. *Yesterday I have read a book.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **went** to Japan last year.
12. I **have been** to many countries in my life.
13. Two months ago I **travelled** to Italy.
14. I have never **been** to Australia.
15. Yesterday I **read** a book.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** formas y palabras de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. past participle of *see* → ____ → *seen / saw / see*
2. past participle of *eat* → ____ → *eaten / ate / eated*
3. past participle of *go* (with *have*) often → ____ → *been/gone / went / going*
4. *experience* ≈ ____ → *something you have done · a clock time · a month name*
5. *twice* = ____ → *two times · never · yesterday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **seen** · 2. **eaten** · 3. **been/gone** · 4. **something you have done** · 5. **two times**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I have ____ to Spain. → *been / being / be*
7. She has ____ that film. → *seen / saw / see*
8. Have you ____ sushi? → *eaten / ate / eat*
9. He has ____ to London today. → *gone / went / go*
10. We have ____ lunch. → *eaten / ate / eated*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **been** · 7. **seen** · 8. **eaten** · 9. **gone** · 10. **eaten**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Present Perfect needs ____. → a) have/has + PP · b) only *-ed* without have · c) *did* + PP
12. Time words like *yesterday/ago* usually take ____. → a) Past Simple · b) Present Perfect always · c) *will*
13. *Have you ever…?* asks about ____. → a) life experience · b) only tomorrow · c) exact clock yesterday
14. *Already/yet/just* typically go with ____. → a) Present Perfect · b) only Future · c) only *to be*
15. A2 travel verbs often: ____. → a) been, seen, eaten, gone · b) only *am* · c) only *-est*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) have/has + PP** · 12. **a) Past Simple** · 13. **a) life experience** · 14. **a) Present Perfect** · 15. **a) been, seen, eaten, gone**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Jake's travels

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/reading-contrast.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Jake's travels"></audio>

> My name is Jake. I love travelling. I have been to many countries in my life. I have never been to Australia but I want to go one day. Last year I went to Japan. It was amazing. I visited Tokyo and Kyoto. Two months ago I travelled to Italy. I ate pizza in Naples and saw the Colosseum in Rome. I have already booked my next trip to Spain. I am excited!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What does Jake love? → a) Travelling · b) Only cooking · c) Nothing
2. Has he been to Australia? → a) Never · b) Yes last week · c) He lives there
3. Where did he go last year? → a) Japan · b) Spain · c) Nowhere
4. What about two months ago? → a) Travelled to Italy · b) Stayed home · c) Exam
5. What has he already booked? → a) Trip to Spain · b) A film · c) Nothing

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Travelling** · 2. **a) Never** · 3. **a) Japan** · 4. **a) Travelled to Italy** · 5. **a) Trip to Spain**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) experiencia (PP) vs tiempo concreto (Past Simple) · b) only *at/on/in* · c) only comparatives
7. Past participles appear ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only adjectives
8. Present Perfect forms use ____. → a) have/has · b) only *did* · c) only *will*
9. The main topic fits unit 15: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 1
10. Reading + audio helps you ____. → a) notice form in context · b) skip grammar · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) experiencia (PP) vs tiempo concreto (Past Simple)** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) have/has** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) notice form in context**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Have/has* agrees with ____. → a) the subject · b) the object only · c) never
12. After *have/has* we use ____. → a) past participle · b) base always · c) *-ing* only
13. Negatives often use ____. → a) haven't/hasn't · b) don't been · c) didn't have been
14. Questions invert ____. → a) Have/Has + subject · b) Subject + Have always · c) Did + have + been wrong mix
15. Mixing PP with a Past Simple time phrase is often ____. → a) a common error · b) required · c) the only correct style

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) the subject** · 12. **a) past participle** · 13. **a) haven't/hasn't** · 14. **a) Have/Has + subject** · 15. **a) a common error**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Nina's books

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/listening-contrast.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Nina's books"></audio>

> Hi! I am Nina. I love reading. I have read many books in my life. I have never read a science fiction book but I want to try one. Last month I read a great novel by Jane Austen. It was beautiful. Three weeks ago I finished a mystery book. I really enjoyed it. I have already bought my next book for the holidays. I am excited!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What does Nina love? → a) Reading · b) Football · c) Cooking only
2. Science fiction? → a) Never read one · b) Many · c) Yesterday only
3. Last month she read ____. → a) Jane Austen · b) Only emails · c) Nothing
4. Three weeks ago? → a) Finished a mystery book · b) Flew · c) Worked abroad
5. What has she already bought? → a) Next holiday book · b) A car · c) Tickets

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Reading** · 2. **a) Never read one** · 3. **a) Jane Austen** · 4. **a) Finished a mystery book** · 5. **a) Next holiday book**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) comprehension of PP forms · b) only spelling of *-est* · c) only *into*
7. Key verbs you hear include past participles: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only future
8. The speaker talks about ____. → a) experiences / recent actions · b) only weather maps · c) only Module 6 food
9. Short answers / already-yet-just / contrast appear as relevant: ____. → a) according to unit · b) never · c) only A1
10. The listening practices unit 15: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) comprehension of PP forms** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) experiences / recent actions** · 9. **a) according to unit** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. You can notice *have/has* + ____. → a) PP · b) only infinitive · c) *-est*
12. Time markers help choose PP vs Past Simple: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. *Been/gone/seen/eaten* are ____. → a) past participles · b) present continuous · c) adjectives only
14. Fluency tip: repeat the audio and ____. → a) shadow the forms · b) ignore verbs · c) translate only titles
15. After listening, write 3 sentences with the unit focus: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) only for teachers

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) PP** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) past participles** · 14. **a) shadow the forms** · 15. **a) good practice**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have ____ to Italy. → *been / being / be*
2. She has ____ that film. → *seen / saw / see*
3. Have you ever ____ sushi? → *eaten / ate / eat*
4. I haven't finished ____. → *yet / already / ago*
5. I have ____ arrived. → *just / yesterday / last*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **been** · 2. **seen** · 3. **eaten** · 4. **yet** · 5. **just**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / have / been / to / Spain.
7. Have / you / ever / tried / sushi?
8. She / has / just / finished / her exam.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I have been to Spain.
7. Have you ever tried sushi?
8. She has just finished her exam.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una experiencia con *have been to*.
10. Una pregunta con *Have you ever…?*
11. Una frase con *never*.
12. Una frase con *already* o *yet*.
13. Una frase con *just*.
14. Una frase Past Simple con *last year / ago*.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) mezclando el foco de la Unidad 15.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I have been to Spain.
10. Have you ever eaten sushi?
11. I have never ridden a horse.
12. I have already finished / I haven't called her yet.
13. I have just arrived home.
14. Last year I went to Japan. / Two months ago I travelled to Italy.
15. I have been to many countries. I have never been to Australia. Last year I went to Japan. I have already booked my next trip. I am excited!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Uso | Tiempo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Experiencia / resultado | **Present Perfect** |
| Tiempo concreto acabado | **Past Simple** |
| Señales PP | ever, never, already, yet, just |
| Señales PS | yesterday, last…, ago, in 2019 |

Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 16 del curso A2** (*Past Continuous*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

![Past Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/a2-unit16-past-continuous.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** was/were + -ing.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ watching TV at 8pm. → *was / were / am*
2. They ____ cooking dinner. → *were / was / are*
3. ____ she studying? → *Was / Were / Did*
4. We ____ not sleeping. → *were / was / did*
5. He ____ walking his dog. → *was / were / is*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was** · 2. **were** · 3. **Was** · 4. **were** · 5. **was**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Form = ____. → a) was/were + -ing · b) have + PP · c) will + base
7. Use for ____. → a) actions in progress in the past · b) only experiences · c) only future
8. I/he/she/it take ____. → a) was · b) were · c) have
9. You/we/they take ____. → a) were · b) was · c) has
10. *Suddenly* often interrupts with ____. → a) Past Simple · b) only Present Perfect · c) *will*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) was/were + -ing** · 7. **a) actions in progress in the past** · 8. **a) was** · 9. **a) were** · 10. **a) Past Simple**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I were watching TV.*
12. *They was cooking.*
13. *Was they playing?*
14. *She were studying.*
15. *We was running.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **was** watching TV.  
12. They **were** cooking.  
13. **Were** they playing?  
14. She **was** studying.  
15. We **were** running.  

</details>

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** palabras y patrones de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige

1. The unit focus is ____. → a) was/were + -ing · b) only colours · c) only A1 *to be*
2. Practice includes ____. → a) grammar + skills · b) only titles · c) no English
3. Reading helps you ____. → a) see forms in context · b) avoid verbs · c) skip audio
4. Listening checks ____. → a) comprehension · b) only spelling of *-est* · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) was/were + -ing** · 2. **a) grammar + skills** · 3. **a) see forms in context** · 4. **a) comprehension** · 5. **a) your own sentences**

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa con ideas de la unidad

6. Key form of this unit: ____.
7. A common signal word from the texts: ____.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

6–10. Dependen de la unidad: revisa la guía teórica y el reading; respuestas abiertas aceptables si usan el foco correctamente.

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

## Lección 3 — Reading

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/reading-continuous.mp3" title="🔊 Reading Unidad 16"></audio>

> Last Saturday night at 8pm I was watching TV in my living room. My sister was studying in her room. My parents were cooking dinner in the kitchen. Suddenly the doorbell rang. It was our neighbour Mr Brown. He was walking his dog when he saw our lights on. He wanted to ask if we had seen his cat. We were all surprised but we helped him look. At that moment the cat was sleeping under the sofa!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When was the story? → a) Saturday night at 8pm · b) Last year · c) Tomorrow
2. What was the speaker doing? → a) Watching TV · b) Cooking only · c) Running
3. What were parents doing? → a) Cooking dinner · b) Sleeping · c) Flying
4. Who rang the doorbell? → a) Mr Brown · b) Lisa · c) Tom
5. Where was the cat? → a) Under the sofa · b) In the park · c) In London

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Saturday night at 8pm** · 2. **a) Watching TV** · 3. **a) Cooking dinner** · 4. **a) Mr Brown** · 5. **a) Under the sofa**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

7. You can find the target forms: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only images
8. Sequence/time words appear as needed: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only future
9. Main idea is clear from the first lines: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) impossible
10. Re-read after checking answers: ____. → a) good idea · b) useless · c) forbidden

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) yes** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) yes** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) good idea**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Mark 3 target forms in the text: ____. → a) do it · b) skip · c) delete the text

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 2 del curso A2** (*Past Simple: Regular Verbs*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Past Simple regulares A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-2-past-simple-verbos-regulares)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 2 — Past Simple: verbos regulares](/curso-a2/unit-2)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Past Simple -ed](/blog/curso-a2/unit-2/a2-unit2-past-simple-ed.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: Past Simple regular](#leccion-1--gramatica-past-simple-regular)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: tiempo y acciones](#leccion-2--vocabulario-tiempo-y-acciones)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: A busy week](#leccion-3--reading-a-busy-week)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: What I did yesterday](#leccion-4--listening-what-i-did-yesterday)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My yesterday](#leccion-5--writing-my-yesterday)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: Past Simple regular

**Objetivo:** *-ed*, misma forma para todas las personas; *didn't / Did* + base.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ to the park yesterday. → *walked / walk / walking*  
2. She ____ her grandmother last week. → *visited / visit / visits*  
3. We ____ football yesterday. → *played / play / playing*  
4. He ____ his homework two hours ago. → *finished / finish / finishes*  
5. They ____ a film last night. → *watched / watch / watching*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **walked**  
2. **visited**  
3. **played**  
4. **finished**  
5. **watched**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Past of *clean* = ____. → a) cleaned · b) cleant · c) cleaning  
7. *I walk yesterday* is ____. → a) wrong · b) correct · c) future  
8. After *didn't* we use ____. → a) base verb · b) *-ed* · c) *-ing* only  
9. *Did you ____?* → a) play · b) played · c) playing  
10. Same form for *I/she/they* = ____. → a) yes for regular past · b) no · c) only with *will*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) cleaned**  
7. **a) wrong**  
8. **a) base verb**  
9. **a) play**  
10. **a) yes for regular past**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I walk yesterday.*  
12. *She didn't visited her friend.*  
13. *Did you played football?*  
14. *He finish his project last week.*  
15. *We watch a film two hours ago.* (pasado)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **walked** yesterday.  
12. She didn't **visit** her friend.  
13. Did you **play** football?  
14. He **finished** his project last week.  
15. We **watched** a film two hours ago.

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: tiempo y acciones

**Objetivo:** *yesterday, last week, ago* + verbos regulares frecuentes.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja

1. yesterday  
2. last week  
3. two hours ago  
4. last night  
5. on Monday  

a) la semana pasada · b) ayer · c) hace dos horas · d) anoche · e) el lunes (pasado en contexto)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **e**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. walk → ____  
7. visit → ____  
8. play → ____  
9. finish → ____  
10. clean → ____  

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **walked** · 7. **visited** · 8. **played** · 9. **finished** · 10. **cleaned**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *Ago* goes ____ the time period. → a) after · b) before · c) never  
12. *Last* + ____. → a) night / week / weekend · b) ago · c) only *to be*  
13. *Talked* is past of ____. → a) talk · b) tell · c) speak  
14. *Rested* means ____. → a) relaxed / didn't work hard · b) ran · c) bought  
15. *Cooked dinner* = ____. → a) prepared dinner · b) watched TV · c) walked

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) after**  
12. **a) night / week / weekend**  
13. **a) talk**  
14. **a) relaxed / didn't work hard**  
15. **a) prepared dinner**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: A busy week

**Objetivo:** leer un relato con varios verbos regulares.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-2/reading-past.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A busy week"></audio>

> Last week I had a busy week. On Monday I walked to work because my car was broken. On Tuesday I visited my grandmother in the hospital. She was happy to see me. On Wednesday I played football with my friends. We won the match! On Thursday I finished my project at work. My boss was very happy. Yesterday I rested at home and watched a film.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Why did the person walk to work on Monday? → a) The car was broken · b) It was raining · c) No reason  
2. Who did they visit on Tuesday? → a) Grandmother · b) Boss · c) Teacher  
3. What did they do on Wednesday? → a) Played football · b) Cleaned · c) Cooked only  
4. What happened on Thursday? → a) Finished a project · b) Went to London · c) Bought a car  
5. What did they do yesterday? → a) Rested and watched a film · b) Worked all day · c) Nothing

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The car was broken**  
2. **a) Grandmother**  
3. **a) Played football**  
4. **a) Finished a project**  
5. **a) Rested and watched a film**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Regular past verbs in the text include ____. → a) walked, visited, played, finished, rested, watched · b) only went · c) only am  
7. *Last week* marks ____. → a) past time · b) future · c) present habit only  
8. The boss was happy because ____. → a) the project was finished · b) football · c) the car  
9. *Won the match* is ____. → a) irregular (preview) · b) regular *-ed* · c) present  
10. The main topic is ____. → a) a busy week in the past · b) introductions · c) health advice

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) walked, visited, played, finished, rested, watched**  
7. **a) past time**  
8. **a) the project was finished**  
9. **a) irregular (preview)**  
10. **a) a busy week in the past**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Walked* = ____ + *-ed*. → a) walk · b) went · c) go  
12. *Visited* is ____. → a) regular past · b) present · c) future  
13. *Yesterday* pairs with ____. → a) past verbs · b) *will* · c) *going to* only  
14. Same form: *I finished / She finished* = ____. → a) correct · b) wrong · c) needs *-s*  
15. *Rested* means past of ____. → a) rest · b) run · c) read

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) walk**  
12. **a) regular past**  
13. **a) past verbs**  
14. **a) correct**  
15. **a) rest**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: What I did yesterday

**Objetivo:** escuchar un relato del día anterior.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-2/listening-past.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: What I did yesterday"></audio>

> Hi! I want to tell you about what I did yesterday. In the morning I walked to the shop and picked up some bread. Then I visited my friend Sarah. We played cards and talked for two hours. In the afternoon I cleaned my room and finished my homework. Last night I watched a film on TV. It was very good!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When is the story about? → a) Yesterday · b) Next week · c) Every day  
2. Where did they walk in the morning? → a) To the shop · b) To school · c) To London  
3. Who did they visit? → a) Sarah · b) The boss · c) Maria  
4. What did they do with Sarah? → a) Played cards and talked · b) Cooked pasta · c) Bought a car  
5. What did they watch last night? → a) A film · b) Football live · c) Nothing

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Yesterday**  
2. **a) To the shop**  
3. **a) Sarah**  
4. **a) Played cards and talked**  
5. **a) A film**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. In the afternoon they ____. → a) cleaned and finished homework · b) only slept · c) flew  
7. *Picked up* here means ____. → a) got / collected · b) played · c) rested  
8. They talked for ____. → a) two hours · b) two days · c) two minutes only  
9. The film was ____. → a) very good · b) terrible · c) not mentioned  
10. The listening practices ____. → a) regular past verbs · b) only *to be* · c) conditionals

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) cleaned and finished homework**  
7. **a) got / collected**  
8. **a) two hours**  
9. **a) very good**  
10. **a) regular past verbs**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Walked / visited / played / cleaned / finished / watched* are ____. → a) regular past · b) present · c) future  
12. *Last night* = ____. → a) past time · b) future · c) never  
13. After *Did* we would use ____. → a) base verb · b) *-ed* · c) *to* + verb  
14. *Talked* is past of ____. → a) talk · b) tell · c) speak  
15. Order of the day: ____. → a) morning → afternoon → last night · b) night first · c) no order

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) regular past**  
12. **a) past time**  
13. **a) base verb**  
14. **a) talk**  
15. **a) morning → afternoon → last night**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My yesterday

**Objetivo:** escribir un día pasado con verbos regulares.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Yesterday I ____ to the park. → *walked / walk / will walk*  
2. Last week I ____ my friend. → *visited / visit / visiting*  
3. Two hours ago I ____ my homework. → *finished / finish / finishes*  
4. Last night we ____ a film. → *watched / watch / watching*  
5. I ____ my room yesterday. → *cleaned / clean / cleaning*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **walked** · 2. **visited** · 3. **finished** · 4. **watched** · 5. **cleaned**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / walked / to work / yesterday.  
7. She / visited / her grandmother / last week.  
8. We / played / football / on Wednesday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I walked to work yesterday.  
7. She visited her grandmother last week.  
8. We played football on Wednesday.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Ayer caminé a la tienda.  
10. La semana pasada visité a un amigo.  
11. Hace dos horas terminé los deberes.  
12. Anoche vi una película (*watched*).  
13. Negativa: no jugué al fútbol ayer.  
14. Pregunta: ¿Limpiaste tu habitación?  
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) sobre ayer con *yesterday / last / ago*.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. Yesterday I walked to the shop.  
10. Last week I visited a friend.  
11. I finished my homework two hours ago.  
12. Last night I watched a film.  
13. I didn't play football yesterday.  
14. Did you clean your room?  
15. Yesterday I walked to the shop. Then I visited my friend. We talked for two hours. In the afternoon I cleaned my room. Last night I watched a film. It was good!

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Afirmativa** | I **walked** yesterday. |
| **Negativa** | I **didn't walk**. |
| **Pregunta** | **Did** you **walk**? |
| **Tiempo** | yesterday · last week · ago |

---

Continúa con la [**Unidad 3 — Past Simple: verbos irregulares**](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-3-past-simple-verbos-irregulares): *went, saw, had, made, wrote, bought*.

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 20 del curso A2** (*Module 2 Review*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Repaso Módulo 2 A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-20-repaso-modulo-2)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 20 — Module 2 Review](/curso-a2/unit-20)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Module 2 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unit-20/a2-unit20-module2-review.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** Present Perfect + Past Continuous + How questions (Module 2 mix).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I have lived here ____ three years. → *for / since / ago*
2. I have worked here ____ 2021. → *since / for / on*
3. I ____ walking when I met a friend. → *was / were / have*
4. How ____ do you exercise? → *often / much / many*
5. I haven't found a job ____. → *yet / already / ago*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **for** · 2. **since** · 3. **was** · 4. **often** · 5. **yet**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Module 2 includes ____. → a) Present Perfect and Past Continuous · b) only *to be* · c) only A1 colours
7. *already/yet* with ____. → a) Present Perfect · b) only Past Continuous · c) *will*
8. *when* often mixes ____. → a) Past Continuous + Past Simple · b) only Future · c) only *the most*
9. *How many* needs ____. → a) countable · b) only uncountable · c) only *-ing*
10. Correct mix: ____. → a) I have lived here for 3 years; I was walking when I met her · b) I live here since 3 years yesterday watching · c) I am lived when

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present Perfect and Past Continuous** · 7. **a) Present Perfect** · 8. **a) Past Continuous + Past Simple** · 9. **a) countable** · 10. **a) I have lived here for 3 years; I was walking when I met her**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I have lived here since three years.*
12. *I was walk when I met him.*
13. *How often you exercise?*
14. *I have already not found a job yet.*
15. *Yesterday I have cooked when she called.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I have lived here **for** three years.  
12. I was **walking** when I met him.  
13. How often **do** you exercise?  
14. I haven't found a job **yet**. / I have **already**…  
15. Yesterday I **was cooking** when she **called**.  

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** palabras y patrones de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige

1. The unit focus is ____. → a) Present Perfect + Past Continuous + How questions (Module 2 mix) · b) only colours · c) only A1 *to be*
2. Practice includes ____. → a) grammar + skills · b) only titles · c) no English
3. Reading helps you ____. → a) see forms in context · b) avoid verbs · c) skip audio
4. Listening checks ____. → a) comprehension · b) only spelling of *-est* · c) only Module 6
5. Writing produces ____. → a) your own sentences · b) nothing · c) only copy images

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Present Perfect + Past Continuous + How questions (Module 2 mix)** · 2. **a) grammar + skills** · 3. **a) see forms in context** · 4. **a) comprehension** · 5. **a) your own sentences**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa con ideas de la unidad

6. Key form of this unit: ____.
7. A common signal word from the texts: ____.
8. Affirmative example (your words): ____.
9. Negative or question example: ____.
10. One vocabulary item from the story: ____.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

6–10. Dependen de la unidad: revisa la guía teórica y el reading; respuestas abiertas aceptables si usan el foco correctamente.

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Forms must agree with the subject: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) never
12. Time markers help choose the tense: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. Shadowing the audio is useful: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) only for teachers
14. After mistakes, reopen «Ver solución»: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) never
15. Then retry in the course unit: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only offline forever

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) true** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) true** · 14. **a) yes** · 15. **a) yes**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-20/reading-review.mp3" title="🔊 Reading Unidad 20"></audio>

> My name is David. I have lived in Barcelona for three years. I have worked as a teacher since 2021. Last week I was walking in the park when I met an old friend. We were talking while we walked. How often do I exercise? I go to the gym three times a week. I have already finished my course this year but I haven't found a new job yet. I feel good because I have a stable life with good friends.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where has David lived? → a) Barcelona for three years · b) Valencia · c) London
2. Job since? → a) 2021 as a teacher · b) 2020 hospital · c) Never
3. Park story? → a) Was walking when he met a friend · b) Only slept · c) Flew
4. Exercise frequency? → a) Three times a week · b) Never · c) Once a year
5. New job? → a) Hasn't found one yet · b) Already found Japan · c) Never worked

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Barcelona for three years** · 2. **a) 2021 as a teacher** · 3. **a) Was walking when he met a friend** · 4. **a) Three times a week** · 5. **a) Hasn't found one yet**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text matches unit 20: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 1
7. You can find the target forms: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only images
8. Sequence/time words appear as needed: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only future
9. Main idea is clear from the first lines: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) impossible
10. Re-read after checking answers: ____. → a) good idea · b) useless · c) forbidden

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) yes** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) yes** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) good idea**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Mark 3 target forms in the text: ____. → a) do it · b) skip · c) delete the text
12. Change one sentence to negative/question: ____. → a) useful · b) wrong always · c) only B2
13. Note any Past Simple / Perfect / Continuous mix: ____. → a) notice it · b) ignore · c) ban English
14. Copy one model sentence aloud: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) never
15. Write a parallel sentence about you: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only tomorrow forever

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11–15. **a)** (práctica abierta; lo importante es usar el foco de la unidad)

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-20/listening-review.mp3" title="🔊 Listening Unidad 20"></audio>

> Hi! I am Maria. I have lived in Valencia for four years. I have worked at a hospital since 2020. Yesterday I was cooking dinner when my sister called. We were talking while I was finishing the food. How often do I exercise? I go swimming twice a week. I have already visited five countries this year but I haven't been to Japan yet. I feel happy because I have a good job and a wonderful family.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where has Maria lived? → a) Valencia for four years · b) Barcelona · c) Manchester
2. Work since? → a) 2020 at a hospital · b) 2021 teacher · c) Never
3. Yesterday? → a) Cooking when sister called · b) Only walked forever · c) Exam only
4. Exercise? → a) Swimming twice a week · b) Gym three times · c) Never
5. Japan? → a) Hasn't been yet · b) Lives there · c) Went yesterday only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Valencia for four years** · 2. **a) 2020 at a hospital** · 3. **a) Cooking when sister called** · 4. **a) Swimming twice a week** · 5. **a) Hasn't been yet**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Audio supports the same grammar focus: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only music
7. Speakers use natural A2 vocabulary: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Latin
8. You can answer without the script first: ____. → a) try it · b) never · c) impossible always
9. Then check with the script: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) delete audio
10. Repeat difficult sentences: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only teachers

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) yes** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) try it** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Transcribe one key sentence: ____. → a) useful · b) useless · c) banned
12. Underline the target grammar: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) never
13. Record yourself saying it: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only offline forever
14. Compare with the model: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) skip English
15. Add the sentence to your notebook: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11–15. **a) yes / useful** (práctica abierta)

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa (según el foco)

1. Write one affirmative sentence with the unit focus.
2. Write one negative sentence.
3. Write one question.
4. Add a time marker that fits.
5. Add one vocabulary word from the reading.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

Usa los modelos del reading/listening de esta unidad; cualquier frase correcta con el foco cuenta.

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena / reescribe

6. Reorder a model sentence from the reading.
7. Change person (*I* → *she/they*).
8. Change time (yesterday / for / since / how often…).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

Compara con el texto modelo; la concordancia sujeto–verbo debe ser correcta.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe

9–14. Six short sentences using the unit focus about your life.
15. Paragraph (6–8 sentences) mixing this unit with one idea from a previous unit.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplo guía)</summary>

15. Escribe un mini-relato como el reading: incluye el foco de la Unidad 20 y una forma de una unidad anterior del Módulo 2.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Foco | Unidad 20 |
| :--- | :--- |
| Gramática | Present Perfect + Past Continuous + How questions (Module 2 mix) |
| Siguiente | [Unidad 21 — Going to](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-21-going-to-planes-intenciones) |
