content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 21 del curso A2** (*Going to: Plans & Intentions*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Going to planes A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-21-going-to-planes-intenciones)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 21 — Going to: Plans & Intentions](/curso-a2/unit-21)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Going to: Plans & Intentions](/blog/curso-a2/unit-21/a2-unit21-going-to.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Emma's plans](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: David's plans](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** am/is/are + going to + infinitivo (planes e intenciones).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ going to travel next summer. → *am / is / are*
2. She ____ going to study engineering. → *is / am / are*
3. They ____ going to move next month. → *are / is / am*
4. We ____ not going to stay at home. → *are / is / am*
5. ____ you going to come? → *Are / Is / Am*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **is** · 3. **are** · 4. **are** · 5. **Are**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Form = ____. → a) am/is/are + going to + infinitive · b) will + -ing · c) have + PP
7. U21 focus is ____. → a) plans & intentions · b) only past habits · c) only zero conditional
8. After *going to* use ____. → a) infinitive (visit) · b) *-ing* only · c) past participle
9. *I going to travel* is ____. → a) wrong (need *am*) · b) correct · c) Past Perfect
10. Negatives use ____. → a) am/is/are + not + going to · b) don't going to · c) didn't going to

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) am/is/are + going to + infinitive** · 7. **a) plans & intentions** · 8. **a) infinitive (visit)** · 9. **a) wrong (need *am*)** · 10. **a) am/is/are + not + going to**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I going to travel to Japan.*
12. *She are going to study English.*
13. *They is going to move.*
14. *We going to to visit Paris.*
15. *Is you going to come?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **am** going to travel to Japan.
12. She **is** going to study English.
13. They **are** going to move.
14. We are going to visit Paris.
15. **Are** you going to come?

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** verbos de planes: travel, visit, study, move, apply, look for.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *travel* ≈ ____ → *go on a trip · stay forever · forget*
2. *move* (house) ≈ ____ → *change home · cook · sleep*
3. *look for a job* ≈ ____ → *try to find work · finish dinner · rain*
4. *apply for* ≈ ____ → *send a job application · buy milk · run*
5. *get married* ≈ ____ → *have a wedding · visit a museum · open a window*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **go on a trip** · 2. **change home** · 3. **try to find work** · 4. **send a job application** · 5. **have a wedding**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I am going to ____ Japan. → *visit / visiting / visited*
7. She is going to ____ engineering. → *study / studying / studied*
8. They are going to ____ next month. → *move / moving / moved*
9. He is going to ____ for a job. → *look / looking / looked*
10. We are going to ____ married. → *get / getting / got*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **visit** · 7. **study** · 8. **move** · 9. **look** · 10. **get**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Time markers for plans: ____. → a) next week / soon / this weekend · b) yesterday only · c) *ago* only
12. *I'm going to* shows ____. → a) a decided plan · b) only Past Simple · c) zero obligation
13. Short answer to *Are you going to come?* → ____. → a) Yes, I am / No, I'm not · b) Yes, I do · c) Yes, I have
14. *Going to visiting* is ____. → a) wrong · b) required · c) Past Perfect
15. Unit 21 is about ____. → a) plans & intentions · b) only weather evidence · c) only *will* promises

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) next week / soon / this weekend** · 12. **a) a decided plan** · 13. **a) Yes, I am / No, I'm not** · 14. **a) wrong** · 15. **a) plans & intentions**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Emma's plans

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-21/reading-plans.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Emma's plans"></audio>

> My name is Emma. I am going to travel to Japan next summer. I am going to visit Tokyo and Kyoto. My brother is going to study at university next year. He is going to study engineering. My parents are going to move to a small village next month. They are going to buy a house there. This weekend I am going to visit my grandmother. She is going to cook my favourite food. I love making plans and thinking about the future!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where is Emma going to travel? → a) Japan · b) Australia · c) Brazil
2. What cities will she visit? → a) Tokyo and Kyoto · b) London only · c) Paris and Rome
3. What is her brother going to study? → a) Engineering · b) Medicine · c) Art
4. Where are her parents going to move? → a) A small village · b) A big city · c) A hotel
5. Who is she going to visit this weekend? → a) Her grandmother · b) Her boss · c) David

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Japan** · 2. **a) Tokyo and Kyoto** · 3. **a) Engineering** · 4. **a) A small village** · 5. **a) Her grandmother**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) going to for plans · b) only Past Continuous · c) only *must*
7. Emma's parents are going to ____. → a) buy a house · b) finish school · c) rain
8. Time words like *next summer* appear: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only *ago*
9. After *going to* verbs are ____. → a) infinitives · b) past participles · c) adjectives only
10. Unit focus matches U21: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 1

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) going to for plans** · 7. **a) buy a house** · 8. **a) yes** · 9. **a) infinitives** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I am going to* needs ____. → a) *am* + going to + infinitive · b) *did* + going · c) *have* + -ing
12. *She is going to cook* is ____. → a) correct · b) wrong · c) Past Perfect
13. Questions invert ____. → a) Am/Is/Are + subject · b) Subject + Are always · c) Did + going to
14. Negatives: ____. → a) aren't / isn't / am not going to · b) don't going to · c) won't going
15. Reading + audio helps you ____. → a) notice form in context · b) skip grammar · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) *am* + going to + infinitive** · 12. **a) correct** · 13. **a) Am/Is/Are + subject** · 14. **a) aren't / isn't / am not going to** · 15. **a) notice form in context**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: David's plans

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-21/listening-plans.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: David's plans"></audio>

> Hi! My name is David. I am going to tell you about my plans for next year. I am going to finish university in June. After that I am going to look for a job. I am going to apply for jobs in London and Manchester. My girlfriend is going to travel to Australia in September. She is going to work there for six months. We are going to get married when she comes back. This weekend I am going to visit my parents. They are going to celebrate their anniversary. I am excited about all my plans!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When is David going to finish university? → a) In June · b) In December · c) Never
2. What is he going to do after that? → a) Look for a job · b) Retire · c) Stop studying forever
3. Where will he apply for jobs? → a) London and Manchester · b) Tokyo only · c) A village
4. Where is his girlfriend going to travel? → a) Australia · b) Japan · c) Spain
5. What are they going to do when she comes back? → a) Get married · b) Move alone · c) Cancel plans

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) In June** · 2. **a) Look for a job** · 3. **a) London and Manchester** · 4. **a) Australia** · 5. **a) Get married**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) going to plans in context · b) only spelling of *-est* · c) only *into*
7. His parents are going to ____. → a) celebrate their anniversary · b) rain · c) finish school
8. David sounds ____. → a) excited about his plans · b) angry · c) bored only
9. *Going to* appears many times: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only once
10. Unit 21 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) going to plans in context** · 7. **a) celebrate their anniversary** · 8. **a) excited about his plans** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. You can notice *am/is/are going to* + ____. → a) infinitive · b) only PP · c) *-est*
12. Plans often use markers like *next year*: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. Shadow the audio and ____. → a) repeat the forms · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. After listening, write 3 plan sentences: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) only for teachers
15. U21 is not mainly about ____. → a) evidence-based weather predictions · b) decided plans · c) *am/is/are going to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) infinitive** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) repeat the forms** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) evidence-based weather predictions**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ going to visit my family. → *am / is / are*
2. She is going to ____ English. → *study / studying / studied*
3. They ____ going to travel to Spain. → *are / is / am*
4. We are not going to ____ late. → *stay / staying / stayed*
5. ____ he going to buy a car? → *Is / Are / Am*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **study** · 3. **are** · 4. **stay** · 5. **Is**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / am / going / to / travel / next / summer.
7. Are / you / going / to / come?
8. She / is / going / to / look / for / a / job.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I am going to travel next summer.
7. Are you going to come?
8. She is going to look for a job.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Un plan de viaje con *I'm going to…*.
10. Un plan de estudios con *She is going to…*.
11. Una negativa con *aren't going to*.
12. Una pregunta con *Are you going to…?*
13. Un plan familiar (*My parents are going to…*).
14. Un plan de fin de semana (*This weekend I am going to…*).
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) sobre tus planes del próximo año.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I am going to travel to Japan next summer.
10. She is going to study engineering.
11. We aren't going to stay at home tonight.
12. Are you going to come to the party?
13. My parents are going to move next month.
14. This weekend I am going to visit my grandmother.
15. Next year I am going to finish university. I am going to look for a job. My sister is going to travel to Australia. We are going to celebrate together!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Afirmativa** | I **am going to** visit my family. |
| **Negativa** | We **aren't going to** stay at home. |
| **Pregunta** | **Are** you **going to** come? |
| **Uso U21** | planes e intenciones ya decididos |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 22 del curso A2** (*Going to: Predictions*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Going to predicciones A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-22-going-to-predicciones)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 22 — Going to: Predictions](/curso-a2/unit-22)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Going to: Predictions](/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/a2-unit22-predictions.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: A weather day](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Picnic plans](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** going to para predicciones con evidencia (*Look! It's going to…*).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Look at the clouds! It ____ going to rain. → *is / are / am*
2. I think they ____ going to win. → *are / is / am*
3. I'm sure she ____ going to pass. → *is / are / am*
4. That cup ____ going to fall! → *is / are / am*
5. ____ it going to be sunny? → *Is / Are / Am*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is** · 2. **are** · 3. **is** · 4. **is** · 5. **Is**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. U22 *going to* often needs ____. → a) evidence / clear signs · b) only Past Simple · c) only *must*
7. *Look!* often signals ____. → a) a prediction from evidence · b) a finished past · c) Present Perfect *yet*
8. *I think / I'm sure* + going to = ____. → a) opinion prediction · b) Past Continuous · c) obligation
9. Form stays ____. → a) am/is/are + going to + infinitive · b) will + -ing · c) have + PP
10. U21 plans vs U22 predictions: ____. → a) different uses, same form · b) different forms always · c) no link

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) evidence / clear signs** · 7. **a) a prediction from evidence** · 8. **a) opinion prediction** · 9. **a) am/is/are + going to + infinitive** · 10. **a) different uses, same form**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *Look! It going to rain.*
12. *I think they is going to win.*
13. *I'm sure she are going to pass.*
14. *That cup are going to fall.*
15. *Are it going to be sunny?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Look! It **is** going to rain.
12. I think they **are** going to win.
13. I'm sure she **is** going to pass.
14. That cup **is** going to fall.
15. **Is** it going to be sunny?

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** clima y evidencia: clouds, sunny, warm, forecast, pass, win.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *forecast* ≈ ____ → *weather prediction · a chair · a passport*
2. *clouds* ≈ ____ → *white/grey sky shapes · books · shoes*
3. *pass an exam* ≈ ____ → *succeed in a test · fail forever · cook*
4. *picnic* ≈ ____ → *meal outdoors · night class · airport*
5. *I'm sure* ≈ ____ → *I feel certain · I never know · yesterday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **weather prediction** · 2. **white/grey sky shapes** · 3. **succeed in a test** · 4. **meal outdoors** · 5. **I feel certain**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. It is going to ____. → *rain / raining / rained*
7. They are going to ____. → *win / winning / won*
8. She is going to ____ her exam. → *pass / passing / passed*
9. We are going to ____ a great day. → *have / having / had*
10. The film is going to ____ good. → *be / being / been*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **rain** · 7. **win** · 8. **pass** · 9. **have** · 10. **be**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Dark clouds often mean ____. → a) rain is likely · b) Past Perfect · c) *ago*
12. *I think* softens a ____. → a) prediction · b) Past Continuous · c) plural noun
13. Evidence predictions still use ____. → a) going to · b) only *did* · c) only *-est*
14. *Look at…!* is a useful ____. → a) signal · b) Past Simple marker · c) article error
15. Unit 22 is about ____. → a) predictions · b) only hotel bookings · c) only *could*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) rain is likely** · 12. **a) prediction** · 13. **a) going to** · 14. **a) signal** · 15. **a) predictions**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: A weather day

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/reading-predictions.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A weather day"></audio>

> Tomorrow the weather is going to be sunny. I think it is going to be warm and nice. I'm sure we are going to have a good day at the beach. Look at the clouds! I think it is going to rain in the afternoon. Maybe we should take an umbrella. I'm sure the match is going to be exciting tonight. My team is going to win!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Tomorrow the weather is going to be ____. → a) Sunny · b) Snowy forever · c) Dark only
2. Where might they have a good day? → a) At the beach · b) At school only · c) Underground
3. What might happen in the afternoon? → a) Rain · b) Snow forever · c) Nothing
4. What about the match tonight? → a) Going to be exciting · b) Cancelled · c) Already finished
5. What about the team? → a) Going to win · b) Going to lose for sure · c) Not mentioned

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sunny** · 2. **a) At the beach** · 3. **a) Rain** · 4. **a) Going to be exciting** · 5. **a) Going to win**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) going to predictions · b) only *for/since* · c) only comparatives
7. *Look at the clouds!* shows ____. → a) evidence · b) a finished past date · c) Present Perfect *yet*
8. *I think / I'm sure* appear: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only Unit 1
9. Form after *going to* is ____. → a) infinitive · b) PP only · c) adjective only
10. Matches unit 22: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) going to predictions** · 7. **a) evidence** · 8. **a) yes** · 9. **a) infinitive** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *It is going to rain* needs ____. → a) is + going to + infinitive · b) did + rain · c) have + raining
12. Opinion phrases + going to are ____. → a) natural · b) wrong · c) only B2
13. Questions: ____. → a) Is it going to…? · b) Did it going to…? · c) Have it going?
14. Evidence words help you ____. → a) choose going to · b) avoid English · c) use only *ago*
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) notice prediction language · b) skip form · c) ignore clouds

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) is + going to + infinitive** · 12. **a) natural** · 13. **a) Is it going to…?** · 14. **a) choose going to** · 15. **a) notice prediction language**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Picnic plans

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-22/listening-predictions.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Picnic plans"></audio>

> Hi! I just checked the weather forecast. I think it is going to be sunny tomorrow. I'm sure we are going to have a great day for our picnic. But look at those dark clouds over there. I think it is going to rain in the evening. Maybe we should go home early. I'm sure the film is going to be good tonight. My friend said it is excellent.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What does the speaker check? → a) Weather forecast · b) Train times only · c) Menu
2. Tomorrow is going to be ____. → a) Sunny · b) Stormy all day · c) Snowy
3. What activity? → a) Picnic · b) Exam · c) Flight
4. Dark clouds suggest ____. → a) Rain in the evening · b) Sun forever · c) No weather
5. What about the film tonight? → a) Going to be good · b) Cancelled · c) Already seen

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Weather forecast** · 2. **a) Sunny** · 3. **a) Picnic** · 4. **a) Rain in the evening** · 5. **a) Going to be good**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) prediction language · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. *I'm sure* appears: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only Past
8. Evidence cue: ____. → a) dark clouds · b) yesterday · c) *ago*
9. Speaker ends positively: ____. → a) everything is going to be fine · b) cancel · c) angry
10. Unit 22 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) prediction language** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) dark clouds** · 9. **a) everything is going to be fine** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Notice *is going to* + ____. → a) infinitive · b) only PP · c) *-est*
12. Forecast + opinion phrases fit U22: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. Shadow and ____. → a) repeat predictions · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 prediction sentences after listening: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U22 is not mainly about ____. → a) hotel diary appointments · b) evidence predictions · c) *going to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) infinitive** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) repeat predictions** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) hotel diary appointments**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Look! It ____ going to rain. → *is / are / am*
2. I think they are going to ____. → *win / winning / won*
3. I'm sure she ____ going to pass. → *is / are / am*
4. That cup is going to ____! → *fall / falling / fell*
5. ____ it going to be warm? → *Is / Are / Am*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is** · 2. **win** · 3. **is** · 4. **fall** · 5. **Is**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. It / is / going / to / rain.
7. I / think / they / are / going / to / win.
8. I'm / sure / she / is / going / to / pass.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. It is going to rain.
7. I think they are going to win.
8. I'm sure she is going to pass.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una predicción con evidencia (*Look!…*).
10. Una predicción con *I think…*.
11. Una predicción con *I'm sure…*.
12. Una predicción de clima.
13. Una predicción sobre un examen o partido.
14. Una pregunta (*Is it going to…?*).
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) con predicciones para mañana.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
10. I think they are going to win.
11. I'm sure she is going to pass her exam.
12. Tomorrow it is going to be sunny.
13. Our team is going to win tonight.
14. Is it going to be warm?
15. Tomorrow it is going to be sunny. I think we are going to have a great picnic. Look at those clouds — maybe it is going to rain later. I'm sure everything is going to be fine!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Evidencia** | Look at the clouds! It **is going to** rain. |
| **Opinión** | I think / I'm sure + **going to** |
| **Vs planes (U21)** | U22 = predicción · U21 = plan decidido |
| **Forma** | am/is/are + going to + infinitivo |

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** will/won't para predicciones, promesas y ofertas.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ help you. → *will / won't / am*
2. She ____ forget. → *won't / willn't / don't*
3. ____ you come to the party? → *Will / Do / Are*
4. The exam ____ be easy. → *will / going / is*
5. I promise I ____ call you. → *will / am / do*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **won't** · 3. **Will** · 4. **will** · 5. **will**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Form = ____. → a) will/won't + infinitive · b) am will · c) have + PP
7. Promises often use ____. → a) will · b) Past Continuous · c) *ago*
8. *Won't* means ____. → a) will not · b) want · c) went
9. Offers like *I'll help* use ____. → a) will · b) only *must* · c) Present Perfect
10. Questions invert ____. → a) Will + subject · b) Subject + Will always · c) Did + will

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) will/won't + infinitive** · 7. **a) will** · 8. **a) will not** · 9. **a) will** · 10. **a) Will + subject**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I will to help you.*
12. *She wills come tomorrow.*
13. *I won't to forget.*
14. *Will you to come?*
15. *He will helping us.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I will help you.
12. She **will** come tomorrow.
13. I won't forget.
14. Will you come?
15. He will **help** us.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** promise, offer, forget, help, party, probably.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *promise* ≈ ____ → *say you will definitely do it · cancel · sleep*
2. *offer* ≈ ____ → *say you can help · rain · forget forever*
3. *won't* = ____ → *will not · want · went*
4. *preparations* ≈ ____ → *things you do before an event · finished past only · adjectives*
5. *probably* ≈ ____ → *likely · never · yesterday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **say you will definitely do it** · 2. **say you can help** · 3. **will not** · 4. **things you do before an event** · 5. **likely**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I will ____ you. → *help / helping / helped*
7. I won't ____. → *forget / forgetting / forgot*
8. I will ____ the drinks. → *buy / buying / bought*
9. The party will ____ great. → *be / being / been*
10. Everyone will ____ fun. → *have / having / had*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **help** · 7. **forget** · 8. **buy** · 9. **be** · 10. **have**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *I promise* pairs well with ____. → a) will · b) Past Perfect · c) *ago*
12. Spontaneous offers often use ____. → a) will · b) only *going to* evidence · c) *was*
13. *Maybe I will…* softens a ____. → a) prediction / possibility · b) obligation · c) past habit
14. After *will* use ____. → a) infinitive · b) *-ing* required · c) PP required
15. Unit 23 focus: ____. → a) will/won't · b) only *for/since* · c) only phrasal verbs

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) will** · 12. **a) will** · 13. **a) prediction / possibility** · 14. **a) infinitive** · 15. **a) will/won't**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Letter to Maria

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/reading-will.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Letter to Maria"></audio>

> Dear Maria, I promise I will help you with your homework tomorrow. Don't worry! I will call you at 6 o'clock. I won't forget. Maybe I will bring some cookies too. I think the exam will be easy next week. I will study hard and I won't give up. I promise I will be there for you!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What does the writer promise? → a) Help with homework · b) Cancel the exam · c) Move house
2. When will they call? → a) At 6 o'clock · b) At midnight only · c) Never
3. What won't they do? → a) Forget · b) Study · c) Call
4. What might they bring? → a) Cookies · b) A car · c) Snow
5. What does the writer also promise? → a) To be there for Maria · b) To cancel · c) To move

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Help with homework** · 2. **a) At 6 o'clock** · 3. **a) Forget** · 4. **a) Cookies** · 5. **a) To be there for Maria**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) will/won't promises & predictions · b) only Past Continuous · c) only *into*
7. *I promise* appears: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only Unit 1
8. *Won't* is used for ____. → a) negative future · b) Past Simple · c) plural nouns
9. After *will* verbs are ____. → a) infinitives · b) PP only · c) adjectives only
10. Matches unit 23: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) will/won't promises & predictions** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) negative future** · 9. **a) infinitives** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I will help* needs ____. → a) will + infinitive · b) will + -ing · c) am will
12. *I won't forget* is ____. → a) correct · b) wrong · c) Past Perfect
13. Questions: ____. → a) Will you…? · b) Do you will…? · c) Are you will…?
14. Promises + *will* are ____. → a) natural · b) forbidden · c) only B2
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) notice will/won't in context · b) skip form · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) will + infinitive** · 12. **a) correct** · 13. **a) Will you…?** · 14. **a) natural** · 15. **a) notice will/won't in context**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Sarah's party

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-23/listening-will.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Sarah's party"></audio>

> Hi Sarah! Don't worry about the party tomorrow. I will help you with the preparations. I will buy the drinks and I won't be late. I promise! Maybe I will bring some music too. I think the party will be great. Everyone will have fun. I won't forget the balloons!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What event? → a) A party · b) An exam only · c) A flight
2. What will the speaker buy? → a) Drinks · b) Tickets only · c) A house
3. What won't they be? → a) Late · b) Happy · c) Ready
4. What else might they bring? → a) Music · b) Snow · c) A sofa
5. What won't they forget? → a) Balloons · b) Homework · c) Passports

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) A party** · 2. **a) Drinks** · 3. **a) Late** · 4. **a) Music** · 5. **a) Balloons**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) will/won't offers & promises · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. *I promise* appears: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only Past
8. Prediction: the party will be ____. → a) great · b) cancelled · c) silent
9. *Will* appears many times: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) once only
10. Unit 23 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) will/won't offers & promises** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) great** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Notice *will/won't* + ____. → a) infinitive · b) only PP · c) *-est*
12. Offers and promises fit U23: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. Shadow and ____. → a) repeat will/won't · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 promise sentences: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U23 is not mainly about ____. → a) Present Continuous diary plans · b) will promises · c) won't

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) infinitive** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) repeat will/won't** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) Present Continuous diary plans**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ help you tomorrow. → *will / am / do*
2. I ____ forget. → *won't / willn't / don't*
3. ____ you come? → *Will / Do / Are*
4. The party will ____ great. → *be / being / been*
5. Maybe I will ____ some music. → *bring / bringing / brought*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **will** · 2. **won't** · 3. **Will** · 4. **be** · 5. **bring**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / will / help / you.
7. I / won't / be / late.
8. Will / you / come / to / the / party?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I will help you.
7. I won't be late.
8. Will you come to the party?

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una promesa con *I will…*.
10. Una negativa con *I won't…*.
11. Una oferta espontánea (*I'll…*).
12. Una predicción general (*I think … will…*).
13. Una pregunta con *Will you…?*
14. Una frase con *probably will*.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) con promesas para un amigo.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. I will help you with your homework.
10. I won't forget.
11. I'll buy the drinks.
12. I think the party will be great.
13. Will you come tomorrow?
14. I will probably arrive late.
15. Don't worry! I will help you. I will call you at six. I won't be late. Maybe I will bring cookies too. I think everything will be fine!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Afirmativa** | I **will** help you. |
| **Negativa** | I **won't** forget. |
| **Usos** | promesas, ofertas, predicciones generales |
| **Vs going to** | *will* = decisión/promesa ahora · *going to* = plan/evidencia |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 24 del curso A2** (*Present Continuous for Future*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Present Continuous futuro A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-24-present-continuous-futuro)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 24 — Present Continuous for Future](/curso-a2/unit-24)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Present Continuous for Future](/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/a2-unit24-pc-future.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** Present Continuous para planes fijados / agenda (*I'm meeting…*).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ meeting John at 3. → *am / is / are*
2. She ____ flying to Paris tomorrow. → *is / am / are*
3. We ____ having dinner on Friday. → *are / is / am*
4. ____ you free on Saturday? → *Are / Is / Do*
5. He ____ playing tennis at 5. → *is / am / are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **is** · 3. **are** · 4. **Are** · 5. **is**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. U24 Present Continuous often means ____. → a) a fixed future arrangement · b) only past progress · c) Present Perfect
7. Diary language likes ____. → a) day + time · b) *ago* only · c) *for/since* only
8. Form = ____. → a) am/is/are + -ing · b) will + -ing · c) have + PP
9. *I meeting John tomorrow* is ____. → a) wrong (need *am*) · b) correct · c) Past Perfect
10. Appointments and flights often use ____. → a) Present Continuous · b) only zero conditional · c) *must have*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) a fixed future arrangement** · 7. **a) day + time** · 8. **a) am/is/are + -ing** · 9. **a) wrong (need *am*)** · 10. **a) Present Continuous**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *I meeting John at 3.*
12. *She are flying to Paris.*
13. *We is having dinner.*
14. *He am playing tennis.*
15. *Is you free on Saturday?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I **am** meeting John at 3.
12. She **is** flying to Paris.
13. We **are** having dinner.
14. He **is** playing tennis.
15. **Are** you free on Saturday?

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** agenda: meeting, appointment, conference, diary, free, arrive.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *appointment* ≈ ____ → *a booked time (doctor/dentist) · a random walk · rain*
2. *diary* ≈ ____ → *calendar of plans · a kitchen · a shoe*
3. *conference* ≈ ____ → *professional meeting/event · breakfast only · Past Simple*
4. *free* (time) ≈ ____ → *available · expensive · cloudy*
5. *confirm* ≈ ____ → *check/agree plans · cancel forever · forget*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a booked time (doctor/dentist)** · 2. **calendar of plans** · 3. **professional meeting/event** · 4. **available** · 5. **check/agree plans**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I am ____ John at 3. → *meeting / meet / met*
7. She is ____ to Barcelona. → *flying / fly / flew*
8. We are ____ dinner on Friday. → *having / have / had*
9. He is ____ tennis at 5. → *playing / play / played*
10. I am ____ lunch with my sister. → *having / have / had*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **meeting** · 7. **flying** · 8. **having** · 9. **playing** · 10. **having**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *On Monday / at 10* often signals ____. → a) fixed schedule · b) only Past Perfect · c) *ago*
12. Present Continuous future feels ____. → a) arranged · b) impossible · c) only weather evidence
13. Questions about availability: ____. → a) Are you free…? · b) Did you free…? · c) Have you free?
14. After *am/is/are* use ____. → a) *-ing* · b) infinitive required · c) PP required
15. Unit 24 focus: ____. → a) diary future · b) only *will* promises · c) only *for/since*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) fixed schedule** · 12. **a) arranged** · 13. **a) Are you free…?** · 14. **a) *-ing*** · 15. **a) diary future**

</details>

## Lección 3 — Reading: Tom's week

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/reading-diary.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Tom's week"></audio>

> My name is Tom. This week I am very busy. On Monday I am meeting John at 3 o'clock. On Tuesday I am having a dentist appointment at 10 in the morning. On Wednesday I am flying to Paris for a meeting. On Thursday I am having dinner with my parents. On Friday I am playing tennis with my friend at 5 pm. I love having a full diary!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who is Tom meeting on Monday? → a) John · b) Lisa · c) His dentist
2. What on Tuesday? → a) Dentist appointment · b) Tennis · c) Flight to London
3. Where is he flying on Wednesday? → a) Paris · b) Tokyo · c) Manchester
4. Who is dinner with on Thursday? → a) His parents · b) His boss · c) Strangers
5. What on Friday at 5? → a) Tennis · b) Exam · c) Moving house

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) John** · 2. **a) Dentist appointment** · 3. **a) Paris** · 4. **a) His parents** · 5. **a) Tennis**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) Present Continuous for fixed plans · b) only *will* · c) only *ago*
7. Days of the week organise ____. → a) his diary · b) Past Perfect · c) zero conditional
8. Times like *at 3 o'clock* appear: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only Unit 1
9. Verbs are in ____. → a) *-ing* · b) PP only · c) infinitive only
10. Matches unit 24: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present Continuous for fixed plans** · 7. **a) his diary** · 8. **a) yes** · 9. **a) *-ing*** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *I am meeting* needs ____. → a) am + -ing · b) will + -ing · c) have + meet
12. *On Wednesday I am flying* is ____. → a) natural for arrangements · b) wrong · c) Past Perfect
13. Questions invert ____. → a) Am/Is/Are + subject · b) Did + -ing · c) Have + are
14. Diary future is common with ____. → a) appointments/flights · b) only *must have* · c) *ago*
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) notice arranged future · b) skip form · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) am + -ing** · 12. **a) natural for arrangements** · 13. **a) Am/Is/Are + subject** · 14. **a) appointments/flights** · 15. **a) notice arranged future**

</details>

## Lección 4 — Listening: Call to Lisa

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-24/listening-diary.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Call to Lisa"></audio>

> Hi Lisa! I am calling to confirm our plans for next week. On Monday I am meeting my boss at 9 o'clock. On Wednesday I am flying to Barcelona for a conference. On Friday I am having lunch with my sister at 1 pm. Are you free on Saturday? I am going to the cinema and I would like you to come with me.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Who is calling? → a) Someone confirming plans with Lisa · b) A stranger · c) No one
2. Monday plan? → a) Meeting the boss at 9 · b) Tennis · c) Sleep all day
3. Wednesday plan? → a) Flying to Barcelona · b) Dentist · c) Cooking class
4. Friday plan? → a) Lunch with sister · b) Exam · c) Moving
5. Saturday idea? → a) Cinema (wants Lisa to come) · b) Cancel forever · c) No plans

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Someone confirming plans with Lisa** · 2. **a) Meeting the boss at 9** · 3. **a) Flying to Barcelona** · 4. **a) Lunch with sister** · 5. **a) Cinema (wants Lisa to come)**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) diary future language · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. *Are you free…?* appears: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) only Past
8. Conference destination: ____. → a) Barcelona · b) Tokyo · c) Village
9. Present Continuous forms appear: ____. → a) yes · b) never · c) once only
10. Unit 24 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) diary future language** · 7. **a) yes** · 8. **a) Barcelona** · 9. **a) yes** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Notice *am/is/are* + ____. → a) *-ing* · b) only PP · c) *-est*
12. Confirming plans fits U24: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. Shadow and ____. → a) repeat diary sentences · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 arranged plans: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U24 is not mainly about ____. → a) spontaneous *I'll help* offers · b) fixed arrangements · c) *-ing* future

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) *-ing*** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) repeat diary sentences** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) spontaneous *I'll help* offers**

</details>

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ meeting my boss at 9. → *am / is / are*
2. She is ____ to Barcelona. → *flying / fly / flew*
3. We ____ having dinner on Saturday. → *are / is / am*
4. ____ you free tomorrow? → *Are / Is / Do*
5. He is ____ tennis at 5. → *playing / play / played*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **flying** · 3. **are** · 4. **Are** · 5. **playing**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / am / meeting / John / at / 3.
7. She / is / flying / to / Paris / tomorrow.
8. Are / you / free / on / Saturday?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I am meeting John at 3.
7. She is flying to Paris tomorrow.

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

10. Un vuelo con *I'm flying…*.
11. Una comida con *We're having…*.
12. Una pregunta (*Are you free…?*).
13. Un plan con día y hora.
14. Un plan de deporte o ocio.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

12. Are you free on Saturday?

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Forma** | am/is/are + *-ing* |
| **Uso U24** | citas / planes fijados en la agenda |
| **Señales** | On Monday, at 3 o'clock, tomorrow morning… |
| **Vs going to** | PC = ya arreglado · going to = intención/plan |

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 25 del curso A2** (*Future: Going to vs Will vs Present Continuous*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Futuro contraste A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 25 — Future: Going to vs Will vs Present Continuous](/curso-a2/unit-25)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Future: Going to vs Will vs Present Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/a2-unit25-three-futures.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: London trip](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Anna's wedding](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** elegir entre going to, will y Present Continuous futuro.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Next week I ____ flying to London. (arreglado) → *am / will / going*
2. I ____ going to visit the museum. (ticket ready) → *am / will / do*
3. I ____ call you when I arrive. (promesa) → *will / am / going*
4. Look! It ____ going to rain. → *is / will / are*
5. Maybe I ____ see a show. → *will / am / are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **am** · 3. **will** · 4. **is** · 5. **will**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Fixed arrangement → ____. → a) Present Continuous · b) only Past Simple · c) *must have*
7. Decided plan / evidence → ____. → a) going to · b) only *ago* · c) Past Perfect
8. Promise / spontaneous decision → ____. → a) will · b) only *-ing* diary · c) *for/since*
9. *Maybe* often pairs with ____. → a) will · b) Past Continuous · c) *was*
10. Unit 25 trains ____. → a) choosing the right future · b) only irregular Past · c) only articles

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present Continuous** · 7. **a) going to** · 8. **a) will** · 9. **a) will** · 10. **a) choosing the right future**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *Next week I will flying to London.* (arreglado)
12. *I will going to visit the museum.* (ticket ready)
13. *I am call you tomorrow.* (promesa)
14. *Look! It will going to rain.*
15. *Maybe I am see a show.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Next week I **am flying** to London.
12. I **am going to** visit the museum.
13. I **will** call you tomorrow.
14. Look! It **is going to** rain.
15. Maybe I **will** see a show.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** arranged, invitation, ticket, ceremony, maybe, perfect.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *arranged* ≈ ____ → *already organised · never planned · yesterday only*
2. *invitation* ≈ ____ → *a request to come to an event · a shoe · rain*
3. *ceremony* ≈ ____ → *formal event (wedding) · breakfast only · Past Perfect*
4. *ticket* ≈ ____ → *pass to enter · cloud · adjective*
5. *maybe* ≈ ____ → *perhaps · definitely never · ago*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **already organised** · 2. **a request to come to an event** · 3. **formal event (wedding)** · 4. **pass to enter** · 5. **perhaps**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. I am ____ to London next week. → *flying / fly / flew*
7. I am going to ____ the museum. → *visit / visiting / visited*
8. I will ____ you tomorrow. → *call / calling / called*
9. It is going to ____. → *rain / raining / rained*
10. Maybe I will ____ a show. → *see / seeing / seen*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **flying** · 7. **visit** · 8. **call** · 9. **rain** · 10. **see**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Ticket already bought → often ____. → a) going to · b) only Past Continuous · c) *ago*
12. Wedding date fixed → often ____. → a) Present Continuous · b) only *must* · c) zero conditional
13. *I will send the invitation* is a ____. → a) promise/decision · b) Past Perfect · c) evidence cloud
14. Evidence rain → ____. → a) going to · b) only *did* · c) *-est*
15. Unit 25 mixes ____. → a) three futures · b) only one form · c) only A1 greetings

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) going to** · 12. **a) Present Continuous** · 13. **a) promise/decision** · 14. **a) going to** · 15. **a) three futures**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: London trip

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/reading-contrast.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: London trip"></audio>

> Next week I am flying to London — that is already arranged. When I arrive, I will call you and we will meet. I am going to visit the British Museum — I have already bought the ticket. Maybe I will see a show in the West End too. On Saturday I am having dinner with my cousin — we booked the restaurant last week. I think the trip will be great!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is already arranged? → a) Flying to London · b) Buying a house · c) Cancelling
2. What will happen on arrival? → a) Call and meet · b) Sleep forever · c) Move alone
3. Why visit the museum with going to? → a) Ticket already bought · b) No plan · c) Past habit
4. What on Saturday? → a) Dinner with cousin (booked) · b) Exam · c) Moving
5. Overall feeling about the trip? → a) Will be great · b) Cancelled · c) Angry

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Flying to London** · 2. **a) Call and meet** · 3. **a) Ticket already bought** · 4. **a) Dinner with cousin (booked)** · 5. **a) Will be great**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text contrasts ____. → a) PC / going to / will · b) only Past Simple · c) only articles
7. *Maybe* appears with ____. → a) will · b) Past Perfect · c) *ago*
8. Restaurant booking shows ____. → a) fixed arrangement · b) Past Perfect only · c) *ago* only
9. Arranged flight uses ____. → a) Present Continuous · b) only *won't* · c) *must have*
10. Matches unit 25: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) PC / going to / will** · 7. **a) will** · 8. **a) fixed arrangement** · 9. **a) Present Continuous** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Choose form by ____. → a) meaning (arranged/plan/promise) · b) random · c) word length
12. Mixing three futures in one story is ____. → a) natural · b) forbidden · c) only C2
13. *I will take an umbrella* can be ____. → a) a decision/response · b) Past Continuous · c) *ago*
14. *I am going to visit* shows ____. → a) intention/plan · b) only evidence rain · c) Past Perfect
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) practise choosing forms · b) skip meaning · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) meaning (arranged/plan/promise)** · 12. **a) natural** · 13. **a) a decision/response** · 14. **a) intention/plan** · 15. **a) practise choosing forms**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Anna's wedding

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/listening-contrast.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Anna's wedding"></audio>

> Hi Anna! I am calling about our plans. Next Saturday I am getting married — it is already arranged! I will send you the invitation tomorrow. I am going to wear a white dress — I have already chosen it. Maybe I will have a party the day after too. I think everything will be perfect!

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is arranged for Saturday? → a) Getting married · b) Flying alone · c) Cancelling
2. What will happen tomorrow? → a) Send the invitation · b) Move house · c) Rain forever
3. What about the dress? → a) Going to wear white (already chosen) · b) No dress · c) Past habit
4. What maybe the day after? → a) A party · b) An exam · c) Nothing
5. Final feeling? → a) Everything will be perfect · b) Angry · c) Cancelled

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Getting married** · 2. **a) Send the invitation** · 3. **a) Going to wear white (already chosen)** · 4. **a) A party** · 5. **a) Everything will be perfect**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) choosing futures in context · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. Arranged wedding uses ____. → a) Present Continuous · b) only *ago* · c) Past Perfect
8. Promise/decision: ____. → a) will send · b) was sending · c) have send
9. Plan with preparation: ____. → a) going to wear · b) only *must* · c) *for/since*
10. Unit 25 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) choosing futures in context** · 7. **a) Present Continuous** · 8. **a) will send** · 9. **a) going to wear** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Notice three patterns: ____. → a) PC / going to / will · b) only one form · c) *-est* only
12. *Maybe* + will softens possibility: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
13. Shadow and ____. → a) mark why each form is used · b) ignore meaning · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 sentences, one per future form: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U25 is mainly about ____. → a) contrast · b) only greetings · c) only irregular Past

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) PC / going to / will** · 12. **a) true** · 13. **a) mark why each form is used** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) contrast**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Next Saturday I ____ getting married. (arreglado) → *am / will / going*
2. I ____ send the invitation tomorrow. → *will / am / are*
3. I ____ going to wear a white dress. → *am / will / do*
4. Maybe I ____ have a big party. → *will / am / are*
5. Look! It ____ going to rain. → *is / will / are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **will** · 3. **am** · 4. **will** · 5. **is**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / am / flying / to / London / next / week.
7. I / will / call / you / when / I / arrive.
8. I / am / going / to / visit / the / museum.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I am flying to London next week.
7. I will call you when I arrive.
8. I am going to visit the museum.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Un plan fijado con Present Continuous.
10. Una intención con *going to*.
11. Una promesa con *will*.
12. Una predicción con evidencia (*going to*).
13. Una posibilidad con *Maybe I will…*.
14. Una frase contrastando dos formas en el mismo tema.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) mezclando las tres formas.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. Next week I am flying to London.
10. I am going to visit the British Museum.
11. I will call you when I arrive.
12. Look at the sky! It is going to rain.
13. Maybe I will see a show.
14. I am flying on Monday, and I am going to visit museums all week.
15. Next week I am flying to London. I am going to visit the museum — I have the ticket. I will call you when I arrive. Maybe I will see a show. Look! It is going to rain, so I will take an umbrella!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Present Continuous** | plan fijado / agenda (*I'm flying…*) |
| **Going to** | intención / evidencia (*I'm going to visit… / It's going to rain*) |
| **Will** | promesa, oferta, decisión ahora, predicción general |
| **Truco** | arreglado → PC · plan/evidencia → going to · promesa/espontáneo → will |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 26 del curso A2** (*First Conditional*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [First Conditional A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 26 — First Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-26)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/a2-unit26-first-conditional.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Tomorrow's plans](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: House rules](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo (condiciones reales futuras).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If it ____ (rain), I will stay at home. → *rains / will rain / rained*
2. If you study hard, you ____ (pass) the exam. → *will pass / pass / passed*
3. If she ____ (come) to visit, I will make coffee. → *comes / will come / come*
4. If the weather ____ (be) nice, I will go for a walk. → *is / will be / are*
5. If I ____ (not / pass), I will study harder. → *don't pass / won't pass / didn't pass*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **rains** · 2. **will pass** · 3. **comes** · 4. **is** · 5. **don't pass**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. After *If* use → ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will · c) Past Simple
7. Result clause uses → ____. → a) will + infinitive · b) Present only · c) going to always
8. *If it will rain* is → ____. → a) wrong · b) correct · c) Zero Conditional
9. First Conditional talks about → ____. → a) real future possibilities · b) always true facts · c) only past
10. Unit 26 trains → ____. → a) If + Present, will · b) only have to · c) only could

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present Simple** · 7. **a) will + infinitive** · 8. **a) wrong** · 9. **a) real future possibilities** · 10. **a) If + Present, will**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *If it will rain, I will stay at home.*
12. *If she come, I will be happy.*
13. *If you study hard, you pass the exam.* *(future possible)*
14. *I will stay at home, if it rains.* *(comma)*
15. *If we will miss the bus, we will be late.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. If it **rains**, I will stay at home.
12. If she **comes**, I will be happy.
13. If you study hard, you **will pass** the exam.
14. I will stay at home if it rains. *(sin coma)*
15. If we **miss** the bus, we will be late.

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** condition, consequence, rain, pass, celebrate, homework, help.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *condition* ≈ ____ → *if-part of a sentence · a shoe · rain only*
2. *consequence* ≈ ____ → *result · yesterday · a ticket*
3. *stay at home* ≈ ____ → *not go out · fly · cook dinner*
4. *pass an exam* ≈ ____ → *succeed in a test · forget · sleep*
5. *study harder* ≈ ____ → *work more for next time · cancel · rain*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **if-part of a sentence** · 2. **result** · 3. **not go out** · 4. **succeed in a test** · 5. **work more for next time**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. If it rains, I will ____ at home. → *stay / staying / stayed*
7. If I pass, I will ____ with my friends. → *celebrate / celebrating / celebrated*
8. If you finish early, I will let you ____ out. → *go / going / went*
9. If you need help, I will ____. → *come / coming / came*
10. If the bus is late, I will be ____. → *late / lately / later*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **stay** · 7. **celebrate** · 8. **go** · 9. **come** · 10. **late**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. *If* at the start often needs a ____. → a) comma · b) question mark only · c) *ago*
12. Negative condition: *If I don't pass…* uses ____. → a) don't + base verb · b) won't in if-clause · c) didn't always
13. *I will stay at home if it rains* has ____. → a) no comma before if · b) comma always · c) Past Perfect
14. First vs Zero: tomorrow's rain is ____. → a) First · b) Zero · c) Past Simple
15. Unit 26 is about ____. → a) If + Present, will · b) only *have to* · c) only *could*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) comma** · 12. **a) don't + base verb** · 13. **a) no comma before if** · 14. **a) First** · 15. **a) If + Present, will**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Tomorrow's plans

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/reading-first.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Tomorrow's plans"></audio>

> If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home. I will watch a film and relax. If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk in the park. If you come to visit me, I will make coffee for you. If I pass the exam, I will celebrate with my friends. If I don't pass, I will study harder next time.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. If it rains tomorrow, what will happen? → a) Stay at home · b) Go to the park · c) Celebrate
2. If the weather is nice, what will they do? → a) Go for a walk · b) Watch a film · c) Study harder
3. If you come to visit, what will they make? → a) Coffee · b) A present · c) Homework
4. If they pass the exam, what will they do? → a) Celebrate with friends · b) Stay at home · c) Be late
5. If they don't pass, what will they do? → a) Study harder next time · b) Go out tonight · c) Make coffee

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Stay at home** · 2. **a) Go for a walk** · 3. **a) Coffee** · 4. **a) Celebrate with friends** · 5. **a) Study harder next time**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) First Conditional · b) only Zero · c) only *have to*
7. *If it rains tomorrow* is ____. → a) a future possibility · b) a scientific fact · c) past ability
8. Result clauses use ____. → a) will · b) only Present · c) *ago*
9. A negative condition appears: ____. → a) If I don't pass · b) If I will pass · c) If I passed
10. Matches unit 26: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) First Conditional** · 7. **a) a future possibility** · 8. **a) will** · 9. **a) If I don't pass** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. After *If* use ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will · c) Past Continuous
12. *If I pass, I will celebrate* is ____. → a) correct First · b) Zero · c) wrong
13. Clause order can change: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) forbidden
14. *If you come… I will make coffee* shows ____. → a) condition + result · b) only obligation · c) past ability
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) notice If/will patterns · b) skip grammar · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Present Simple** · 12. **a) correct First** · 13. **a) true** · 14. **a) condition + result** · 15. **a) notice If/will patterns**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: House rules

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/listening-first.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: House rules"></audio>

> If you finish your homework early, I will let you go out tonight. If it rains on Saturday, we will stay at home and play games. If you pass the exam, I will buy you a present. If the bus is late, I will be late to work. If you need help, just call me and I will come.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Finish homework early → ____. → a) Go out tonight · b) Buy a present · c) Be late to work
2. Rain on Saturday → ____. → a) Stay home and play games · b) Go to work · c) Call for help
3. Pass the exam → ____. → a) Buy a present · b) Go out tonight · c) Miss the bus
4. Bus is late → ____. → a) Late to work · b) Play games · c) Make coffee
5. Need help → ____. → a) Call and they will come · b) Study harder · c) Stay at home

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Go out tonight** · 2. **a) Stay home and play games** · 3. **a) Buy a present** · 4. **a) Late to work** · 5. **a) Call and they will come**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) First Conditional in context · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. All sentences follow ____. → a) If + Present, will · b) If + will, will · c) Zero only
8. Homework rule is a ____. → a) condition for going out · b) scientific fact · c) past ability
9. *If you need help* offers ____. → a) support · b) a present · c) games only
10. Unit 26 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) First Conditional in context** · 7. **a) If + Present, will** · 8. **a) condition for going out** · 9. **a) support** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Notice *If* + ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will · c) *-ing* only
12. Results use *will* + ____. → a) infinitive · b) *-ing* · c) PP
13. Shadow and ____. → a) mark If vs will · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 First Conditional sentences: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U26 is mainly about ____. → a) If + Present, will · b) only greetings · c) only Zero

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Present Simple** · 12. **a) infinitive** · 13. **a) mark If vs will** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) If + Present, will**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If it ____ tomorrow, I will stay at home. → *rains / will rain / rained*
2. If you study hard, you ____ pass. → *will / are / did*
3. If she ____ to visit, I will make coffee. → *comes / will come / come*
4. If I don't pass, I ____ study harder. → *will / am / do*
5. If you need help, I ____ come. → *will / am / do*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **rains** · 2. **will** · 3. **comes** · 4. **will** · 5. **will**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. If / it / rains, / I / will / stay / at / home.
7. If / you / pass / the / exam, / I / will / buy / you / a / present.
8. I / will / make / coffee / if / you / come / to / visit / me.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. If it rains, I will stay at home.
7. If you pass the exam, I will buy you a present.
8. I will make coffee if you come to visit me.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Una condición con el tiempo (*If it rains…*).
10. Una condición de estudio (*If I pass…*).
11. Una negativa (*If I don't…*).
12. Resultado primero (*I will… if…*).
13. Un consejo (*If you need help…*).
14. Un plan del fin de semana con First Conditional.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) con varias condiciones futuras.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
10. If I pass the exam, I will celebrate with my friends.
11. If I don't pass, I will study harder next time.
12. I will make coffee for you if you come to visit me.
13. If you need help, just call me and I will come.
14. If it rains on Saturday, we will stay at home and play games.
15. If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home and watch a film. If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk. If I pass the exam, I will celebrate. If I don't pass, I will study harder next time!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Condición** | *If* + Present Simple |
| **Resultado** | *will* + infinitivo |
| **Uso** | posibilidad real en el futuro |
| **Truco** | nunca *will* después de *If* |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 27 del curso A2** (*Zero Conditional*) con **soluciones comentadas**.

> **Guía teórica:** [Zero Conditional A2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 27 — Zero Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-27)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Zero Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/a2-unit27-zero-conditional.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática](#leccion-1--gramatica)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario](#leccion-2--vocabulario)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: General truths](#leccion-3--reading)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Science and habits](#leccion-4--listening)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing](#leccion-5--writing)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática

**Objetivo:** If + Present Simple, Present Simple (hechos generales).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If you heat water, it ____ (boil). → *boils / will boil / boiled*
2. If you freeze water, it ____ (turn) into ice. → *turns / will turn / turned*
3. If you mix red and blue, you ____ (get) purple. → *get / will get / got*
4. If you don't eat enough, you ____ (feel) hungry. → *feel / will feel / felt*
5. If you exercise regularly, you ____ (stay) healthy. → *stay / will stay / stayed*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **boils** · 2. **turns** · 3. **get** · 4. **feel** · 5. **stay**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Zero Conditional uses ____. → a) Present + Present · b) If + will, will · c) Past + Past
7. *If you heat water, it will boil* for a general fact is ____. → a) wrong (use boils) · b) correct · c) First only
8. Zero talks about ____. → a) always true facts · b) tomorrow's plans only · c) past ability
9. After *If* in Zero still use ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will · c) *-ing* only
10. Unit 27 trains ____. → a) If + Present, Present · b) only *could* · c) only *have to*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present + Present** · 7. **a) wrong (use boils)** · 8. **a) always true facts** · 9. **a) Present Simple** · 10. **a) If + Present, Present**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Corrige

11. *If you heat water, it will boil.* *(general fact)*
12. *If you will freeze water, it turns into ice.*
13. *If you don't sleep well, you will feel tired.* *(general routine)*
14. *If people don't eat, they will get hungry.* *(always)*
15. *If it rains tomorrow, I stay at home.* *(future possible — wrong form)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. If you heat water, it **boils**.
12. If you **freeze** water, it turns into ice.
13. If you don't sleep well, you **feel** tired.
14. If people don't eat, they **get** hungry.
15. If it rains tomorrow, I **will stay** at home. *(First, not Zero)*

</details>


---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario

**Objetivo:** heat, freeze, boil, melt, mix, hungry, healthy, vocabulary.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Empareja / elige

1. *boil* ≈ ____ → *reach 100°C and bubble · freeze · sleep*
2. *melt* ≈ ____ → *turn from solid to liquid · boil · mix colours*
3. *freeze* ≈ ____ → *turn to ice · feel hungry · read*
4. *general truth* ≈ ____ → *always true fact · tomorrow's plan · polite request*
5. *regularly* ≈ ____ → *often / in a routine · never · yesterday*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **reach 100°C and bubble** · 2. **turn from solid to liquid** · 3. **turn to ice** · 4. **always true fact** · 5. **often / in a routine**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Completa

6. If you heat water, it ____. → *boils / will boil / boiled*
7. If you put ice in the sun, it ____. → *melts / will melt / melted*
8. If you don't water plants, they ____. → *die / will die / died*
9. If you read every day, your vocabulary ____. → *improves / will improve / improved*
10. If you drink water every day, you ____ better. → *feel / will feel / felt*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **boils** · 7. **melts** · 8. **die** · 9. **improves** · 10. **feel**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Elige

11. Science facts use ____. → a) Zero Conditional · b) only will · c) only *could*
12. *If you don't water plants, they die* is ____. → a) Zero · b) First · c) Past Simple
13. Zero vs First: tomorrow's rain → ____. → a) First · b) Zero · c) neither
14. Both clauses in Zero are ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will + inf · c) Past Perfect
15. Unit 27 is about ____. → a) general truths · b) only promises · c) only obligations

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Zero Conditional** · 12. **a) Zero** · 13. **a) First** · 14. **a) Present Simple** · 15. **a) general truths**

</details>


---

## Lección 3 — Reading: General truths

**Objetivo:** comprender un texto con el foco de la unidad.

### Texto y audio

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/reading-zero.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: General truths"></audio>

> If you heat water, it boils. If you freeze water, it turns into ice. If you mix red and blue, you get purple. If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry. If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy. If you don't sleep well, you feel tired the next day.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. If you heat water, what happens? → a) It boils · b) It freezes · c) It melts
2. If you freeze water, what happens? → a) Turns into ice · b) Boils · c) Gets purple
3. Mix red and blue → ____. → a) Purple · b) Yellow · c) Ice
4. Don't eat enough → ____. → a) Feel hungry · b) Stay healthy · c) Boil
5. Don't sleep well → ____. → a) Feel tired the next day · b) Get purple · c) Turn into ice

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) It boils** · 2. **a) Turns into ice** · 3. **a) Purple** · 4. **a) Feel hungry** · 5. **a) Feel tired the next day**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. The text practices ____. → a) Zero Conditional · b) only First · c) only *have to*
7. All results use ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will · c) *ago*
8. *Exercise regularly* leads to ____. → a) stay healthy · b) boil · c) melt
9. Negative conditions use ____. → a) don't · b) won't in if-clause · c) didn't always
10. Matches unit 27: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Module 6

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Zero Conditional** · 7. **a) Present Simple** · 8. **a) stay healthy** · 9. **a) don't** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Zero = If + Present, ____. → a) Present · b) will · c) Past
12. *If you heat water, it boils* is ____. → a) correct Zero · b) First · c) wrong
13. General facts avoid ____. → a) will in the result · b) Present Simple · c) *if*
14. Ask: is it always true? → ____. → a) Zero · b) First · c) neither
15. Reading helps you ____. → a) notice Present + Present · b) skip form · c) avoid English

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Present** · 12. **a) correct Zero** · 13. **a) will in the result** · 14. **a) Zero** · 15. **a) notice Present + Present**

</details>


---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Science and habits

**Objetivo:** escuchar el foco gramatical en contexto.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/listening-zero.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Science and habits"></audio>

> If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils. If you put ice in the sun, it melts. If you don't water plants, they die. If you eat too much sugar, you get tired. If you drink water every day, you feel better. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Water at 100 degrees → ____. → a) Boils · b) Melts · c) Dies
2. Ice in the sun → ____. → a) Melts · b) Boils · c) Freezes
3. Don't water plants → ____. → a) They die · b) They boil · c) Vocabulary improves
4. Too much sugar → ____. → a) Get tired · b) Feel better · c) Boil
5. Read every day → ____. → a) Vocabulary improves · b) Plants die · c) Ice melts

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Boils** · 2. **a) Melts** · 3. **a) They die** · 4. **a) Get tired** · 5. **a) Vocabulary improves**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Listening checks ____. → a) Zero facts & habits · b) only spelling · c) only *into*
7. No *will* in Zero results: ____. → a) true · b) false · c) irrelevant
8. *100 degrees* appears with ____. → a) boiling water · b) melting ice · c) dying plants
9. Health habits are ____. → a) general truths · b) future promises · c) past ability
10. Unit 27 practice: ____. → a) yes · b) no · c) only Unit 60

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Zero facts & habits** · 7. **a) true** · 8. **a) boiling water** · 9. **a) general truths** · 10. **a) yes**

</details>


### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Notice both clauses in ____. → a) Present Simple · b) will · c) Past
12. *If you read every day…* is ____. → a) Zero · b) First · c) wrong
13. Shadow and ____. → a) repeat Present + Present · b) ignore verbs · c) translate titles only
14. Write 3 general facts: ____. → a) good practice · b) useless · c) teachers only
15. U27 is not mainly about ____. → a) future will promises · b) science facts · c) routines

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Present Simple** · 12. **a) Zero** · 13. **a) repeat Present + Present** · 14. **a) good practice** · 15. **a) future will promises**

</details>


---

## Lección 5 — Writing

**Objetivo:** producir frases con el foco de la unidad.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. If you heat water, it ____. → *boils / will boil / boiled*
2. If you put ice in the sun, it ____. → *melts / will melt / melted*
3. If you don't water plants, they ____. → *die / will die / died*
4. If you exercise regularly, you ____ healthy. → *stay / will stay / stayed*
5. If you read every day, your vocabulary ____. → *improves / will improve / improved*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **boils** · 2. **melts** · 3. **die** · 4. **stay** · 5. **improves**

</details>


### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. If / you / heat / water, / it / boils.
7. If / you / don't / eat / enough, / you / feel / hungry.
8. Water / boils / if / you / heat / it.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. If you heat water, it boils.
7. If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry.
8. Water boils if you heat it.

</details>


### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Un hecho científico con Zero Conditional.
10. Un hábito de salud (*If you exercise…*).
11. Una negativa (*If you don't…*).
12. Reordenar: resultado primero (*Water boils if…*).
13. Un hecho sobre estudio o lectura.
14. Contrasta una frase Zero y una First.
15. Párrafo (6–8 frases) con verdades generales.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. If you heat water, it boils.
10. If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy.
11. If you don't sleep well, you feel tired the next day.
12. Water boils if you heat it.
13. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves.
14. Zero: If you heat water, it boils. First: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.
15. If you heat water, it boils. If you freeze water, it turns into ice. If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry. If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves!

</details>


---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Condición** | *If* + Present Simple |
| **Resultado** | Present Simple (sin *will*) |
| **Uso** | hechos generales / ciencia / rutinas |
| **vs First** | ¿siempre verdadero? → Zero |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

Continúa con la [**Unidad 28 — Have to / Don't have to**](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to).
