content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 42 del curso A1** (*Transport*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Transport A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 42 — Transport](/curso-a1/unit-42)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![By + transport](/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/a1-unit42-by-transport.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: by / take the](#leccion-1--gramatica-by--take-the)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: transporte](#leccion-2--vocabulario-transporte)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: How we travel](#leccion-3--reading-how-we-travel)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Commute](#leccion-4--listening-commute)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My transport](#leccion-5--writing-my-transport)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: by / take the

**Objetivo:** *by + transporte* (sin artículo) y *take the + transporte*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I go to work ____ bus. → *by / the / a*  
2. We travel ____ plane. → *by / the / an*  
3. I ____ the bus every day. → *take / takes / taking*  
4. She goes ____ car. → *by / the / a*  
5. He ____ the train to London. → *takes / take / taking*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by** — *by bus* (sin *the*).  
2. **by**  
3. **take**  
4. **by**  
5. **takes**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Go by bus* means ____. → a) using the bus to travel · b) buying a bus · c) walking only  
7. *Take the bus* means ____. → a) using the bus as a passenger · b) driving a plane · c) never travel  
8. After *by* we use ____. → a) transport without an article (by car, by train) · b) the always · c) a always  
9. Correct: ____. → a) I go by train. · b) I go by the train. · c) I go train by.  
10. With *take* we usually ____. → a) use “the” before bus or train · b) never use the · c) use -ing only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) using the bus to travel**  
7. **a) using the bus as a passenger**  
8. **a) transport without an article (by car, by train)**  
9. **a) I go by train.**  
10. **a) use “the” before bus or train**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. I / go / to work / by / bus.  
12. She / takes / the / train / every Monday.  
13. We / travel / by / plane / to Spain.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I go to work by bus.  
12. She takes the train every Monday.  
13. We travel by plane to Spain.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. We say *by bus* (not *by the bus*). → True / False  
15. We say *take the train* (with *the*). → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: transporte

**Objetivo:** *bus, train, plane, taxi, bicycle*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Bus* = ____. → a) a large road vehicle that carries many people · b) a plane · c) a bike  
2. *Train* = ____. → a) a long vehicle that travels on rails · b) a taxi · c) a bicycle  
3. *Plane* = ____. → a) a vehicle that flies in the air · b) a bus · c) a train  
4. *Taxi* = ____. → a) a car you pay to take you somewhere · b) a free bike · c) a train  
5. *Bicycle* = ____. → a) a two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal · b) a plane · c) a bus

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a large road vehicle that carries many people**  
2. **a) a long vehicle that travels on rails**  
3. **a) a vehicle that flies in the air**  
4. **a) a car you pay to take you somewhere**  
5. **a) a two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: bus / train / plane / taxi / bicycle → many passengers on the road · on rails · flies · you pay the driver · two wheels and pedals  
7. Empareja: by bus / by train / by plane / by taxi / by bicycle → take the bus · take the train · fly · pay for a car ride · cycle

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **bus → many passengers on the road** · **train → on rails** · **plane → flies** · **taxi → you pay the driver** · **bicycle → two wheels and pedals**  
7. **by bus → take the bus** · **by train → take the train** · **by plane → fly** · **by taxi → pay for a car ride** · **by bicycle → cycle**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–10 — Completa

8. I go ____ bicycle. → *by / the / a*  
9. She takes ____ train. → *the / a / —*  
10. We travel by ____. → *plane / planesing / the*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **by**  
9. **the**  
10. **plane**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Definiciones

11. Which vehicle flies? → a) Plane. · b) Bus. · c) Bicycle.  
12. Which has two wheels and pedals? → a) Bicycle. · b) Train. · c) Plane.  
13. Which do you pay a driver for? → a) A taxi. · b) A bicycle. · c) Walking.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Plane.**  
12. **a) Bicycle.**  
13. **a) A taxi.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *By car* and *by taxi* do not need *the*. → True / False  
15. *Take the bus* uses *the*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: How we travel

**Objetivo:** leer cómo viaja una familia.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/reading-transport.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: How we travel"></audio>

> I go to work by bus every day. My sister takes the train to London. We sometimes travel by plane for holidays. Last week I went to the airport by taxi. My brother goes to school by bicycle. He likes it because it is fast and cheap.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. How does the writer go to work? → a) By bus. · b) By plane. · c) By train.  
2. What does the sister take? → a) The train. · b) The bus. · c) The taxi.  
3. When do they travel by plane? → a) For holidays. · b) Every day. · c) Never.  
4. How did the writer go to the airport last week? → a) By taxi. · b) By bicycle. · c) By bus.  
5. How does the brother go to school? → a) By bicycle. · b) By plane. · c) By train.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) By bus.**  
2. **a) The train.**  
3. **a) For holidays.**  
4. **a) By taxi.**  
5. **a) By bicycle.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. Why does the brother like the bicycle? → a) Because it is fast and cheap. · b) Because it is slow. · c) The text doesn't say.  
7. *Go by bus* means ____. → a) Using the bus. · b) Buying a bus. · c) Flying.  
8. *Take the train* means ____. → a) Using the train. · b) Driving a plane. · c) Walking.  
9. A plane ____. → a) flies in the air · b) travels only on rails · c) has pedals  
10. A taxi is ____. → a) a car you pay for · b) a free bike · c) a train

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Because it is fast and cheap.**  
7. **a) Using the bus.**  
8. **a) Using the train.**  
9. **a) flies in the air**  
10. **a) a car you pay for**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) Different types of transport. · b) Only food. · c) Only sports.  
12. A bicycle is ____. → a) A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal. · b) A plane. · c) A train.  
13. A bus is ____. → a) A road vehicle that carries many people. · b) A plane. · c) A bike.  
14. A train is ____. → a) A vehicle that travels on rails. · b) A taxi. · c) A bicycle.  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) How people travel. · b) Cooking. · c) Music.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Different types of transport.**  
12. **a) A vehicle with two wheels that you pedal.**  
13. **a) A road vehicle that carries many people.**  
14. **a) A vehicle that travels on rails.**  
15. **a) How people travel.**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Commute

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre transporte diario.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/listening-commute.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Commute"></audio>

> **A:** How do you go to work?  
> **B:** I take the bus.  
> **A:** I go by car. What about your sister?  
> **B:** She travels by train to London.  
> **A:** Do you ever go by plane?  
> **B:** Yes, for holidays. Last time I went to the airport by taxi.  
> **A:** My son goes to school by bicycle.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. How does B go to work? → a) By bus; B takes the bus. · b) By plane. · c) By bicycle.  
2. How does A go to work? → a) By car. · b) By train. · c) By bus.  
3. How does B's sister travel? → a) By train. · b) By bus. · c) By taxi.  
4. When does B go by plane? → a) For holidays. · b) Every day. · c) Never.  
5. How did B go to the airport last time? → a) By taxi. · b) By bicycle. · c) By train.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) By bus; B takes the bus.**  
2. **a) By car.**  
3. **a) By train.**  
4. **a) For holidays.**  
5. **a) By taxi.**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. How does A's son go to school? → a) By bicycle. · b) By plane. · c) By taxi.  
7. *Take the bus* means ____. → a) Use the bus. · b) Buy a bus. · c) Fly.  
8. *Travel by train* means ____. → a) Use the train. · b) Drive a plane. · c) Walk.  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) How people travel. · b) Food. · c) Sports.  
10. A plane ____. → a) flies · b) only pedals · c) only rails

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) By bicycle.**  
7. **a) Use the bus.**  
8. **a) Use the train.**  
9. **a) How people travel.**  
10. **a) flies**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. A taxi is ____. → a) A car you pay for. · b) A free bike. · c) A train.  
12. A bicycle is ____. → a) A two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal. · b) A plane. · c) A bus.  
13. Who travels by train to London? → a) B’s sister. · b) A’s son. · c) Nobody.  
14. A bus is ____. → a) A road vehicle that carries many people. · b) A plane. · c) A bike.  
15. The topic is ____. → a) Transport. · b) Cooking. · c) Music.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) A car you pay for.**  
12. **a) A two-wheeled vehicle that you pedal.**  
13. **a) B’s sister.**  
14. **a) A road vehicle that carries many people.**  
15. **a) Transport.**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My transport

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre cómo viajas.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I go to work ____ bus. → *by / the / a*  
2. She ____ the train every Monday. → *takes / take / taking*  
3. We travel by ____. → *plane / the / a*  
4. He goes ____ bicycle. → *by / the / an*  
5. I take ____ bus every day. → *the / a / —*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by**  
2. **takes**  
3. **plane**  
4. **by**  
5. **the**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / go / to work / by / bus.  
7. She / takes / the / train / every Monday.  
8. We / travel / by / plane / for holidays.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I go to work by bus.  
7. She takes the train every Monday.  
8. We travel by plane for holidays.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe cómo vas al trabajo/colegio con *by*.  
10. Escribe sobre un familiar con *takes the…*.  
11. Dos frases: diario + vacaciones.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *How do you go to work?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4 frases) sobre transporte en tu familia.  
14. Dos frases sobre *take the bus*.  
15. Una frase en pasado + una en presente.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I go to work by bus.  
10. My sister takes the train to London.  
11. I go to school by bus. We travel by plane for holidays.  
12. How do you go to work? I take the bus.  
13. I go to work by bus. My sister takes the train. We travel by plane for holidays. My brother goes by bicycle.  
14. I take the bus every day. It is cheap and fast.  
15. I went to the airport by taxi. I go to work by bus.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **by + transporte** | I go **by bus** / **by car** / **by plane**. |
| **take the + transporte** | I **take the bus** / She **takes the train**. |
| Sin *the* | by bus, by train, by taxi, by bicycle |
| Con *the* | take **the** bus, take **the** train |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 43 del curso A1** (*Travel Verbs*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Travel Verbs A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/curso-a1/unit-43)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Travel schedules](/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/a1-unit43-schedules.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: horarios](#leccion-1--gramatica-horarios)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: verbos de viaje](#leccion-2--vocabulario-verbos-de-viaje)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: London trip](#leccion-3--reading-london-trip)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Schedules](#leccion-4--listening-schedules)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My trip](#leccion-5--writing-my-trip)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: horarios

**Objetivo:** Present Simple para horarios fijos (*leaves, arrives, departs*).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. The train ____ at nine o'clock. → *leaves / leave / leaving*  
2. The bus ____ at 8. → *departs / depart / departing*  
3. My flight ____ at ten. → *leaves / leave / leaving*  
4. The plane ____ at five o'clock. → *arrives / arrive / arriving*  
5. It ____ London at half past ten. → *arrives in / arrives at / arrive*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves** — horarios = Present Simple.  
2. **departs**  
3. **leaves**  
4. **arrives**  
5. **arrives in** — *arrive in* + ciudad.

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. For fixed times we use ____. → a) Present Simple (leaves, arrives) · b) only Past Simple · c) only -ing  
7. *Leaves at nine* talks about ____. → a) schedule, fixed time · b) a wish only · c) past habit only  
8. The train ____ at nine. → a) leaves · b) leave · c) leaving  
9. Correct: ____. → a) The bus departs at 8. · b) The bus departing at 8. · c) The bus depart at 8.  
10. *Arrives* means ____. → a) reaches a place (time) · b) leaves forever · c) stays home

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Present Simple (leaves, arrives)**  
7. **a) schedule, fixed time**  
8. **a) leaves**  
9. **a) The bus departs at 8.**  
10. **a) reaches a place (time)**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. The / train / leaves / at / nine o'clock.  
12. The / plane / arrives / at / five o'clock.  
13. My / flight / departs / at / ten / in the morning.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. The train leaves at nine o'clock.  
12. The plane arrives at five o'clock.  
13. My flight departs at ten in the morning.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. Timetables often use Present Simple: *The train leaves at 9.* → True / False  
15. We say *arrive in London* (city) / *arrive at the station*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: verbos de viaje

**Objetivo:** *arrive, depart, visit, stay, explore*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Arrive* = ____. → a) reach a place · b) leave forever · c) only sleep  
2. *Depart* = ____. → a) leave, go away · b) stay · c) visit only  
3. *Visit* = ____. → a) go to see a place or person · b) leave · c) depart  
4. *Stay* = ____. → a) remain in a place · b) fly only · c) depart  
5. *Explore* = ____. → a) discover, look around · b) sleep only · c) depart

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) reach a place**  
2. **a) leave, go away**  
3. **a) go to see a place or person**  
4. **a) remain in a place**  
5. **a) discover, look around**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: arrive / depart / visit / stay / explore → reach a place · leave · go to see · remain · discover  
7. Empareja: the train arrives / the plane departs / visit Paris / stay at a hotel / explore the city → reaches the station · leaves the airport · go to see Paris · sleep there · look around

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **arrive → reach a place** · **depart → leave** · **visit → go to see** · **stay → remain** · **explore → discover**  
7. **the train arrives → reaches the station** · **the plane departs → leaves the airport** · **visit Paris → go to see Paris** · **stay at a hotel → sleep there** · **explore the city → look around**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–10 — Completa

8. The train ____ at ten. → *arrives / arrive / arriving*  
9. I want to ____ the museums. → *visit / visits / visiting*  
10. I ____ at a hotel for three nights. → *stay / stays / staying*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **arrives**  
9. **visit**  
10. **stay**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Definiciones

11. *Depart* means ____. → a) leave · b) arrive · c) stay  
12. *Explore* means ____. → a) look around, discover · b) only sleep · c) only depart  
13. *Stay at a hotel* means ____. → a) sleep there for some days · b) leave forever · c) fly only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) leave**  
12. **a) look around, discover**  
13. **a) sleep there for some days**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Arrive* = reach a place; *depart* = leave. → True / False  
15. *Visit* and *explore* are useful for city trips. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: London trip

**Objetivo:** leer un plan de viaje con horarios y verbos de viaje.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-london.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: London trip"></audio>

> I am going to London next week. My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning. It arrives in London at half past ten. I stay at a hotel for three nights. I want to visit the museums and explore the city. My flight departs on Sunday at five o'clock.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. Where is the writer going? → a) To London · b) To Paris · c) To Madrid  
2. When does the train leave? → a) At eight o'clock · b) At ten · c) At noon  
3. When does it arrive in London? → a) At half past ten · b) At eight · c) At five  
4. Where does the writer stay? → a) At a hotel · b) At school · c) At the airport only  
5. How many nights? → a) Three · b) One · c) Ten

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) To London**  
2. **a) At eight o'clock**  
3. **a) At half past ten**  
4. **a) At a hotel**  
5. **a) Three**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What does the writer want to do? → a) Visit museums and explore the city · b) Only sleep · c) Only work  
7. When does the flight depart? → a) On Sunday at five · b) On Monday at eight · c) Never  
8. *Departs* means ____. → a) leaves · b) arrives · c) stays  
9. *Explore* means ____. → a) discover, look around · b) only sleep · c) only depart  
10. *Stay at a hotel* means ____. → a) sleep there for some days · b) leave forever · c) fly only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Visit museums and explore the city**  
7. **a) On Sunday at five**  
8. **a) leaves**  
9. **a) discover, look around**  
10. **a) sleep there for some days**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) a trip to London · b) only food · c) only sports  
12. *Arrives* means ____. → a) reaches a place · b) leaves forever · c) stays home  
13. *Visit* means ____. → a) go to see · b) depart · c) never go  
14. The train ____ at eight. → a) leaves · b) leave · c) leaving  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) Travel plans: leave, arrive, stay, visit, explore · b) Cooking · c) Music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a trip to London**  
12. **a) reaches a place**  
13. **a) go to see**  
14. **a) leaves**  
15. **a) Travel plans: leave, arrive, stay, visit, explore**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Schedules

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre tren, hotel y vuelo.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/listening-schedules.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Schedules"></audio>

> **A:** When does your train leave?  
> **B:** It leaves at nine o'clock.  
> **A:** What time does it arrive in London?  
> **B:** At half past eleven. I stay at a hotel for two nights.  
> **A:** Do you visit museums?  
> **B:** Yes, I want to explore the city. My flight departs on Monday at six in the evening.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. When does the train leave? → a) At nine o'clock · b) At eight · c) At noon  
2. When does it arrive in London? → a) At half past eleven · b) At nine · c) At five  
3. Where does B stay? → a) At a hotel · b) At school · c) At the airport only  
4. How many nights? → a) Two · b) Five · c) Ten  
5. Does B visit museums? → a) Yes, and explore the city · b) No · c) Never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At nine o'clock**  
2. **a) At half past eleven**  
3. **a) At a hotel**  
4. **a) Two**  
5. **a) Yes, and explore the city**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. When does the flight depart? → a) On Monday at six · b) On Sunday at five · c) Never  
7. *Departs* here means ____. → a) schedule, leaves · b) arrives · c) stays  
8. *Explore* means ____. → a) discover, look around · b) only sleep · c) only depart  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) travel plans · b) food · c) sports  
10. *Arrive* means ____. → a) reach a place · b) leave forever · c) stay home

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) On Monday at six**  
7. **a) schedule, leaves**  
8. **a) discover, look around**  
9. **a) travel plans**  
10. **a) reach a place**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Leave* means ____. → a) go away / depart · b) arrive · c) stay  
12. *Stay at a hotel* means ____. → a) sleep there · b) fly only · c) depart  
13. A asks about ____. → a) when the train leaves and when it arrives · b) only food · c) only sports  
14. *Visit* means ____. → a) go to see · b) depart · c) never go  
15. The topic is ____. → a) travel: train, hotel, flight, explore · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) go away / depart**  
12. **a) sleep there**  
13. **a) when the train leaves and when it arrives**  
14. **a) go to see**  
15. **a) travel: train, hotel, flight, explore**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My trip

**Objetivo:** escribir horarios y planes de viaje.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. The train ____ at nine o'clock. → *leaves / leave / leaving*  
2. The plane ____ at five. → *arrives / arrive / arriving*  
3. I ____ at a hotel for three nights. → *stay / stays / staying*  
4. I want to ____ the museums. → *visit / visits / visiting*  
5. My flight ____ at ten. → *departs / depart / departing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves**  
2. **arrives**  
3. **stay**  
4. **visit**  
5. **departs**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. The / train / leaves / at / nine o'clock.  
7. The / plane / arrives / at / five o'clock.  
8. I / want / to / explore / the / city.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. The train leaves at nine o'clock.  
7. The plane arrives at five o'clock.  
8. I want to explore the city.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe la hora de salida de tu tren/bus/vuelo.  
10. Escribe dónde te alojas y cuántas noches.  
11. Dos frases: *departs* + *arrives*.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *What time does the train leave?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4–5 frases) sobre un viaje.  
14. Dos frases: *visit* + *explore*.  
15. Horario de bus: *departs* + *arrive*.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. My train leaves at eight o'clock.  
10. I stay at a hotel for three nights.  
11. My flight departs at ten. It arrives at two o'clock.  
12. What time does the train leave? It leaves at nine.  
13. My train leaves at eight. It arrives in London at noon. I stay at a hotel. I want to visit museums and explore the city.  
14. I want to visit the museums. I want to explore the city.  
15. The bus departs at seven. I arrive at half past eight.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Verbo | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **leave / depart** | salir | The train **leaves** at 9. |
| **arrive** | llegar | It **arrives in** London at 10:30. |
| **stay** | alojarse | I **stay** at a hotel. |
| **visit** | visitar | I want to **visit** museums. |
| **explore** | explorar | I want to **explore** the city. |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 44 del curso A1** (*The Weather*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [The Weather A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a1/unit-44)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![It is + weather](/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/a1-unit44-it-is-weather.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: It is + clima](#leccion-1--gramatica-it-is--clima)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: el tiempo](#leccion-2--vocabulario-el-tiempo)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Today and seasons](#leccion-3--reading-today-and-seasons)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Weather talk](#leccion-4--listening-weather-talk)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My weather](#leccion-5--writing-my-weather)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: It is + clima

**Objetivo:** *It is* + adjetivo de tiempo (*sunny, cold…*) y *It is raining / snowing*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It ____ sunny today. → *is / are / am*  
2. It ____ raining now. → *is / are / am*  
3. It ____ cold in winter. → *is / are / am*  
4. It ____ hot in summer. → *is / are / am*  
5. It ____ cloudy this morning. → *is / are / am*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is** — *It is* + adjetivo.  
2. **is** — *It is raining.*  
3. **is**  
4. **is**  
5. **is**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. The pattern is ____. → a) It is + adjective · b) I is + adjective · c) They is + adjective  
7. *It is raining* means ____. → a) Rain is falling now · b) The sun shines · c) It is never wet  
8. Correct for low temperature: ____. → a) It is cold. · b) It are cold. · c) It am cold.  
9. *It is sunny* means ____. → a) The sun is shining · b) It snows · c) It rains  
10. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) It is + adjective**  
7. **a) Rain is falling now**  
8. **a) It is cold.**  
9. **a) The sun is shining**  
10. **a) Snow falls**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. It / is / sunny / today.  
12. It / is / raining / now.  
13. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. It is sunny today.  
12. It is raining now.  
13. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. For weather we use *It is*, not *I is* or *They is*. → True / False  
15. *It is hot* means the temperature is high. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: el tiempo

**Objetivo:** *sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, hot, cold*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Sunny* = ____. → a) The sun is shining · b) It rains · c) It snows  
2. *Rainy* = ____. → a) It rains; the weather is wet · b) The sun shines · c) It is never wet  
3. *Cloudy* = ____. → a) There are clouds in the sky · b) It is always hot · c) Snow falls  
4. *Snowy* / *It is snowing* = ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only  
5. *Hot* = ____. → a) The temperature is high or warm · b) The temperature is low · c) It snows

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) The sun is shining**  
2. **a) It rains; the weather is wet**  
3. **a) There are clouds in the sky**  
4. **a) Snow falls**  
5. **a) The temperature is high or warm**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Empareja y completa

6. *Cold* means ____. → a) The temperature is low · b) The temperature is high · c) The sun shines  
7. Empareja: sunny / rainy / cloudy / snowy / hot / cold → the sun shines · it rains · clouds · snow · high temperature · low temperature  
8. Empareja: It is sunny / It is rainy / It is cold / It is hot / It is snowy → take sunglasses · take an umbrella · wear a coat · wear shorts · snow on the ground

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) The temperature is low**  
7. **sunny → the sun shines** · **rainy → it rains** · **cloudy → clouds** · **snowy → snow** · **hot → high temperature** · **cold → low temperature**  
8. **It is sunny → take sunglasses** · **It is rainy → take an umbrella** · **It is cold → wear a coat** · **It is hot → wear shorts** · **It is snowy → snow on the ground**

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–13 — Completa / elige

9. It is ____ today — the sun is shining. → *sunny / rainy / snowy*  
10. Take an umbrella — it is ____. → *rainy / sunny / hot*  
11. Wear a coat — it is ____. → *cold / hot / sunny*  
12. Low temperature = ____. → a) cold · b) hot · c) sunny  
13. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

9. **sunny**  
10. **rainy**  
11. **cold**  
12. **a) cold**  
13. **a) Snow falls**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Cloudy* means there are clouds in the sky. → True / False  
15. Sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot and cold are weather words. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Today and seasons

**Objetivo:** leer sobre el tiempo hoy, ayer y en las estaciones.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-weather.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Weather"></audio>

> Today it is sunny and hot. I like this weather. Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. It was raining in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. What is the weather like today? → a) Sunny and hot · b) Cold and snowy · c) Only rainy  
2. What was it like yesterday? → a) Cloudy and rainy · b) Sunny and hot · c) Snowy  
3. When was it raining yesterday? → a) In the afternoon · b) At night only · c) Never  
4. What is winter like? → a) Cold and sometimes snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny  
5. What is summer like? → a) Hot and sunny · b) Always snowy · c) Always cold

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sunny and hot**  
2. **a) Cloudy and rainy**  
3. **a) In the afternoon**  
4. **a) Cold and sometimes snowy**  
5. **a) Hot and sunny**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What weather does the writer prefer? → a) Sunny weather · b) Rainy weather · c) Snowy weather  
7. Why? → a) Because the writer can go outside · b) Because it is cold · c) The text doesn't say  
8. *It was raining* means ____. → a) Rain falls / fell · b) The sun shines · c) It is hot  
9. *Sunny* means ____. → a) The sun shines · b) It snows · c) It rains  
10. *Cloudy* means ____. → a) There are clouds in the sky · b) It is always hot · c) Snow falls

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Sunny weather**  
7. **a) Because the writer can go outside**  
8. **a) Rain falls / fell**  
9. **a) The sun shines**  
10. **a) There are clouds in the sky**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) Weather at different times · b) Only food · c) Only sports  
12. *Hot* means ____. → a) High temperature · b) Low temperature · c) Snow  
13. *Cold* means ____. → a) Low temperature · b) High temperature · c) Sunny only  
14. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot, and cold · b) Cooking · c) Music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Weather at different times**  
12. **a) High temperature**  
13. **a) Low temperature**  
14. **a) Snow falls**  
15. **a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot, and cold**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Weather talk

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre el tiempo.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/listening-weather.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Weather talk"></audio>

> **A:** What is the weather like today?  
> **B:** It is sunny and hot.  
> **A:** Great. Yesterday it was cloudy and it was raining.  
> **B:** Yes, I had an umbrella. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing.  
> **A:** I prefer sunny weather.  
> **B:** Me too.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is the weather like today? → a) Sunny and hot · b) Cold and snowy · c) Only rainy  
2. What was it like yesterday? → a) Cloudy and raining · b) Sunny and hot · c) Snowy  
3. What did B have yesterday? → a) An umbrella · b) Sunglasses · c) Shorts  
4. What is winter like? → a) Cold and sometimes snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny  
5. What weather does A prefer? → a) Sunny weather · b) Rainy weather · c) Snowy weather

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Sunny and hot**  
2. **a) Cloudy and raining**  
3. **a) An umbrella**  
4. **a) Cold and sometimes snowy**  
5. **a) Sunny weather**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Does B agree? → a) Yes. B says “Me too.” · b) No · c) The audio doesn't say  
7. *Sunny* means ____. → a) The sun shines · b) It rains · c) It snows  
8. *It was raining* means ____. → a) Rain falls / fell · b) The sun shines · c) It is hot  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) The weather · b) Food · c) Sports  
10. *Hot* means ____. → a) High temperature · b) Low temperature · c) Snow

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Yes. B says “Me too.”**  
7. **a) The sun shines**  
8. **a) Rain falls / fell**  
9. **a) The weather**  
10. **a) High temperature**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. *Cold* means ____. → a) Low temperature · b) High temperature · c) Sunny only  
12. *Cloudy* means ____. → a) There are clouds in the sky · b) It is always hot · c) Snow falls  
13. A's first question is ____. → a) What the weather is like today · b) What time it is · c) Where the hotel is  
14. *It is snowing* means ____. → a) Snow falls · b) It is hot · c) It is sunny only  
15. The topic is ____. → a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cold, and snowy · b) Cooking · c) Music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Low temperature**  
12. **a) There are clouds in the sky**  
13. **a) What the weather is like today**  
14. **a) Snow falls**  
15. **a) Weather: sunny, rainy, cold, and snowy**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My weather

**Objetivo:** escribir frases sobre el tiempo.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It ____ sunny today. → *is / are / am*  
2. It ____ raining now. → *is / are / am*  
3. It is ____ in winter. → *cold / hot / sunny*  
4. It is ____ in summer. → *hot / cold / snowy*  
5. It is ____ this morning — there are clouds. → *cloudy / sunny / hot*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **is**  
3. **cold**  
4. **hot**  
5. **cloudy**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. It / is / sunny / today.  
7. It / is / raining / now.  
8. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. It is sunny today.  
7. It is raining now.  
8. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe el tiempo de hoy con *It is…*.  
10. Escribe el invierno con *cold* / *snowy*.  
11. Dos frases: ayer + hoy.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *What is the weather like?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4 frases) sobre el tiempo.  
14. Escribe qué tiempo prefieres y por qué.  
15. Dos tips: qué llevar si hace frío / si llueve.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. It is sunny and hot today.  
10. It is cold and snowy in winter.  
11. Yesterday it was rainy. Today it is sunny.  
12. What is the weather like? It is sunny.  
13. Today it is sunny and hot. In winter it is cold. Sometimes it is rainy and cloudy. I like sunny weather.  
14. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.  
15. When it is cold, wear a coat. When it is rainy, take an umbrella.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **It is + adj.** | It is **sunny** / **hot** / **cold** / **cloudy**. |
| **It is + -ing** | It is **raining** / **snowing**. |
| Pregunta | **What is the weather like?** |
| Ayer | Yesterday it **was** rainy. |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 45 del curso A1** (*Seasons*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Seasons A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 45 — Seasons](/curso-a1/unit-45)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![In + seasons](/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/a1-unit45-in-seasons.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: in + estación](#leccion-1--gramatica-in--estacion)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: estaciones](#leccion-2--vocabulario-estaciones)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Four seasons](#leccion-3--reading-four-seasons)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Favourite season](#leccion-4--listening-favourite-season)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My seasons](#leccion-5--writing-my-seasons)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: in + estación

**Objetivo:** preposición *in* con *spring, summer, autumn, winter*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It is hot ____ summer. → *in / on / at*  
2. The flowers bloom ____ spring. → *in / on / at*  
3. It is cold ____ winter. → *in / on / at*  
4. The leaves fall ____ autumn. → *in / on / at*  
5. I go to the beach ____ summer. → *in / on / at*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in** — *in* + estación.  
2. **in**  
3. **in**  
4. **in**  
5. **in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. Before seasons we use ____. → a) in · b) on · c) at  
7. Correct: ____. → a) in spring · b) on spring · c) at spring  
8. *In autumn* means ____. → a) during autumn · b) never autumn · c) only winter  
9. The four seasons are ____. → a) spring, summer, autumn, winter · b) only summer · c) Monday–Friday  
10. It is snowy ____ winter. → a) in · b) on · c) at

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) in**  
7. **a) in spring**  
8. **a) during autumn**  
9. **a) spring, summer, autumn, winter**  
10. **a) in**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. It / is / hot / in / summer.  
12. The / flowers / bloom / in / spring.  
13. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. It is hot in summer.  
12. The flowers bloom in spring.  
13. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. We say *in summer* (not *on summer*). → True / False  
15. The four seasons are spring, summer, autumn and winter. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: estaciones

**Objetivo:** *spring, summer, autumn, winter, nature, flowers, leaves*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Spring* = ____. → a) the season after winter, when flowers bloom · b) the cold season · c) only snow  
2. *Summer* = ____. → a) the hot, sunny season · b) the cold season · c) only autumn  
3. *Autumn* = ____. → a) the season when leaves fall · b) the hot beach season · c) only spring  
4. *Winter* = ____. → a) the cold season, associated with snow · b) the hot season · c) only flowers  
5. *Nature* = ____. → a) plants, animals, weather, and things not made by people · b) only cars · c) only schools

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) the season after winter, when flowers bloom**  
2. **a) the hot, sunny season**  
3. **a) the season when leaves fall**  
4. **a) the cold season, associated with snow**  
5. **a) plants, animals, weather, and things not made by people**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: spring / summer / autumn / winter / nature → flowers bloom · hot and sunny · leaves fall · cold and snow · trees, animals, and plants  
7. Empareja: in spring / in summer / in autumn / in winter / nature → warm weather and new leaves · holidays and the beach · orange leaves · snow and a coat · parks and forests

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **spring → flowers bloom** · **summer → hot and sunny** · **autumn → leaves fall** · **winter → cold and snow** · **nature → trees, animals, and plants**  
7. **in spring → warm weather and new leaves** · **in summer → holidays and the beach** · **in autumn → orange leaves** · **in winter → snow and a coat** · **nature → parks and forests**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. It is hot ____ summer. → *in / on / at*  
9. Flowers bloom ____. → a) in spring · b) on spring · c) at spring  
10. I like ____ in every season. → *nature / natures / naturings*  
11. Which season is cold and snowy? → a) Winter · b) Summer · c) Spring  
12. Which season do leaves fall? → a) Autumn · b) Summer · c) Spring  
13. Parks and forests are part of ____. → a) nature · b) only hotels · c) only tickets

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **in**  
9. **a) in spring**  
10. **nature**  
11. **a) Winter**  
12. **a) Autumn**  
13. **a) nature**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Autumn* is when leaves fall. → True / False  
15. *In spring* uses the preposition *in*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Four seasons

**Objetivo:** leer sobre las cuatro estaciones y la naturaleza.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/reading-seasons.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Four seasons"></audio>

> I love all four seasons. In spring, the flowers bloom and the weather is warm. In summer, it is hot and sunny; I go to the beach. In autumn, the leaves fall and the trees are orange and yellow. In winter, it is cold and sometimes it snows. I like nature in every season.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. What does the writer love? → a) All four seasons · b) Only winter · c) Only summer  
2. What happens in spring? → a) The flowers bloom and the weather is warm · b) It always snows · c) Leaves fall  
3. Where does the writer go in summer? → a) To the beach · b) To school only · c) Nowhere  
4. What happens in autumn? → a) The leaves fall, and the trees are orange and yellow · b) Flowers bloom · c) It is always hot  
5. What is winter like? → a) It is cold and sometimes snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) All four seasons**  
2. **a) The flowers bloom and the weather is warm**  
3. **a) To the beach**  
4. **a) The leaves fall, and the trees are orange and yellow**  
5. **a) It is cold and sometimes snowy**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What does the writer like in every season? → a) Nature · b) Only hotels · c) Only cars  
7. Summer is ____. → a) hot and sunny · b) always snowy · c) always cold  
8. In spring, ____. → a) flowers bloom · b) leaves fall · c) it always snows  
9. In autumn, ____. → a) leaves fall · b) flowers bloom · c) it is always hot  
10. Winter is ____. → a) cold and snow · b) always hot · c) always sunny

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Nature**  
7. **a) hot and sunny**  
8. **a) flowers bloom**  
9. **a) leaves fall**  
10. **a) cold and snow**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) the four seasons and nature · b) only food · c) only sports  
12. *Nature* means ____. → a) trees, flowers, animals, and other things not made by people · b) only cars · c) only tickets  
13. Before seasons we use ____. → a) in · b) on · c) at  
14. Summer is ____. → a) the hot season · b) the cold season · c) only autumn  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) seasons and nature · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) the four seasons and nature**  
12. **a) trees, flowers, animals, and other things not made by people**  
13. **a) in**  
14. **a) the hot season**  
15. **a) seasons and nature**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Favourite season

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre estaciones favoritas.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-45/listening-seasons.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Favourite season"></audio>

> **A:** What is your favourite season?  
> **B:** I like summer. It is hot and sunny in summer.  
> **A:** I prefer spring. The flowers bloom in spring.  
> **B:** In autumn, the leaves fall. In winter, it is cold and snowy.  
> **A:** I love nature in all seasons.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What is B's favourite season? → a) Summer · b) Winter · c) Autumn  
2. What is summer like for B? → a) Hot and sunny · b) Cold and snowy · c) Always rainy  
3. What does A prefer? → a) Spring · b) Winter · c) Autumn  
4. What happens in spring? → a) The flowers bloom · b) Leaves fall · c) It always snows  
5. What happens in autumn? → a) The leaves fall · b) Flowers bloom · c) It is always hot

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) Summer**  
2. **a) Hot and sunny**  
3. **a) Spring**  
4. **a) The flowers bloom**  
5. **a) The leaves fall**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. What is winter like? → a) Cold and snowy · b) Always hot · c) Always sunny  
7. What does A love? → a) Nature in all seasons · b) Only winter · c) Only cars  
8. Before summer we use ____. → a) in · b) on · c) at  
9. The dialogue is about ____. → a) seasons and nature · b) food · c) sports  
10. In spring, ____. → a) flowers bloom · b) leaves fall · c) it always snows

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Cold and snowy**  
7. **a) Nature in all seasons**  
8. **a) in**  
9. **a) seasons and nature**  
10. **a) flowers bloom**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. Winter is ____. → a) cold and snow · b) always hot · c) always sunny  
12. *Nature* includes ____. → a) trees, flowers, and animals · b) only hotels · c) only tickets  
13. A's first question is ____. → a) “What is your favourite season?” · b) “What time is it?” · c) “Where is the hotel?”  
14. In autumn, ____. → a) leaves fall · b) flowers bloom · c) it is always hot  
15. The topic is ____. → a) the four seasons and nature · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) cold and snow**  
12. **a) trees, flowers, and animals**  
13. **a) “What is your favourite season?”**  
14. **a) leaves fall**  
15. **a) the four seasons and nature**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My seasons

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre estaciones y naturaleza.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. It is hot ____ summer. → *in / on / at*  
2. Flowers bloom ____ spring. → *in / on / at*  
3. It is cold ____. → a) in winter · b) on winter · c) at winter  
4. Leaves fall ____ autumn. → *in / on / at*  
5. My favourite season is ____. → *spring / springs / springing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in**  
2. **in**  
3. **a) in winter**  
4. **in**  
5. **spring** (u otra estación válida)

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. It / is / hot / in / summer.  
7. The / flowers / bloom / in / spring.  
8. It / is / cold / in / winter.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. It is hot in summer.  
7. The flowers bloom in spring.  
8. It is cold in winter.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe el verano con *It is… in summer*.  
10. Escribe tu estación favorita y por qué.  
11. Dos frases: spring + autumn.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta: *What is your favourite season?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4–5 frases) sobre las cuatro estaciones.  
14. Dos actividades: summer + winter.  
15. Cuatro frases: una por estación.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. It is hot and sunny in summer.  
10. My favourite season is summer because it is hot.  
11. In spring, the flowers bloom. In autumn, the leaves fall.  
12. What is your favourite season? My favourite season is summer.  
13. In spring, the flowers bloom. In summer, it is hot. In autumn, the leaves fall. In winter, it is cold. I like nature in every season.  
14. In summer, I go to the beach. In winter, I stay at home when it is snowing.  
15. In spring, it is warm. In summer, it is hot. In autumn, the leaves fall. In winter, it is cold.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Estación | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **spring** | In spring, the flowers bloom. |
| **summer** | It is hot **in summer**. |
| **autumn** | In autumn, the leaves fall. |
| **winter** | It is cold **in winter**. |
| Preposición | **in** + estación |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 46 del curso A1** (*At the Hotel*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [At the Hotel A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-46-hotel-can-i-have)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 46 — At the Hotel](/curso-a1/unit-46)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Hotel requests](/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/a1-unit46-hotel-requests.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: peticiones](#leccion-1--gramatica-peticiones)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: hotel](#leccion-2--vocabulario-hotel)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Check-in](#leccion-3--reading-check-in)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Reception](#leccion-4--listening-reception)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: At the hotel](#leccion-5--writing-at-the-hotel)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: peticiones

**Objetivo:** *Can I have/get…?*, *Is there…?*, *I would like…*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Can I ____ a key? → *have / has / having*  
2. ____ there a restaurant? → *Is / Are / Am*  
3. Can I ____ room service? → *get / gets / getting*  
4. Is there ____ Wi-Fi? → *any / an / a*  
5. I would ____ a double room. → *like / likes / liking*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have** — *Can I have…?*  
2. **Is** — *Is there…?*  
3. **get**  
4. **any**  
5. **like**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *Can I have…?* is a ____. → a) polite request · b) past story · c) refusal  
7. *Is there…?* asks about ____. → a) the existence of something · b) only the past · c) a sport  
8. At reception you ____. → a) ask for a key and check in · b) only cook · c) only fly  
9. Correct: ____. → a) Can I have a key? · b) Can I has a key? · c) Can I having a key?  
10. *Room service* means ____. → a) food or help brought to your room · b) only the lobby · c) only the key

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) polite request**  
7. **a) the existence of something**  
8. **a) ask for a key and check in**  
9. **a) Can I have a key?**  
10. **a) food or help brought to your room**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. Can / I / have / a / key / for / room / five?  
12. Is / there / a / double / room / available?  
13. I / would / like / room / service, / please.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. Can I have a key for room five?  
12. Is there a double room available?  
13. I would like room service, please.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Can I have…?* is a polite way to ask for something. → True / False  
15. *Is there Wi-Fi?* asks if Wi-Fi exists in the hotel. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: hotel

**Objetivo:** *reception, room service, single/double room, key, booking, check in*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Reception* = ____. → a) a desk where you check in · b) only the beach · c) only the plane  
2. *Room service* = ____. → a) food or help brought to your room · b) only the lobby · c) only the key  
3. *Single room* = ____. → a) a room for one person · b) a room for ten people · c) only the restaurant  
4. *Double room* = ____. → a) a room for two people, often with one bed · b) a room for one person · c) only Wi-Fi  
5. *Key* = ____. → a) something used to open your room · b) only a password · c) only a booking

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a desk where you check in**  
2. **a) food or help brought to your room**  
3. **a) a room for one person**  
4. **a) a room for two people, often with one bed**  
5. **a) something used to open your room**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: reception / room service / single room / double room / key → check in/get a key · order food to your room · one person · two people · open the room  
7. Empareja: hotel / available / check in / booking / lobby → place to stay · free to use · register when you arrive · reservation · entrance area

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **reception → check in/get a key** · **room service → order food to your room** · **single room → one person** · **double room → two people** · **key → open the room**  
7. **hotel → place to stay** · **available → free to use** · **check in → register when you arrive** · **booking → reservation** · **lobby → entrance area**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. Can I have a ____ for room five? → *key / keysing / lobby*  
9. I go to ____ to check in. → *reception / restauranting / beach*  
10. Is there a ____ room available? → *double / doubles / doubling*  
11. *Available* means ____. → a) free; available for use · b) closed forever · c) only past  
12. *Check in* means ____. → a) register when you arrive at the hotel · b) leave forever · c) only cook  
13. Where do you get your key? → a) at reception · b) at the beach · c) on the plane

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **key**  
9. **reception**  
10. **double**  
11. **a) free; available for use**  
12. **a) register when you arrive at the hotel**  
13. **a) at reception**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. A single room is for one person. → True / False  
15. A booking is a reservation. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Check-in

**Objetivo:** leer un check-in en el hotel.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/reading-hotel.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Check-in"></audio>

> I am at the hotel today. I go to reception to check in. Can I have a key for room twelve? The receptionist says yes. Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is. I would like room service tonight. I have a single room. It is clean and quiet.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. Where is the writer? → a) At the hotel · b) At school · c) At the beach  
2. What does the writer ask for? → a) A key for room twelve · b) A plane ticket · c) A bike  
3. Is there a restaurant? → a) Yes, there is · b) No · c) The text doesn't say  
4. What does the writer want tonight? → a) Room service · b) A taxi only · c) Nothing  
5. What type of room? → a) A single room · b) A double room · c) A suite only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) At the hotel**  
2. **a) A key for room twelve**  
3. **a) Yes, there is**  
4. **a) Room service**  
5. **a) A single room**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. How is the room? → a) It is clean and quiet · b) It is dirty · c) It is noisy  
7. Where does the writer go first? → a) To reception · b) To the beach · c) To school  
8. A *receptionist* is ____. → a) a person at reception · b) a plane · c) a key  
9. *Can I have…?* is ____. → a) a polite request · b) a refusal · c) a past tense  
10. Room twelve is ____. → a) room number twelve · b) a restaurant · c) Wi-Fi only

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) It is clean and quiet**  
7. **a) To reception**  
8. **a) a person at reception**  
9. **a) a polite request**  
10. **a) room number twelve**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) hotel check-in and a hotel stay · b) only food · c) only sports  
12. *Is there…?* is ____. → a) asking whether something exists · b) only past · c) a sport  
13. *Quiet* means ____. → a) not noisy · b) always loud · c) always dirty  
14. A *key* is ____. → a) something used to open your room · b) only a password forever · c) only a booking  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) staying at a hotel, checking in and getting a room · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) hotel check-in and a hotel stay**  
12. **a) asking whether something exists**  
13. **a) not noisy**  
14. **a) something used to open your room**  
15. **a) staying at a hotel, checking in and getting a room**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Reception

**Objetivo:** escuchar un check-in en recepción.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-46/listening-check-in.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Reception"></audio>

> **Guest:** Hello. I have a booking.  
> **Receptionist:** Welcome. Can I have your name?  
> **Guest:** John.  
> **Receptionist:** Here is your key for room eight.  
> **Guest:** Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?  
> **Receptionist:** Yes, there is. The password is on the key card.  
> **Guest:** Can I have room service?  
> **Receptionist:** Yes. Call reception.  
> **Guest:** Thank you.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. What does the guest say first? → a) I have a booking · b) I need a taxi · c) Goodbye  
2. What room is the key for? → a) Room eight · b) Room twelve · c) Room one  
3. Is there Wi-Fi? → a) Yes, there is · b) No · c) The audio doesn't say  
4. Where is the password? → a) On the key card · b) On the plane · c) At school  
5. What else does the guest ask for? → a) Room service · b) A bike · c) A ticket

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) I have a booking**  
2. **a) Room eight**  
3. **a) Yes, there is**  
4. **a) On the key card**  
5. **a) Room service**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. How do you get room service? → a) Call reception · b) Go to the beach · c) Fly  
7. A *booking* is a ____. → a) reservation · b) key only · c) password only  
8. The dialogue is at ____. → a) hotel reception · b) school · c) the beach  
9. *Can I have…?* is ____. → a) a polite request · b) a refusal · c) past simple  
10. A *key card* is ____. → a) a key card, sometimes with the password · b) only a plane · c) only food

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Call reception**  
7. **a) reservation**  
8. **a) hotel reception**  
9. **a) a polite request**  
10. **a) a key card, sometimes with the password**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. The guest ends with ____. → a) Thank you · b) Goodbye forever · c) Never  
12. *Welcome* is ____. → a) a greeting used when someone arrives · b) a refusal · c) a password  
13. For room service, ____. → a) phone reception · b) leave the hotel · c) buy a plane  
14. A *password* is ____. → a) a secret code used for Wi-Fi or another service · b) a room number only · c) a key forever  
15. The topic is ____. → a) hotel check-in and hotel requests · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) Thank you**  
12. **a) a greeting used when someone arrives**  
13. **a) phone reception**  
14. **a) a secret code used for Wi-Fi or another service**  
15. **a) hotel check-in and hotel requests**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: At the hotel

**Objetivo:** escribir peticiones y un mini diálogo de check-in.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. Can I ____ a key? → *have / has / having*  
2. ____ there Wi-Fi? → *Is / Are / Am*  
3. I would ____ room service. → *like / likes / liking*  
4. I go ____ reception to check in. → *to / for / at*  
5. Here is your ____. → *key / keysing / lobby*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have**  
2. **Is**  
3. **like**  
4. **to**  
5. **key**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. Can / I / have / a / key / for / room / five?  
7. Is / there / a / double / room / available?  
8. I / go / to / reception / to / check / in.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. Can I have a key for room five?  
7. Is there a double room available?  
8. I go to reception to check in.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Pide una llave para una habitación.  
10. Pregunta si hay Wi-Fi.  
11. Dos frases: booking + tipo de habitación.  
12. Mini diálogo: room service.  
13. Párrafo corto (3–4 frases) de check-in.  
14. Tres peticiones/preguntas de hotel.  
15. Escribe lo que quieres: habitación + baño.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. Can I have a key for room ten?  
10. Is there Wi-Fi in the hotel?  
11. I have a booking. I would like a double room.  
12. Can I have room service? Yes, call reception.  
13. I go to reception to check in. Can I have a key for room eight? Is there a restaurant? Yes, there is.  
14. Can I have a key? Is there Wi-Fi? I would like room service.  
15. I would like a single room. Is there a bathroom in the room?

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Can I have…?** | Can I have a key? |
| **Is there…?** | Is there Wi-Fi? |
| **I would like…** | I would like room service. |
| **Check in** | I go to reception to check in. |
| **Booking** | I have a booking. |

---

content:
Este artículo reúne **los ejercicios de la Unidad 47 del curso A1** (*Holidays & Vacation*) con **soluciones comentadas**. Corresponde a las lecciones del curso: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

> **Guía teórica:** [Holidays A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-47-vacaciones-was-were)  
> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 47 — Holidays & Vacation](/curso-a1/unit-47)

Haz cada bloque **sin mirar** la solución. Luego comprueba y lee la explicación.

![Was / were](/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/a1-unit47-was-were.png)

**Contenido de la unidad:**
1. [Lección 1 — Gramática: was/were](#leccion-1--gramatica-waswere)
2. [Lección 2 — Vocabulario: vacaciones](#leccion-2--vocabulario-vacaciones)
3. [Lección 3 — Reading: Last summer](#leccion-3--reading-last-summer)
4. [Lección 4 — Listening: Last week](#leccion-4--listening-last-week)
5. [Lección 5 — Writing: My holiday](#leccion-5--writing-my-holiday)

---

## Lección 1 — Gramática: was/were

**Objetivo:** *was/were* y pasado regular (*visited, played*).

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ on the beach last week. → *was / were / am*  
2. We ____ in the mountains. → *were / was / are*  
3. She ____ the museum yesterday. → *visited / visit / visiting*  
4. They ____ volleyball on the beach. → *played / play / playing*  
5. It ____ sunny. → *was / were / are*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was** — *I/he/she/it was*.  
2. **were** — *you/we/they were*.  
3. **visited** — pasado regular *-ed*.  
4. **played**  
5. **was**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Elige

6. *I ____ happy.* → a) was · b) were · c) are  
7. *You ____ on holiday.* → a) were · b) was · c) is  
8. Past of *visit*: ____. → a) visited · b) visit · c) visiting  
9. *She ____ at the hotel.* → a) was · b) were · c) are  
10. *Did* is used for ____. → a) past questions · b) only present · c) only future

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) was**  
7. **a) were**  
8. **a) visited**  
9. **a) was**  
10. **a) past questions**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–13 — Ordena

11. I / was / on / the / beach / last week.  
12. She / visited / the / museum / yesterday.  
13. We / were / in / the / mountains.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. I was on the beach last week.  
12. She visited the museum yesterday.  
13. We were in the mountains.

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. *Was* goes with I/he/she/it; *were* goes with you/we/they. → True / False  
15. Regular past verbs often end in *-ed*: *visited, played*. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 2 — Vocabulario: vacaciones

**Objetivo:** *beach, mountains, sightseeing, souvenir, holiday*.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige el significado

1. *Beach* = ____. → a) a sandy place by the sea · b) high land · c) only a museum  
2. *Mountains* = ____. → a) high land or hills · b) the sea · c) only a hotel  
3. *Sightseeing* = ____. → a) visiting places as a tourist · b) only sleeping · c) only cooking  
4. *Souvenir* = ____. → a) something you buy to remember a place · b) only a ticket · c) only weather  
5. *Holiday* = ____. → a) time off or a trip · b) only work · c) only school

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) a sandy place by the sea**  
2. **a) high land or hills**  
3. **a) visiting places as a tourist**  
4. **a) something you buy to remember a place**  
5. **a) time off or a trip**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–7 — Empareja

6. Empareja: beach / mountains / sightseeing / souvenir / last year → sea and sand · hiking and snow · visiting monuments · something bought as a reminder · past time  
7. Empareja: visited / played / was / were / yesterday → past of visit · past of play · past of is/am · past of are · a past day

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **beach → sea and sand** · **mountains → hiking and snow** · **sightseeing → visiting monuments** · **souvenir → something bought as a reminder** · **last year → past time**  
7. **visited → past of visit** · **played → past of play** · **was → past of is/am** · **were → past of are** · **yesterday → a past day**

</details>

### Ejercicios 8–13 — Completa / elige

8. I was on the ____ every day. → *beach / beachesing / mountain*  
9. I bought a ____. → *souvenir / souvenirsing / weather*  
10. We did ____ in Barcelona. → *sightseeing / sightsee / sights*  
11. *Yesterday* is ____. → a) past time · b) future time · c) never  
12. Past of *visit*: ____. → a) visited · b) visit · c) visiting  
13. Sightseeing often includes ____. → a) museums and monuments · b) only sleeping · c) only cooking

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

8. **beach**  
9. **souvenir**  
10. **sightseeing**  
11. **a) past time**  
12. **a) visited**  
13. **a) museums and monuments**

</details>

### Ejercicios 14–15 — Verdadero o falso

14. A souvenir helps you remember a place. → True / False  
15. *Last summer* talks about the past. → True / False

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

14. **True**  
15. **True**

</details>

---

## Lección 3 — Reading: Last summer

**Objetivo:** leer sobre unas vacaciones en España.

### Texto

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/reading-holiday.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Last summer"></audio>

> Last summer I was on holiday in Spain. I was on the beach every day. My friends visited the mountains too. We did sightseeing in Barcelona. I bought a souvenir—a small statue. The weather was sunny. We played volleyball on the beach. It was great.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Elige la respuesta correcta

1. Where was the writer? → a) In Spain, on holiday · b) At school · c) At work only  
2. Where was the writer every day? → a) On the beach · b) In the mountains · c) At home  
3. Where did friends visit? → a) The mountains · b) Only the hotel · c) Nowhere  
4. Where did they do sightseeing? → a) In Barcelona · b) In Paris · c) In London  
5. What souvenir? → a) A small statue · b) A car · c) A plane

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) In Spain, on holiday**  
2. **a) On the beach**  
3. **a) The mountains**  
4. **a) In Barcelona**  
5. **a) A small statue**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Comprensión

6. What was the weather like? → a) Sunny · b) Snowy · c) Cold  
7. What sport did they play? → a) Volleyball · b) Football only · c) Tennis only  
8. *Sightseeing* means ____. → a) visiting places as a tourist · b) only sleeping · c) only cooking  
9. A *souvenir* is ____. → a) something you buy to remember a place · b) only a ticket · c) only weather  
10. *It was great* means ____. → a) It was very good · b) It was terrible · c) It was never fun

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) Sunny**  
7. **a) Volleyball**  
8. **a) visiting places as a tourist**  
9. **a) something you buy to remember a place**  
10. **a) It was very good**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Detalles

11. The text is about ____. → a) a holiday in Spain · b) only food · c) only work  
12. *Was* is the past of ____. → a) is/am · b) are · c) will  
13. *Visited* is ____. → a) the past of visit · b) the present · c) the future  
14. *Mountains* means ____. → a) high land · b) the sea · c) only a hotel  
15. The main topic is ____. → a) a summer holiday with beach, mountains and sightseeing · b) cooking · c) music

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a holiday in Spain**  
12. **a) is/am**  
13. **a) the past of visit**  
14. **a) high land**  
15. **a) a summer holiday with beach, mountains and sightseeing**

</details>

---

## Lección 4 — Listening: Last week

**Objetivo:** escuchar un diálogo sobre unas vacaciones recientes.

### Audio y guion

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-47/listening-holiday.mp3" title="🔊 Listening: Last week"></audio>

> **A:** Where were you last week?  
> **B:** I was on the beach. I played volleyball and swam.  
> **A:** Nice. Did you do sightseeing?  
> **B:** Yes. I visited the old town. I bought a souvenir.  
> **A:** Were you in the mountains too?  
> **B:** No, I was not. Next year I will go to the mountains.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Comprensión

1. Where was B last week? → a) On the beach · b) In the mountains · c) At school  
2. What did B do? → a) Played volleyball and swam · b) Only worked · c) Only slept  
3. Did B do sightseeing? → a) Yes · b) No · c) The audio doesn't say  
4. What did B visit? → a) The old town · b) Only a hotel · c) Nowhere  
5. Did B buy a souvenir? → a) Yes · b) No · c) Never

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a) On the beach**  
2. **a) Played volleyball and swam**  
3. **a) Yes**  
4. **a) The old town**  
5. **a) Yes**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–10 — Detalles

6. Was B in the mountains? → a) No · b) Yes · c) Always  
7. Where will B go next year? → a) To the mountains · b) To school · c) Nowhere  
8. *Old town* means ____. → a) the historic centre of a city · b) only a beach · c) only a hotel  
9. *Was* is ____. → a) the past of I am · b) the present · c) the future  
10. *Swam* is ____. → a) the past of swim · b) the present · c) the future

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. **a) No**  
7. **a) To the mountains**  
8. **a) the historic centre of a city**  
9. **a) the past of I am**  
10. **a) the past of swim**

</details>

### Ejercicios 11–15 — Forma

11. The dialogue is about ____. → a) a holiday, the beach, and sightseeing · b) only food · c) only work  
12. *Bought* is ____. → a) the past of buy · b) the present · c) the future  
13. *Nice* here is ____. → a) an expression of approval · b) a refusal · c) a ticket  
14. *Were you…?* is ____. → a) a past-tense question with you · b) a present question · c) a future question  
15. The dialogue uses ____. → a) the past tense · b) only present · c) only future

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

11. **a) a holiday, the beach, and sightseeing**  
12. **a) the past of buy**  
13. **a) an expression of approval**  
14. **a) a past-tense question with you**  
15. **a) the past tense**

</details>

---

## Lección 5 — Writing: My holiday

**Objetivo:** escribir sobre vacaciones en pasado.

### Ejercicios 1–5 — Completa

1. I ____ on the beach last week. → *was / were / am*  
2. She ____ the museum yesterday. → *visited / visit / visiting*  
3. We ____ in the mountains. → *were / was / are*  
4. I ____ a souvenir. → *bought / buy / buying*  
5. They ____ volleyball. → *played / play / playing*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was**  
2. **visited**  
3. **were**  
4. **bought**  
5. **played**

</details>

### Ejercicios 6–8 — Ordena

6. I / was / on / the / beach / last week.  
7. We / did / sightseeing / in / Barcelona.  
8. She / visited / the / museum / yesterday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

6. I was on the beach last week.  
7. We did sightseeing in Barcelona.  
8. She visited the museum yesterday.

</details>

### Ejercicios 9–15 — Escribe (modelos)

9. Escribe dónde estuviste la semana pasada.  
10. Dos actividades: visit + play.  
11. Dos frases: tiempo + souvenir.  
12. Pregunta y respuesta con *Were you…?*  
13. Párrafo corto (4 frases) sobre unas vacaciones.  
14. Dos frases: *I was…* + *My friends were…*  
15. Dos frases sobre ayer.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución (ejemplos)</summary>

9. I was on the beach last week.  
10. I visited the old town and played volleyball.  
11. The weather was sunny. I bought a souvenir—a small statue.  
12. Were you on the beach? Yes, I was.  
13. Last summer I was on the beach. I played volleyball and did sightseeing. The weather was sunny. I bought a souvenir.  
14. I was on the beach last week. My friends were in the mountains.  
15. Yesterday I was in town. I visited the museum.

</details>

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **was** | I **was** on the beach. |
| **were** | We **were** in the mountains. |
| **visited / played** | She **visited** the museum. |
| **sightseeing** | We did sightseeing. |
| **souvenir** | I bought a souvenir. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Continúa con la [**Unidad 48 — Sightseeing**](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-48-sightseeing-superlativos): *the biggest museum*, *the most famous square*.
