description: Habla de viajes en inglés A2: by bus/train, take the bus, get to, arrive at. Vocabulario de estación y aeropuerto. Guía Unidad 41 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Travel and Transport A2

faqs.question: ¿Se dice by bus o by the bus?
faqs.answer: Se dice by bus / by train / by plane (sin the). Con take usamos the: take the bus / take the train.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre get to y arrive at?
faqs.answer: Get to = llegar a un destino (How do I get to the airport?). Arrive at = llegar a un sitio concreto (We arrived at the station at 9). Arrive in se usa con ciudades/países (arrive in Madrid).

faqs.question: ¿Journey, trip o travel?
faqs.answer: Travel es el verbo/general. Trip es un viaje concreto (a weekend trip). Journey enfatiza el trayecto (a long train journey).

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto cómo llegar a un sitio?
faqs.answer: How do I get to + lugar? Por ejemplo: How do I get to the airport?

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 41 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-41-travel-transport-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 41 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás transporte y viajes en gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

content:
El [Módulo 4](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-40-module-4-review) ya está repasado. En la **Unidad 41 del curso A2** (*Travel & Transport*) empiezas el **Módulo 5**: hablar de **cómo te mueves** y **cómo llegas** a un sitio.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 41 — Travel & Transport](/curso-a2/unit-41)  
> **Antes:** [U40 — Module 4 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-40-module-4-review)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 41 (A2)

- Decir el medio: **by bus / by train / by plane / by car**.
- Usar **take the** + transporte.
- Usar **get to** y **arrive at / arrive in**.
- Vocabulario: *airport, station, platform, ticket, fare, journey*.
- Preguntar y explicar rutas sencillas.

![Travel and Transport A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/a2-unit41-travel-transport.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave: *by* vs *take the*

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **by** + transporte | medio en general (sin *the*) | I go **by bus**. |
| **take the** + transporte | coger un medio concreto | I **take the bus** to work. |
| **on foot** | a pie (no *by foot*) | We go **on foot**. |

> She travels **by train**.  
> We **take the underground** to the centre.

~~by the bus~~ → **by bus**  
~~take bus~~ → **take the bus**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/by-bus.mp3" title="🔊 I go by bus."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/take-the-train.mp3" title="🔊 Take the train to the airport."></audio>

---

## 2. *Get to* y *arrive at / in*

| Verbo | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **get to** + lugar | llegar / cómo llegar | How do I **get to** the station? |
| **arrive at** + sitio | estación, aeropuerto, hotel… | We **arrived at** the airport at 6. |
| **arrive in** + ciudad/país | Madrid, Spain… | They **arrived in** London yesterday. |

> How do I **get to** the museum?  
> Take the bus and **get off** at the square.  
> We **arrived at** the hotel late.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/get-to-the-airport.mp3" title="🔊 How do I get to the airport?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/arrive-at-the-station.mp3" title="🔊 We arrived at the station at nine."></audio>

![Verbs map](/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/a2-unit41-verbs-map.png)

---

## 3. Vocabulario de viaje

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **airport** | aeropuerto | Meet me at the **airport**. |
| **station** | estación | The train leaves from the **station**. |
| **platform** | andén | The train is on **platform** 3. |
| **ticket** | billete | I need a return **ticket**. |
| **fare** | tarifa / precio del trayecto | What's the **fare** to the centre? |
| **journey** | trayecto / viaje | It was a long **journey**. |
| **timetable** | horario | Check the **timetable**. |
| **delay** | retraso | There is a 20-minute **delay**. |

Otros útiles: *gate, departure, arrival, luggage, passenger, stop, get on / get off*.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/platform-three.mp3" title="🔊 The train is on platform three."></audio>

---

## 4. Preguntas útiles

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| How do I **get to** the airport? | Take the train and get off at Airport Central. |
| How long does the **journey** take? | About 40 minutes. |
| Where do I buy a **ticket**? | At the machine / at the ticket office. |
| Which **platform**? | Platform 2. |
| Is there a **delay**? | Yes — 15 minutes. |

> Excuse me, how do I **get to** the city centre?  
> **Take the bus** number 10.

![Station scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/a2-unit41-station.png)

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres decir… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Medio (general) | by + transport | by bus / by plane |
| Coger un medio | take the + transport | take the metro |
| Cómo llegar | get to | get to the hotel |
| Llegar a un sitio | arrive at | arrive at the station |
| Llegar a una ciudad | arrive in | arrive in Paris |
| A pie | on foot | go on foot |

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — To the airport

Leo needs to **get to** the **airport**. He **takes the train** from the city **station**. The **journey** takes 35 minutes. He buys a **ticket** at the machine. The train leaves from **platform** 4. There is no **delay** today. He **arrives at** the airport at 8 and looks for the gate. He prefers travelling **by train** — it's faster than going **by bus**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/reading-airport.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: To the airport"></audio>

### Diálogo — At the station

**Tourist:** Excuse me, how do I **get to** the museum?  
**Clerk:** **Take the bus** number 7 and **get off** at Green Park.  
**Tourist:** How long is the **journey**?  
**Clerk:** About 20 minutes. A single **ticket** is £2.50.  
**Tourist:** Which stop?  
**Clerk:** Ask the driver — or check the **timetable** on the app.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/dialogue-station.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: At the station"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I go ___ train.  
2. ___ the bus to the centre.  
3. How do I ___ the airport?  
4. We ___ at the hotel at 10.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-41/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~by the bus~~ → **by bus**  
2. ~~take bus~~ → **take the bus**  
3. ~~by foot~~ → **on foot**  
4. ~~arrive to the station~~ → **arrive at the station** / **get to the station**  
5. ~~arrive at London~~ → **arrive in London**  
6. ~~How I get to…?~~ → **How do I get to…?**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — *by* o *take the*

1. I usually go ___ metro.  
2. ___ train to Terminal 2.  
3. She hates travelling ___ plane.  
4. We ___ taxi when it's late. *(take)*

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. by  
2. Take the  
3. by  
4. take a / take the  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *get to* / *arrive at* / *arrive in*

1. How do I ___ the stadium?  
2. We ___ Madrid at noon.  
3. The flight ___ the airport late.  
4. When did you ___ Spain?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. get to  
2. arrived in  
3. arrived at  
4. arrive in / arrive in  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Vocabulario

Empareja:

1. platform  
2. fare  
3. timetable  
4. journey  
5. delay  

a) horario  
b) andén  
c) retraso  
d) trayecto  
e) precio del billete/trayecto

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b  
2 → e  
3 → a  
4 → d  
5 → c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. I go by the train.  
2. Take bus 12.  
3. We arrived to the station.  
4. They arrived at France.  
5. How I get to the hotel?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I go by train.  
2. Take the bus 12. / Take bus number 12.  
3. We arrived at the station.  
4. They arrived in France.  
5. How do I get to the hotel?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Voy en autobús.  
2. Coge el tren al aeropuerto.  
3. ¿Cómo llego a la estación?  
4. Llegamos al hotel a las nueve.  
5. El trayecto dura 40 minutos.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I go by bus.  
2. Take the train to the airport.  
3. How do I get to the station?  
4. We arrived at the hotel at nine.  
5. The journey takes 40 minutes.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** Excuse me, how do I ___ the airport?  
**B:** ___ the train from Central Station.  
**A:** Which ___ ?  
**B:** Platform 5. The ___ takes about half an hour.  
**A:** Is there a ___ today?  
**B:** No — it's on time.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

get to  
Take  
platform  
journey  
delay  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la mejor opción

1. Meet me ___ the airport.  
   a) in  b) at  c) by  
2. We travelled ___ car.  
   a) by  b) in the  c) on  
3. Please ___ at the next stop.  
   a) get off  b) get to  c) arrive in

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. a  
3. a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. to / get / How / I / do / the / station / ?  
2. the / Take / bus / and / at / get off / the park  
3. at / arrived / We / airport / the / 7

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. How do I get to the station?  
2. Take the bus and get off at the park.  
3. We arrived at the airport at 7.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — *journey* / *trip* / *travel*

1. I love to ___ . *(verbo)*  
2. We had a great weekend ___ to Lisbon.  
3. The train ___ was uncomfortable.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. travel  
2. trip  
3. journey  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu viaje (8–12 líneas)

Describe cómo vas del centro al aeropuerto (o a otro sitio real). Incluye:

- *by* o *take the*  
- *get to* o *arrive at*  
- al menos 3 palabras: *ticket / platform / journey / delay / station / airport*

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tablas *by* / *take the* / *get to* / *arrive*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo; anota vocabulario.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *by bus* (sin *the*)  
- [ ] Uso *take the train*  
- [ ] Pregunto *How do I get to…?*  
- [ ] Distingo *arrive at* / *arrive in*  
- [ ] Conozco *platform, ticket, journey, delay*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Aprende bloques: *get to the airport*, *take the train*, *arrive at the station*.  
2. Practica preguntar direcciones en voz alta.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 41](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-41-travel-transport-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 41 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-41).

La **Unidad 42** es **Accommodation** (hotel, reserva, check-in).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Medio | by + transport | by bus |
| Coger | take the + transport | take the metro |
| Cómo llegar | get to | get to the museum |
| Llegar (sitio) | arrive at | arrive at the hotel |
| Llegar (ciudad) | arrive in | arrive in Rome |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 42** verás **Accommodation**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 42 — Accommodation](/curso-a2/unit-42)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 41 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-41-travel-transport-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 41 — Travel & Transport](/curso-a2/unit-41)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U40 — Module 4 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-40-module-4-review)
- [Inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-viajar)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Travel and transport: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: Accommodation A2: book, check in, single/double room
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 42 del curso A2: book, check in/out, tipos de habitación y servicios del hotel, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Reserva y habla de alojamiento en inglés A2: hotel, hostel, apartment, check in/out, single/double room, WiFi y breakfast included. Guía Unidad 42.
alt: Esquema Accommodation A2 hotel English

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa check in y check out?
faqs.answer: Check in es registrarse al llegar al hotel. Check out es dejar la habitación y pagar al marcharte.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre single y double room?
faqs.answer: Single room = habitación individual (una persona). Double room = habitación doble (normalmente una cama de matrimonio o para dos).

faqs.question: ¿Cómo reservo una habitación en inglés?
faqs.answer: I'd like to book a room, please. / Do you have a double room for two nights?

faqs.question: ¿Breakfast included qué significa?
faqs.answer: Que el desayuno está incluido en el precio de la habitación.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 42 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-42-accommodation-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 42 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás vocabulario y diálogos de alojamiento.

content:
En la [Unidad 41](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-41-travel-transport) llegaste al destino. En la **Unidad 42 del curso A2** (*Accommodation*) aprendes a **reservar** y **gestionar** el alojamiento.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 42 — Accommodation](/curso-a2/unit-42)  
> **Antes:** [U41 — Travel & Transport](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-41-travel-transport)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 42 (A2)

- Hablar de **hotel / hostel / apartment**.
- Usar **book**, **check in**, **check out**.
- Pedir **single / double room**.
- Preguntar servicios: **WiFi**, **breakfast included**, **room service**.
- Hacer un diálogo de **reserva** o **recepción**.

![Accommodation A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/a2-unit42-accommodation.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave: el ciclo del hotel

| Paso | Inglés | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1. Reservar | **book** a room | I'd like to **book** a room. |
| 2. Llegar | **check in** | We'd like to **check in**, please. |
| 3. Estancia | stay / room key | Here's your **key card**. |
| 4. Salir | **check out** | What time is **check-out**? |

> I'd like to **book** a **double room** for two nights.  
> Can I **check in** early?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/book-a-room.mp3" title="🔊 I'd like to book a room, please."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/check-in.mp3" title="🔊 We'd like to check in."></audio>

![Hotel steps](/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/a2-unit42-hotel-steps.png)

---

## 2. Tipos de alojamiento y habitación

| Palabra | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| **hotel** | hotel |
| **hostel** | hostal / albergue |
| **apartment / flat** | apartamento |
| **single room** | individual |
| **double room** | doble |
| **twin room** | dos camas individuales |
| **suite** | suite (más cara) |

> Do you have a **single room**?  
> I'd like a **double room** with a bathroom.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/double-room.mp3" title="🔊 I'd like a double room for two nights."></audio>

---

## 3. Servicios y preguntas útiles

| Expresión | Uso |
| :--- | :--- |
| **reception** | recepción |
| **reservation / booking** | reserva |
| **WiFi** | WiFi |
| **breakfast included** | desayuno incluido |
| **room service** | servicio de habitaciones |
| **key card** | tarjeta de la habitación |
| **Is there…?** | ¿Hay…? |
| **How much is…?** | ¿Cuánto cuesta…? |

> **Is there** WiFi in the rooms?  
> **Is breakfast included**?  
> **How much is** a double room per night?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/breakfast-included.mp3" title="🔊 Is breakfast included?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/is-there-wifi.mp3" title="🔊 Is there WiFi in the rooms?"></audio>

---

## 4. Diálogos modelo

### Reservar (por teléfono / web)

> **Guest:** Hello. I'd like to **book** a room for Friday and Saturday.  
> **Hotel:** Of course. **Single** or **double**?  
> **Guest:** A **double room**, please. Is **breakfast included**?  
> **Hotel:** Yes. May I have your name?

### Check-in

> **Guest:** Good evening. We have a **reservation** under Garcia.  
> **Reception:** Yes — a double room for two nights. May I see your ID?  
> **Guest:** Here you are. What time is **check-out**?  
> **Reception:** 11 a.m. Your room is 214. Here's your **key card**.

![Reception](/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/a2-unit42-reception.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/check-out.mp3" title="🔊 What time is check-out?"></audio>

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Di… |
| :--- | :--- |
| Reservar | I'd like to **book** a room. |
| Habitación individual/doble | a **single** / **double** room |
| Registrarte | I'd like to **check in**. |
| Preguntar desayuno | Is **breakfast included**? |
| Preguntar WiFi | **Is there** WiFi? |
| Marcharte | I'd like to **check out**. |

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — At the Blue Hotel

Ana and Leo **book** a **double room** at the Blue Hotel. **Breakfast is included**. They **check in** at 3 p.m. The **reception** gives them a **key card** for room 305. **There is** free **WiFi** and **room service** until 11 p.m. The next morning they have breakfast downstairs. They **check out** at 10:30 and leave their bags at reception until their train.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/reading-hotel.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: At the Blue Hotel"></audio>

### Diálogo — Booking

**Reception:** City Hotel, good morning.  
**Guest:** Hi. I'd like to **book** a room for next weekend.  
**Reception:** How many nights?  
**Guest:** Two. Do you have a **single room**?  
**Reception:** Yes. **Breakfast included**. 80 euros per night.  
**Guest:** Perfect. Is **there** a lift?  
**Reception:** Yes. And free **WiFi**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/dialogue-booking.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Booking"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I'd like to ___ a room.  
2. We'd like to ___ in, please.  
3. Is breakfast ___ ?  
4. What time is ___ ?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-42/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~I want book a room.~~ → **I'd like to book** a room.  
2. ~~check-in me~~ → **I'd like to check in.**  
3. ~~a individual room~~ → **a single room**  
4. ~~Is there WiFi?~~ ✅ (correcto) / ~~Have WiFi?~~ → **Do you have WiFi?** / **Is there WiFi?**  
5. ~~breakfast include~~ → **breakfast included**  
6. ~~What hour is check out?~~ → **What time is check-out?**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa

1. I'd like to ___ a double room.  
2. Guests ___ in at reception.  
3. You ___ out before 11.  
4. Is breakfast ___ ?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. book  
2. check  
3. check / must check  
4. included  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Single o double

1. One person → ___ room  
2. Two people, one big bed → ___ room  
3. Two single beds → ___ room

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. single  
2. double  
3. twin  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *Is there…?* / *Do you have…?*

1. ___ WiFi in the rooms?  
2. ___ a restaurant in the hotel?  
3. ___ any free rooms tonight?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Is there / Do you have  
2. Is there / Do you have  
3. Do you have / Are there  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. I like to book a room. *(reserva ahora)*  
2. We want check in.  
3. A individual room, please.  
4. Breakfast is include.  
5. What hour is check-out?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'd like to book a room.  
2. We want to check in. / We'd like to check in.  
3. A single room, please.  
4. Breakfast is included.  
5. What time is check-out?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Querría reservar una habitación doble.  
2. ¿El desayuno está incluido?  
3. ¿Hay WiFi?  
4. Querríamos hacer el check-in.  
5. ¿A qué hora es el check-out?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'd like to book a double room.  
2. Is breakfast included?  
3. Is there WiFi? / Do you have WiFi?  
4. We'd like to check in.  
5. What time is check-out?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja

1. reception  
2. key card  
3. room service  
4. hostel  
5. reservation  

a) reserva  
b) recepción  
c) comida a la habitación  
d) tarjeta de acceso  
e) alojamiento más barato / compartido

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b  
2 → d  
3 → c  
4 → e  
5 → a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** Good evening. We have a ___ under Lopez.  
**B:** A ___ room for two nights. May I see your passport?  
**A:** Sure. Is ___ included?  
**B:** Yes. ___ is on the second floor. Here's your ___.  
**A:** Thanks. What time is ___ ?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

reservation / booking  
double  
breakfast  
Your room / Room 2xx  
key card  
check-out  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la mejor opción

1. I'd like to ___ a room for tonight.  
   a) book  b) check out  c) stay  
2. Guests usually ___ between 2 and 4 p.m.  
   a) check out  b) check in  c) book  
3. A ___ room is for one person.  
   a) double  b) twin  c) single

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. a  
2. b  
3. c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Ordena

1. book / to / I'd / like / a / room / single  
2. there / Is / WiFi / free / ?  
3. check / We'd / to / like / in

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'd like to book a single room.  
2. Is there free WiFi?  
3. We'd like to check in.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu diálogo (8–12 líneas)

Escribe un diálogo en recepción. Incluye:

- *book* o *reservation*  
- *single* o *double room*  
- *breakfast included* o *WiFi*  
- *check in* o *check-out*

**Modelo:** los diálogos de las secciones 4 y 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Ciclo book → check in → check out.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10 en voz alta.

### Checklist

- [ ] Sé decir *book a room*  
- [ ] Distingo *single / double / twin*  
- [ ] Uso *check in* / *check out*  
- [ ] Pregunto *Is breakfast included?* / *Is there WiFi?*  
- [ ] Puedo hacer un mini diálogo de recepción

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Combina con [Would like](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-37-would-like-vs-like): *I'd like to book…*  
2. Practica el check-in en voz alta (pasaporte + room number).  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 42](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-42-accommodation-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 42 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-42).

La **Unidad 43** es **Holiday Activities** (qué hacer de vacaciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Reservar | book a room | I'd like to book a room. |
| Habitaciones | single / double / twin | a double room |
| Llegar | check in | We'd like to check in. |
| Salir | check out | What time is check-out? |
| Servicios | Is there…? / included | Is breakfast included? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 43** verás **Holiday Activities**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 43 — Holiday Activities](/curso-a2/unit-43)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 42 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-42-accommodation-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 42 — Accommodation](/curso-a2/unit-42)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U41 — Travel & Transport](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-41-travel-transport)
- [U37 — Would like vs Like](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-37-would-like-vs-like)
- [Inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-viajar)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Hotels and accommodation: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: Holiday Activities A2: sightseeing, hiking y experiencias
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 43 del curso A2: actividades de vacaciones y contraste Past Simple / Present Perfect, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Habla de vacaciones en inglés A2: sightseeing, guided tour, beach, hiking, souvenir. Contraste Past Simple y Present Perfect. Guía Unidad 43 con audios.
alt: Esquema Holiday Activities A2
keywords: present perfect vs past simple viaje

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa sightseeing?
faqs.answer: Ir a ver los lugares turísticos de una ciudad (monumentos, plazas, museos). We went sightseeing in Rome.

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso Past Simple y cuándo Present Perfect en vacaciones?
faqs.answer: Past Simple con tiempo acabado (last year, yesterday, in 2022): I visited Paris last summer. Present Perfect para experiencia sin tiempo concreto: I have visited Paris.

faqs.question: ¿Qué es un guided tour?
faqs.answer: Una visita guiada: un guía te explica el lugar. We took a guided tour of the museum.

faqs.question: ¿Have you ever… qué pregunta?
faqs.answer: Pregunta si alguna vez has hecho algo en tu vida: Have you ever been hiking?

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 43 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-43-holiday-activities-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 43 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás actividades de vacaciones y experiencias de viaje.

content:
En la [Unidad 42](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-42-accommodation) reservaste hotel. En la **Unidad 43 del curso A2** (*Holiday Activities*) cuentas **qué hiciste** y **qué has hecho** de vacaciones.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 43 — Holiday Activities](/curso-a2/unit-43)  
> **Antes:** [U42 — Accommodation](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-42-accommodation)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 43 (A2)

- Vocabulario: **sightseeing**, **guided tour**, **beach**, **hiking**, **souvenir**.
- Contar vacaciones con **Past Simple**.
- Hablar de experiencias con **Present Perfect** (*Have you ever…?*).
- Escribir una postal / mini blog de viaje.
- Evitar mezclar *I went* / *I have been* sin criterio.

![Holiday Activities A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/a2-unit43-holiday-activities.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario de vacaciones

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **sightseeing** | turismo / ver lugares | We went **sightseeing**. |
| **guided tour** | visita guiada | We took a **guided tour**. |
| **beach** | playa | They relaxed on the **beach**. |
| **hiking** | senderismo | I love **hiking** in the mountains. |
| **souvenir** | recuerdo | I bought a **souvenir**. |
| **sunbathe** | tomar el sol | She **sunbathed** all afternoon. |
| **museum / castle** | museo / castillo | We visited a **castle**. |
| **local food** | comida local | Try the **local food**. |

> We went **sightseeing** in the morning and to the **beach** in the afternoon.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/sightseeing.mp3" title="🔊 We went sightseeing in Rome."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/guided-tour.mp3" title="🔊 We took a guided tour of the museum."></audio>

---

## 2. Past Simple: vacaciones con tiempo concreto

Usa **Past Simple** cuando hay un **tiempo acabado**: *yesterday, last summer, in 2023, two years ago*.

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Affirmative | We **visited** Lisbon last July. |
| Negative | We **didn't go** hiking. |
| Question | **Did** you **buy** any souvenirs? |

> Last year I **went** to Greece.  
> We **stayed** near the beach and **took** a guided tour.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/last-year-greece.mp3" title="🔊 Last year I went to Greece."></audio>

---

## 3. Present Perfect: experiencia (sin tiempo concreto)

Usa **Present Perfect** para decir si **alguna vez** has hecho algo (experiencia de vida), sin decir cuándo.

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Affirmative | I **have visited** Italy. / I've **been** hiking. |
| Negative | I **haven't been** to Japan. |
| Question | **Have** you **ever** been sightseeing in London? |

> **Have you ever** taken a guided tour?  
> Yes, I **have**. / No, I **haven't**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/have-you-ever.mp3" title="🔊 Have you ever been hiking?"></audio>

![Past vs Present Perfect](/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/a2-unit43-past-vs-perfect.png)

---

## 4. Contraste rápido

| Pregunta mental | Usa | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| ¿Cuándo? (fecha / last…) | **Past Simple** | I **went** there **last summer**. |
| ¿Alguna vez en tu vida? | **Present Perfect** | I **have been** there. |
| Experiencia + detalle de cuándo | Perfect → Past | I've been to Rome. I **went** in 2022. |

~~I have gone to Paris last year.~~ → **I went to Paris last year.**  
~~Did you ever visit Rome?~~ *(mejor)* → **Have you ever visited Rome?**

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres decir… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ver la ciudad | go sightseeing | We went sightseeing. |
| Visita con guía | take a guided tour | We took a guided tour. |
| Experiencia | Have you ever…? | Have you ever been hiking? |
| Vacaciones pasadas | Past Simple + time | We swam every day last week. |
| Recuerdo | buy a souvenir | I bought a souvenir. |

![Holiday scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/a2-unit43-holiday-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — A postcard from Porto

Hi! We're in Porto. Yesterday we **went sightseeing** and **took** a **guided tour** of the old town. We **haven't bought** any **souvenirs** yet, but we **have tried** the local food — delicious! Tomorrow we want to go to the **beach**. Have you ever **been** to Portugal? See you soon!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/reading-postcard.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A postcard from Porto"></audio>

### Diálogo — Talking about holidays

**Ana:** **Have you ever** been **hiking**?  
**Leo:** Yes, I **have**. I **went** hiking in Asturias **last year**.  
**Ana:** Nice! Did you buy a **souvenir**?  
**Leo:** Just a photo book. What about you?  
**Ana:** I've **never** been hiking, but I **love** the **beach**. We **went** to Cadiz **in August**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/dialogue-holidays.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Talking about holidays"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. We ___ sightseeing yesterday.  
2. ___ you ever ___ a guided tour?  
3. I ___ a souvenir last week.  
4. She ___ never ___ hiking.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-43/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~I have visited Rome last year.~~ → **I visited Rome last year.**  
2. ~~Did you ever go to Japan?~~ → **Have you ever been to Japan?**  
3. ~~We did sightseeing.~~ → **We went sightseeing.**  
4. ~~I have gone to Paris~~ *(si vives fuera y ya volviste; en BrE suele preferirse)* → **I've been to Paris.**  
5. ~~buy a memory~~ → **buy a souvenir**  
6. ~~a guide tour~~ → **a guided tour**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Vocabulario

Completa: *sightseeing / hiking / souvenir / beach / guided tour*

1. We walked around the city and took photos: ___.  
2. A person explained the museum: ___.  
3. We walked in the mountains: ___.  
4. I swam and sunbathed: ___.  
5. I bought a small gift: ___.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. sightseeing  
2. guided tour  
3. hiking  
4. beach  
5. souvenir  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Past Simple o Present Perfect

1. I ___ (visit) Madrid in 2021.  
2. ___ you ever ___ (try) local food in Mexico?  
3. We ___ (not buy) souvenirs yesterday.  
4. She ___ (be) to Italy three times.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. visited  
2. Have / tried  
3. didn't buy  
4. has been  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Corrige el error

1. I have gone to London last summer.  
2. We did sightseeing all day.  
3. Did you ever take a guided tour?  
4. I buyed a souvenir.  
5. Have you been hiking yesterday?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I went to London last summer.  
2. We went sightseeing all day.  
3. Have you ever taken a guided tour?  
4. I bought a souvenir.  
5. Did you go hiking yesterday? / Have you been hiking?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce al inglés

1. Fuimos de sightseeing ayer.  
2. ¿Has hecho alguna vez senderismo?  
3. Compramos un recuerdo.  
4. Hicimos una visita guiada el lunes.  
5. Nunca he estado en la playa en invierno.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. We went sightseeing yesterday.  
2. Have you ever been hiking?  
3. We bought a souvenir.  
4. We took a guided tour on Monday.  
5. I have never been to the beach in winter.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Empareja

1. Have you ever…?  
2. last summer  
3. guided tour  
4. souvenir  

a) Past Simple time expression  
b) experience question  
c) something you buy to remember the trip  
d) visit with a guide

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b  
2 → a  
3 → d  
4 → c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** ___ you ever ___ to Greece?  
**B:** Yes, I ___. I ___ there last June.  
**A:** What did you do?  
**B:** We ___ sightseeing and we ___ on the beach.  
**A:** Did you buy a ___ ?  
**B:** Yes — a small vase.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

Have / been  
have / went  
went / sunbathed (or relaxed / swam)  
souvenir  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la mejor opción

1. We ___ a guided tour yesterday.  
   a) took  b) have taken  c) taking  
2. ___ you ever tried Japanese food?  
   a) Did  b) Have  c) Do  
3. They ___ souvenirs yet.  
   a) didn't buy  b) haven't bought  c) don't buy

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. a  
2. b  
3. b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. sightseeing / went / We / yesterday  
2. ever / you / Have / hiking / been / ?  
3. tour / a / took / guided / They

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. We went sightseeing yesterday.  
2. Have you ever been hiking?  
3. They took a guided tour.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Experiencia + detalle

Completa con Present Perfect + Past Simple:

1. I ___ (be) to Rome. I ___ (go) in 2020.  
2. She ___ (try) paella. She ___ (eat) it in Valencia last year.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. have been / went  
2. has tried / ate  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu postal (8–12 líneas)

Escribe una postal de vacaciones. Incluye:

- 2 actividades (*sightseeing / beach / hiking / guided tour…*)  
- 1 frase en **Past Simple** con tiempo  
- 1 frase en **Present Perfect** (*Have you ever…?* o *I have…*)  
- 1 *souvenir* (opcional)

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + contraste Past / Perfect.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha postal y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *go sightseeing* / *take a guided tour*  
- [ ] Past Simple con *last / yesterday / in 20XX*  
- [ ] Present Perfect con *ever / never / experience*  
- [ ] No mezclo *I have gone… last year*  
- [ ] Puedo escribir una mini postal

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregúntate siempre: ¿digo **cuándo** o solo **experiencia**?  
2. Lista 5 actividades de tus últimas vacaciones en Past Simple.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 43](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-43-holiday-activities-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 43 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-43).

La **Unidad 44** es **The Weather** (describir el tiempo).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Actividad | go sightseeing / take a tour | We went sightseeing. |
| Tiempo concreto | Past Simple | We went last July. |
| Experiencia | Present Perfect | I have been hiking. |
| Pregunta experiencia | Have you ever…? | Have you ever…? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 44** verás **The Weather**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a2/unit-44)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 43 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-43-holiday-activities-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 43 — Holiday Activities](/curso-a2/unit-43)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U41 — Travel & Transport](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-41-travel-transport)
- [U42 — Accommodation](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-42-accommodation)
- [Present Perfect vs Past Simple](/blog/gramatica/present-perfect-vs-past-simple)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Holidays and travel: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: The Weather A2: Vocabulario, Pronóstico y Predicciones
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 44 del curso A2: describir el tiempo y hacer predicciones con going to y will, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Describe el tiempo en inglés A2: sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy. It's…, It's going to… y will. Guía Unidad 44 con audios, pronósticos y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema The Weather A2

faqs.question: ¿Se dice It's sunny o There's sun?
faqs.answer: Lo natural es It's sunny / It's raining. También The sun is shining. There's sun suena poco natural.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre It's going to rain y It will rain?
faqs.answer: It's going to rain suele basarse en indicios ahora (nubes negras). It will rain es predicción más general o del pronóstico.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo la temperatura?
faqs.answer: It's 20 degrees (Celsius). / It's twenty degrees. También It's hot / warm / cool / cold.

faqs.question: ¿Rain o rainy?
faqs.answer: Rain puede ser verbo/sustantivo: It rains / There's rain. Rainy es adjetivo: It's a rainy day.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 44 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-44-the-weather-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 44 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás vocabulario y predicciones del tiempo.

content:
En la [Unidad 43](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-43-holiday-activities) hablaste de vacaciones. En la **Unidad 44 del curso A2** (*The Weather*) describes **cómo está el tiempo** y **qué va a hacer**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a2/unit-44)  
> **Antes:** [U43 — Holiday Activities](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-43-holiday-activities)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 44 (A2)

- Vocabulario: **sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, foggy, storm**.
- Describir ahora: **It's…**
- Predicciones: **It's going to…** / **It will…**
- Hablar de **temperaturas**.
- Entender un **pronóstico** sencillo.

![The Weather A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/a2-unit44-the-weather.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario del tiempo

| Adjetivo / palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **sunny** | soleado | It's **sunny** today. |
| **rainy** | lluvioso | It's a **rainy** morning. |
| **cloudy** | nublado | It's **cloudy**. |
| **windy** | ventoso | It's very **windy**. |
| **foggy** | con niebla | It's **foggy** this morning. |
| **storm / stormy** | tormenta | There's a **storm**. |
| **hot / warm / cool / cold** | calor → frío | It's **hot** in July. |
| **snow / snowy** | nieve | It's **snowing**. |

Verbos útiles: **rain**, **snow**, **shine**.

> It's **raining**. / The sun is **shining**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/its-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 It's sunny today."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/its-raining.mp3" title="🔊 It's raining."></audio>

---

## 2. Describir ahora: *It's…*

| Estructura | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| It's + adjective | It's **cold**. / It's **cloudy**. |
| It's + -ing (weather verb) | It's **raining**. / It's **snowing**. |
| There's a + noun | There's a **storm**. |

Preguntas:

> What's the weather **like**?  
> What's the temperature?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/whats-the-weather-like.mp3" title="🔊 What's the weather like?"></audio>

---

## 3. Predicciones: *going to* y *will*

| Forma | Cuándo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **It's going to…** | indicios ahora / plan del cielo | Look at those clouds — it's **going to rain**. |
| **It will…** | predicción / pronóstico | Tomorrow **it will be** sunny. |

> It's **going to be** windy this afternoon.  
> Next week **it will be** warmer.

También: **I think it will…** / **It might…** (posibilidad suave).

![Forecast](/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/a2-unit44-forecast.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/going-to-rain.mp3" title="🔊 It's going to rain."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/it-will-be-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 Tomorrow it will be sunny."></audio>

---

## 4. Temperaturas

| Expresión | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| It's + number + degrees | It's **18 degrees**. |
| below zero | It's **below zero**. |
| high / low | The **high** will be 25°. |

En muchos países se usa **Celsius**. En conversación: *It's twenty degrees.*

> It's **22 degrees** and sunny — perfect for the beach.

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres decir… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Tiempo ahora | It's + adj / -ing | It's windy. / It's raining. |
| Preguntar | What's the weather like? | What's the weather like? |
| Predicción con indicios | going to | It's going to snow. |
| Pronóstico | will | It will be cloudy. |
| Temperatura | degrees | It's 10 degrees. |

![Weather scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/a2-unit44-weather-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Weekend forecast

Today it's **cloudy** and **cool** — about **14 degrees**. This afternoon it's **going to rain**, so take an umbrella. Tomorrow **it will be sunny** and warmer: a **high** of **21 degrees**. Perfect for a walk! On Sunday it **might** be **windy**, but there won't be a **storm**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/reading-forecast.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Weekend forecast"></audio>

### Diálogo — Before a trip

**Ana:** What's the weather **like** in Lisbon?  
**Leo:** Today it's **sunny**. Tomorrow **it's going to be** hotter.  
**Ana:** Will it rain?  
**Leo:** I don't think so. The forecast says **it will be** dry all weekend.  
**Ana:** Great — no umbrella then!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/dialogue-trip.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Before a trip"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. It's ___ today. *(soleado)*  
2. Look — it's ___ to rain.  
3. Tomorrow it ___ be cold.  
4. What's the weather ___ ?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-44/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~It's a sun.~~ → **It's sunny.** / **The sun is shining.**  
2. ~~It's rain.~~ → **It's raining.** / **It's rainy.**  
3. ~~There is sunny.~~ → **It's sunny.**  
4. ~~It will raining.~~ → **It will rain.** / **It will be raining.**  
5. ~~How is the weather?~~ *(posible)* → más natural: **What's the weather like?**  
6. ~~20 grades~~ → **20 degrees**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige el adjetivo

1. The sun is out → ___  
2. There are many clouds → ___  
3. The wind is strong → ___  
4. You can't see well — thick mist → ___  
5. Lots of rain → ___

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. sunny  
2. cloudy  
3. windy  
4. foggy  
5. rainy  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con *It's…*

1. ___ snowing.  
2. ___ very hot today.  
3. ___ a storm outside. *(There's)*  
4. ___ going to be cold tonight.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. It's  
2. It's  
3. There's  
4. It's  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *going to* o *will*

1. Look at the sky! It ___ rain.  
2. According to the forecast, tomorrow it ___ be sunny.  
3. Take a coat — it ___ be windy later. *(indicio: viento empieza)*  
4. I think it ___ snow in the mountains next week.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. 's going to / is going to  
2. will  
3. 's going to / is going to  
4. will  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. It's a sunny.  
2. It's rain now.  
3. What the weather like?  
4. It will raining tomorrow.  
5. It's 15 grades.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. It's sunny.  
2. It's raining now. / It's rainy now.  
3. What's the weather like?  
4. It will rain tomorrow.  
5. It's 15 degrees.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Hoy está nublado.  
2. Está lloviendo.  
3. Va a hacer viento esta tarde.  
4. Mañana hará sol.  
5. ¿Qué tiempo hace?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. It's cloudy today.  
2. It's raining.  
3. It's going to be windy this afternoon.  
4. It will be sunny tomorrow. / It's going to be sunny tomorrow.  
5. What's the weather like?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja

1. sunny  
2. storm  
3. degrees  
4. forecast  
5. foggy  

a) pronóstico  
b) soleado  
c) niebla  
d) tormenta  
e) grados

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b  
2 → d  
3 → e  
4 → a  
5 → c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** What's the weather ___ in your city?  
**B:** It's ___ and cold — about 8 ___.  
**A:** ___ it rain later?  
**B:** Yes, it's ___ to rain this evening.  
**A:** Then I ___ take my umbrella.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

like  
cloudy (or rainy/windy) / degrees  
Will / Is  
going  
will / 'll  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la mejor opción

1. ___ the weather like today?  
   a) How is  b) What's  c) What's is  
2. There's ___ storm coming.  
   a) a  b) an  c) the  
3. Tomorrow it will ___ warmer.  
   a) being  b) be  c) to be

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. a  
3. b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Ordena

1. sunny / It's / and / warm  
2. rain / going / It's / to  
3. weather / What's / like / the / ?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. It's sunny and warm.  
2. It's going to rain.  
3. What's the weather like?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu pronóstico (8–12 líneas)

Describe el tiempo en tu ciudad: hoy + mañana + fin de semana. Incluye:

- 3 adjetivos (*sunny / rainy / cloudy…*)  
- 1 *going to*  
- 1 *will*  
- 1 temperatura (*degrees*)

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + *It's…*  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha forecast y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *It's sunny / raining / cloudy*  
- [ ] Pregunto *What's the weather like?*  
- [ ] Distingo *going to* (indicios) y *will* (pronóstico)  
- [ ] Digo temperaturas con *degrees*  
- [ ] Evito *It's a sun* / *15 grades*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Mira el cielo y di una frase en voz alta cada día.  
2. Lee un forecast en inglés (BBC Weather / app) y resume en 3 frases.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 44](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-44-the-weather-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 44 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-44).

La **Unidad 45** es **Entertainment & Media** (cine, series, música).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ahora | It's + adj / -ing | It's cold. / It's raining. |
| Pregunta | What's the weather like? | What's the weather like? |
| Indicios | going to | It's going to rain. |
| Pronóstico | will | It will be sunny. |
| Temperatura | degrees | It's 20 degrees. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 45** verás **Entertainment & Media**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 45 — Entertainment & Media](/curso-a2/unit-45)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 44 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-44-the-weather-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a2/unit-44)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U43 — Holiday Activities](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-43-holiday-activities)
- [U25 — Futuros: going to / will](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Weather: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: Entertainment & Media A2: watch, listen to, prefer
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 45 del curso A2: hablar de películas, series y música con watch, listen to, like + -ing y prefer, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Habla de cine, series y música en inglés A2: watch, listen to, read; like + -ing; prefer. Guía Unidad 45 con audios, reseñas y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Entertainment & Media A2

faqs.question: ¿Se dice listen music o listen to music?
faqs.answer: Se dice listen to music / listen to the radio. El to es obligatorio con listen cuando hay objeto.

faqs.question: ¿Like watching o like watch?
faqs.answer: Tras like / love / hate / enjoy suele ir el gerundio: I like watching films. I like to watch también es posible, pero en A2 prioriza like + -ing.

faqs.question: ¿Film o movie?
faqs.answer: Film es más británico; movie más americano. Ambos se entienden. En exámenes UK suele verse film.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre I like y I prefer?
faqs.answer: I like = me gusta. I prefer = me gusta más (comparación). I prefer comedies to dramas.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 45 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-45-entertainment-media-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 45 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás vocabulario y estructuras relacionadas con ocio y medios.

content:
En la [Unidad 44](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-44-the-weather) hablaste del tiempo. En la **Unidad 45 del curso A2** (*Entertainment & Media*) hablas de **cine, series, música y noticias**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 45 — Entertainment & Media](/curso-a2/unit-45)  
> **Antes:** [U44 — The Weather](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-44-the-weather)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 45 (A2)

- Vocabulario: **film, series, concert, documentary, news** y **géneros**.
- Verbos: **watch**, **listen to**, **read**.
- Gustos: **like / love / enjoy + -ing**.
- Comparar: **prefer… to…**.
- Entender una **reseña** sencilla y **recomendar**.

![Entertainment & Media A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/a2-unit45-entertainment-media.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario: medios y géneros

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **film / movie** | película | I watched a great **film**. |
| **series** | serie | This **series** has 8 episodes. |
| **documentary** | documental | We saw a **documentary** about space. |
| **concert** | concierto | We're going to a **concert**. |
| **news** | noticias | I read the **news** online. |
| **podcast** | podcast | She listens to a **podcast**. |

Géneros útiles: **comedy**, **drama**, **action**, **romance**, **horror**, **crime**, **science fiction**.

> I love **comedies**. / I don't like **horror** films.

![Genres](/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/a2-unit45-genres.png)

---

## 2. Verbos: *watch*, *listen to*, *read*

| Verbo | Uso típico | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **watch** | TV, films, series, sports | I **watch** films at the weekend. |
| **listen to** | music, radio, podcasts | I **listen to** music every day. |
| **read** | books, news, magazines | She **reads** the news in the morning. |

Importante: **listen to** (no *listen music*).

> Do you **watch** series on Netflix?  
> I **listen to** rock music.  
> He **reads** comics.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/i-watch-films.mp3" title="🔊 I watch films at the weekend."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/listen-to-music.mp3" title="🔊 I listen to music every day."></audio>

---

## 3. Gustos: *like* + *-ing*

Tras **like / love / hate / enjoy** suele ir el gerundio (**-ing**):

| Estructura | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| like + -ing | I **like watching** series. |
| love + -ing | She **loves listening** to jazz. |
| hate + -ing | He **hates reading** the news. |
| enjoy + -ing | We **enjoy going** to concerts. |

> I like **watching** documentaries.  
> Do you enjoy **listening** to podcasts?

También existe *like to + infinitive*, pero en A2 prioriza **like + -ing**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/i-like-watching.mp3" title="🔊 I like watching series."></audio>

---

## 4. Preferir: *prefer… to…*

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| prefer + noun | I **prefer** comedies. |
| prefer A to B | I **prefer** comedies **to** dramas. |
| prefer + -ing | I **prefer watching** films at home. |

> I prefer **series** to **films**.  
> She prefers **listening** to music **to** watching TV.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/i-prefer-comedies.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer comedies to dramas."></audio>

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres decir… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ver TV / cine | watch | I watch series. |
| Oír música | listen to | I listen to pop. |
| Leer noticias | read | I read the news. |
| Me gusta… | like + -ing | I like watching films. |
| Prefiero… | prefer… to… | I prefer comedy to horror. |

![Media scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/a2-unit45-media-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — A short review

Last night I **watched** a **documentary** about the ocean. It was interesting and a bit sad. I usually **prefer comedies**, but this **film** was excellent. My sister **likes watching series** on her phone. She **listens to** podcasts too. On Friday we're going to a **concert**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/reading-review.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: A short review"></audio>

### Diálogo — A recommendation

**Mia:** Have you **seen** that new **series**?  
**Omar:** Not yet. Is it good?  
**Mia:** Yes — I **love watching** crime dramas.  
**Omar:** I **prefer films**, but this series is brilliant.  
**Mia:** Do you want to **watch** episode one tonight?  
**Omar:** Sure!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/dialogue-recommend.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: A recommendation"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I ___ films at the weekend. *(ver)*  
2. I ___ to music every day.  
3. I like ___ series. *(-ing)*  
4. I prefer comedies ___ dramas.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-45/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~listen music~~ → **listen to music**  
2. ~~I like watch films.~~ → **I like watching films.**  
3. ~~I prefer comedy than drama.~~ → **I prefer comedy to drama.**  
4. ~~see a film~~ *(a veces OK)* → más natural para cine/TV: **watch a film**  
5. ~~a serie~~ → **a series** (singular y plural suelen ser *series*)  
6. ~~the news are~~ → **the news is** *(uncountable)*

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige el verbo

1. ___ a film on TV → watch / listen to / read  
2. ___ to a podcast → watch / listen to / read  
3. ___ the newspaper → watch / listen to / read  
4. ___ a football match → watch / listen to / read  
5. ___ the news online → watch / listen to / read

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. watch  
2. listen to  
3. read  
4. watch  
5. read (también *watch the news* en TV)

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con *to* si hace falta

1. listen ___ music  
2. watch ___ films  
3. listen ___ the radio  
4. read ___ magazines

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. to  
2. — (nada)  
3. to  
4. — (nada)

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *like* + *-ing*

1. I like ___ (watch) series.  
2. She loves ___ (listen) to jazz.  
3. They enjoy ___ (go) to concerts.  
4. He hates ___ (read) long books.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. watching  
2. listening  
3. going  
4. reading  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — *prefer… to…*

1. I prefer films ___ series.  
2. She prefers comedy ___ horror.  
3. We prefer ___ (watch) at home ___ going to the cinema.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. to  
2. to  
3. watching / to  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. I listen music every day.  
2. I like watch documentaries.  
3. I prefer action than romance.  
4. The news are interesting.  
5. This is a good serie.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I listen to music every day.  
2. I like watching documentaries.  
3. I prefer action to romance.  
4. The news is interesting.  
5. This is a good series.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Traduce al inglés

1. Veo películas el fin de semana.  
2. Escucho música todos los días.  
3. Me gusta ver series.  
4. Prefiero las comedias a los dramas.  
5. ¿Has visto esa serie nueva?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I watch films at the weekend.  
2. I listen to music every day.  
3. I like watching series.  
4. I prefer comedies to dramas.  
5. Have you seen that new series?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja

1. documentary  
2. concert  
3. comedy  
4. news  

a) live music event  
b) funny film / show  
c) information about current events  
d) non-fiction film about real life

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → d  
2 → a  
3 → b  
4 → c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** Do you ___ watching films?  
**B:** Yes. I ___ comedies ___ dramas.  
**A:** Do you ___ to music too?  
**B:** Every day. And I ___ the news in the morning.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

like / prefer / to  
listen  
read  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Ordena

1. watching / like / I / series  
2. to / listen / music / I  
3. comedies / prefer / I / to / dramas

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I like watching series.  
2. I listen to music.  
3. I prefer comedies to dramas.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu recomendación (8–12 líneas)

Recomienda una película o serie. Incluye:

- 1 *watch / listen to / read*  
- 1 *like / love + -ing*  
- 1 *prefer… to…*  
- 1 género (*comedy / drama / documentary…*)

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + *watch / listen to / read*  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha review y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *watch / listen to / read* correctamente  
- [ ] Digo *I like watching…*  
- [ ] Comparo con *prefer… to…*  
- [ ] Nombró géneros (*comedy, drama…*)  
- [ ] Evito *listen music* y *a serie*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Di en voz alta qué viste / escuchaste ayer.  
2. Lee una reseña corta en inglés y copia 3 frases útiles.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 45](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-45-entertainment-media-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 45 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-45).

La **Unidad 46** es **Shopping & Services** (compras y servicios).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ver | watch | I watch films. |
| Oír | listen to | I listen to music. |
| Leer | read | I read the news. |
| Gustos | like + -ing | I like watching series. |
| Preferir | prefer A to B | I prefer comedy to horror. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 46** verás **Shopping & Services**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 46 — Shopping & Services](/curso-a2/unit-46)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 45 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-45-entertainment-media-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 45 — Entertainment & Media](/curso-a2/unit-45)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U44 — The Weather](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-44-the-weather)
- [U37 — Would like vs Like](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-37-would-like-vs-like)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
