title: Making Suggestions A2: Shall We, Let’s y Ejemplos
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 51 del curso A2: hacer y responder sugerencias con Shall we, Let's, Why don't we, How about y Would you like to, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende a hacer sugerencias A2 con Shall we, Let's, Why don't we, How about y Would you like to, con ejemplos y ejercicios para practicar.
alt: Esquema Making Suggestions A2

faqs.question: ¿Shall we o Let's?
faqs.answer: Let's + verbo = sugerencia directa (Let's go!). Shall we + verbo? = más pregunta/invitación (Shall we go?). Ambos son comunes en A2.

faqs.question: ¿How about lleva gerundio o infinitivo?
faqs.answer: How about + -ing / noun: How about going to the cinema? / How about a coffee? No uses to después de How about.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo rechazo una sugerencia con educación?
faqs.answer: Sorry, I can't. / I'd love to, but… / Maybe another day. Evita un No seco.

faqs.question: ¿Would you like to es sugerencia o oferta?
faqs.answer: Sirve para invitar o sugerir un plan: Would you like to come with us? También aparece en ofertas (Would you like a drink?).

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 51 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 51 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás sugerencias y respuestas a planes.

content:
Tras el [repaso del Módulo 5](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-50-module-5-review), el **Módulo 6** empieza con la **Unidad 51 del curso A2** (*Making Suggestions*): **proponer planes** y **responder**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 51 — Making Suggestions](/curso-a2/unit-51)  
> **Antes:** [U50 — Module 5 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-50-module-5-review)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 51 (A2)

- Formas: **Shall we…?**, **Let's…**, **Why don't we…?**, **How about…?**
- Invitaciones: **Would you like to…?**
- Respuestas: aceptar, dudar, rechazar con educación.
- Vocabulario de **planes y actividades en grupo**.
- Entender invitaciones y producir un mini diálogo de planes.

![Making Suggestions A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/a2-unit51-making-suggestions.png)

---

## 1. Formas clave para sugerir

| Forma | Estructura | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Shall we…?** | Shall we + verbo base | **Shall we** go to the park? |
| **Let's…** | Let's + verbo base | **Let's** have lunch. |
| **Why don't we…?** | Why don't we + verbo base | **Why don't we** watch a film? |
| **How about…?** | How about + -ing / noun | **How about** meeting at 6? |
| **Would you like to…?** | Would you like to + verbo | **Would you like to** come? |

> **Shall we** take the bus?  
> **Let's** stay at home.  
> **How about** a pizza?

![Ways to suggest](/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/a2-unit51-suggest-forms.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/shall-we-go.mp3" title="🔊 Shall we go to the park?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/lets-have-lunch.mp3" title="🔊 Let's have lunch."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/how-about-meeting.mp3" title="🔊 How about meeting at six?"></audio>

---

## 2. *Would you like to…?* (invitar)

Más suave / educado para invitar:

> **Would you like to** come with us?  
> **Would you like to** see a film tonight?

Relacionado con gustos/pedidos: [Would like vs Like](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-37-would-like-vs-like).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/would-you-like-to.mp3" title="🔊 Would you like to come with us?"></audio>

---

## 3. Responder a una sugerencia

| Tipo | Frases |
| :--- | :--- |
| Aceptar | **Yes, great!** / **Good idea.** / **I'd love to.** / **Sure.** |
| Dudar | **Maybe.** / **I'm not sure.** / **What time?** |
| Rechazar (educado) | **Sorry, I can't.** / **I'd love to, but I'm busy.** / **Maybe another day.** |

> A: Shall we go shopping?  
> B: **I'd love to, but** I have to study.

---

## 4. Vocabulario de planes

| Actividad | Ejemplo de sugerencia |
| :--- | :--- |
| go for a walk | Let's **go for a walk**. |
| have a coffee | Shall we **have a coffee**? |
| see a film / go to the cinema | Why don't we **see a film**? |
| hang out | How about **hanging out** on Saturday? |
| stay in | Let's **stay in** tonight. |
| meet up | Shall we **meet up** at 5? |

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Sugerir (directo) | Let's… | Let's go! |
| Preguntar plan | Shall we…? | Shall we leave now? |
| Alternativa suave | Why don't we…? / How about…? | How about pizza? |
| Invitar | Would you like to…? | Would you like to join us? |
| Aceptar / rechazar | Great / Sorry, I can't | I'd love to, but… |

![Plans scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/a2-unit51-plans-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Weekend plans

**Shall we** do something this weekend? **Let's** go to the beach on Saturday if the weather is good. **Why don't we** take the train at 9? **How about** inviting Lara too? **Would you like to** bring some sandwiches? If it rains, **let's** stay in and watch a series instead.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/reading-weekend.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Weekend plans"></audio>

### Diálogo — Making plans

**Eva:** **Shall we** go to the cinema tonight?  
**Nico:** **I'd love to, but** I finish work late.  
**Eva:** **How about** tomorrow?  
**Nico:** **Good idea.** **Would you like to** meet at 7?  
**Eva:** Sure. **Let's** have a coffee first.  
**Nico:** Perfect.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/dialogue-plans.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Making plans"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. ___ we go for a walk?  
2. ___ have pizza.  
3. How ___ meeting at 6?  
4. Would you ___ to come?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-51/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~Let's to go.~~ → **Let's go.**  
2. ~~Shall we to eat?~~ → **Shall we eat?**  
3. ~~How about to go?~~ → **How about going?**  
4. ~~Why we don't go?~~ → **Why don't we go?**  
5. ~~Would you like come?~~ → **Would you like to come?**  
6. ~~No.~~ *(seco)* → **Sorry, I can't.** / **I'd love to, but…**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. Let's…  
2. Shall we…?  
3. How about…?  
4. Would you like to…?  
5. I'd love to, but…  

a) polite invitation  
b) soft alternative (+ -ing / noun)  
c) direct suggestion  
d) polite refusal start  
e) suggestion as a question

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → c  
2 → e  
3 → b  
4 → a  
5 → d  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. ___ we take a taxi?  
2. ___ stay at home.  
3. Why ___ we call her?  
4. How about ___ (go) for a walk?  
5. Would you like ___ (come) with us?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Shall  
2. Let's  
3. don't  
4. going  
5. to come  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Elige la forma correcta

1. ___ a coffee?  
   a) How about  b) Shall we  c) Let's to  
2. ___ go now!  
   a) How about  b) Let's  c) Would you like  
3. ___ you like to join us?  
   a) Shall  b) Would  c) Let's

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. a  
2. b  
3. b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. Let's to watch a film.  
2. Shall we to leave?  
3. How about to meet at 5?  
4. Why we don't eat out?  
5. Would you like come?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Let's watch a film.  
2. Shall we leave?  
3. How about meeting at 5?  
4. Why don't we eat out?  
5. Would you like to come?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. ¿Salimos?  
2. Vamos a tomar un café.  
3. ¿Qué tal si quedamos a las 6?  
4. ¿Te gustaría venir?  
5. Me encantaría, pero estoy ocupado/a.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Shall we go out? / Shall we leave?  
2. Let's have a coffee.  
3. How about meeting at 6?  
4. Would you like to come?  
5. I'd love to, but I'm busy.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** ___ we go shopping?  
**B:** Sorry, I ___. How ___ tomorrow?  
**A:** Good idea. Would you ___ to meet at 11?  
**B:** Sure. ___ have lunch after that.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

Shall  
can't  
about  
like  
Let's  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Aceptar o rechazar

Escribe una respuesta educada:

1. Shall we go running? *(rechazar — llueve)*  
2. Would you like to come to my party? *(aceptar)*  
3. How about pizza? *(dudar — hora)*

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Sorry, I can't — it's raining. / I'd love to, but it's raining.  
2. Yes, I'd love to. / Sure, great!  
3. Maybe — what time? / I'm not sure. What time?

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. we / Shall / go / ?  
2. about / How / a / coffee / ?  
3. like / Would / you / to / join / us / ?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Shall we go?  
2. How about a coffee?  
3. Would you like to join us?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Elige según el tono

1. Más directo → ___ go!  
2. Más pregunta → ___ we leave now?  
3. Con gerundio → How about ___ (stay) in?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Let's  
2. Shall  
3. staying  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu diálogo de planes (8–12 líneas)

Escribe un diálogo entre dos personas. Incluye:

- **Shall we…?** o **Let's…**  
- **How about…?** o **Why don't we…?**  
- **Would you like to…?**  
- 1 aceptación y 1 rechazo educado (o duda)

**Modelo:** el diálogo de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Formas de sugerir + respuestas  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *Shall we…?* y *Let's…*  
- [ ] Uso *How about + -ing/noun*  
- [ ] Invito con *Would you like to…?*  
- [ ] Acepto / rechazo con educación  
- [ ] Evito *Let's to* y *How about to*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Propón 3 planes en voz alta cada día.  
2. Practica rechazos corteses (*I'd love to, but…*).  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 51](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 51 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-51).

La **Unidad 52** es **Making Offers & Requests** (ofertas y peticiones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Directo | Let's… | Let's go. |
| Pregunta | Shall we…? | Shall we eat? |
| Suave | Why don't we…? / How about…? | How about pizza? |
| Invitar | Would you like to…? | Would you like to come? |
| Responder | Great / Sorry, I can't | I'd love to, but… |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 52** verás **Making Offers & Requests**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 52 — Making Offers & Requests](/curso-a2/unit-52)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 51 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 51 — Making Suggestions](/curso-a2/unit-51)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 51 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [U50 — Module 5 Review](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-50-module-5-review)
- [U37 — Would like vs Like](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-37-would-like-vs-like)
- [Will / Shall](/blog/gramatica/will-shall-ingles)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Making suggestions: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: Offers & Requests A2: Can I…?, Could you…?, Would you like me to…?
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 52 del curso A2: ofrecer ayuda y pedir cosas con Can I…?, Could you…? y Would you like me to…?, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Ofertas y peticiones en inglés A2: Can I…?, Could you…?, Would you like me to…? Guía Unidad 52 con audios, diálogos de cortesía y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Offers & Requests A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre una offer y una request?
faqs.answer: Offer = ofreces ayuda o algo (Can I help you? / Would you like me to…?). Request = pides algo a otra persona (Could you open the window?).

faqs.question: ¿Can you o Could you?
faqs.answer: Ambos piden algo. Could you…? suele sonar un poco más educado/formal que Can you…?

faqs.question: ¿Cómo acepto o rechazo una oferta?
faqs.answer: Aceptar: Yes, please. / That would be great. Rechazar: No, thanks. / It's OK, I can manage.

faqs.question: ¿Would you like me to lleva verbo en base?
faqs.answer: Sí: Would you like me to + verbo base (Would you like me to help?).

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 52 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-52-offers-requests-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 52 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás ofertas y peticiones educadas.

content:
En la [Unidad 51](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions) sugeriste planes. En la **Unidad 52 del curso A2** (*Making Offers & Requests*) practicas **ofrecer ayuda** y **pedir cosas con cortesía**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 52 — Making Offers & Requests](/curso-a2/unit-52)  
> **Antes:** [U51 — Making Suggestions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 52 (A2)

- **Offers:** *Can I…?*, *Would you like me to…?*, *Shall I…?*
- **Requests:** *Can you…?*, *Could you…?*, *Could you please…?*
- Respuestas educadas (aceptar / rechazar).
- Vocabulario en **casa, trabajo y tienda**.
- Producir diálogos cortos de cortesía.

![Offers & Requests A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/a2-unit52-offers-requests.png)

---

## 1. Offers: ofrecer ayuda

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Can I…?** | ofrecer hacer algo | **Can I** help you? |
| **Shall I…?** | ofrecer (británico, frecuente) | **Shall I** open the window? |
| **Would you like me to…?** | ofrecer con más cortesía | **Would you like me to** carry that? |
| **Let me…** | ofrecer de forma directa | **Let me** help you. |

> **Can I** get you a drink?  
> **Would you like me to** call a taxi?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/can-i-help-you.mp3" title="🔊 Can I help you?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/would-you-like-me-to.mp3" title="🔊 Would you like me to carry that?"></audio>

---

## 2. Requests: pedir algo

| Forma | Tono | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Can you…?** | neutro / informal | **Can you** pass the salt? |
| **Could you…?** | más educado | **Could you** open the door? |
| **Could you please…?** | más cortés | **Could you please** wait a minute? |
| **Would you mind + -ing?** | muy educado (A2+) | **Would you mind** helping me?

> **Could you** send me the email?  
> **Can you** help me with this bag?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/could-you-open.mp3" title="🔊 Could you open the window?"></audio>

![Offer or request](/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/a2-unit52-offer-vs-request.png)

---

## 3. Respuestas

### A una oferta

| Aceptar | Rechazar |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Yes, please.** | **No, thanks.** |
| **That would be great.** | **It's OK, thanks.** |
| **Thank you!** | **I can manage.** |

### A una petición

| Aceptar | Rechazar (educado) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Of course.** | **Sorry, I can't right now.** |
| **Sure.** | **I'm afraid I'm busy.** |
| **No problem.** | **Maybe later.** |

> A: Could you help me?  
> B: **Of course.** / **Sorry, I'm busy at the moment.**

---

## 4. Contextos: casa, trabajo, tienda

| Lugar | Offer | Request |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Casa | Shall I make tea? | Could you close the door? |
| Trabajo | Can I help with the report? | Could you send the file? |
| Tienda | Can I help you? | Could you gift-wrap this? |

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Ofrecer ayuda | Can I…? / Would you like me to…? | Can I help? |
| Pedir algo | Could you…? / Can you…? | Could you wait? |
| Aceptar oferta | Yes, please. | Yes, please. |
| Rechazar oferta | No, thanks. | No, thanks. |
| Aceptar petición | Of course. / Sure. | Of course. |

![Help scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/a2-unit52-help-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — At the office

Good morning. **Can I** help you with those boxes? If you want, **Would you like me to** call reception? Later, **Could you please** send me the report by email? And **Shall I** book a meeting room for 3? Thanks — that would be great.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/reading-office.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: At the office"></audio>

### Diálogo — Helping a neighbour

**Alex:** Hi! Those bags look heavy. **Can I** help you?  
**Sam:** **Yes, please.** Thanks!  
**Alex:** **Would you like me to** take them upstairs?  
**Sam:** That would be great.  
**Alex:** **Could you** open the door?  
**Sam:** **Of course.** Here you are.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/dialogue-help.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: Helping a neighbour"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. ___ I help you?  
2. Would you like me ___ carry that?  
3. ___ you open the window?  
4. Yes, ___. *(aceptar oferta)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-52/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~Can I to help you?~~ → **Can I help you?**  
2. ~~Could you to open…?~~ → **Could you open…?**  
3. ~~Would you like me help?~~ → **Would you like me to help?**  
4. ~~Please you help me.~~ → **Could you please help me?**  
5. ~~Yes.~~ *(muy seco a oferta)* → **Yes, please.** / **That would be great.**  
6. ~~No.~~ → **No, thanks.** / **It's OK, thanks.**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — ¿Offer o request?

1. Can I help you?  
2. Could you wait here?  
3. Would you like me to call a taxi?  
4. Can you pass the salt?  
5. Shall I open the window?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. offer  
2. request  
3. offer  
4. request  
5. offer  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. ___ I carry your bag?  
2. Could you ___ close the door? *(please)*  
3. Would you like me ___ help?  
4. ___ I make some tea?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Can / Shall  
2. please  
3. to  
4. Shall / Can  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Elige la mejor opción

1. Ofrecer ayuda educada:  
   a) Help me!  b) Would you like me to help?  c) You help.  
2. Pedir con cortesía:  
   a) Open the window.  b) Could you open the window?  c) You must open.  
3. Aceptar una oferta:  
   a) No.  b) Yes, please.  c) Of course not.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. b  
3. b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. Can I to help you?  
2. Could you to wait?  
3. Would you like me help with this?  
4. Please you send the email.  
5. No. *(rechazo de oferta — hazlo educado)*

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Can I help you?  
2. Could you wait?  
3. Would you like me to help with this?  
4. Could you please send the email?  
5. No, thanks. / It's OK, thanks.

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. ¿Puedo ayudarte?  
2. ¿Te gustaría que te lleve eso?  
3. ¿Podrías abrir la ventana?  
4. Sí, por favor.  
5. Lo siento, ahora no puedo.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Can I help you?  
2. Would you like me to carry that?  
3. Could you open the window?  
4. Yes, please.  
5. Sorry, I can't right now.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** Those bags look heavy. ___ I help you?  
**B:** Yes, ___.  
**A:** Would you like me ___ take them upstairs?  
**B:** That would be ___.  
**A:** ___ you open the door?  
**B:** Of ___.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

Can  
please  
to  
great  
Could  
course  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja respuesta

1. Can I help you?  
2. Could you send the file?  
3. Would you like me to call a taxi?  

a) Of course.  
b) Yes, please.  
c) No, thanks — I'll walk.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b (también OK otras)  
2 → a  
3 → c  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. help / I / Can / you / ?  
2. open / Could / you / the / window / ?  
3. me / like / Would / you / to / help / ?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. Can I help you?  
2. Could you open the window?  
3. Would you like me to help?  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Casa / trabajo / tienda

Escribe una offer y una request para cada lugar:

1. Casa  
2. Trabajo  
3. Tienda

<details>
<summary>Soluciones (modelo)</summary>

1. Shall I make tea? / Could you close the door?  
2. Can I help with the report? / Could you send the email?  
3. Can I help you? / Could you gift-wrap this?

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu diálogo (8–12 líneas)

Escribe un diálogo con:

- 2 **offers** (*Can I…?* / *Would you like me to…?* / *Shall I…?*)  
- 1 **request** (*Could you…?* / *Can you…?*)  
- 1 aceptación y 1 rechazo educado

**Modelo:** el diálogo de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Offer vs request + respuestas  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Ofrezco con *Can I…?* / *Would you like me to…?*  
- [ ] Pido con *Could you…?* / *Can you…?*  
- [ ] Respondo *Yes, please* / *No, thanks* / *Of course*  
- [ ] Distingo offer y request  
- [ ] Evito *Can I to* y *Would you like me help*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Practica en voz alta: 3 ofertas + 3 peticiones al día.  
2. Graba un mini diálogo y comprueba la cortesía.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 52](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-52-offers-requests-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 52 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-52).

La **Unidad 53** es **Expressing Opinions** (dar opiniones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Offer | Can I…? | Can I help you? |
| Offer | Would you like me to…? | Would you like me to carry that? |
| Request | Could you…? | Could you open the window? |
| Aceptar oferta | Yes, please. | Yes, please. |
| Aceptar petición | Of course. | Of course. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 53** verás **Expressing Opinions**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 53 — Expressing Opinions](/curso-a2/unit-53)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 52 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-52-offers-requests-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 52 — Offers & Requests](/curso-a2/unit-52)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 52 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-52-offers-requests-ejercicios-soluciones)

title: Expressing Opinions A2: I think…, In my opinion…, I agree
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 53 del curso A2: expresar opiniones con I think, In my opinion e I agree/disagree, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Da tu opinión en inglés A2: I think…, I don't think…, In my opinion…, I agree / I disagree. Guía Unidad 53 con audios, reseñas y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Expressing Opinions A2

faqs.question: ¿Se dice I think that o solo I think?
faqs.answer: Ambas valen. I think it's great. / I think that it's great. En conversación a menudo se omite that.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo que no estoy de acuerdo con educación?
faqs.answer: I don't think so. / I'm not sure. / I see your point, but… Evita un I disagree seco si el tono es informal amistoso.

faqs.question: ¿In my opinion necesita that?
faqs.answer: No es obligatorio: In my opinion, the film is too long. También In my opinion, it's too long.

faqs.question: ¿I agree with you o I agree you?
faqs.answer: I agree. / I agree with you. / I agree with that idea. No digas I agree you.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 53 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 53 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás opiniones y acuerdo/desacuerdo.

content:
En la [Unidad 52](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-52-offers-requests) practicaste ofertas y peticiones. En la **Unidad 53 del curso A2** (*Expressing Opinions*) das **tu opinión** y **reaccionas** a la de otros.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 53 — Expressing Opinions](/curso-a2/unit-53)  
> **Antes:** [U52 — Offers & Requests](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-52-offers-requests)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 53 (A2)

- Dar opinión: **I think…**, **I don't think…**, **In my opinion…**
- Reaccionar: **I agree**, **I disagree**, **I don't think so**
- Vocabulario de temas: películas, música, comida, viajes
- Entender opiniones en reseñas / foros
- Escribir 2–3 frases de opinión

![Expressing Opinions A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/a2-unit53-expressing-opinions.png)

---

## 1. Dar tu opinión

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **I think…** | **I think** this film is great. |
| **I don't think…** | **I don't think** it's funny. |
| **In my opinion…** | **In my opinion**, it's too long. |
| **I believe…** | **I believe** travel is important. |
| **For me…** | **For me**, pizza is the best. |

> **I think** we should go by train.  
> **In my opinion**, the museum is better than the mall.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/i-think.mp3" title="🔊 I think this film is great."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/in-my-opinion.mp3" title="🔊 In my opinion, it's too long."></audio>

---

## 2. Acordar y discrepar

| Acordar | Discrepar (suave → más claro) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **I agree.** | **I don't think so.** |
| **I agree with you.** | **I'm not sure.** |
| **You're right.** | **I see your point, but…** |
| **Exactly!** | **I disagree.** |

> A: I think the food is delicious.  
> B: **I agree!** / **I don't think so** — it's too spicy for me.

![Agree or disagree](/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/a2-unit53-agree-disagree.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/i-agree.mp3" title="🔊 I agree with you."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/i-dont-think-so.mp3" title="🔊 I don't think so."></audio>

---

## 3. Vocabulario por tema

| Tema | Opiniones útiles |
| :--- | :--- |
| Películas / series | boring, exciting, funny, too long, brilliant |
| Música | catchy, loud, relaxing, my favourite |
| Comida | delicious, spicy, sweet, healthy, terrible |
| Viajes | expensive, worth it, crowded, amazing |

> **I think** the soundtrack is **catchy**.  
> **In my opinion**, the city is **too crowded** in summer.

---

## 4. Preguntar la opinión

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **What do you think?** | I think it's good. |
| **What's your opinion?** | In my opinion, … |
| **Do you agree?** | Yes, I agree. / Not really. |

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Opinar | I think… | I think it's great. |
| Opinar (formal) | In my opinion… | In my opinion, it's long. |
| Negar opinión | I don't think… | I don't think it's funny. |
| Acordar | I agree. | I agree with you. |
| Discrepar | I don't think so. | I don't think so. |

![Opinion scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/a2-unit53-opinion-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Forum review

**What do you think** of the new series? **In my opinion**, episode one is slow, but the story is interesting. **I think** the actors are brilliant. Some people say it's boring — **I don't think so**. **I agree** that it's a bit long, but it's worth watching.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/reading-forum.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Forum review"></audio>

### Diálogo — After a film

**Lara:** **What do you think** of the film?  
**Ben:** **I think** it was exciting.  
**Lara:** **I agree.** The ending was amazing.  
**Ben:** **Do you agree** that it was too long?  
**Lara:** **I'm not sure.** **In my opinion**, it was fine.  
**Ben:** Fair enough!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/dialogue-film.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: After a film"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I ___ this song is catchy.  
2. In my ___, the food is too spicy.  
3. I ___ with you.  
4. I don't think ___.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-53/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~I am agree.~~ → **I agree.**  
2. ~~I agree you.~~ → **I agree with you.**  
3. ~~In my opinion that the film is bad.~~ → **In my opinion, the film is bad.**  
4. ~~I think yes.~~ → **I think so.** / **Yes, I think so.**  
5. ~~I don't think yes.~~ → **I don't think so.**  
6. ~~According to me…~~ → más natural: **In my opinion…** / **For me…**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. I think…  
2. In my opinion…  
3. I agree.  
4. I don't think so.  
5. What do you think?  

a) ask for an opinion  
b) give an opinion  
c) disagree politely  
d) another way to give an opinion  
e) say you have the same opinion

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b  
2 → d  
3 → e  
4 → c  
5 → a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. I ___ the museum is amazing.  
2. I don't ___ it's a good idea.  
3. In my ___, we should stay.  
4. I agree ___ you.  
5. I don't think ___.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. think  
2. think  
3. opinion  
4. with  
5. so  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Agree o disagree

1. You're right. → ___  
2. I'm not sure. → ___  
3. Exactly! → ___  
4. I see your point, but… → ___

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. agree  
2. soft disagree / unsure  
3. agree  
4. soft disagree  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. I am agree with you.  
2. I agree you.  
3. I think so not.  
4. In my opinion that it's boring.  
5. According to me, it's great.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I agree with you.  
2. I agree with you.  
3. I don't think so.  
4. In my opinion, it's boring.  
5. In my opinion, / For me, it's great.

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Creo que la película es genial.  
2. En mi opinión, es demasiado larga.  
3. Estoy de acuerdo contigo.  
4. No lo creo.  
5. ¿Qué opinas?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I think the film is great.  
2. In my opinion, it's too long.  
3. I agree with you.  
4. I don't think so.  
5. What do you think? / What's your opinion?

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** What do you ___ of this restaurant?  
**B:** I ___ the food is delicious.  
**A:** I ___ — but in my ___, it's expensive.  
**B:** I don't think ___ . It's OK for a special day.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

think  
think  
agree  
opinion  
so  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la mejor opción

1. ___ the music is too loud.  
   a) I am think  b) I think  c) I thinking  
2. ___ , we should leave early.  
   a) In my opinion  b) I agree you  c) I think so not  
3. A: It's boring. B: ___ — I loved it.  
   a) I agree  b) I don't think so  c) Exactly

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. a  
3. b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. think / I / it's / great  
2. opinion / In / my / it's / long / too  
3. with / I / agree / you

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I think it's great.  
2. In my opinion, it's too long.  
3. I agree with you.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Temas

Escribe 1 opinión (*I think* / *In my opinion*) para cada tema:

1. A film  
2. A song  
3. A city

<details>
<summary>Soluciones (modelo)</summary>

1. I think the film is exciting.  
2. In my opinion, the song is catchy.  
3. I think the city is too crowded.

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu mini reseña (8–12 líneas)

Elige una película, canción, comida o viaje. Incluye:

- **I think…**  
- **In my opinion…**  
- **I agree** o **I don't think so** (reacción a una idea imaginaria)  
- 2 adjetivos del tema

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Formas de opinar + agree/disagree  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha forum y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *I think / I don't think*  
- [ ] Uso *In my opinion…*  
- [ ] Digo *I agree with you*  
- [ ] Discrepo con *I don't think so*  
- [ ] Evito *I am agree* e *I agree you*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Da tu opinión en voz alta sobre 3 cosas cada día.  
2. Lee comentarios cortos en inglés y marca *I think / I agree*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 53](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 53 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-53).

La **Unidad 54** es **Feelings & Emotions** (sentimientos).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Opinar | I think… | I think it's great. |
| Opinar | In my opinion… | In my opinion, it's long. |
| Negar | I don't think… | I don't think it's funny. |
| Acordar | I agree (with you). | I agree with you. |
| Discrepar | I don't think so. | I don't think so. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 54** verás **Feelings & Emotions**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 54 — Feelings & Emotions](/curso-a2/unit-54)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 53 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 53 — Expressing Opinions](/curso-a2/unit-53)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 53 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [U52 — Offers & Requests](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-52-offers-requests)
- [U45 — Entertainment & Media](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-45-entertainment-media)
- [U51 — Making Suggestions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-51-making-suggestions)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Giving opinions: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: Feelings & Emotions A2: I feel…, excited, worried, proud
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 54 del curso A2: expresar sentimientos con I feel… / I'm… y vocabulario de emociones, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Expresa sentimientos en inglés A2: I feel…, I'm…, excited, worried, bored, disappointed, proud, nervous. Guía Unidad 54 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Feelings & Emotions A2

faqs.question: ¿Se dice I feel bored o I am boring?
faqs.answer: I feel bored / I'm bored = me aburro. Boring describe algo/alguien que aburre: The film is boring.

faqs.question: ¿I feel o I'm con emociones?
faqs.answer: Ambos son frecuentes: I feel nervous. / I'm nervous. Con adjetivos de emoción suelen intercambiarse en A2.

faqs.question: ¿Excited o exciting?
faqs.answer: Excited = cómo te sientes. Exciting = cómo es la cosa: I'm excited about the trip. / The trip is exciting.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto cómo se siente alguien?
faqs.answer: How do you feel? / How are you feeling? / Are you OK?

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 54 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 54 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás vocabulario de emociones y cómo te sientes.

content:
En la [Unidad 53](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions) diste opiniones. En la **Unidad 54 del curso A2** (*Feelings & Emotions*) describes **cómo te sientes**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 54 — Feelings & Emotions](/curso-a2/unit-54)  
> **Antes:** [U53 — Expressing Opinions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 54 (A2)

- Estructuras: **I feel…**, **I'm…**, **How do you feel?**
- Vocabulario: **excited**, **worried**, **bored**, **disappointed**, **proud**, **nervous**
- Diferencia *-ed* vs *-ing* (*bored / boring*)
- Hablar de emociones en experiencias cotidianas
- Describir cómo te sientes en 5–8 líneas

![Feelings & Emotions A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/a2-unit54-feelings-emotions.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario de emociones

| Adjetivo | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **excited** | emocionado/a (ilusión) | I'm **excited** about the trip. |
| **worried** | preocupado/a | She's **worried** about the exam. |
| **bored** | aburrido/a (tú) | I'm **bored** at home. |
| **disappointed** | decepcionado/a | He felt **disappointed**. |
| **proud** | orgulloso/a | We're **proud** of you. |
| **nervous** | nervioso/a | I feel **nervous** before interviews. |
| **happy / sad** | feliz / triste | I feel **happy** today. |
| **angry / tired** | enfadado / cansado | He's **angry**. / I'm **tired**. |

![Emotion words](/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/a2-unit54-emotion-words.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/i-feel-excited.mp3" title="🔊 I feel excited about the trip."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/im-worried.mp3" title="🔊 I'm worried about the exam."></audio>

---

## 2. *I feel…* e *I'm…*

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| I feel + adjective | I **feel nervous**. |
| I'm + adjective | **I'm** proud of my team. |
| How do you feel? | **How do you feel** today? |
| I feel like + -ing | I **feel like** staying in. |

> **How are you feeling?** — A bit tired, but OK.  
> I **feel disappointed** about the result.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/how-do-you-feel.mp3" title="🔊 How do you feel today?"></audio>

---

## 3. *-ed* vs *-ing* (importante)

| Cómo te sientes (*-ed*) | Cómo es la cosa (*-ing*) |
| :--- | :--- |
| I'm **bored**. | The lesson is **boring**. |
| I'm **excited**. | The news is **exciting**. |
| I'm **interested**. | The book is **interesting**. |
| I'm **tired**. | The work is **tiring**. |

> The film was **boring**, so I felt **bored**.

---

## 4. Preposiciones útiles

| Patrón | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| excited **about** | excited about the concert |
| worried **about** | worried about money |
| proud **of** | proud of my sister |
| disappointed **with / about** | disappointed with the service |
| nervous **about** | nervous about the test |

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Decir cómo te sientes | I feel / I'm + adj | I feel proud. |
| Preguntar | How do you feel? | How do you feel? |
| Causa | about / of / with | worried about… |
| Emoción vs causa | -ed / -ing | bored / boring |

![Feelings scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/a2-unit54-feelings-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Before the interview

Tomorrow I have a job interview. I feel **nervous**, but also **excited**. My mum says I should be **proud** of my CV. Last week I was **disappointed** about another interview, so I'm a bit **worried**. I don't want to feel **bored** waiting all morning — I'll take a book. How do I feel right now? Hopeful!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/reading-interview.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Before the interview"></audio>

### Diálogo — After an exam

**Mia:** How do you **feel**?  
**Omar:** I'm **relieved** — and a bit **tired**.  
**Mia:** Were you **nervous**?  
**Omar:** Yes. I was also **worried** about the listening part.  
**Mia:** You should be **proud**. You studied a lot.  
**Omar:** Thanks. I was **disappointed** last time, so this feels better.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/dialogue-exam.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: After an exam"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. I feel ___ about the trip. *(ilusión)*  
2. I'm ___ about the exam. *(preocupado)*  
3. How do you ___ ?  
4. The film is ___ , so I feel ___. *(aburrido / me aburro)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-54/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~I am boring.~~ *(si te aburres)* → **I'm bored.**  
2. ~~I feel me happy.~~ → **I feel happy.**  
3. ~~I'm excite.~~ → **I'm excited.**  
4. ~~proud for you~~ → **proud of you**  
5. ~~worried of the exam~~ → **worried about** the exam  
6. ~~How you feel?~~ → **How do you feel?**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. excited  
2. worried  
3. bored  
4. proud  
5. disappointed  

a) not happy with the result  
b) looking forward / full of energy about something  
c) thinking something bad may happen  
d) nothing interesting to do  
e) happy about someone's success (including yours)

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → b  
2 → c  
3 → d  
4 → e  
5 → a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con la emoción

1. The test is tomorrow → I feel ___.  
2. My team won → I'm ___.  
3. Nothing to do at home → I'm ___.  
4. The concert is next week → I'm ___ about it.  
5. We lost the final → I felt ___.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. nervous / worried  
2. proud / happy / excited  
3. bored  
4. excited  
5. disappointed / sad  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *-ed* o *-ing*

1. I'm ___ (bore). The lesson is ___ (bore).  
2. She's ___ (excite) about the news. The news is ___ (excite).  
3. This job is ___ (tire). I feel ___ (tire).

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. bored / boring  
2. excited / exciting  
3. tiring / tired  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Preposiciones

1. excited ___ the party  
2. worried ___ the results  
3. proud ___ my brother  
4. nervous ___ flying

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. about  
2. about  
3. of  
4. about  

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. I am boring today.  
2. I feel me sad.  
3. I'm proud for you.  
4. How you feel?  
5. I'm worry about money.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'm bored today.  
2. I feel sad.  
3. I'm proud of you.  
4. How do you feel?  
5. I'm worried about money.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Traduce al inglés

1. Estoy emocionado/a por el viaje.  
2. Me siento nervioso/a.  
3. Estoy preocupado/a por el examen.  
4. Estamos orgullosos de ti.  
5. ¿Cómo te sientes?

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I'm excited about the trip. / I feel excited about the trip.  
2. I feel nervous. / I'm nervous.  
3. I'm worried about the exam.  
4. We're proud of you.  
5. How do you feel?

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** How do you ___ ?  
**B:** A bit ___ about the interview.  
**A:** Don't worry — you should be ___ of your work.  
**B:** Thanks. Last time I was ___ , so I want this to go well.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

feel  
nervous / worried  
proud  
disappointed  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. feel / I / nervous  
2. about / worried / I'm / the / exam  
3. of / proud / We're / you

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. I feel nervous.  
2. I'm worried about the exam.  
3. We're proud of you.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Elige la mejor opción

1. The film was ___, so I left.  
   a) bored  b) boring  c) bore  
2. I'm ___ about my driving test.  
   a) nervous  b) nervousing  c) nervously  
3. She's ___ of her daughter.  
   a) proud  b) pride  c) proudly

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. b  
2. a  
3. a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Cómo te sientes (8–12 líneas)

Describe un momento reciente. Incluye:

- **I feel / I'm** + 3 emociones  
- 1 preposición (*about / of*)  
- 1 contraste *-ed / -ing*  
- **How do you feel?** (pregunta a alguien) o respuesta

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + *I feel / I'm*  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha lectura y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *I feel…* / *I'm…* con emociones  
- [ ] Distingo *bored / boring*, *excited / exciting*  
- [ ] Uso *about / of* correctamente  
- [ ] Pregunto *How do you feel?*  
- [ ] Evito *I am boring* e *I feel me…*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Di en voz alta cada mañana: *Today I feel…*  
2. Etiqueta emociones en series/canciones (*She looks worried*).  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 54](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 54 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-54).

La **Unidad 55** es **The Environment** (medio ambiente).

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Sentir | I feel + adj | I feel nervous. |
| Estado | I'm + adj | I'm proud. |
| Preguntar | How do you feel? | How do you feel? |
| *-ed* | cómo te sientes | I'm bored. |
| *-ing* | cómo es la cosa | It's boring. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 55** verás **The Environment**.

Curso:

- [Unidad 55 — The Environment](/curso-a2/unit-55)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 54 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 54 — Feelings & Emotions](/curso-a2/unit-54)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 54 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [U53 — Expressing Opinions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-53-expressing-opinions)
- [U47 — Health & Body](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-47-health-body)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Feelings: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/

title: The Environment A2: recycle, save water, should
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 55 del curso A2: hablar del medio ambiente con recycle, save, pollution y should, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Medio ambiente en inglés A2: recycle, save, pollute, plastic, pollution. Consejos con should. Guía Unidad 55 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema The Environment A2

faqs.question: ¿Environment o environmental?
faqs.answer: Environment es el sustantivo (the environment). Environmental es el adjetivo (environmental problems).

faqs.question: ¿Recycle o recycling?
faqs.answer: Recycle es el verbo: We recycle plastic. Recycling puede ser gerundio o sustantivo: Recycling is important.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo doy consejos ecológicos?
faqs.answer: Con should / shouldn't: You should recycle. You shouldn't waste water.

faqs.question: ¿Pollution o pollute?
faqs.answer: Pollution = contaminación (sustantivo). Pollute = contaminar (verbo): Factories pollute the air. / Air pollution is a problem.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 55 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 55 del curso A2 de Linguafly practicarás vocabulario y consejos sobre el medio ambiente.

content:
En la [Unidad 54](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions) expresaste emociones. En la **Unidad 55 del curso A2** (*The Environment*) hablas del **medio ambiente** y de **acciones cotidianas**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 55 — The Environment](/curso-a2/unit-55)  
> **Antes:** [U54 — Feelings & Emotions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-54-feelings-emotions)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 55 (A2)

- Vocabulario: **recycle**, **save water**, **pollution**, **plastic**, **environment**
- Verbos: **recycle**, **save**, **pollute**, **waste**, **reuse**
- Consejos: **should / shouldn't**
- Entender textos de sostenibilidad
- Decir qué haces tú por el planeta

![The Environment A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/a2-unit55-the-environment.png)

---

## 1. Vocabulario clave

| Palabra | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **environment** | medio ambiente | Protect the **environment**. |
| **recycle** | reciclar | We **recycle** glass and paper. |
| **pollution** | contaminación | Air **pollution** is a problem. |
| **pollute** | contaminar | Cars **pollute** the air. |
| **plastic** | plástico | Use less **plastic**. |
| **save** | ahorrar / salvar | **Save** water and energy. |
| **waste** | desperdiciar | Don't **waste** food. |
| **reuse** | reutilizar | **Reuse** your bags. |

También: **rubbish / trash**, **bin**, **public transport**, **energy**, **climate**.

---

## 2. Acciones cotidianas

| Acción | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| recycle | I **recycle** bottles every week. |
| save water | Turn off the tap — **save water**. |
| save energy | Turn off the lights to **save energy**. |
| use less plastic | I try to **use less plastic**. |
| walk / cycle / take the bus | I **go by bike** to work. |
| plant trees | They **plant trees** in the park. |

![Eco actions](/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/a2-unit55-eco-actions.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/we-recycle.mp3" title="🔊 We recycle glass and paper."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/save-water.mp3" title="🔊 Save water and energy."></audio>

---

## 3. Consejos con *should*

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| should + verbo | You **should** recycle. |
| shouldn't + verbo | You **shouldn't** waste water. |
| We should… | **We should** use public transport. |

> You **should** take a reusable bag.  
> People **shouldn't** throw plastic in the sea.

Repaso: [Should / Ought to](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-38-should-ought-to).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/you-should-recycle.mp3" title="🔊 You should recycle."></audio>

---

## 4. Hablar de problemas

| Problema | Frase útil |
| :--- | :--- |
| pollution | There's a lot of **pollution** in cities. |
| plastic | **Plastic** stays in nature for years. |
| waste | Food **waste** is a big problem. |
| cutting trees | Cutting trees is bad for the **environment**. |

> Factories **pollute** rivers.  
> We need cleaner air.

---

## 5. Mapa rápido

| Quieres… | Usa… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Acción positiva | recycle / save / reuse | Recycle plastic. |
| Problema | pollution / waste | Air pollution… |
| Consejo | should / shouldn't | You should walk more. |
| Tema general | the environment | Protect the environment. |

![Recycle scene](/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/a2-unit55-recycle-scene.png)

---

## 6. Lectura y diálogo

### Lectura — Green tips at home

Protecting the **environment** starts at home. You **should recycle** paper, glass and **plastic**. **Save water** when you brush your teeth, and turn off lights to **save energy**. **Don't waste** food. If you can, walk or take the bus — cars **pollute** the air. Small actions help every day.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/reading-tips.mp3" title="🔊 Reading: Green tips at home"></audio>

### Diálogo — At the supermarket

**Ana:** We **shouldn't** buy so many plastic bags.  
**Leo:** You're right. We **should** reuse this one.  
**Ana:** Do you **recycle** at home?  
**Leo:** Yes — paper and bottles. I also try to **save water**.  
**Ana:** Good. **Pollution** is getting worse in the city.  
**Leo:** Let's walk more and use the bus.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/dialogue-shop.mp3" title="🔊 Dialogue: At the supermarket"></audio>

### Mini práctica

1. We ___ glass and paper. *(reciclar)*  
2. ___ water when you can.  
3. You ___ recycle. *(should)*  
4. Cars ___ the air. *(contaminan)*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-55/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 Practice four sentences"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

1. ~~the nature~~ *(a menudo)* → **nature** / **the environment**  
2. ~~You should to recycle.~~ → **You should recycle.**  
3. ~~pollutions~~ → **pollution** (incontable en este uso)  
4. ~~recycle the environment~~ → **protect** the environment / **recycle** plastic  
5. ~~save the water always~~ → **save water**  
6. ~~I'm recycle~~ → **I recycle**

---

## 8. Ejercicios (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Empareja

1. recycle  
2. pollution  
3. save  
4. waste  
5. plastic  

a) use less / not throw away energy or water  
b) material in bottles and bags  
c) dirty air, water or land  
d) use again after processing  
e) use badly or throw away useful things

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1 → d  
2 → c  
3 → a  
4 → e  
5 → b  

</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. We ___ bottles every week.  
2. ___ water — turn off the tap.  
3. You ___ use public transport.  
4. You ___ throw plastic in the sea.  
5. Cars ___ the air.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. recycle  
2. Save  
3. should  
4. shouldn't  
5. pollute  

</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *should* / *shouldn't*

1. People ___ recycle more.  
2. We ___ waste food.  
3. You ___ walk or cycle when you can.  
4. Factories ___ pollute rivers.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. should  
2. shouldn't  
3. should  
4. shouldn't  

</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. You should to recycle.  
2. There are many pollutions in the city.  
3. Save the water always.  
4. I am recycle at home.  
5. Protect the nature environment. *(elige una forma natural)*

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. You should recycle.  
2. There is a lot of pollution in the city.  
3. Always save water. / Save water.  
4. I recycle at home.  
5. Protect the environment. / Protect nature.

</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Traduce al inglés

1. Reciclamos papel y plástico.  
2. Ahorra agua.  
3. Deberías usar menos plástico.  
4. No deberías desperdiciar comida.  
5. Los coches contaminan el aire.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. We recycle paper and plastic.  
2. Save water.  
3. You should use less plastic.  
4. You shouldn't waste food.  
5. Cars pollute the air.

</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

**A:** Do you ___ at home?  
**B:** Yes. We also try to ___ water and energy.  
**A:** Good. We ___ buy so many plastic bags.  
**B:** Agreed. ___ is a big problem in the city.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

recycle  
save  
shouldn't  
Pollution  

</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la mejor opción

1. ___ the environment is important.  
   a) Protect  b) Recycle  c) Pollute  
2. Don't ___ food.  
   a) save  b) waste  c) recycle  
3. Use ___ plastic.  
   a) less  b) many  c) much more always

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. a  
2. b  
3. a  

</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Ordena

1. should / You / recycle  
2. water / Save / energy / and  
3. pollute / Cars / the / air

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. You should recycle.  
2. Save water and energy.  
3. Cars pollute the air.  

</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — True / False

> You should recycle paper, glass and plastic. Save water when you brush your teeth.

1. Recycling plastic is a good idea.  
2. The tip says wasting water is fine.  
3. Paper can be recycled.

<details>
<summary>Soluciones</summary>

1. True  
2. False  
3. True  

</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu plan verde (8–12 líneas)

Escribe qué haces (o deberías hacer) por el medio ambiente. Incluye:

- 2 acciones (*recycle / save / reuse…*)  
- 2 *should / shouldn't*  
- *pollution* o *plastic*  
- *the environment*

**Modelo:** la lectura de la sección 6.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Vocabulario + acciones  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha tips y diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Ejercicio 10.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *recycle / save / reuse / waste / pollute*  
- [ ] Doy consejos con *should / shouldn't*  
- [ ] Hablo de *pollution* y *plastic*  
- [ ] Uso *the environment*  
- [ ] Evito *should to* y *pollutions*

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Lista 5 acciones verdes en voz alta cada día.  
2. Lee una tip card en inglés (ayuntamiento / ONG) y resume en 3 frases.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 55](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-55-the-environment-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 55 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-55).

La **Unidad 56** es **Technology & Communication**.

faqs.question: ¿Download o upload?
faqs.answer: Download = bajar del internet al dispositivo. Upload = subir del dispositivo a internet/nube.

faqs.question: ¿WiFi se escribe con guion?
faqs.answer: Suele verse Wi‑Fi o WiFi. En conversación: What's the WiFi password?

faqs.question: ¿Turn on the computer o open the computer?
faqs.answer: Turn on / switch on = encender. Open suele ser abrir un archivo, app o carpeta.

faqs.question: ¿Send an email to o send to an email?
faqs.answer: Send an email to someone / Send someone an email. También email someone.
