faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 25 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En las [unidades 21–24](/blog/curso-a2) aprendiste tres formas de futuro. En la **Unidad 25 del curso A2** (*Future: Going to vs Will vs Present Continuous*) **eliges** la forma correcta según el contexto.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 25 — Future Contrast](/curso-a2/unit-25)  
> **Antes:** [U24 — Present Continuous for Future](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-24-present-continuous-futuro)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 25 (A2)

- Contrastar **going to**, **will** y **Present Continuous**.
- Decidir según: intención, evidencia, promesa, espontáneo o cita fijada.
- Mezclar las tres formas en un mismo texto (viaje, boda, planes).
- Revisar marcadores temporales de futuro.
- Evitar mezclas incorrectas (*I will flying*, *I am go to…*).

![Tres formas de futuro A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/a2-unit25-three-futures.png)

---

## 1. Mapa rápido de las tres formas

| Forma | Uso principal | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **going to** | plan/intención · evidencia | I **am going to** visit the museum. / Look! It **is going to** rain. |
| **will** | promesa · oferta · espontáneo · predicción general | I **will** call you. / Maybe I **will** see a show. / I think it **will** be great. |
| **Present Continuous** | plan ya fijado (agenda) | I **am flying** to London. / On Saturday I **am having** dinner with my cousin. |

---

## 2. Mapa de decisión

![Mapa de decisión de futuros](/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/a2-unit25-decision-map.png)

1. ¿Está **ya organizado** (hora, reserva, billete en agenda)? → **Present Continuous**.  
2. ¿Es un **plan/intención** o hay **evidencia** ahora? → **going to**.  
3. ¿Es **promesa**, **oferta**, decisión **ahora** o predicción **general**? → **will**.

> She **is going to** fly to London next month. She already has the ticket.  
> Look! The sky is dark. It **is going to** rain soon.  
> We **are meeting** John at 3 o'clock tomorrow. It's fixed.  
> I **will** stay at home if it rains tomorrow.  
> I **will** send you the invitation tomorrow.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/going-to-ticket.mp3" title="🔊 She is going to fly to London. She already has the ticket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/look-going-to-rain.mp3" title="🔊 Look! The sky is dark. It is going to rain soon"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/are-meeting-fixed.mp3" title="🔊 We are meeting John at 3 o'clock tomorrow. It's fixed"></audio>

---

## 3. Repaso rápido de cada forma

### Going to (U21–22)

> I **am going to** visit the British Museum — I have already bought the ticket.  
> I **am going to** wear a white dress — I have already chosen it.

### Will (U23)

> When I arrive, I **will** call you and we **will** meet.  
> Maybe I **will** see a show in the West End too.  
> I think the trip **will** be great!

### Present Continuous (U24)

> Next week I **am flying** to London — that is already arranged.  
> On Saturday I **am having** dinner with my cousin — we booked the restaurant last week.  
> Next Saturday I **am getting married** — it is already arranged!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/will-call-you.mp3" title="🔊 When I arrive, I will call you and we will meet"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/am-flying-london.mp3" title="🔊 Next week I am flying to London — that is already arranged"></audio>

---

## 4. Misma idea, forma distinta (elige el matiz)

| Situación | Mejor forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Billete / reserva hecha | PC o *going to* | I **am flying** / I **am going to** fly… |
| Decisión en el momento | *will* | OK, I **'ll** call you. |
| Nubes oscuras | *going to* | It **is going to** rain. |
| Opinión general | *will* | I think it **will** be perfect. |
| Cita en el diary | Present Continuous | I **am meeting** John at 3. |
| Promesa | *will* | I **will** send the invitation tomorrow. |

---

## 5. Texto modelo: viaje a Londres

> Next week I am flying to London — that is already arranged. When I arrive, I will call you and we will meet. I am going to visit the British Museum — I have already bought the ticket. Maybe I will see a show in the West End too. On Saturday I am having dinner with my cousin — we booked the restaurant last week. I think the trip will be great!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/reading-london.mp3" title="🔊 Next week I am flying to London…"></audio>

![Viaje a Londres con tres futuros](/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/a2-unit25-london-trip.png)

| Frase | Forma | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I am flying to London | Present Continuous | ya organizado |
| I will call you / we will meet | *will* | promesa / decisión al llegar |
| I am going to visit the museum | *going to* | plan + ticket |
| Maybe I will see a show | *will* | posibilidad espontánea |
| I am having dinner… | Present Continuous | reserva hecha |
| I think the trip will be great | *will* | predicción general |

---

## 6. Listening: boda de Anna

> Hi Anna! I am calling about our plans. Next Saturday I am getting married — it is already arranged! I will send you the invitation tomorrow. I am going to wear a white dress — I have already chosen it. Maybe I will have a party the day after too. I think everything will be perfect!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/dialogue-wedding.mp3" title="🔊 Hi Anna! I am calling about our plans…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Qué pasa el sábado? → *getting married* (PC — ya organizado)  
2. ¿Qué hará mañana? → *will send the invitation* (*will* — promesa)  
3. ¿El vestido? → *am going to wear a white dress* (plan + ya elegido)  
4. ¿Fiesta después? → *Maybe I will have a party* (*will* — quizás)  
5. ¿Predicción final? → *everything will be perfect*

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> I am …ing … tomorrow.  
> I am going to…  
> I will…  
> Look! … is going to…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I am meeting… I am going to… I will…"></audio>

1. Di **1** frase con cada forma (PC / *going to* / *will*).  
2. Explica **por qué** elegiste cada una.  
3. Mezcla las tres en un mini relato (viaje o fin de semana).

---

## 8. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| arrangement / arranged / fixed | acuerdo / organizado / fijado |
| spontaneous / prediction / intention | espontáneo / predicción / intención |
| ticket / booked / chosen | billete·entrada / reservado / elegido |
| invitation / wedding / get married | invitación / boda / casarse |
| museum / show / restaurant | museo / espectáculo / restaurante |
| send / wear / visit / meet / call | enviar / llevar puesto / visitar / quedar / llamar |
| already / next week / the day after | ya / la próxima semana / al día siguiente |
| Maybe / I think / Look! | quizás / creo / ¡mira! |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I will flying to London. | I **am flying** / I **will fly**… | No mezcles *will* + *-ing* |
| I am go to visit the museum. | I **am going to** visit… | *going to* + infinitivo |
| Look! It will rain. *(nubes ahora)* | Look! It **is going to** rain. | evidencia → *going to* |
| I promise I am helping you. | I promise I **will** help you. | promesa → *will* |
| Tomorrow I will meeting John at 3. *(cita fijada)* | Tomorrow I **am meeting** John at 3. | agenda → PC |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/will-send-invitation.mp3" title="🔊 I will send you the invitation tomorrow"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/going-to-wear-dress.mp3" title="🔊 I am going to wear a white dress"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-25/think-will-be-perfect.mp3" title="🔊 I think everything will be perfect"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige la forma

1. Look! The sky is dark. It ____ rain soon. (*going to / will / are*)  
2. We ____ meeting John at 3 tomorrow. It's fixed. (*will / are / are going to*)  
3. I ____ call you when I arrive. (*will / am / am going to*)  
4. She ____ fly to London next month. She already has the ticket. (*will / is going to / is*)  
5. I think the trip ____ be great. (*will / is going to / is*)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is going to** · 2. **are** · 3. **will** · 4. **is going to** · 5. **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Etiqueta la forma

Escribe **GT** (*going to*), **W** (*will*) o **PC** (Present Continuous):

1. Next week I am flying to London.  
2. I will call you when I arrive.  
3. I am going to visit the British Museum.  
4. Maybe I will see a show.  
5. On Saturday I am having dinner with my cousin.  
6. I think the trip will be great.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **PC** · 2. **W** · 3. **GT** · 4. **W** · 5. **PC** · 6. **W**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa Londres

Next week I ____ flying to London. When I arrive, I ____ call you. I ____ going to visit the museum — I have already bought the ticket. On Saturday I ____ having dinner with my cousin.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**am** · **will** · **am** · **am**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa la boda

Next Saturday I ____ getting married. I ____ send you the invitation tomorrow. I ____ going to wear a white dress. Maybe I ____ have a party the day after. I think everything ____ be perfect!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**am** · **will** · **am** · **will** · **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Empareja uso ↔ forma

1. evidencia ahora  
2. cita fijada  
3. promesa  
4. intención + ticket  
5. predicción general (*I think*)  

a) *will* · b) *going to* (evidencia) · c) Present Continuous · d) *going to* (plan) · e) *will*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **a/e** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **a/e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Elige la mejor opción

1. Prometo enviarte la invitación mañana.  
   a) I am sending you… tomorrow. · b) I will send you… tomorrow. · c) Look! I am going to send…  
2. Reserva del restaurante hecha.  
   a) I will have dinner… · b) I am having dinner… · c) Maybe I will having dinner…  
3. Nubes oscuras.  
   a) It will rain. · b) It is going to rain. · c) It is raining tomorrow.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b** · 3. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *I will flying to London next week.*  
2. *I am go to visit the museum.*  
3. *Look! It will rain.* *(ves nubes ahora)*  
4. *I promise I am helping you.*  
5. *Tomorrow I will meeting John at 3.* *(cita fijada)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **am flying** to London next week. / I **will fly**…  
2. I **am going to** visit the museum.  
3. Look! It **is going to** rain.  
4. I promise I **will** help you.  
5. Tomorrow I **am meeting** John at 3.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce (elige la forma natural)

1. La próxima semana vuelo a Londres (ya organizado).  
2. Cuando llegue, te llamaré.  
3. Voy a visitar el museo (ya tengo la entrada).  
4. Quizás vea un espectáculo.  
5. El sábado ceno con mi primo (reserva hecha).  
6. Creo que el viaje será genial.  
7. El sábado que viene me caso (ya organizado).  
8. Te enviaré la invitación mañana.  
9. Voy a llevar un vestido blanco (ya lo he elegido).  
10. ¡Mira! Va a llover pronto.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. Next week I am flying to London.  
2. When I arrive, I will call you.  
3. I am going to visit the museum.  
4. Maybe I will see a show.  
5. On Saturday I am having dinner with my cousin.  
6. I think the trip will be great.  
7. Next Saturday I am getting married.  
8. I will send you the invitation tomorrow.  
9. I am going to wear a white dress.  
10. Look! It is going to rain soon.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Mini contraste

Completa con *will / going to / am-is-are + -ing* (una forma lógica):

1. A: The phone is ringing! B: OK, I ____ answer it.  
2. Look at those dark clouds! It ____ rain.  
3. I ____ meeting my boss at 9 tomorrow.  
4. I ____ wear this dress — I have already chosen it.  
5. I think everything ____ be perfect.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **'ll / will** · 2. **is going to** · 3. **am** · 4. **am going to** · 5. **will**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu texto mixto

Escribe 8–12 líneas mezclando las **tres** formas:

- 2 × Present Continuous (agenda)  
- 2 × *going to* (plan/evidencia)  
- 2 × *will* (promesa / Maybe / I think)  

**Modelo:** viaje a Londres o boda.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla de las 3 formas + mapa de decisión.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha Londres y la boda; etiqueta cada verbo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe tu texto mixto (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Distingo *going to / will / Present Continuous*  
- [ ] Uso PC para citas fijadas  
- [ ] Uso *going to* para plan o evidencia  
- [ ] Uso *will* para promesa, oferta y predicción general  
- [ ] Puedo mezclar las tres en un mismo relato

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta: ¿agenda, evidencia o promesa?  
2. Luego elige la forma.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 25](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 25 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-25).

La **Unidad 26** introduce el **First Conditional**: *If it rains, I'll stay at home.*

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Pregunta clave |
| :--- | :--- |
| Present Continuous | ¿Ya está fijado en la agenda? |
| *going to* | ¿Plan/intención o evidencia ahora? |
| *will* | ¿Promesa, oferta, espontáneo o predicción general? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 26** verás el **First Conditional**.

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 26 — First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional)

Curso:

- [Unidad 26 — First Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-26)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 25 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 25 — Future: Going to vs Will vs Present Continuous](/curso-a2/unit-25)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U24 — Present Continuous for Future](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-24-present-continuous-futuro)
- [U23 — Will / Won't](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-23-will-wont-predicciones-promesas)
- [U22 — Going to: predicciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-22-going-to-predicciones)
- [U21 — Going to: planes](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-21-going-to-planes-intenciones)
- [Will vs going to](/blog/gramatica/will-going-to-diferencia)

---

title: First Conditional A2: If it rains, I will stay at home
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 26 del curso A2: First Conditional (If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo), con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende el First Conditional en inglés A2: If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo. Condiciones reales y consecuencias. Guía Unidad 26 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema del First Conditional A2

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el First Conditional?
faqs.answer: Habla de una condición real o posible en el futuro y su resultado: If it rains, I will stay at home. Forma: If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo cambiar el orden de las cláusulas?
faqs.answer: Sí. If it rains, I will stay at home. / I will stay at home if it rains. Con If al principio suele haber coma; si if va en medio, normalmente no.

faqs.question: ¿Uso will en la cláusula de If?
faqs.answer: No. Después de If usas Present Simple (If it rains…), no If it will rain. Will va en el resultado: … I will stay at home.

faqs.question: ¿Para qué sirve en A2?
faqs.answer: Para consejos, advertencias y planes condicionados: If you study hard, you will pass. If you need help, I will come.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 26 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 26 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 25](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous) contrastaste futuros. En la **Unidad 26 del curso A2** (*First Conditional*) unes **condición** y **resultado**: *If it rains, I'll stay at home.*

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 26 — First Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-26)  
> **Antes:** [U25 — Futuro: going to vs will vs Present Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 26 (A2)

- Formar **If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo**.
- Hablar de condiciones **reales / posibles** en el futuro.
- Cambiar el **orden** de las cláusulas.
- Usar negativa: *If I don't pass… / I won't…*
- Dar consejos y advertencias (*If you need help…*).

![First Conditional A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/a2-unit26-first-conditional.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Parte | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Condición | *If* + **Present Simple** | If it **rains**… |
| Resultado | **will** + infinitivo | … I **will stay** at home. |

Significado: **si pasa X (posible), entonces haré / pasará Y**.

> If it **rains**, I **will stay** at home.  
> If you **study** hard, you **will pass** the exam.  
> If she **comes** to the party, I **will be** very happy.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-rains-stay-home.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains, I will stay at home"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-study-pass.mp3" title="🔊 If you study hard, you will pass the exam"></audio>

---

## 2. Dos órdenes (mismo significado)

![Orden de cláusulas First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/a2-unit26-clause-order.png)

| Orden | Ejemplo | Coma |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *If* primero | **If** it rains**,** I will stay at home. | Sí (normalmente) |
| Resultado primero | I will stay at home **if** it rains. | No |

> If the weather **is** nice, I **will go** for a walk in the park.  
> I **will make** coffee for you if you **come** to visit me.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-weather-nice.mp3" title="🔊 If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk in the park"></audio>

---

## 3. Negativa y *don't / won't*

| Tipo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Condición negativa | If I **don't pass**, I **will study** harder next time. |
| Resultado negativo | If we **miss** the bus, we **won't** be on time. / we **will be** late. |
| Ambos posibles | If you **don't** finish early, I **won't** let you go out. |

> If I **pass** the exam, I **will celebrate** with my friends.  
> If I **don't pass**, I **will study** harder next time.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-pass-celebrate.mp3" title="🔊 If I pass the exam, I will celebrate with my friends"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-dont-pass-study.mp3" title="🔊 If I don't pass, I will study harder next time"></audio>

---

## 4. Consejos, advertencias y planes

| Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Consejo / trato | If you **finish** your homework early, I **will let** you go out tonight. |
| Advertencia | If the bus **is** late, I **will be** late to work. |
| Oferta de ayuda | If you **need** help, just call me and I **will come**. |
| Plan condicionado | If it **rains** on Saturday, we **will stay** at home and play games. |
| Recompensa | If you **pass** the exam, I **will buy** you a present. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-finish-homework.mp3" title="🔊 If you finish your homework early, I will let you go out tonight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-need-help.mp3" title="🔊 If you need help, just call me and I will come"></audio>

---

## 5. Texto modelo: planes de mañana

> If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home. I will watch a film and relax. If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk in the park. If you come to visit me, I will make coffee for you. If I pass the exam, I will celebrate with my friends. If I don't pass, I will study harder next time.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/reading-plans.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home…"></audio>

![Escenarios If… I will…](/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/a2-unit26-if-scenarios.png)

| If… | … will… |
| :--- | :--- |
| it rains | stay at home / watch a film |
| the weather is nice | go for a walk |
| you come to visit | make coffee |
| I pass the exam | celebrate |
| I don't pass | study harder |

---

## 6. Listening: reglas en casa

> If you finish your homework early, I will let you go out tonight. If it rains on Saturday, we will stay at home and play games. If you pass the exam, I will buy you a present. If the bus is late, I will be late to work. If you need help, just call me and I will come.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/dialogue-rules.mp3" title="🔊 If you finish your homework early…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Deberes temprano? → *go out tonight*  
2. ¿Llueve el sábado? → *stay at home and play games*  
3. ¿Aprueba? → *buy a present*  
4. ¿Bus tarde? → *late to work*  
5. ¿Necesitas ayuda? → *call me / I will come*

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> If it rains tomorrow, I will…  
> If I pass the exam, I will…  
> If you need help, I will…  
> What will you do if…?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains tomorrow, I will…"></audio>

1. Di **4** frases *If…, I will…*  
2. Incluye **1** con *don't* o *won't*.  
3. Pregunta a un compañero: *What will you do if…?*

---

## 8. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| condition / consequence | condición / consecuencia |
| if / unless *(más adelante)* | si / a menos que |
| rain / weather / nice | llover / tiempo / bueno |
| stay at home / go for a walk | quedarse en casa / ir a pasear |
| pass / don't pass / study harder | aprobar / no aprobar / estudiar más |
| finish / homework / go out | terminar / deberes / salir |
| miss the bus / be late | perder el bus / llegar tarde |
| need help / call / come | necesitar ayuda / llamar / venir |
| celebrate / present / play games | celebrar / regalo / jugar |
| tomorrow / on Saturday / next time | mañana / el sábado / la próxima vez |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| If it **will** rain, I will stay… | If it **rains**, I will stay… | Tras *If* → Present Simple |
| If she **come**, I will be happy. | If she **comes**, … | *she* → *-s* |
| If you study, you **pass**. *(futuro posible)* | If you study, you **will pass**. | Resultado con *will* en First |
| If we will miss the bus… | If we **miss** the bus… | No *will* en la condición |
| I will stay at home, if it rains. *(coma)* | I will stay at home if it rains. | Sin coma si *if* va en medio |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-miss-bus.mp3" title="🔊 If we miss the bus, we will be late"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-pass-present.mp3" title="🔊 If you pass the exam, I will buy you a present"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-26/if-rains-saturday.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains on Saturday, we will stay at home and play games"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Present Simple o *will*

1. If it ____ (rain), I will stay at home.  
2. If you study hard, you ____ (pass) the exam.  
3. If she ____ (come) to the party, I will be happy.  
4. If we miss the bus, we ____ (be) late.  
5. If you ____ (need) help, I will come.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **rains** · 2. **will pass** · 3. **comes** · 4. **will be** · 5. **need**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa

1. If it rains tomorrow, I will ____ at home.  
2. If the weather is nice, I will ____ for a walk.  
3. If you come to visit, I will ____ coffee.  
4. If I pass the exam, I will ____ with my friends.  
5. If I don't pass, I will ____ harder.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **stay** · 2. **go** · 3. **make** · 4. **celebrate** · 5. **study**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Une

1. If you finish your homework early,  
2. If it rains on Saturday,  
3. If you pass the exam,  
4. If the bus is late,  
5. If you need help,  

a) I will buy you a present.  
b) I will be late to work.  
c) I will let you go out tonight.  
d) just call me and I will come.  
e) we will stay at home and play games.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **e** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **b** · 5 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena / reescribe

1. stay / If / rains / I / it / will / home / at → ____  
2. Rewrite without starting with *If*: *If it rains, I will stay at home.* → ____

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **If it rains, I will stay at home.**  
2. **I will stay at home if it rains.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Negativa

1. If I ____ (not / pass), I will study harder.  
2. If you ____ (not / finish) early, I ____ (not / let) you go out.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **don't pass**  
2. **don't finish** · **won't let** / **will not let**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) If it will rain, I will stay home. · b) If it rains, I will stay home. · c) If it rains, I stay home. *(First Conditional A2)*  
2. ____  
   a) If she come, I will be happy. · b) If she comes, I will be happy. · c) If she will come, I will be happy.  
3. ____  
   a) I will stay at home if it rains. · b) I will stay at home, if it rains. *(coma típica)* · c) I stay at home if it will rain.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b** · 3. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *If it will rain, I will stay at home.*  
2. *If she come, I will be happy.*  
3. *If you study hard, you pass the exam.* *(futuro posible)*  
4. *If we will miss the bus, we will be late.*  
5. *I will stay at home, if it rains.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If it **rains**, I will stay at home.  
2. If she **comes**, I will be happy.  
3. If you study hard, you **will pass** the exam.  
4. If we **miss** the bus, we will be late.  
5. I will stay at home if it rains. *(sin coma)*
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce

1. Si llueve, me quedaré en casa.  
2. Si estudias mucho, aprobarás el examen.  
3. Si ella viene a la fiesta, estaré muy feliz.  
4. Si perdemos el autobús, llegaremos tarde.  
5. Si el tiempo es bueno, iré a pasear al parque.  
6. Si vienes a visitarme, te haré un café.  
7. Si apruebo, celebraré con mis amigos.  
8. Si no apruebo, estudiaré más la próxima vez.  
9. Si terminas los deberes temprano, te dejaré salir.  
10. Si necesitas ayuda, llámame y vendré.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If it rains, I will stay at home.  
2. If you study hard, you will pass the exam.  
3. If she comes to the party, I will be very happy.  
4. If we miss the bus, we will be late.  
5. If the weather is nice, I will go for a walk in the park.  
6. If you come to visit me, I will make coffee for you.  
7. If I pass, I will celebrate with my friends.  
8. If I don't pass, I will study harder next time.  
9. If you finish your homework early, I will let you go out.  
10. If you need help, call me and I will come.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Completa el listening

If you ____ your homework early, I will let you ____ out. If it ____ on Saturday, we will stay at home and ____ games. If you ____ the exam, I will buy you a present.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**finish** · **go** · **rains** · **play** · **pass**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tus condiciones

Escribe 8–12 líneas con First Conditional:

- 3 × *If…, I will…*  
- 1 × con *don't*  
- 1 × con el resultado primero (*I will… if…*)  
- Temas: tiempo, estudio, planes del fin de semana  

**Modelo:** el texto de planes de mañana.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Fórmula *If + Present Simple, will + infinitivo*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha los dos textos; subraya cada *If / will*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y di tus condiciones (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso Present Simple tras *If* (no *will*)  
- [ ] Uso *will* + infinitivo en el resultado  
- [ ] Cambio el orden de las cláusulas  
- [ ] Formo negativas con *don't / won't*  
- [ ] Puedo dar consejos y planes condicionados

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Primero la **condición** (Present Simple).  
2. Luego el **resultado** (*will*).  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 26](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 26 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-26).

La **Unidad 27** introduce el **Zero Conditional**: hechos generales (*If you heat water, it boils*).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Parte | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Condición | *If* + Present Simple |
| Resultado | *will* + infinitivo |
| Uso | posibilidad real en el futuro |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 27** verás el **Zero Conditional**.

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 27 — Zero Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional)

Curso:

- [Unidad 27 — Zero Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-27)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 26 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 26 — First Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-26)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U25 — Futuro: going to vs will vs Present Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous)
- [U23 — Will / Won't](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-23-will-wont-predicciones-promesas)
- [First Conditional](/blog/gramatica/first-conditional-ingles)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

title: Zero Conditional A2: If + Present Simple y Ejercicios
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 27 del curso A2: Zero Conditional (If + Present Simple, Present Simple), con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende el Zero Conditional A2 con if + present simple para hechos generales, rutinas y resultados, con reglas, ejemplos y ejercicios para practicar.
alt: Esquema del Zero Conditional A2
keywords: If you heat water it boils

faqs.question: ¿Qué es el Zero Conditional?
faqs.answer: Habla de verdades generales y hechos científicos: If you heat water, it boils. Forma: If + Present Simple, Present Simple (sin will).

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia con el First Conditional?
faqs.answer: Zero = siempre verdadero (hechos/rutinas): If you heat water, it boils. First = posibilidad futura: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.

faqs.question: ¿Uso will en el Zero Conditional?
faqs.answer: No. Ambas partes van en Present Simple. Incorrecto: If you heat water, it will boils. Correcto: If you heat water, it boils.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo cambiar el orden?
faqs.answer: Sí. If you heat water, it boils. / Water boils if you heat it. Con If al principio suele haber coma.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 27 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 27 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 26](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional) hablaste de posibilidades futuras. En la **Unidad 27 del curso A2** (*Zero Conditional*) hablas de lo que **siempre** pasa: *If you heat water, it boils.*

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 27 — Zero Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-27)  
> **Antes:** [U26 — First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 27 (A2)

- Formar **If + Present Simple, Present Simple**.
- Expresar **hechos generales** y **científicos**.
- Hablar de **rutinas** y resultados naturales.
- Contrastar con el **First Conditional** (U26).
- Evitar *will* en este tipo de condicional.

![Zero Conditional A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/a2-unit27-zero-conditional.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Parte | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Condición | *If* + **Present Simple** | If you **heat** water… |
| Resultado | **Present Simple** | … it **boils**. |

Significado: **si X (siempre), entonces Y (siempre)**.

> If you **heat** water, it **boils**.  
> If it **rains**, the ground **gets** wet.  
> If you **mix** red and blue, you **get** purple.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/heat-water-boils.mp3" title="🔊 If you heat water, it boils"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/rains-ground-wet.mp3" title="🔊 If it rains, the ground gets wet"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/mix-red-blue.mp3" title="🔊 If you mix red and blue, you get purple"></audio>

---

## 2. Zero vs First Conditional

![Zero vs First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/a2-unit27-zero-vs-first.png)

| | Zero (U27) | First (U26) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Forma | *If* + Present, **Present** | *If* + Present, **will** + infinitivo |
| Uso | hecho / verdad general | posibilidad futura |
| Ejemplo | If you heat water, it **boils**. | If it rains tomorrow, I **will stay** home. |
| Pregunta | ¿Siempre es así? | ¿Qué pasará si…? |

> Zero: If people **don't eat**, they **get** hungry.  
> First: If I **don't pass**, I **will study** harder next time.

---

## 3. Hechos, ciencia y rutinas

| Tipo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Ciencia | If you heat water to 100 degrees, it **boils**. |
| Ciencia | If you put ice in the sun, it **melts**. |
| Ciencia | If you freeze water, it **turns** into ice. |
| Rutina / salud | If you exercise regularly, you **stay** healthy. |
| Rutina / salud | If you don't sleep well, you **feel** tired the next day. |
| Hábito | If you read every day, your vocabulary **improves**. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/ice-melts.mp3" title="🔊 If you put ice in the sun, it melts"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/exercise-healthy.mp3" title="🔊 If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy"></audio>

---

## 4. Negativa y orden

> If you **don't eat** enough, you **feel** hungry.  
> If you **don't water** plants, they **die**.  
> If you **don't sleep** well, you **feel** tired.

Orden flexible:

> If you heat water, it boils.  
> Water boils if you heat it.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/dont-eat-hungry.mp3" title="🔊 If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/dont-water-plants.mp3" title="🔊 If you don't water plants, they die"></audio>

---

## 5. Texto modelo: verdades generales

> If you heat water, it boils. If you freeze water, it turns into ice. If you mix red and blue, you get purple. If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry. If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy. If you don't sleep well, you feel tired the next day.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/reading-truths.mp3" title="🔊 If you heat water, it boils…"></audio>

![Hechos siempre verdaderos](/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/a2-unit27-facts.png)

| If… | … Present Simple |
| :--- | :--- |
| heat water | boils |
| freeze water | turns into ice |
| mix red and blue | get purple |
| don't eat enough | feel hungry |
| exercise regularly | stay healthy |
| don't sleep well | feel tired |

---

## 6. Listening: ciencia y hábitos

> If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils. If you put ice in the sun, it melts. If you don't water plants, they die. If you eat too much sugar, you get tired. If you drink water every day, you feel better. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/dialogue-science.mp3" title="🔊 If you heat water to 100 degrees, it boils…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Agua a 100°? → *boils*  
2. ¿Hielo al sol? → *melts*  
3. ¿No riegan plantas? → *die*  
4. ¿Mucha azúcar? → *get tired*  
5. ¿Leer cada día? → *vocabulary improves*

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> If you heat water, it…  
> If you don't sleep well, you…  
> If you read every day, …  
> What happens if…?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 If you heat water, it boils…"></audio>

1. Di **4** hechos con Zero Conditional.  
2. Incluye **1** negativa (*If you don't…*).  
3. Pregunta: *What happens if…?*

---

## 8. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| general truth / scientific fact | verdad general / hecho científico |
| heat / freeze / boil / melt | calentar / congelar / hervir / derretir |
| mix / get / turn into | mezclar / obtener / convertirse en |
| ice / water / degrees | hielo / agua / grados |
| hungry / tired / healthy | hambriento / cansado / saludable |
| exercise / sleep / eat / drink | hacer ejercicio / dormir / comer / beber |
| water (v.) plants / die | regar plantas / morir |
| sugar / vocabulary / improve | azúcar / vocabulario / mejorar |
| regularly / every day / enough | regularmente / cada día / suficiente |
| the next day / in the sun | al día siguiente / al sol |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| If you heat water, it **will boil**. *(hecho general)* | If you heat water, it **boils**. | Zero → Present + Present |
| If you **will** heat water, it boils. | If you **heat** water, it boils. | Tras *If* → Present |
| If you mix red and blue, you **will get** purple. *(hecho)* | … you **get** purple. | Verdad general |
| If people don't eat, they **will get** hungry. *(siempre)* | … they **get** hungry. | Zero, no First |
| Confundir Zero y First | Pregunta: ¿siempre o futuro posible? | Elige la unidad correcta |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/freeze-ice.mp3" title="🔊 If you freeze water, it turns into ice"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/read-vocabulary.mp3" title="🔊 If you read every day, your vocabulary improves"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-27/drink-water-better.mp3" title="🔊 If you drink water every day, you feel better"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa (Present Simple)

1. If you heat water, it ____ (boil).  
2. If it rains, the ground ____ (get) wet.  
3. If you mix red and blue, you ____ (get) purple.  
4. If you don't eat enough, you ____ (feel) hungry.  
5. If you exercise regularly, you ____ (stay) healthy.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **boils** · 2. **gets** · 3. **get** · 4. **feel** · 5. **stay**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Zero o First

Marca **Z** o **F**:

1. If you heat water, it boils.  
2. If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home.  
3. If you don't sleep well, you feel tired.  
4. If I pass the exam, I will celebrate.  
5. If you put ice in the sun, it melts.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Z** · 2. **F** · 3. **Z** · 4. **F** · 5. **Z**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa el texto

If you ____ water, it boils. If you ____ water, it turns into ice. If you ____ red and blue, you get purple. If you don't ____ enough, you feel hungry.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**heat** · **freeze** · **mix** · **eat**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa el listening

If you heat water to ____ degrees, it boils. If you put ice in the sun, it ____. If you don't water plants, they ____. If you read every day, your vocabulary ____.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**100** · **melts** · **die** · **improves**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Empareja

1. heat water  
2. freeze water  
3. mix red and blue  
4. don't water plants  
5. read every day  

a) get purple · b) boils · c) die · d) turns into ice · e) vocabulary improves

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **c** · 5 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Elige

1. Hecho científico:  
   a) If you heat water, it will boil. · b) If you heat water, it boils. · c) If you will heat water, it boils.  
2. Posibilidad mañana:  
   a) If it rains tomorrow, I stay home. · b) If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home. · c) If it will rain tomorrow, I stay home.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *If you heat water, it will boil.* *(hecho general)*  
2. *If you will freeze water, it turns into ice.*  
3. *If you don't sleep well, you will feel tired.* *(verdad general de rutina)*  
4. *If people don't eat, they will get hungry.* *(siempre)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If you heat water, it **boils**.  
2. If you **freeze** water, it turns into ice.  
3. If you don't sleep well, you **feel** tired.  
4. If people don't eat, they **get** hungry.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce

1. Si calientas agua, hierve.  
2. Si congelas agua, se convierte en hielo.  
3. Si mezclas rojo y azul, obtienes morado.  
4. Si no comes lo suficiente, tienes hambre.  
5. Si haces ejercicio regularmente, te mantienes saludable.  
6. Si no duermes bien, te sientes cansado al día siguiente.  
7. Si pones hielo al sol, se derrite.  
8. Si no riegas las plantas, mueren.  
9. Si bebes agua cada día, te sientes mejor.  
10. Si lees cada día, tu vocabulario mejora.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. If you heat water, it boils.  
2. If you freeze water, it turns into ice.  
3. If you mix red and blue, you get purple.  
4. If you don't eat enough, you feel hungry.  
5. If you exercise regularly, you stay healthy.  
6. If you don't sleep well, you feel tired the next day.  
7. If you put ice in the sun, it melts.  
8. If you don't water plants, they die.  
9. If you drink water every day, you feel better.  
10. If you read every day, your vocabulary improves.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Reescribe el orden

1. If you heat water, it boils. → ____ *(empieza por Water…)*  
2. If you put ice in the sun, it melts. → ____

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Water boils if you heat it.**  
2. **Ice melts if you put it in the sun.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tus verdades

Escribe 8–12 líneas con Zero Conditional:

- 3 × hechos / ciencia  
- 2 × hábitos de salud o estudio  
- 1 × negativa  
- 1 contraste con First: una frase Zero y una First  

**Modelo:** el texto de verdades generales.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Fórmula Zero + contraste con First.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha los dos textos; marca Present + Present.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe tus verdades (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso Present Simple en **ambas** partes  
- [ ] Distingo Zero (siempre) y First (futuro posible)  
- [ ] Hablo de hechos y rutinas  
- [ ] Formo negativas (*don't…*)  
- [ ] Evito *will* en Zero Conditional

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta: ¿es **siempre** así? → Zero.  
2. ¿Es un **plan/resultado futuro posible**? → First.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 27](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 27 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-27).

La **Unidad 28** introduce **Have to / Don't have to**: obligaciones.

---

## Resumen rápido

| | Zero Conditional |
| :--- | :--- |
| Forma | *If* + Present Simple, Present Simple |
| Uso | hechos generales, ciencia, rutinas |
| vs First | sin *will* · verdad siempre |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 28** verás **Have to / Don't have to**.

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 28 — Have to / Don't have to](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to)

Curso:

- [Unidad 28 — Have to / Don't have to](/curso-a2/unit-28)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 27 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 27 — Zero Conditional](/curso-a2/unit-27)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U26 — First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional)
- [First Conditional](/blog/gramatica/first-conditional-ingles)
- [U25 — Contraste de futuros](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-25-futuro-going-to-will-present-continuous)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/

title: Have To y Don't Have To A2: Obligación y Ejemplos
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 28 del curso A2: have to y don't have to para obligaciones y lo opcional, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende have to y don't have to en inglés A2 para expresar obligación y ausencia de obligación, con reglas, ejemplos y ejercicios para practicar.
alt: Esquema de have to y don't have to A2
keywords: have to don't have to A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso have to?
faqs.answer: Para obligaciones o necesidad: I have to get up early. She has to wear a uniform. Con he/she/it usas has to.

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa don't have to?
faqs.answer: Que no es necesario (opcional): I don't have to work on Saturdays. No significa prohibición; significa que puedes no hacerlo.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo hago preguntas?
faqs.answer: Do/Does + sujeto + have to + infinitivo…? Do you have to wear a uniform? Does she have to pay today?

faqs.question: ¿Have to o has to?
faqs.answer: I/you/we/they → have to. He/she/it → has to. Negativa: don't have to / doesn't have to.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 28 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 28 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 27](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional) hablaste de hechos generales. En la **Unidad 28 del curso A2** (*Have to / Don't have to*) hablas de **obligaciones** y de lo que **no es necesario**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 28 — Have to / Don't have to](/curso-a2/unit-28)  
> **Antes:** [U27 — Zero Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 28 (A2)

- Usar **have to / has to** (obligación).
- Usar **don't / doesn't have to** (no necesario).
- Preguntar: **Do / Does … have to…?**
- Hablar de reglas en **trabajo** y **escuela**.
- Distinguir obligación de opción.

![Have to / Don't have to A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/a2-unit28-have-to.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Forma | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **have to / has to** | es necesario / obligación | I **have to** get up early. |
| **don't / doesn't have to** | no es necesario (opcional) | I **don't have to** work on Saturdays. |

> She **has to** wear a uniform at work.  
> You **don't have to** wear a tie today — it's optional.  
> He **doesn't have to** pay the bill today.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/have-to-get-up.mp3" title="🔊 I have to get up early every day"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/has-to-uniform.mp3" title="🔊 She has to wear a uniform at work"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/dont-have-to-saturdays.mp3" title="🔊 I don't have to work on Saturdays"></audio>

---

## 2. Formas

![Formas de have to](/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/a2-unit28-forms.png)

| Sujeto | Afirmativa | Negativa | Pregunta |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I / you / we / they | **have to** | **don't have to** | **Do** you **have to**…? |
| he / she / it | **has to** | **doesn't have to** | **Does** she **have to**…? |

Después de *have to / has to* va el **infinitivo**: *go, wear, pay, study…*

> **Do** you **have to** wear a uniform? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.  
> **Does** he **have to** pay today? — No, he **doesn't**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/do-you-have-to.mp3" title="🔊 Do you have to wear a uniform?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/doesnt-have-to-pay.mp3" title="🔊 He doesn't have to pay the bill today"></audio>

---

## 3. Obligación vs opcional (cuidado)

| Frase | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| You **have to** arrive on time. | Obligación / regla |
| You **don't have to** bring lunch. | No es necesario (puedes, pero no hace falta) |

*Don't have to* **no** es lo mismo que “no debes / está prohibido”. En A2: **no es obligatorio**.

---

## 4. Trabajo, casa y escuela

| Contexto | *have to* | *don't have to* |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Trabajo | get up early · wear a uniform · pay bills | work on Saturdays · cook today |
| Escuela | wear uniform · arrive on time · do homework | bring lunch · pay for books |
| Estudio | study tonight for the exam | — |

> I **have to** study tonight for my exam tomorrow.  
> I **don't have to** cook today because my mother is making dinner.  
> Students **don't have to** pay for books — the school gives them free.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/have-to-study.mp3" title="🔊 I have to study tonight for my exam tomorrow"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/dont-have-to-cook.mp3" title="🔊 I don't have to cook today"></audio>

---

## 5. Texto modelo: un día con obligaciones

> I have to get up early every day because I work at 8 o'clock. I have to wear a uniform at work. I don't have to work on Saturdays, so I can rest. I have to pay my bills every month. I don't have to cook today because my mother is making dinner. I have to study tonight for my exam tomorrow.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/reading-day.mp3" title="🔊 I have to get up early every day…"></audio>

![Reglas en trabajo y escuela](/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/a2-unit28-rules.png)

| Obligación | No necesario |
| :--- | :--- |
| get up early | work on Saturdays |
| wear a uniform | cook today |
| pay bills every month | — |
| study tonight | — |

---

## 6. Listening: reglas en la escuela

> At school, students have to wear uniform. They have to arrive on time. They don't have to bring lunch because the school has a canteen. Students have to do homework every day. They don't have to pay for books — the school gives them free. Teachers have to correct exams and help students.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/dialogue-school.mp3" title="🔊 At school, students have to wear uniform…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Uniforme? → *have to wear uniform*  
2. ¿Llegar? → *have to arrive on time*  
3. ¿Traer comida? → *don't have to* (canteen)  
4. ¿Deberes? → *have to do homework every day*  
5. ¿Pagar libros? → *don't have to* (free)

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> I have to…  
> I don't have to…  
> Do you have to…?  
> She has to / doesn't have to…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I have to… I don't have to… Do you have to…?"></audio>

1. Di **3** obligaciones (*I have to…*).  
2. Di **2** cosas opcionales (*I don't have to…*).  
3. Pregunta a un compañero: *Do you have to…?*

---

## 8. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| obligation / rule / necessary / optional | obligación / regla / necesario / opcional |
| have to / has to / don't have to | tener que / no tener que |
| get up early / arrive on time | levantarse temprano / llegar a tiempo |
| wear a uniform / wear a tie | llevar uniforme / corbata |
| work / pay bills / cook | trabajar / pagar facturas / cocinar |
| homework / exam / study | deberes / examen / estudiar |
| canteen / books / free | cafetería / libros / gratis |
| correct exams / help students | corregir exámenes / ayudar |
| every day / every month / tonight | cada día / cada mes / esta noche |
| on Saturdays / tomorrow | los sábados / mañana |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| She **have to** wear a uniform. | She **has to** wear… | *she* → *has to* |
| He **don't have to** pay. | He **doesn't have to** pay. | *he* → *doesn't* |
| Do she have to…? | **Does** she have to…? | *Does* con *he/she/it* |
| I have to **to** go. | I have to go. | Un infinitivo, sin *to* doble |
| Don't have to = prohibido | Don't have to = **no necesario** | No confundir con *mustn't* (más adelante) |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/students-have-to-homework.mp3" title="🔊 Students have to do homework every day"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/dont-have-to-books.mp3" title="🔊 They don't have to pay for books"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-28/teachers-have-to.mp3" title="🔊 Teachers have to correct exams and help students"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *have to* o *has to*

1. I ____ go to work tomorrow.  
2. She ____ wear a uniform at work.  
3. They ____ arrive on time.  
4. He ____ study tonight.  
5. We ____ pay our bills every month.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have to** · 2. **has to** · 3. **have to** · 4. **has to** · 5. **have to**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *don't / doesn't have to*

1. I ____ work on Saturdays.  
2. He ____ pay the bill today. *(optional)*  
3. You ____ wear a tie today. *(optional)*  
4. She ____ cook tonight.  
5. Students ____ bring lunch. *(canteen)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **don't have to** · 2. **doesn't have to** · 3. **don't have to** · 4. **doesn't have to** · 5. **don't have to**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Preguntas

1. ____ you have to wear a uniform?  
2. ____ she have to get up early?  
3. ____ they have to do homework every day?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Do** · 2. **Does** · 3. **Do**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa el texto

I ____ to get up early every day. I ____ to wear a uniform at work. I ____ have to work on Saturdays. I ____ to study tonight for my exam.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**have** · **have** · **don't** · **have**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa la escuela

Students ____ to wear uniform. They ____ to arrive on time. They ____ have to bring lunch. They ____ have to pay for books. Teachers ____ to correct exams.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**have** · **have** · **don't** · **don't** · **have**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja

1. have to  
2. don't have to  
3. has to  
4. doesn't have to  
5. Do you have to…?  

a) pregunta · b) obligación (*I/you/we/they*) · c) no necesario (*I/you…*) · d) obligación (*he/she*) · e) no necesario (*he/she*)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *She have to wear a uniform.*  
2. *He don't have to pay today.*  
3. *Do she have to study tonight?*  
4. *I have to to get up early.*  
5. *They has to arrive on time.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She **has to** wear a uniform.  
2. He **doesn't have to** pay today.  
3. **Does** she have to study tonight?  
4. I have to get up early.  
5. They **have to** arrive on time.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce

1. Tengo que levantarme temprano cada día.  
2. Ella tiene que llevar uniforme.  
3. No tengo que trabajar los sábados.  
4. Él no tiene que pagar hoy.  
5. ¿Tienes que llevar uniforme?  
6. Los estudiantes tienen que llegar a tiempo.  
7. No tienen que traer comida.  
8. Tengo que estudiar esta noche.  
9. No tengo que cocinar hoy.  
10. Los profesores tienen que corregir exámenes.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I have to get up early every day.  
2. She has to wear a uniform.  
3. I don't have to work on Saturdays.  
4. He doesn't have to pay today.  
5. Do you have to wear a uniform?  
6. Students have to arrive on time.  
7. They don't have to bring lunch.  
8. I have to study tonight.  
9. I don't have to cook today.  
10. Teachers have to correct exams.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Obligación u opción

Marca **O** (obligación) o **Op** (opcional / no necesario):

1. I have to pay my bills every month.  
2. I don't have to work on Saturdays.  
3. Students have to do homework every day.  
4. They don't have to pay for books.  
5. She has to wear a uniform at work.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **O** · 2. **Op** · 3. **O** · 4. **Op** · 5. **O**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tus reglas

Escribe 8–12 líneas sobre tu trabajo/estudios/casa:

- 3 × *I have to…*  
- 2 × *I don't have to…*  
- 1 × *he/she has to…*  
- 1 × pregunta *Do you have to…?*  

**Modelo:** el texto del día o las reglas de la escuela.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla *have to / has to / don't / doesn't*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha trabajo y escuela; marca obligaciones.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe tus reglas (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *have to / has to* para obligación  
- [ ] Uso *don't / doesn't have to* para lo no necesario  
- [ ] Pregunto con *Do/Does … have to…?*  
- [ ] Distingo obligación y opción  
- [ ] Puedo hablar de reglas en trabajo y escuela

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. ¿Es **necesario**? → *have to / has to*.  
2. ¿Es **opcional**? → *don't / doesn't have to*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 28](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 28 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-28).

La **Unidad 29** introduce **Could**: capacidad en pasado y peticiones educadas (*Could you…?*).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Forma | Uso |
| :--- | :--- |
| *have to / has to* | obligación |
| *don't / doesn't have to* | no necesario |
| *Do/Does … have to…?* | pregunta |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 29** verás **Could: Past Ability & Polite Requests**.

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 29 — Could](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-29-could-habilidad-peticiones)

Curso:

- [Unidad 29 — Could](/curso-a2/unit-29)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 28 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 28 — Have to / Don't have to](/curso-a2/unit-28)

Guías relacionadas:

- [U27 — Zero Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-27-zero-conditional)
- [U26 — First Conditional](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-26-first-conditional)
- [Verbos modales](/blog/gramatica/verbos-modales-ingles-guia)
- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Have to: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar

title: ¿Cómo se Usa Could en Inglés? Habilidad y Peticiones (A2)
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: I could swim, Could you...? Aprende a usar could para hablar de capacidad pasada y hacer peticiones corteses (Unidad 29 A2).
description: Aprende could en inglés A2: capacidad en el pasado (I could swim) y peticiones corteses (Could you…?). Guía Unidad 29 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema de could para habilidad pasada y peticiones A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso could para el pasado?
faqs.answer: Para habilidad en el pasado: When I was young, I could swim very well. I could ride a bike at the age of five. Negativa: couldn't.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pido algo de forma educada?
faqs.answer: Con Could you…, please?: Could you pass the salt, please? Could you help me with this bag? Es más cortés que un mandato directo.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre can y could?
faqs.answer: Can = habilidad ahora (I can swim now). Could = habilidad pasada (I could swim when I was a child) o petición educada (Could you open the window?).

faqs.question: ¿Could cambia con he/she?
faqs.answer: No. Could es igual para todos: I/you/he/she/we/they could + infinitivo.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 29 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el [cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-29-could-habilidad-peticiones-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la Unidad 29 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 28](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to) hablaste de obligaciones. En la **Unidad 29 del curso A2** (*Could: Past Ability & Polite Requests*) usas **could** para lo que **podías** hacer antes y para pedir con educación.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 29 — Could](/curso-a2/unit-29)  
> **Antes:** [U28 — Have to / Don't have to](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-28-have-to-dont-have-to)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 29 (A2)

- Usar **could** + infinitivo para **habilidad pasada**.
- Formar **couldn't** (no podía).
- Hacer **peticiones educadas**: *Could you…, please?*
- Contrastar con **can** (ahora).
- Responder a peticiones de forma natural.

![Could A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/a2-unit29-could.png)

---

## 1. Dos usos de *could*

| Uso | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Past ability** | lo que sabías / podías hacer antes | When I was young, I **could** swim. |
| **Polite request** | pedir con educación | **Could you** pass the salt, please? |

Misma palabra. Contexto distinto.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-swim.mp3" title="🔊 When I was young, I could swim very well"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-you-pass-salt.mp3" title="🔊 Could you pass the salt, please?"></audio>

---

## 2. Habilidad pasada: *could / couldn't*

Forma: **could / couldn't** + infinitivo (igual para todos los sujetos).

> When I was a child, I **could** swim very well.  
> I **could** ride a bike at the age of five.  
> She **could** speak French when she was a child.  
> I **couldn't** speak English when I was young, but now I **can**.  
> When I was young, I **could** run very fast.  
> I **could** play the piano at the age of seven.  
> I **couldn't** cook when I lived with my parents.

Marcadores útiles: *when I was young / a child*, *at the age of…*, *then / now*.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-ride-bike.mp3" title="🔊 I could ride a bike at the age of five"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/couldnt-speak-english.mp3" title="🔊 I couldn't speak English when I was young, but now I can"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-play-piano.mp3" title="🔊 I could play the piano at the age of seven"></audio>

---

## 3. Peticiones educadas: *Could you…?*

Patrón: **Could you** + infinitivo + **…, please?**

> **Could you** pass me the salt, please?  
> **Could you** help me with this bag?  
> **Could you** open the window? It's hot in here.  
> **Could you** turn down the volume, please?  
> **Could you** repeat that, please?  
> **Could you** tell me the time? I forgot my watch at home.

Respuestas típicas: *Sure. / Of course. / No problem. / Sorry, I can't.*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-you-help.mp3" title="🔊 Could you help me with this bag?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-you-open-window.mp3" title="🔊 Could you open the window? It's hot in here"></audio>

---

## 4. *Can* vs *could*

![Can vs could](/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/a2-unit29-can-vs-could.png)

| | *can* | *could* |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Habilidad ahora | I **can** swim now. | — |
| Habilidad pasada | — | I **could** swim when I was a child. |
| Petición | Can you…? *(más directo)* | **Could you…?** *(más educado)* |

En esta unidad prioriza: pasado = *could* · petición cortés = *Could you…?*

---

## 5. Texto modelo: niño y peticiones

> When I was a child, I could swim very well. I could ride a bike at the age of five. I couldn't speak English when I was young, but now I can. Could you pass me the salt, please? Could you help me with this bag? Could you open the window? It is hot in here.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/reading-child.mp3" title="🔊 When I was a child, I could swim very well…"></audio>

![Then & Please](/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/a2-unit29-then-please.png)

| Entonces (*could*) | Ahora / petición |
| :--- | :--- |
| swim very well | now I **can** speak English |
| ride a bike (age five) | Could you pass the salt? |
| couldn't speak English | Could you help me? / open the window? |

---

## 6. Listening: joven y por favor

> When I was young, I could run very fast. I could play the piano at the age of seven. I couldn't cook when I lived with my parents. Could you turn down the volume, please? Could you repeat that, please? Could you tell me the time? I forgot my watch at home.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/dialogue-young.mp3" title="🔊 When I was young, I could run very fast…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿De niño/joven? → *run very fast*  
2. ¿Piano? → *at the age of seven*  
3. ¿Cocinar con los padres? → *couldn't*  
4. ¿Peticiones? → *turn down the volume / repeat / tell the time*

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> When I was a child, I could…  
> I couldn't…  
> Could you…, please?  
> Now I can…

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 When I was a child, I could… Could you…, please?"></audio>

1. Di **2** habilidades pasadas y **1** *couldn't*.  
2. Haz **3** peticiones con *Could you…?*  
3. Contrasta: *Then I could… / Now I can…*

---

## 8. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| ability / request / polite | habilidad / petición / educado |
| could / couldn't / can | podía / no podía / puedo |
| swim / ride a bike / run | nadar / montar en bici / correr |
| play the piano / cook / speak | tocar el piano / cocinar / hablar |
| pass the salt / help / open | pasar la sal / ayudar / abrir |
| turn down the volume / repeat | bajar el volumen / repetir |
| tell me the time / watch | decir la hora / reloj |
| when I was young / a child | cuando era joven / niño |
| at the age of five / seven | a los cinco / siete años |
| please / Sure / Of course | por favor / claro / por supuesto |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I could **to** swim. | I could swim. | Infinitivo sin *to* |
| She **coulds** speak French. | She **could** speak… | *could* no cambia |
| When I was young, I **can** swim. | … I **could** swim. | Pasado → *could* |
| Pass the salt! *(muy directo)* | **Could you** pass the salt, please? | Petición educada |
| Could you **to** help me? | Could you help me? | Sin *to* |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-run-fast.mp3" title="🔊 When I was young, I could run very fast"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/couldnt-cook.mp3" title="🔊 I couldn't cook when I lived with my parents"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-29/could-you-repeat.mp3" title="🔊 Could you repeat that, please?"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *could* o *can*

1. When I was young, I ____ swim very well.  
2. Now I ____ speak English.  
3. She ____ speak French when she was a child.  
4. I ____ cook when I lived with my parents. *(negativa)*  
5. ____ you pass the salt, please?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **could** · 2. **can** · 3. **could** · 4. **couldn't** · 5. **Could**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa la petición

1. Could you ____ the salt, please?  
2. Could you ____ me with this bag?  
3. Could you ____ the window?  
4. Could you ____ down the volume, please?  
5. Could you ____ that, please?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **pass** · 2. **help** · 3. **open** · 4. **turn** · 5. **repeat**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa el texto

When I was a child, I ____ swim very well. I ____ ride a bike at the age of five. I ____ speak English when I was young, but now I ____.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**could** · **could** · **couldn't** · **can**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa el listening

When I was young, I could ____ very fast. I could play the ____ at the age of seven. I ____ cook when I lived with my parents. Could you tell me the ____?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**run** · **piano** · **couldn't** · **time**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Empareja

1. past ability  
2. polite request  
3. present ability  
4. negative past  

a) Could you help me? · b) I can swim now. · c) I could swim then. · d) I couldn't cook.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **b** · 4 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Elige

1. Habilidad de niño:  
   a) I can swim when I was a child. · b) I could swim when I was a child. · c) I could to swim when I was a child.  
2. Petición educada:  
   a) Open the window! · b) Could you open the window, please? · c) You open the window.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *I could to swim very well.*  
2. *She coulds speak French.*  
3. *When I was young, I can run fast.*  
4. *Could you to help me?*  
5. *I no could cook.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I could swim very well.  
2. She **could** speak French.  
3. When I was young, I **could** run fast.  
4. Could you help me?  
5. I **couldn't** cook.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce

1. Cuando era niño, podía nadar muy bien.  
2. Podía montar en bici a los cinco años.  
3. No podía hablar inglés de joven, pero ahora puedo.  
4. ¿Podrías pasarme la sal, por favor?  
5. ¿Podrías ayudarme con esta bolsa?  
6. ¿Podrías abrir la ventana?  
7. Cuando era joven, podía correr muy rápido.  
8. Podía tocar el piano a los siete años.  
9. No podía cocinar cuando vivía con mis padres.  
10. ¿Podrías repetir eso, por favor?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. When I was a child, I could swim very well.  
2. I could ride a bike at the age of five.  
3. I couldn't speak English when I was young, but now I can.  
4. Could you pass me the salt, please?  
5. Could you help me with this bag?  
6. Could you open the window?  
7. When I was young, I could run very fast.  
8. I could play the piano at the age of seven.  
9. I couldn't cook when I lived with my parents.  
10. Could you repeat that, please?
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Entonces o petición

Marca **P** (pasado) o **R** (request):

1. I could ride a bike at the age of five.  
2. Could you turn down the volume, please?  
3. I couldn't cook then.  
4. Could you tell me the time?  
5. She could speak French when she was a child.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **P** · 2. **R** · 3. **P** · 4. **R** · 5. **P**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu texto

Escribe 8–12 líneas:

- 3 × *When I was…, I could…*  
- 1 × *I couldn't…*  
- 1 × contraste *now I can…*  
- 3 × *Could you…, please?*  

**Modelo:** el texto del niño o el del piano.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Dos usos de *could* + *can* vs *could*.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha los textos; separa pasado y peticiones.  
4. **5–8 min** — Graba tus frases (Ejercicio 10).

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *could* para habilidad pasada  
- [ ] Formo *couldn't*  
- [ ] Pido con *Could you…, please?*  
- [ ] Distingo *can* (ahora) y *could* (pasado / cortesía)  
- [ ] Puedo hablar de mi infancia y pedir ayuda

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. ¿Hablas del **pasado**? → *could / couldn't*.  
2. ¿**Pides** algo? → *Could you…?*  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 29](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-29-could-habilidad-peticiones-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 29 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-29).

La **Unidad 30** es el **Repaso del Módulo 3**: futuro, condicionales y *have to / could*.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Uso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Habilidad pasada | *could / couldn't* + infinitivo |
| Petición educada | *Could you…, please?* |
| Ahora | *can* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 30** harás el **Repaso del Módulo 3**.

- [Unidad 30 — Repaso Módulo 3](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-30-repaso-modulo-3)

Guías relacionadas:
