title: ¿Present Perfect o Past Simple? Diferencias Clave (A2)
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Ever, just o yesterday: aprende a elegir entre Present Perfect y Past Simple según los marcadores temporales, con audios y ejercicios (A2).
description: Aprende a elegir Present Perfect o Past Simple en inglés A2: experiencia vs momento concreto. Guía Unidad 15 con marcadores, audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Present Perfect vs Past Simple A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso Present Perfect y cuándo Past Simple?
faqs.answer: Present Perfect para experiencias o resultados sin decir cuándo exacto (ever, never, already, yet, just). Past Simple cuando das un momento concreto del pasado (yesterday, last week, ago, in 2020).

faqs.question: ¿Puedo decir I have been to Paris last year?
faqs.answer: No. Last year es un tiempo acabado: usa Past Simple — I went to Paris last year. Para experiencia sin fecha: I have been to Paris.

faqs.question: ¿Ever va con Present Perfect o Past Simple?
faqs.answer: En A2, ever/never van con Present Perfect: Have you ever been to Japan? I have never been to Australia.

faqs.question: ¿Just y already también eligen Present Perfect?
faqs.answer: Sí. Just, already y yet se usan con Present Perfect en este nivel: I have just arrived. I have already booked my trip. I haven't finished yet.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 15 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 15 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 14](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-14-present-perfect-just) dijiste *I have just…*. En la **Unidad 15 del curso A2** (*Present Perfect vs Past Simple*) aprendes a **elegir el tiempo**: experiencia / resultado cercano vs momento concreto del pasado.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 15 — Present Perfect vs Past Simple](/curso-a2/unit-15)  
> **Antes:** [U14 — Just](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-14-present-perfect-just)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 15 (A2)

- Usar **Present Perfect** para experiencias sin fecha (*I have been to…*).
- Usar **Past Simple** con momento concreto (*I went… last year*).
- Reconocer **marcadores**: *ever / never / already / yet / just* vs *yesterday / last… / ago*.
- Evitar mezclas como *I have been to Paris last year*.
- Leer y escuchar textos que **mezclan** ambos tiempos.

![Present Perfect vs Past Simple A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/a2-unit15-pp-vs-ps.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Tiempo | ¿Cuándo? | Pregunta mental |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Present Perfect** | experiencia / resultado ligado al presente; **sin** momento concreto | ¿Ha pasado alguna vez? ¿Ya / aún / acaba de…? |
| **Past Simple** | acción **acabada** en un momento concreto | ¿Cuándo? (*yesterday, last week, ago…*) |

Regla de oro A2: **mira el marcador de tiempo**. Él casi siempre elige el verbo.

---

## 2. Present Perfect (repaso rápido)

Forma: **have/has + past participle**

> I **have been** to many countries.  
> I **have never been** to Australia.  
> **Have** you **ever been** to Japan?  
> I **have already** booked my next trip.  
> I **have just** arrived.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/have-been-many-countries.mp3" title="🔊 I have been to many countries"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/have-never-been-australia.mp3" title="🔊 I have never been to Australia"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/have-you-ever-japan.mp3" title="🔊 Have you ever been to Japan?"></audio>

Marcadores típicos: **ever, never, already, yet, just** (+ *recently* opcional).

---

## 3. Past Simple (repaso rápido)

Forma: verbo en pasado (*went, visited, ate, saw, read, finished…*) o *did/didn't* en negativas y preguntas.

> Last year I **went** to Japan.  
> I **visited** Tokyo and Kyoto.  
> Two months ago I **travelled** to Italy.  
> I **ate** pizza in Naples.  
> Yesterday she **saw** him.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/went-japan-last-year.mp3" title="🔊 Last year I went to Japan"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/two-months-ago-italy.mp3" title="🔊 Two months ago I travelled to Italy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/ate-pizza-naples.mp3" title="🔊 I ate pizza in Naples"></audio>

Marcadores típicos: **yesterday, last week / month / year, … ago, in 2019, on Monday**.

---

## 4. Marcadores: la clave del contraste

![Marcadores Present Perfect y Past Simple](/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/a2-unit15-time-markers.png)

| Con Present Perfect | Con Past Simple |
| :--- | :--- |
| ever | yesterday |
| never | last week / last month / last year |
| already | … ago (*two days ago, three weeks ago*) |
| yet | in 2020 / on Monday |
| just | when I was a child *(momento cerrado)* |

Parejas típicas:

| Present Perfect | Past Simple |
| :--- | :--- |
| I **have been** to Paris. | I **went** to Paris **last year**. |
| **Have** you **ever** eaten sushi? | **Did** you eat sushi **yesterday**? |
| I **have never** read sci-fi. | I **read** a novel **last month**. |
| I **have already** bought the book. | I **bought** the book **three weeks ago**. |

---

## 5. Errores que hay que evitar

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I have been to Paris last year. | I **went** to Paris last year. | *last year* → Past Simple |
| I went to Paris. *(si quieres experiencia sin fecha)* | I **have been** to Paris. | experiencia → Present Perfect |
| Did you ever go to Japan? *(prioridad A2)* | **Have** you **ever been** to Japan? | *ever* → Present Perfect |
| I have saw him yesterday. | I **saw** him yesterday. | *yesterday* + Past Simple; participio mal |
| She has visited Tokyo last year. | She **visited** Tokyo last year. | *last year* → Past Simple |
| I have finished my book three weeks ago. | I **finished** my book three weeks ago. | *ago* → Past Simple |

---

## 6. Texto modelo: Jake

> My name is Jake. I love travelling. I have been to many countries in my life. I have never been to Australia but I want to go one day. Last year I went to Japan. It was amazing. I visited Tokyo and Kyoto. Two months ago I travelled to Italy. I ate pizza in Naples and saw the Colosseum in Rome. I have already booked my next trip to Spain. I am excited!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/reading-jake.mp3" title="🔊 My name is Jake. I love travelling…"></audio>

![Viajes de Jake con ambos tiempos](/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/a2-unit15-jake-travels.png)

| Frase | Tiempo | Señal |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I have been to many countries | Present Perfect | experiencia (sin fecha) |
| I have never been to Australia | Present Perfect | *never* |
| Last year I went to Japan | Past Simple | *last year* |
| Two months ago I travelled to Italy | Past Simple | *ago* |
| I ate pizza… / I saw the Colosseum… | Past Simple | parte del viaje concreto |
| I have already booked my next trip | Present Perfect | *already* |

---

## 7. Listening: Nina

> Hi! I am Nina. I love reading. I have read many books in my life. I have never read a science fiction book but I want to try one. Last month I read a great novel by Jane Austen. It was beautiful. Three weeks ago I finished a mystery book. I really enjoyed it. I have already bought my next book for the holidays. I am excited!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/dialogue-nina.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! I am Nina. I love reading…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Ha leído ciencia ficción? → *No* (*have never read*)  
2. ¿Qué leyó el mes pasado? → *a novel by Jane Austen* (Past Simple + *last month*)  
3. ¿Cuándo terminó el misterio? → *three weeks ago* (Past Simple)  
4. ¿Qué ha hecho ya para las vacaciones? → *bought her next book* (*already* + Present Perfect)

---

## 8. Mini práctica oral

> I have been to many countries.  
> Last year I went to Japan.  
> I have never been to Australia.  
> Two months ago I travelled to Italy.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I have been to many countries…"></audio>

1. Di 2 experiencias con Present Perfect (*I have… / I have never…*).  
2. Di 2 hechos con fecha: *Last year / … ago I…*  
3. Combina: *I have been to X. Last year I went to Y.*

---

## 9. Vocabulario y marcadores (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea / uso |
| :--- | :--- |
| ever / never | alguna vez / nunca → Present Perfect |
| already / yet / just | ya / aún / acabar de → Present Perfect |
| yesterday | ayer → Past Simple |
| last week / month / year | la semana / mes / año pasado → Past Simple |
| … ago | hace… → Past Simple |
| travel / trip | viajar / viaje |
| visit | visitar |
| book (a trip / a book) | reservar / libro *(según contexto)* |
| novel / mystery / science fiction | novela / misterio / ciencia ficción |

Participios / pasados útiles: *been, gone, read, bought, booked, went, visited, travelled, ate, saw, finished, enjoyed*.

---

## 10. Más ejemplos lado a lado

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/have-already-booked.mp3" title="🔊 I have already booked my next trip to Spain"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/saw-colosseum.mp3" title="🔊 I saw the Colosseum in Rome"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/last-month-read-novel.mp3" title="🔊 Last month I read a great novel"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-15/three-weeks-ago-finished.mp3" title="🔊 Three weeks ago I finished a mystery book"></audio>

| Situación | Frase A2 |
| :--- | :--- |
| Experiencia de vida | I **have read** many books. |
| Nunca | I **have never read** science fiction. |
| Mes pasado | Last month I **read** a novel. |
| Hace tres semanas | Three weeks ago I **finished** a mystery book. |
| Ya reservado / comprado | I **have already** booked / bought… |

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige el tiempo

1. I ____ to Paris last year. *(went / have been)*  
2. I ____ to Paris. It was amazing. *(went / have been)* — *sin fecha*  
3. She ____ him yesterday. *(saw / has seen)*  
4. ____ you ever ____ to Japan? *(Did… go / Have… been)*  
5. I ____ this car two years ago. *(bought / have bought)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **went** · 2. **have been** · 3. **saw** · 4. **Have… been** · 5. **bought**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Marcador → tiempo

Di Present Perfect (PP) o Past Simple (PS):

1. yesterday  
2. ever  
3. last week  
4. already  
5. three weeks ago  
6. never  
7. just  
8. last year

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 PS · 2 PP · 3 PS · 4 PP · 5 PS · 6 PP · 7 PP · 8 PS
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa a Jake

I ____ been to many countries. I have ____ been to Australia. Last year I ____ to Japan. Two months ago I ____ to Italy. I ____ pizza in Naples. I have ____ booked my next trip to Spain.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**have** · **never** · **went** · **travelled** · **ate** · **already**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa a Nina

I ____ read many books. I have ____ read a science fiction book. Last month I ____ a great novel. Three weeks ago I ____ a mystery book. I have ____ bought my next book.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**have** · **never** · **read** · **finished** · **already**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *I have been to Japan last year.*  
2. *I went to many countries in my life.* *(si quieres experiencia)*  
3. *Did you ever been to Italy?*  
4. *She has saw him yesterday.*  
5. *I have finished the book three weeks ago.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **went** to Japan last year.  
2. I **have been** to many countries in my life.  
3. **Have** you ever **been** to Italy?  
4. She **saw** him yesterday.  
5. I **finished** the book three weeks ago.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Transforma

1. I visited Tokyo last year. → experiencia sin fecha (*have been / have visited*)  
2. I have been to Italy. → añade *two months ago*  
3. Have you ever read Jane Austen? → pregunta sobre *last month*  
4. I bought a book. → con *already*  
5. I arrived a moment ago. → con *just*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **have visited** / **have been to** Tokyo.  
2. I **travelled / went** to Italy **two months ago**.  
3. **Did** you read Jane Austen **last month**?  
4. I **have already** bought a book.  
5. I **have just** arrived.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja

1. ever  
2. yesterday  
3. already  
4. … ago  
5. never  

a) Past Simple · b) Present Perfect (experiencia) · c) Present Perfect (progreso) · d) Past Simple · e) Present Perfect (negativa de experiencia)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) I have been to Paris last year. · b) I went to Paris last year. · c) I have went to Paris last year.  
2. ____  
   a) Have you ever been to Japan? · b) Did you ever been to Japan? · c) Have you ever went to Japan?  
3. ____  
   a) I have already booked my trip. · b) I already booked have my trip. · c) I have booked already my trip. *(prioridad mid)*  
4. ____  
   a) Two months ago I have travelled to Italy. · b) Two months ago I travelled to Italy. · c) Two months ago I have been travel to Italy.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **a** · 3. **a** · 4. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. He estado en muchos países.  
2. Nunca he estado en Australia.  
3. El año pasado fui a Japón.  
4. Hace dos meses viajé a Italia.  
5. Comí pizza en Nápoles.  
6. Ya he reservado mi próximo viaje a España.  
7. ¿Has estado alguna vez en Japón?  
8. El mes pasado leí una gran novela.  
9. Hace tres semanas terminé un libro de misterio.  
10. Ya he comprado mi próximo libro.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I have been to many countries.  
2. I have never been to Australia.  
3. Last year I went to Japan.  
4. Two months ago I travelled to Italy.  
5. I ate pizza in Naples.  
6. I have already booked my next trip to Spain.  
7. Have you ever been to Japan?  
8. Last month I read a great novel.  
9. Three weeks ago I finished a mystery book.  
10. I have already bought my next book.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu contraste

Escribe 8–12 frases:

- 3 × Present Perfect (*have been / have never / have already / have just*)  
- 3 × Past Simple con *last… / yesterday / … ago*  
- 2 × el mismo tema en los dos tiempos (p. ej. París)

**Modelo:** Jake (viajes) o Nina (libros).

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla: PP vs PS + marcadores.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha a Jake y Nina; marca PP / PS.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe tu párrafo mixto y léelo en voz alta.

### Checklist

- [ ] Sé cuándo usar Present Perfect (sin fecha / ever-never-already-yet-just)  
- [ ] Sé cuándo usar Past Simple (*yesterday, last…, ago*)  
- [ ] Evito *I have… last year / … ago*  
- [ ] Puedo mezclar ambos tiempos en un texto corto  
- [ ] Reconozco las señales en listening

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta: **¿Hay fecha concreta?** Sí → Past Simple. No / ever-never-already-yet-just → Present Perfect.  
2. Practica parejas: *I have been to X* / *Last year I went to X*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 15](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-15-present-perfect-vs-past-simple-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 15 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-15).

La **Unidad 16** introduce el **Past Continuous**: *I was watching TV when…*

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Tiempo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Experiencia sin fecha | Present Perfect | I have been to Paris. |
| Nunca / alguna vez | Present Perfect | I have never… / Have you ever…? |
| Ya / aún / acabar de | Present Perfect | already / yet / just |
| Ayer / la semana pasada / hace… | Past Simple | yesterday / last… / ago |
| Viaje concreto con fecha | Past Simple | Last year I went to Japan. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 16** estudiarás **Past Continuous**: *I was watching TV when…* / *She was working at 8 o'clock*.

- [Unidad 16 — Past Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-16-past-continuous)

Curso:

Practica ahora:

Guías relacionadas:

- [Present Perfect vs Past Simple](/blog/gramatica/present-perfect-vs-past-simple)

title: Past Continuous A2: was/were + -ing (I was watching…)
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 16 del curso A2: Past Continuous (was/were + -ing), acciones en curso, audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende Past Continuous en inglés A2: was/were + -ing para acciones en curso en el pasado. Guía Unidad 16 con audios, formas y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Past Continuous was/were + -ing A2

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se forma el Past Continuous?
faqs.answer: Con was/were + verbo en -ing. I/he/she/it + was; you/we/they + were. Ejemplo: I was watching TV. They were playing football.

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso Past Continuous en A2?
faqs.answer: Para decir qué estaba pasando en un momento del pasado: I was reading at 3pm. Also para ambientar una escena: My parents were cooking dinner.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre was y were?
faqs.answer: Was con I, he, she, it. Were con you, we, they. Negativas: wasn't / weren't. Preguntas: Was she…? / Were you…?

faqs.question: ¿Past Continuous es lo mismo que Past Simple?
faqs.answer: No. Past Simple cuenta un hecho acabado (The doorbell rang). Past Continuous describe la acción en curso (I was watching TV). En la Unidad 17 los combinas con when/while.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 16 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 16 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 15](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-15-present-perfect-vs-past-simple) elegiste Present Perfect o Past Simple. En la **Unidad 16 del curso A2** (*Past Continuous*) describes **qué estaba pasando** en un momento del pasado: *I was watching TV…*

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 16 — Past Continuous](/curso-a2/unit-16)  
> **Antes:** [U15 — Present Perfect vs Past Simple](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-15-present-perfect-vs-past-simple)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 16 (A2)

- Formar **was/were + -ing**.
- Usar **afirmativa, negativa y preguntas**.
- Describir **actividades en curso** (*watching, studying, cooking, reading…*).
- Ambientar una escena del pasado (sábado por la noche, tarde en el parque…).
- Preparar el contraste con Past Simple (Unidad 17).

![Past Continuous was/were + -ing](/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/a2-unit16-past-continuous.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Tiempo | Idea A2 | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Past Continuous** | acción **en curso** en un momento del pasado | I **was watching** TV at 8pm. |
| Past Simple *(repaso)* | hecho **acabado** | The doorbell **rang**. |

Piensa: **¿Qué estabas haciendo a las…?** → Past Continuous.

---

## 2. Forma: *was/were + -ing*

| Sujeto | Auxiliar | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I / he / she / it | **was** | I **was** watching TV. |
| you / we / they | **were** | They **were** playing football. |

> I **was watching** TV at 8pm.  
> She **was reading** a book last night.  
> They **were playing** football.  
> We **were cooking** dinner.  
> He **was walking** his dog.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/was-watching-tv.mp3" title="🔊 I was watching TV at 8pm"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/was-reading-book.mp3" title="🔊 She was reading a book last night"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/were-playing-football.mp3" title="🔊 They were playing football"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/were-cooking-dinner.mp3" title="🔊 We were cooking dinner"></audio>

Estructura: **was/were + verb-ing**

---

## 3. Negativa y preguntas

![Formas del Past Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/a2-unit16-forms.png)

### Negativa

> I **wasn't** studying.  
> She **wasn't** sleeping.  
> We **weren't** working.  
> They **weren't** watching TV.

### Preguntas

> **Was** she reading?  
> **Were** you working?  
> **Was** he walking his dog?  
> **Were** they playing football?

Respuestas cortas:

- *Yes, I was.* / *No, I wasn't.*  
- *Yes, they were.* / *No, they weren't.*

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/wasnt-studying.mp3" title="🔊 I wasn't studying"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/were-you-working.mp3" title="🔊 Were you working?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/was-she-reading.mp3" title="🔊 Was she reading?"></audio>

---

## 4. Ortografía de *-ing* (repaso útil)

| Regla | Base | -ing |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| + *-ing* | watch, read, play | watching, reading, playing |
| quita *-e* muda | come, write | coming, writing |
| doble consonante corta | run, swim, get | running, swimming, getting |
| *-ie* → *-y* | lie | lying |

En esta unidad verás mucho: *watching, studying, cooking, reading, running, playing, walking, sleeping, raining, coming*.

---

## 5. Texto modelo: Saturday night

> Last Saturday night at 8pm I was watching TV in my living room. My sister was studying in her room. My parents were cooking dinner in the kitchen. Suddenly the doorbell rang. It was our neighbour Mr Brown. He was walking his dog when he saw our lights on. He wanted to ask if we had seen his cat. We were all surprised but we helped him look. At that moment the cat was sleeping under the sofa!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/reading-saturday.mp3" title="🔊 Last Saturday night at 8pm I was watching TV…"></audio>

![Escena del sábado a las 8](/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/a2-unit16-saturday-night.png)

| Quién | Estaba… |
| :--- | :--- |
| Narrador | watching TV |
| Sister | studying |
| Parents | cooking dinner |
| Mr Brown | walking his dog |
| Cat | sleeping under the sofa |

Nota: *the doorbell **rang*** es Past Simple (hecho puntual). El ambiente es Past Continuous. En la **Unidad 17** practicarás más este contraste con *when/while*.

---

## 6. Listening: en el parque

> Yesterday afternoon at 3pm I was reading a book in the park. My friend was running around the lake. Some children were playing football near. Suddenly it started to rain. Everyone was running to find shelter. I was getting wet when a kind woman offered me her umbrella. We waited under a tree until the rain stopped. At that moment the sun was coming out again. I was grateful for her help.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/dialogue-park.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday afternoon at 3pm I was reading…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Qué hacía el hablante a las 3? → *reading a book*  
2. ¿Y su amigo? → *running around the lake*  
3. ¿Los niños? → *playing football*  
4. ¿Qué pasó de repente? → *it started to rain* (Past Simple)

---

## 7. Mini práctica oral

> I was watching TV at 8pm.  
> She was studying in her room.  
> They were cooking dinner.  
> Was he walking his dog?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I was watching TV at 8pm…"></audio>

1. Di 3 cosas que **estabas haciendo** anoche (*I was…*).  
2. Habla de otras personas: *My friend was… / They were…*  
3. Haz 2 preguntas: *Were you…? / Was she…?*

---

## 8. Vocabulario de actividades en curso (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| watch TV | ver la tele |
| study | estudiar |
| cook dinner | cocinar la cena |
| read a book | leer un libro |
| play football | jugar al fútbol |
| walk the dog | pasear al perro |
| run | correr |
| sleep | dormir |
| work | trabajar |
| rain / get wet | llover / mojarse |
| come out (the sun) | salir (el sol) |
| doorbell / neighbour / umbrella | timbre / vecino / paraguas |

---

## 9. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I were watching TV. | I **was** watching TV. | *I* → *was* |
| They was playing. | They **were** playing. | *they* → *were* |
| She was study. | She was **studying**. | hace falta *-ing* |
| Was you working? | **Were** you working? | *you* → *were* |
| I watching TV at 8pm. | I **was** watching TV at 8pm. | falta *was* |
| I was watch TV. | I was **watching** TV. | *-ing* |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/was-walking-dog.mp3" title="🔊 He was walking his dog"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/was-sleeping-sofa.mp3" title="🔊 The cat was sleeping under the sofa"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-16/was-running-lake.mp3" title="🔊 My friend was running around the lake"></audio>

---

## 10. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *was* o *were*

1. I ____ watching TV at 8pm.  
2. They ____ playing football.  
3. She ____ reading a book.  
4. We ____ cooking dinner.  
5. He ____ walking his dog.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was** · 2. **were** · 3. **was** · 4. **were** · 5. **was**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con *-ing*

1. I was ____ (watch) TV.  
2. My sister was ____ (study).  
3. My parents were ____ (cook) dinner.  
4. Some children were ____ (play) football.  
5. The cat was ____ (sleep) under the sofa.  
6. My friend was ____ (run) around the lake.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **watching** · 2. **studying** · 3. **cooking** · 4. **playing** · 5. **sleeping** · 6. **running**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Negativa

1. I was studying. → ____  
2. They were working. → ____  
3. She was sleeping. → ____

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **wasn't** studying.  
2. They **weren't** working.  
3. She **wasn't** sleeping.
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Preguntas

1. she / read → ____  
2. you / work → ____  
3. they / play football → ____  
4. he / walk his dog → ____

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Was** she reading?  
2. **Were** you working?  
3. **Were** they playing football?  
4. **Was** he walking his dog?
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Completa el sábado

Last Saturday night at 8pm I ____ watching TV. My sister ____ studying. My parents ____ cooking dinner. Mr Brown ____ walking his dog. The cat ____ sleeping under the sofa.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**was** · **was** · **were** · **was** · **was**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el parque

Yesterday afternoon at 3pm I ____ reading a book. My friend ____ running around the lake. Some children ____ playing football. I ____ getting wet when a woman offered me her umbrella. The sun ____ coming out again.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**was** · **was** · **were** · **was** · **was**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Corrige

1. *I were watching TV.*  
2. *She was study in her room.*  
3. *Was you working?*  
4. *They was cooking dinner.*  
5. *He walking his dog.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **was** watching TV.  
2. She was **studying** in her room.  
3. **Were** you working?  
4. They **were** cooking dinner.  
5. He **was** walking his dog.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Empareja

1. I / he / she / it  
2. you / we / they  
3. wasn't  
4. Were you…?  
5. was + -ing  

a) were · b) was · c) negativa de *was* · d) pregunta con *you* · e) acción en curso (I/he/she/it)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) I was watching TV. · b) I were watching TV. · c) I was watch TV.  
2. ____  
   a) They was playing. · b) They were playing. · c) They were play.  
3. ____  
   a) Was she reading? · b) Were she reading? · c) Was she read?  
4. ____  
   a) We wasn't cooking. · b) We weren't cooking. · c) We not were cooking.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **b** · 3. **a** · 4. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Traduce

1. Estaba viendo la tele a las 8.  
2. Ella estaba estudiando en su habitación.  
3. Mis padres estaban cocinando la cena.  
4. Ellos estaban jugando al fútbol.  
5. Él estaba paseando a su perro.  
6. El gato estaba durmiendo debajo del sofá.  
7. ¿Estabas trabajando?  
8. No estaba estudiando.  
9. Ayer a las 3 estaba leyendo un libro en el parque.  
10. Mi amigo estaba corriendo alrededor del lago.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I was watching TV at 8 o'clock / at 8pm.  
2. She was studying in her room.  
3. My parents were cooking dinner.  
4. They were playing football.  
5. He was walking his dog.  
6. The cat was sleeping under the sofa.  
7. Were you working?  
8. I wasn't studying.  
9. Yesterday at 3pm I was reading a book in the park.  
10. My friend was running around the lake.
</details>

### Ejercicio 11 — Tu escena

Escribe 8–12 frases sobre un momento del pasado (anoche / el sábado / ayer a las 3):

- 4 × *I was… / She was…*  
- 2 × *They/We were…*  
- 1 × negativa · 1 × pregunta  

**Modelo:** sábado en casa o tarde en el parque.

---

## 11. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla *was/were* + ejemplos.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha sábado y parque; marca cada *was/were + -ing*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu escena.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *was* con I/he/she/it y *were* con you/we/they  
- [ ] Añado *-ing* al verbo  
- [ ] Sé hacer negativa y pregunta  
- [ ] Puedo describir una escena en curso en el pasado  
- [ ] Distingo ambiente (Past Continuous) de hecho puntual (Past Simple)

---

## 12. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Plantilla: *At 8pm I was… My friend was… They were…*  
2. Vocabulario rápido: *watch, study, cook, read, play, walk, run, sleep*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 16](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-16-past-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 16 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-16).

La **Unidad 17** combina **Past Simple + Past Continuous**: *When I was walking, I saw…*

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Afirmativa | **was/were + -ing** |
| Negativa | **wasn't / weren't + -ing** |
| Pregunta | **Was/Were + sujeto + -ing?** |
| *was* | I, he, she, it |
| *were* | you, we, they |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 17** estudiarás **Past Simple + Past Continuous**: *When I was walking, I saw…* / *While she was cooking, the phone rang.*

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 17 — Past Simple + Past Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-17-past-simple-past-continuous)

Curso:

- [Unidad 17 — Past Simple + Past Continuous](/curso-a2/unit-17)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 16 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-16-past-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 16 — Past Continuous](/curso-a2/unit-16)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Past Simple vs Past Continuous](/blog/gramatica/past-simple-vs-past-continuous)
- [Past Simple: usos y reglas](/blog/gramatica/past-simple-usos-reglas)
- [Errores de tiempos de pasado](/blog/gramatica/errores-tiempos-pasado-espanoles)

---

title: Past Simple + Past Continuous: When y While Explicados (A2)
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: When vs while: la guía definitiva para combinar Past Simple y Past Continuous al contar historias, con ejemplos, audios y ejercicios (A2).
description: ¿When o while? Descubre cómo combinar Past Simple y Past Continuous para contar historias con acciones interrumpidas, reglas claras y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Past Simple y Past Continuous con when y while A2
keywords: I was walking when I saw

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso Past Continuous y cuándo Past Simple juntos?
faqs.answer: Past Continuous para la acción larga en curso (fondo). Past Simple para la acción corta que interrumpe o el hecho puntual. Ejemplo: I was walking when I saw him.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre when y while?
faqs.answer: When suele introducir la acción corta (Past Simple): when the phone rang. While suele ir con la acción larga (Past Continuous): while she was cooking.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo poner Past Continuous después de when?
faqs.answer: A veces sí, pero en A2 prioriza: when + Past Simple (interrupción) y while + Past Continuous (fondo). Ejemplo prioritario: I was reading when the door opened.

faqs.question: ¿Qué conectores uso para contar la historia?
faqs.answer: At first, then, suddenly, finally. Ayudan a ordenar el relato: At first I was walking… Suddenly it started to rain… Finally the sun came out.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 17 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 17 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 16](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-16-past-continuous) formaste *was/were + -ing*. En la **Unidad 17 del curso A2** (*Past Simple + Past Continuous*) **combinas** ambos tiempos: *When I was walking, I saw…*

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 17 — Past Simple + Past Continuous](/curso-a2/unit-17)  
> **Antes:** [U16 — Past Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-16-past-continuous)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 17 (A2)

- Combinar **Past Continuous** (fondo) + **Past Simple** (interrupción).
- Usar **when** y **while**.
- Contar historias con **at first / then / suddenly / finally**.
- Describir acciones **simultáneas** e **interrumpidas**.
- Escribir un relato breve con ambos tiempos.

![Past Simple + Past Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/a2-unit17-ps-pc.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Tiempo | Rol en el relato | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Past Continuous** | acción **larga** / fondo | I **was walking**… |
| **Past Simple** | acción **corta** / hecho puntual | … when I **saw** him. |

Imagen mental: una línea larga (estabas haciendo algo) y un punto (pasó algo).

> I **was walking** when I **saw** him.  
> While she **was cooking**, the phone **rang**.

---

## 2. *When* + Past Simple (interrupción)

**When** suele introducir la acción corta:

> I was walking when I **saw** him.  
> He was reading when the door **opened**.  
> They were having dinner when we **arrived**.  
> I was watching TV when the doorbell **rang**.  
> He was walking his dog when he **saw** smoke.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/was-walking-when-saw.mp3" title="🔊 I was walking when I saw him"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/was-reading-when-opened.mp3" title="🔊 He was reading when the door opened"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/was-watching-when-rang.mp3" title="🔊 I was watching TV when the doorbell rang"></audio>

Patrón A2: **was/were + -ing + when + Past Simple**

---

## 3. *While* + Past Continuous (fondo / simultáneo)

**While** suele ir con la acción en curso:

> While she **was cooking**, the phone rang.  
> We **were talking** while we walked around the lake.  
> I **was cooking** dinner while I **was watching** TV.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/while-cooking-phone-rang.mp3" title="🔊 While she was cooking, the phone rang"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/were-talking-while-walked.mp3" title="🔊 We were talking while we walked around the lake"></audio>

Patrón A2: **While + was/were + -ing, + Past Simple** (o dos acciones en curso).

---

## 4. *When* vs *while*

![When vs while](/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/a2-unit17-when-while.png)

| Conector | Prioridad A2 | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **when** | acción corta (Past Simple) | when I saw him / when the phone rang |
| **while** | acción larga (Past Continuous) | while she was cooking / while we were talking |

Ambas frases son posibles a veces, pero en A2 sigue la prioridad de la tabla.

---

## 5. Conectores de relato

| Conector | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| **At first** | al principio |
| **Then** | entonces / después |
| **Suddenly** | de repente |
| **Finally** | finalmente |
| **until** | hasta que |

> **At first** I was walking in the park…  
> **Then** suddenly it started to rain.  
> **Finally** the sun came out.

---

## 6. Texto modelo: el parque

> At first last Saturday I was walking in the park when I met an old friend. We were talking while we walked around the lake. Then suddenly it started to rain. We were running to find shelter when a woman offered us her umbrella. We waited under a tree until the rain stopped. Finally the sun came out and we continued our walk.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/reading-park.mp3" title="🔊 At first last Saturday I was walking…"></audio>

![Historia del parque](/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/a2-unit17-park-story.png)

| Frase | Continuous | Simple |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I was walking… when I met… | walking | met |
| We were talking while we walked… | talking | walked *(simultáneo / secuencia)* |
| We were running… when a woman offered… | running | offered |
| Suddenly it started to rain | — | started |
| Finally the sun came out | — | came out |

---

## 7. Listening: el vecino y el humo

> At first yesterday evening I was watching TV when the doorbell rang. It was my neighbour Mr Jones. He was walking his dog when he saw smoke coming from my kitchen. I was cooking dinner while I was watching TV. Suddenly something burned in the oven. Mr Jones helped me open the windows. Then we checked the kitchen together. Finally everything was okay and I thanked him for his help.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/dialogue-neighbour.mp3" title="🔊 At first yesterday evening I was watching TV…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Qué hacía cuando sonó el timbre? → *watching TV*  
2. ¿Quién era? → *Mr Jones*  
3. ¿Qué vio el vecino? → *smoke from the kitchen*  
4. ¿Qué pasó de repente? → *something burned in the oven*

---

## 8. Mini práctica oral

> I was walking when I saw him.  
> While she was cooking, the phone rang.  
> They were having dinner when we arrived.  
> I was watching TV when the doorbell rang.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I was walking when I saw him…"></audio>

1. Di 3 frases *I was … when …*  
2. Di 2 frases *While … was/were …, …*  
3. Cuenta 4–6 frases con *At first / Then / Suddenly / Finally*

---

## 9. Vocabulario y conectores (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| when / while | cuando / mientras |
| at first / then / suddenly / finally | al principio / entonces / de repente / finalmente |
| meet / see / arrive / ring / open | conocer/encontrarse / ver / llegar / sonar / abrir |
| walk / talk / run / watch / cook | caminar / hablar / correr / ver / cocinar |
| shelter / umbrella / smoke / oven | refugio / paraguas / humo / horno |
| neighbour / doorbell | vecino / timbre |

---

## 10. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I walked when I was seeing him. | I **was walking** when I **saw** him. | fondo = Continuous; interrupción = Simple |
| While she cooked, the phone was ringing. *(prioridad A2)* | While she **was cooking**, the phone **rang**. | *while* + Continuous; hecho corto = Simple |
| I was walk when I saw him. | I was **walking** when I saw him. | falta *-ing* |
| When I was seeing him, I walked. | When I **saw** him, I **was walking**. / I was walking when I saw him. | *see* puntual → Simple |
| Suddenly it was starting to rain. | Suddenly it **started** to rain. | *suddenly* + hecho puntual |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/were-having-dinner-arrived.mp3" title="🔊 They were having dinner when we arrived"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/was-walking-dog-smoke.mp3" title="🔊 He was walking his dog when he saw smoke"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-17/suddenly-started-rain.mp3" title="🔊 Suddenly it started to rain"></audio>

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige Continuous o Simple

1. I ____ (walk) when I ____ (see) him.  
2. While she ____ (cook), the phone ____ (ring).  
3. He ____ (read) when the door ____ (open).  
4. They ____ (have) dinner when we ____ (arrive).  
5. I ____ (watch) TV when the doorbell ____ (ring).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **was walking** · **saw**  
2. **was cooking** · **rang**  
3. **was reading** · **opened**  
4. **were having** · **arrived**  
5. **was watching** · **rang**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *when* o *while*

1. I was walking ____ I met an old friend.  
2. ____ she was cooking, the phone rang.  
3. We were running ____ a woman offered us her umbrella.  
4. I was cooking dinner ____ I was watching TV.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **when** · 2. **While** · 3. **when** · 4. **while**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa el parque

At first I ____ walking in the park when I ____ an old friend. We ____ talking while we walked around the lake. Suddenly it ____ to rain. We ____ running when a woman ____ us her umbrella. Finally the sun ____ out.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**was** · **met** · **were** · **started** · **were** · **offered** · **came**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa el vecino

I ____ watching TV when the doorbell ____. Mr Jones ____ walking his dog when he ____ smoke. I ____ cooking dinner while I ____ watching TV. Suddenly something ____ in the oven.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**was** · **rang** · **was** · **saw** · **was** · **was** · **burned**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Conectores

Ordena la historia con: *At first / Then / Suddenly / Finally*

1. ____ I was walking in the park.  
2. ____ I met my friend and we were talking.  
3. ____ it started to rain.  
4. ____ the sun came out and we continued.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **At first** · 2. **Then** · 3. **Suddenly** · 4. **Finally**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *I walked when I was seeing him.*  
2. *While she cooked, the phone was ringing.* *(prioridad A2)*  
3. *I was watch TV when the doorbell rang.*  
4. *Suddenly it was starting to rain.*  
5. *They was having dinner when we arrived.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **was walking** when I **saw** him.  
2. While she **was cooking**, the phone **rang**.  
3. I was **watching** TV when the doorbell rang.  
4. Suddenly it **started** to rain.  
5. They **were** having dinner when we arrived.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Transforma

1. I walked in the park. I met a friend. → *was walking when met*  
2. She cooked. The phone rang. → *While… was cooking…*  
3. He walked his dog. He saw smoke. → *was walking when saw*  
4. We had dinner. They arrived. → *were having when arrived*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I **was walking** in the park when I **met** a friend.  
2. While she **was cooking**, the phone **rang**.  
3. He **was walking** his dog when he **saw** smoke.  
4. We **were having** dinner when they **arrived**.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Empareja

1. when  
2. while  
3. Past Continuous  
4. Past Simple  
5. suddenly  

a) fondo / acción larga · b) interrupción / hecho corto · c) a menudo + Simple · d) a menudo + Continuous · e) de repente (hecho puntual)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **b** · 5 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) I was walking when I saw him. · b) I walked when I was seeing him. · c) I was walk when I saw him.  
2. ____  
   a) While she was cooking, the phone rang. · b) While she cooked, the phone was ringing. · c) While she was cook, the phone rang.  
3. ____  
   a) Suddenly it started to rain. · b) Suddenly it was starting to rain. · c) Suddenly it start to rain.  
4. ____  
   a) They were having dinner when we arrived. · b) They was having dinner when we arrived. · c) They were have dinner when we arrived.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **a** · 3. **a** · 4. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Traduce

1. Estaba caminando cuando lo vi.  
2. Mientras ella cocinaba, sonó el teléfono.  
3. Él leía cuando se abrió la puerta.  
4. Estaban cenando cuando llegamos.  
5. Estaba viendo la tele cuando sonó el timbre.  
6. De repente empezó a llover.  
7. Al principio estaba caminando en el parque.  
8. Finalmente salió el sol.  
9. Estaba paseando a su perro cuando vio humo.  
10. Estaba cocinando mientras veía la tele.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I was walking when I saw him.  
2. While she was cooking, the phone rang.  
3. He was reading when the door opened.  
4. They were having dinner when we arrived.  
5. I was watching TV when the doorbell rang.  
6. Suddenly it started to rain.  
7. At first I was walking in the park.  
8. Finally the sun came out.  
9. He was walking his dog when he saw smoke.  
10. I was cooking while I was watching TV. / I was cooking dinner while I was watching TV.
</details>

### Ejercicio 11 — Tu relato

Escribe 8–12 frases con:

- 3 × *was/were … when …*  
- 1 × *While …*  
- conectores: *At first / Then / Suddenly / Finally*  

**Modelo:** parque o vecino/cocina.

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Regla: Continuous = fondo · Simple = interrupción.  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha parque y vecino; marca *when/while*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu relato.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso Past Continuous para el fondo  
- [ ] Uso Past Simple para la interrupción  
- [ ] Distingo *when* y *while*  
- [ ] Uso *at first / then / suddenly / finally*  
- [ ] Puedo contar una historia corta con ambos tiempos

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Plantilla: *I was … when …* / *While … was …, …*  
2. Conectores: *At first → Then → Suddenly → Finally*.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 17](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-17-past-simple-past-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 17 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-17).

La **Unidad 18** introduce **for & since** con Present Perfect: *I have lived here for two years / since 2020*.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Fondo | **was/were + -ing** |
| Interrupción | **Past Simple** |
| *when* | a menudo + Past Simple |
| *while* | a menudo + Past Continuous |
| Relato | **At first / Then / Suddenly / Finally** |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 18** estudiarás **For & Since**: *I have lived here for two years* / *since 2020*.

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 18 — For & Since](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-18-for-since)

Curso:

- [Unidad 18 — For & Since](/curso-a2/unit-18)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 17 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-17-past-simple-past-continuous-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 17 — Past Simple + Past Continuous](/curso-a2/unit-17)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Past Simple vs Past Continuous](/blog/gramatica/past-simple-vs-past-continuous)
- [Past Simple: usos y reglas](/blog/gramatica/past-simple-usos-reglas)
- [Errores de tiempos de pasado](/blog/gramatica/errores-tiempos-pasado-espanoles)

title: For & Since A2: Duración y Punto de Inicio
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 18 del curso A2: for y since con Present Perfect, duración y punto de inicio, audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende for y since con Present Perfect en inglés A2: duración y punto de inicio, con audios, How long…? y ejercicios de la Unidad 18.
alt: Esquema for y since con Present Perfect A2

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre for y since?
faqs.answer: For + duración (cuánto tiempo): for two years, for a week. Since + punto de inicio (desde cuándo): since 2020, since Monday, since last Christmas.

faqs.question: ¿For y since van con Present Perfect?
faqs.answer: Sí, en A2 los usamos con Present Perfect para situaciones que empezaron en el pasado y continúan: I have lived here for five years. She has worked here since 2020.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto cuánto tiempo?
faqs.answer: Con How long + Present Perfect: How long have you lived here? Respuestas típicas: For five years. / Since 2020.

faqs.question: ¿Puedo decir for 2020 o since five years?
faqs.answer: No. 2020 es un punto → since 2020. Five years es una duración → for five years. No mezcles: evita for 2020 y since five years.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 18 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 18 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 17](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-17-past-simple-past-continuous) combinaste pasados. En la **Unidad 18 del curso A2** (*For & Since*) vuelves al **Present Perfect** para decir **durante cuánto tiempo** o **desde cuándo**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 18 — For & Since](/curso-a2/unit-18)  
> **Antes:** [U17 — Past Simple + Past Continuous](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-17-past-simple-past-continuous)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 18 (A2)

- Usar **for** + duración: *for two years, for a week*.
- Usar **since** + punto de inicio: *since 2020, since last Christmas*.
- Preguntar con **How long…?**
- Hablar de vida, trabajo, amigos y hobbies con Present Perfect.
- Evitar mezclas (*for 2020*, *since five years*).

![For y since con Present Perfect](/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/a2-unit18-for-since.png)

---

## 1. Idea clave

| Palabra | Qué añade | Pregunta mental | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **for** | **duración** (cuánto tiempo) | ¿Cuánto tiempo? | for five years |
| **since** | **punto de inicio** (desde cuándo) | ¿Desde cuándo? | since 2020 |

Ambos van muy bien con **Present Perfect** cuando la situación **sigue** ahora:

> I **have lived** here **for** five years.  
> I **have worked** here **since** 2020.

---

## 2. *For* + duración

> I have lived in London **for five years**.  
> They have been married **for ten years**.  
> I have known Sara **for ten years**.  
> I have been learning Spanish **for six months**.  
> I have lived in Manchester **for three years**.  
> I have been married **for five years**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/lived-for-five-years.mp3" title="🔊 I have lived in London for five years"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/known-for-ten-years.mp3" title="🔊 I have known my best friend Sara for ten years"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/married-for-five-years.mp3" title="🔊 I have been married for five years"></audio>

Duraciones típicas: *a week, two years, six months, a long time, ten years, three years*.

---

## 3. *Since* + punto de inicio

> She has worked here **since 2020**.  
> He has known her **since last summer**.  
> I have had my dog Max **since last Christmas**.  
> I have loved travelling **since I was a child**.  
> I have worked as a teacher **since 2021**.  
> I have had my car **since last January**.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/worked-since-2020.mp3" title="🔊 I have worked at the same company since 2020"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/dog-since-christmas.mp3" title="🔊 I have had my dog Max since last Christmas"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/teacher-since-2021.mp3" title="🔊 I have worked as a teacher since 2021"></audio>

Puntos típicos: *2020, Monday, last Christmas, last January, last summer, I was a child / a teenager*.

---

## 4. *How long…?*

![How long with for and since](/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/a2-unit18-how-long.png)

> **How long** have you lived here?  
> — **For** five years.  
> — **Since** 2020.

> **How long** has she worked there?  
> — **For** three years. / **Since** 2021.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/how-long-lived.mp3" title="🔊 How long have you lived here?"></audio>

Estructura: **How long + have/has + sujeto + past participle…?**

---

## 5. *For* / *since* vs *ago* (repaso rápido)

| Expresión | Tiempo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **for / since** | Present Perfect (sigue ahora) | I have lived here **for** five years. |
| **ago** | Past Simple (acabado) | I moved here five years **ago**. |

No digas: *I have lived here five years ago.*

---

## 6. Texto modelo: Emma

> My name is Emma. I have lived in London for five years. I have worked at the same company since 2020. I have known my best friend Sara for ten years. We met when we were at university. I have had my dog Max since last Christmas. He is very friendly. I have been learning Spanish for six months. I have loved travelling since I was a child. I feel good because I have a stable life with good friends.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/reading-emma.mp3" title="🔊 My name is Emma. I have lived in London…"></audio>

![Vida de Emma con for y since](/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/a2-unit18-emma-life.png)

| Frase | for / since |
| :--- | :--- |
| lived in London **for** five years | duración |
| worked… **since** 2020 | punto |
| known Sara **for** ten years | duración |
| had Max **since** last Christmas | punto |
| learning Spanish **for** six months | duración |
| loved travelling **since** I was a child | punto |

---

## 7. Listening: Tom

> Hi! I am Tom. I have lived in Manchester for three years. I have worked as a teacher since 2021. I have been married for five years. My wife and I met when we were at university. I have had my car since last January. I have been learning guitar for six months. I have loved music since I was a teenager. I feel happy because I have a good job and a wonderful family.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/dialogue-tom.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! I am Tom. I have lived in Manchester…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Cuánto tiempo lleva en Manchester? → *for three years*  
2. ¿Desde cuándo es profesor? → *since 2021*  
3. ¿Cuánto tiempo casado? → *for five years*  
4. ¿Desde cuándo tiene el coche? → *since last January*

---

## 8. Mini práctica oral

> I have lived here for five years.  
> I have worked here since 2020.  
> How long have you lived here?  
> I have known her for ten years.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 I have lived here for five years…"></audio>

1. Di 3 frases con **for**.  
2. Di 3 frases con **since**.  
3. Haz 2 preguntas *How long have you…?*

---

## 9. Vocabulario de períodos (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea / tipo |
| :--- | :--- |
| for two / three / five / ten years | duración |
| for six months / a week / a long time | duración |
| since 2020 / 2021 | punto (año) |
| since last Christmas / January / summer | punto |
| since I was a child / a teenager | punto (cláusula) |
| live / work / know / have / love | vivir / trabajar / conocer / tener / amar |
| married / teacher / university | casado / profesor / universidad |

---

## 10. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I have lived here since five years. | I have lived here **for** five years. | duración → *for* |
| I have worked here for 2020. | I have worked here **since** 2020. | punto → *since* |
| I live here for five years. | I **have lived** here for five years. | Present Perfect |
| How long do you live here? | How long **have** you **lived** here? | *How long* + Present Perfect |
| I have lived here five years ago. | I moved here five years **ago**. / I have lived here **for** five years. | *ago* ≠ Present Perfect |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/learning-spanish-six-months.mp3" title="🔊 I have been learning Spanish for six months"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/loved-travelling-since-child.mp3" title="🔊 I have loved travelling since I was a child"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-18/car-since-january.mp3" title="🔊 I have had my car since last January"></audio>

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *for* o *since*

1. I have lived here ____ two years.  
2. She has worked here ____ 2020.  
3. They have been married ____ ten years.  
4. He has known her ____ last summer.  
5. I have had my dog ____ last Christmas.  
6. I have been learning Spanish ____ six months.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **for** · 2. **since** · 3. **for** · 4. **since** · 5. **since** · 6. **for**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa a Emma

I have lived in London ____ five years. I have worked at the same company ____ 2020. I have known Sara ____ ten years. I have had Max ____ last Christmas. I have been learning Spanish ____ six months. I have loved travelling ____ I was a child.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**for** · **since** · **for** · **since** · **for** · **since**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa a Tom

I have lived in Manchester ____ three years. I have worked as a teacher ____ 2021. I have been married ____ five years. I have had my car ____ last January. I have been learning guitar ____ six months. I have loved music ____ I was a teenager.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**for** · **since** · **for** · **since** · **for** · **since**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — *How long…?*

Escribe la pregunta:

1. You live here. *(How long…?)*  
2. She works there.  
3. They are married.  
4. He has his car.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. How long **have you lived** here?  
2. How long **has she worked** there?  
3. How long **have they been** married?  
4. How long **has he had** his car?
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *I have lived here since five years.*  
2. *She has worked here for 2020.*  
3. *How long do you live here?*  
4. *I have lived here five years ago.*  
5. *They have been married since ten years.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I have lived here **for** five years.  
2. She has worked here **since** 2020.  
3. How long **have** you **lived** here?  
4. I moved here five years **ago**. / I have lived here **for** five years.  
5. They have been married **for** ten years.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja

1. for  
2. since  
3. How long…?  
4. five years  
5. 2020  

a) duración · b) punto de inicio · c) pregunta de duración · d) va con *for* · e) va con *since*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → idea duración · 2 → punto · 3 → **c** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **e**  
(1=a, 2=b)
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) I have lived here for five years. · b) I have lived here since five years. · c) I live here for five years.  
2. ____  
   a) She has worked here since 2020. · b) She has worked here for 2020. · c) She works here since 2020.  
3. ____  
   a) How long have you lived here? · b) How long do you live here? · c) How long you have lived here?  
4. ____  
   a) I have known her for ten years. · b) I have known her since ten years. · c) I know her for ten years.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **a** · 3. **a** · 4. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Traduce

1. He vivido en Londres durante cinco años.  
2. He trabajado en la misma empresa desde 2020.  
3. Conozco a Sara desde hace diez años. / Llevo diez años conociendo a Sara.  
4. Tengo a Max desde la Navidad pasada.  
5. Llevo seis meses aprendiendo español.  
6. Me gusta viajar desde que era niña.  
7. ¿Cuánto tiempo llevas viviendo aquí?  
8. He vivido en Manchester durante tres años.  
9. Trabajo como profesor desde 2021.  
10. Llevo cinco años casado.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I have lived in London for five years.  
2. I have worked at the same company since 2020.  
3. I have known Sara for ten years.  
4. I have had Max since last Christmas.  
5. I have been learning Spanish for six months.  
6. I have loved travelling since I was a child.  
7. How long have you lived here?  
8. I have lived in Manchester for three years.  
9. I have worked as a teacher since 2021.  
10. I have been married for five years.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Tu biografía corta

Escribe 8–12 frases:

- 4 × *for*  
- 4 × *since*  
- 1 × pregunta *How long…?*  

**Modelo:** Emma o Tom.

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla *for* (duración) / *since* (punto).  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha a Emma y Tom; marca *for/since*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y graba tu biografía corta.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *for* con duración  
- [ ] Uso *since* con punto de inicio  
- [ ] Pregunto con *How long have/has…?*  
- [ ] Evito *for 2020* y *since five years*  
- [ ] Combino Present Perfect + *for/since* sobre mi vida

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Pregunta: **¿Duración o punto?** → *for* / *since*.  
2. Plantilla: *I have … for …* / *I have … since …*  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 18](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-18-for-since-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 18 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-18).

La **Unidad 19** trabaja **How questions**: *How often…? How much…? How long…?* y más.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Caso | Forma |
| :--- | :--- |
| Duración | **for** + período |
| Punto de inicio | **since** + momento / cláusula |
| Pregunta | **How long + have/has + PP…?** |
| Tiempo verbal | **Present Perfect** (sigue ahora) |
| No mezclar | ~~for 2020~~ · ~~since five years~~ |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 19** estudiarás **How questions**: *How often…? How much…? How long…?*

Guía blog:

- [Unidad 19 — How Questions](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-19-how-questions)

Curso:

- [Unidad 19 — How Questions](/curso-a2/unit-19)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 18 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-18-for-since-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 18 — For & Since](/curso-a2/unit-18)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Present Perfect: since / for](/blog/gramatica/present-perfect-since-for)
- [Present Perfect: usos principales](/blog/gramatica/present-perfect-usos-principales)
- [Present Perfect vs Past Simple](/blog/gramatica/present-perfect-vs-past-simple)
- [Present Perfect: just / already / yet](/blog/gramatica/present-perfect-just-already-yet)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A2: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- Cambridge English — A2 Key: https://www.cambridgeenglish.org/exams-and-tests/key/
- British Council — Present Perfect: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/present-perfect
- Cambridge Dictionary — for or since: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/for-or-since

title: How Questions A2: How Long, Often, Much y Many
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 19 del curso A2: preguntas How long, How often, How much, How many y How long ago, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende preguntas con How en inglés A2: How long, How often, How much, How many y How long ago, con ejemplos, audio y ejercicios prácticos.
alt: Esquema de preguntas How en inglés A2

faqs.question: ¿Qué pregunta How uso para la frecuencia?
faqs.answer: How often…? Respuestas típicas: once a week, twice a week, three times a week, every day. Ejemplo: How often do you exercise? Three times a week.

faqs.question: ¿How much o How many?
faqs.answer: How much con incontables (water, coffee, money). How many con contables (books, people, languages). Ejemplo: How much water…? / How many books…?

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso How long?
faqs.answer: Para duración: How long have you lived here? / How long do you study every day? Respuestas con for… o un período (for four hours, for thirty minutes).

faqs.question: ¿Qué es How long ago?
faqs.answer: Pregunta por un momento acabado del pasado: How long ago did you arrive? Respuesta típica con ago: Two hours ago. / Three years ago.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 19 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 19 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 18](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-18-for-since) usaste *How long…?* con *for/since*. En la **Unidad 19 del curso A2** (*How Questions*) amplías el mapa de preguntas **How…?**

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 19 — How Questions](/curso-a2/unit-19)  
> **Antes:** [U18 — For & Since](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-18-for-since)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 19 (A2)

- Preguntar **How long…?** (duración).
- Preguntar **How often…?** (frecuencia).
- Preguntar **How much…?** / **How many…?** (cantidad).
- Preguntar **How long ago…?** (pasado acabado).
- Responder en encuestas y rutinas (gimnasio, estudio, hábitos).

![How questions A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/a2-unit19-how-questions.png)

---

## 1. Mapa rápido de *How…?*

| Pregunta | Pregunta por… | Respuesta típica |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **How long…?** | duración | for four hours / for two years |
| **How often…?** | frecuencia | three times a week / every day |
| **How much…?** | cantidad (incontable) | two litres / £10 |
| **How many…?** | cantidad (contable) | twelve books / three languages |
| **How long ago…?** | cuándo en el pasado | two hours ago / three years ago |

---

## 2. *How long…?* (duración)

> **How long** have you lived here?  
> — For five years. / Since 2020.

> **How long** do you study every day?  
> — For four hours.

> **How long** do you run each time?  
> — For thirty minutes.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-long-lived.mp3" title="🔊 How long have you lived here?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-long-study.mp3" title="🔊 How long do you study every day?"></audio>

Con Present Perfect enlaza con la [Unidad 18](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-18-for-since). Con Present Simple habla de rutina: *How long do you…?*

---

## 3. *How often…?* (frecuencia)

> **How often** do you exercise?  
> — Three times a week.

> **How often** do you go to the gym?  
> — Three times a week.

> **How often** do you watch films?  
> — Twice a week.

> **How often** do you go running?  
> — Four times a week.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-often-exercise.mp3" title="🔊 How often do you exercise?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-often-films.mp3" title="🔊 How often do you watch films?"></audio>

Respuestas útiles: *once a week, twice a week, three/four times a week, every day, never, sometimes*.

---

## 4. *How much…?* vs *How many…?*

![How much vs How many](/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/a2-unit19-much-many.png)

| How much | How many |
| :--- | :--- |
| incontables | contables |
| water, coffee, money, time | books, people, languages, cups |
| How much water do you drink? | How many books have you read? |
| How much does it cost? | How many people are in your class? |

> **How much** water do you drink? — About two litres a day.  
> **How much** coffee do you drink? — Two cups every morning.  
> **How many** books have you read this year? — Twelve.  
> **How many** languages do you speak? — Three.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-much-water.mp3" title="🔊 How much water do you drink?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-many-books.mp3" title="🔊 How many books have you read this year?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-many-languages.mp3" title="🔊 How many languages do you speak?"></audio>

---

## 5. *How long ago…?* (pasado acabado)

> **How long ago** did you arrive?  
> — Two hours ago.

> **How long ago** did you meet her?  
> — Ten years ago.

Usa **Past Simple** + respuesta con **ago** (no *for/since* aquí).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-long-ago-arrive.mp3" title="🔊 How long ago did you arrive?"></audio>

| How long…? | How long ago…? |
| :--- | :--- |
| duración (sigue / rutina) | cuándo pasó (acabado) |
| How long have you lived here? | How long ago did you move here? |
| For five years. | Five years ago. |

---

## 6. Texto modelo: Jake

> My name is Jake. I am a student and I have a busy routine. How often do I exercise? I go to the gym three times a week. How long do I study every day? I study for four hours every day. How much water do I drink? I drink about two litres a day. How many books have I read this year? I have read twelve books. I also watch films twice a week. I feel healthy and productive because I have good habits.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/reading-jake.mp3" title="🔊 My name is Jake. I am a student…"></audio>

![Rutina de Jake con How](/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/a2-unit19-jake-routine.png)

| Pregunta | Respuesta de Jake |
| :--- | :--- |
| How often… gym? | three times a week |
| How long… study? | for four hours every day |
| How much water…? | about two litres a day |
| How many books…? | twelve |
| How often… films? | twice a week |

---

## 7. Listening: Lisa

> Hi! I am Lisa. People often ask me about my habits. How often do I exercise? I go running four times a week. How long do I run each time? I run for thirty minutes. How much coffee do I drink a day? I drink two cups every morning. How many languages do I speak? I speak three: English, Spanish and French. I have been learning Spanish for two years. I feel energetic because I exercise regularly and drink enough water.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/dialogue-lisa.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! I am Lisa. People often ask me…"></audio>

Preguntas rápidas:

1. ¿Con qué frecuencia corre? → *four times a week*  
2. ¿Cuánto corre cada vez? → *for thirty minutes*  
3. ¿Cuánto café? → *two cups*  
4. ¿Cuántos idiomas? → *three*

---

## 8. Mini práctica oral

> How often do you exercise?  
> How long do you study every day?  
> How much water do you drink?  
> How many books have you read this year?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/practice-four.mp3" title="🔊 How often do you exercise?…"></audio>

1. Haz 4 preguntas *How…?* a un compañero (o en voz alta).  
2. Responde sobre **tu** rutina.  
3. Incluye una con *How long ago…?*

---

## 9. Vocabulario (del curso)

| Inglés | Idea |
| :--- | :--- |
| once / twice / three times a week | una / dos / tres veces a la semana |
| every day / regularly | cada día / con regularidad |
| for four hours / for thirty minutes | durante… |
| litre(s) / cup(s) | litro(s) / taza(s) |
| gym / run / exercise | gimnasio / correr / hacer ejercicio |
| habits / routine | hábitos / rutina |
| languages / books / films | idiomas / libros / películas |

---

## 10. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| How many water do you drink? | How **much** water…? | *water* incontable |
| How much books…? | How **many** books…? | *books* contable |
| How often have you lived here? | How **long** have you lived here? | duración ≠ frecuencia |
| How long ago have you arrived? | How long ago **did** you arrive? | *ago* → Past Simple |
| How long do you live here? *(si sigue ahora)* | How long **have** you **lived** here? | Present Perfect + *for/since* |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-much-coffee.mp3" title="🔊 How much coffee do you drink a day?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-often-running.mp3" title="🔊 How often do you go running?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-19/how-long-run.mp3" title="🔊 How long do you run each time?"></audio>

---

## 11. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige la pregunta

1. ____ do you exercise? — Three times a week.  
2. ____ have you lived here? — For five years.  
3. ____ water do you drink? — Two litres.  
4. ____ books have you read? — Twelve.  
5. ____ did you arrive? — Two hours ago.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **How often** · 2. **How long** · 3. **How much** · 4. **How many** · 5. **How long ago**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *much* o *many*

1. How ____ coffee do you drink?  
2. How ____ languages do you speak?  
3. How ____ people are in your class?  
4. How ____ money do you need?  
5. How ____ films do you watch a week?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **much** · 2. **many** · 3. **many** · 4. **much** · 5. **many**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa a Jake

How ____ do I exercise? Three times a week. How ____ do I study every day? For four hours. How ____ water do I drink? Two litres. How ____ books have I read? Twelve. I watch films ____ a week.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**often** · **long** · **much** · **many** · **twice**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa a Lisa

How ____ do I go running? Four times a week. How ____ do I run each time? For thirty minutes. How ____ coffee do I drink? Two cups. How ____ languages do I speak? Three.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**often** · **long** · **much** · **many**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Empareja

1. How long  
2. How often  
3. How much  
4. How many  
5. How long ago  

a) frecuencia · b) duración · c) incontable · d) contable · e) pasado + *ago*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **c** · 4 → **d** · 5 → **e**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *How many water do you drink?*  
2. *How much books have you read?*  
3. *How often have you lived here?*  
4. *How long ago have you arrived?*  
5. *How long do you live here?* *(sigue viviendo allí)*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. How **much** water do you drink?  
2. How **many** books have you read?  
3. How **long** have you lived here?  
4. How long ago **did** you arrive?  
5. How long **have** you **lived** here?
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe la pregunta

1. I go to the gym three times a week. → ____  
2. I study for four hours every day. → ____  
3. I drink two litres of water a day. → ____  
4. I have read twelve books. → ____  
5. I arrived two hours ago. → ____

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. How often do you go to the gym?  
2. How long do you study every day?  
3. How much water do you drink a day?  
4. How many books have you read?  
5. How long ago did you arrive?
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) How often do you exercise? · b) How long do you exercise a week? *(si quieres frecuencia)* · c) How many do you exercise?  
2. ____  
   a) How much water…? · b) How many water…? · c) How often water…?  
3. ____  
   a) How many languages do you speak? · b) How much languages do you speak? · c) How long languages do you speak?  
4. ____  
   a) How long ago did you arrive? · b) How long ago have you arrived? · c) How long ago you arrived?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **a** · 3. **a** · 4. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. ¿Con qué frecuencia haces ejercicio?  
2. ¿Cuánto tiempo estudias cada día?  
3. ¿Cuánta agua bebes?  
4. ¿Cuántos libros has leído este año?  
5. ¿Hace cuánto llegaste?  
6. Voy al gimnasio tres veces a la semana.  
7. Estudio durante cuatro horas cada día.  
8. Bebo dos litros al día.  
9. Hablo tres idiomas.  
10. Corro durante treinta minutos.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. How often do you exercise?  
2. How long do you study every day?  
3. How much water do you drink?  
4. How many books have you read this year?  
5. How long ago did you arrive?  
6. I go to the gym three times a week.  
7. I study for four hours every day.  
8. I drink two litres a day.  
9. I speak three languages.  
10. I run for thirty minutes.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Tu encuesta

Escribe 8–12 líneas:

- 2 × *How often…?* + respuesta  
- 2 × *How long…?* + respuesta  
- 1 × *How much…?* · 1 × *How many…?*  
- 1 × *How long ago…?*  

**Modelo:** Jake o Lisa.

---

## 12. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Tabla de las 5 preguntas *How…?*  
2. **8 min** — Ejercicios 1–7.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha a Jake y Lisa; marca cada *How*.  
4. **5–8 min** — Graba tu mini encuesta.

### Checklist

- [ ] Distingo *How long / often / much / many / long ago*  
- [ ] Uso *much* con incontables y *many* con contables  
- [ ] Respondo frecuencia con *once/twice/… times a week*  
- [ ] Uso *How long ago* + Past Simple + *ago*  
- [ ] Puedo hablar de mi rutina con preguntas y respuestas

---

## 13. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Primero elige **qué** preguntas (tiempo, frecuencia, cantidad…).  
2. Luego elige la forma *How…?* correcta.  
3. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 19](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-19-how-questions-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 19 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-19).

La **Unidad 20** es el **repaso del Módulo 2**: Present Perfect, Past Continuous, *for/since* y *How* questions.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Pregunta | Uso |
| :--- | :--- |
| How long…? | duración |
| How often…? | frecuencia |
| How much…? | incontable |
| How many…? | contable |
| How long ago…? | pasado + *ago* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 20** harás el **Repaso del Módulo 2**: Present Perfect, Past Continuous, *for/since* y *How* questions.

- [Unidad 20 — Repaso Módulo 2](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-20-repaso-modulo-2)

- [A1 U33 — Adverbios de frecuencia](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-33-adverbios-frecuencia)

---
