description: Aprende a hablar de transporte en inglés A1: by bus/train/plane y take the bus/train. Guía Unidad 42 con vocabulario, audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema by + transporte y take the + transporte en inglés A1
keywords: by plane by taxi by bicycle
how do you go to work

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se dice «en autobús» en inglés A1?
faqs.answer: Se dice by bus (sin artículo). También puedes decir take the bus (con the). Las dos formas son correctas y muy frecuentes.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre by bus y take the bus?
faqs.answer: Significan casi lo mismo. By + transporte va sin artículo (by bus). Take the + transporte usa the (take the bus). Ejemplo: I go by bus. / I take the bus.

faqs.question: ¿Se dice by the train o by train?
faqs.answer: By train, sin the. Con take sí usas the: take the train. Incorrecto: by the train / take bus.

faqs.question: ¿Qué medios de transporte practico en la Unidad 42?
faqs.answer: Bus, train, plane, taxi, bicycle y también car. Frases: by bus, by train, by plane, by taxi, by bicycle, by car; take the bus, take the train.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 42 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 42 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y speaking.

content:
En la [Unidad 41](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should) estuviste en el aeropuerto (*must/should*). En la **Unidad 42 del curso A1** (*Transport*) explicas **cómo te mueves**: ***by bus***, ***by train***, ***take the bus***.

Repasas *go* y hábitos del Present Simple y conectas con viajes del Módulo 5. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 42 — Transport](/curso-a1/unit-42)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 41 — At the Airport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should) · [Unidad 32 — Sports & Hobbies](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-32-deportes-hobbies-play-go-do)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 42 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***by + transporte*** sin artículo (*by bus*, *by train*).
- Usar ***take the + transporte*** (*take the bus*, *take the train*).
- Nombrar ***bus, train, plane, taxi, bicycle, car***.
- Preguntar: ***How do you go to work?***
- Hablar de viajes diarios y de vacaciones.

---

## 1. By + transporte (sin artículo)

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| by **bus** | I go to work **by bus**. |
| by **train** | She travels **by train** to London. |
| by **plane** | We travel **by plane** for holidays. |
| by **car** | He goes **by car** to the office. |
| by **taxi** | I went to the airport **by taxi**. |
| by **bicycle** | He goes to school **by bicycle**. |

![By + transporte A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/a1-unit42-by-transport.png)

```
by + transport (NO article)
→ by bus · by train · by plane · by car · by taxi · by bicycle
(NO: by the bus / by a train)
```

### Tip

Después de ***by*** no pongas *the* ni *a*. Piensa: *by + medio* = «en + medio».

---

## 2. Take the + transporte

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| take **the bus** | I **take the bus** every day. |
| take **the train** | She **takes the train** every Monday. |
| take **the plane** | They **take the plane** to Spain. |

![by vs take the A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/a1-unit42-by-vs-take.png)

```
take the + transport
→ take the bus · take the train · take the plane
(con "the")
```

### Misma idea, dos estructuras

| by… | take the… |
| :--- | :--- |
| I go **by bus**. | I **take the bus**. |
| She travels **by train**. | She **takes the train**. |
| We travel **by plane**. | We **take the plane**. |

En A1 las dos valen. Elige una y practícala hasta que salga automática; luego añade la otra.

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> I go to work **by bus** every day.  
> She travels **by train** to London.  
> We **take the bus** every day.  
> She **takes the train** every Monday.  
> We travel **by plane** to Spain.  
> He goes **by car** to the office.  
> I went to the airport **by taxi**.  
> My brother goes to school **by bicycle**.  
> How do you go to work?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/go-by-bus.mp3" title="🔊 I go to work by bus every day"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/travel-by-train.mp3" title="🔊 She travels by train to London"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/take-the-bus.mp3" title="🔊 We take the bus every day"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/takes-the-train.mp3" title="🔊 She takes the train every Monday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/travel-by-plane.mp3" title="🔊 We travel by plane to Spain"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/go-by-car.mp3" title="🔊 He goes by car to the office"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/by-taxi-airport.mp3" title="🔊 I went to the airport by taxi"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/by-bicycle-school.mp3" title="🔊 My brother goes to school by bicycle"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/how-do-you-go.mp3" title="🔊 How do you go to work?"></audio>

### Regla rápida

| Correcto | Incorrecto |
| :--- | :--- |
| by **bus** | by **the** bus |
| by **train** | by **a** train |
| take **the** bus | take bus |
| take **the** train | take **a** train (menos natural en A1 aquí) |

---

## 4. Vocabulario de transporte

![Vocabulario transporte A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/a1-unit42-transport-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| bus | autobús | by bus / take the bus |
| train | tren | by train / take the train |
| plane | avión | by plane |
| taxi | taxi | by taxi |
| bicycle | bicicleta | by bicycle |
| car | coche | by car |
| travel | viajar | We travel by plane. |
| go to work | ir al trabajo | I go to work by bus. |
| every day | cada día | every day |
| holidays | vacaciones | for holidays |
| fast | rápido | It is fast. |
| cheap | barato | It is cheap. |

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **How do you go** to work?  
> **I take the bus.** / **I go by bus.**

> **How does she travel** to London?  
> **She travels by train.**

> **Do you ever go by plane?**  
> **Yes, for holidays.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/i-take-the-bus.mp3" title="🔊 I take the bus"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/she-travels-by-train.mp3" title="🔊 She travels by train"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/yes-for-holidays.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, for holidays"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| How do you go to work? | I go by bus. / I take the bus. |
| How does he go to school? | He goes by bicycle. |
| Do you travel by plane? | Yes, for holidays. |
| How did you go to the airport? | By taxi. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: cómo viajamos

> **I go to work by bus every day.** My sister **takes the train** to London. We sometimes travel **by plane** for holidays. Last week I went to the airport **by taxi**. My brother goes to school **by bicycle**. He likes it because it is fast and cheap.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/reading-go-by-bus.mp3" title="🔊 I go to work by bus every day"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/reading-sister-train.mp3" title="🔊 My sister takes the train to London"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/reading-by-plane-holidays.mp3" title="🔊 We sometimes travel by plane for holidays"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/reading-by-taxi.mp3" title="🔊 Last week I went to the airport by taxi"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/reading-by-bicycle.mp3" title="🔊 My brother goes to school by bicycle"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Cómo va el narrador al trabajo? → **By bus**.  
2. ¿Qué toma la hermana a Londres? → **The train**.  
3. ¿Cuándo viajan en avión? → **For holidays**.  
4. ¿Cómo fue al aeropuerto? → **By taxi**.  
5. ¿Cómo va el hermano al colegio? → **By bicycle**.  
6. ¿Por qué le gusta la bici? → **Fast and cheap**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** How do you go to work?  
> **B:** I take the bus.  
> **A:** I go by car. What about your sister?  
> **B:** She travels by train to London.  
> **A:** Do you ever go by plane?  
> **B:** Yes, for holidays. Last time I went to the airport by taxi.  
> **A:** My son goes to school by bicycle.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/dialogue-how-work.mp3" title="🔊 How do you go to work?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/dialogue-take-bus.mp3" title="🔊 I take the bus"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/dialogue-by-car.mp3" title="🔊 I go by car"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-42/dialogue-sister-train.mp3" title="🔊 She travels by train to London"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *by **the** bus* | *by bus* | sin artículo |
| *by **a** train* | *by train* | sin artículo |
| *take bus* | *take **the** bus* | con *the* |
| *I go **in** bus* | *I go **by** bus* | *by* para medio |
| *I go **with** the bus* | *I go **by** bus* | no *with* |
| *by the bicycle* | *by bicycle* | sin *the* |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **by bus** | *bai BAS*. |
| **by train** | *bai TREIN*. |
| **by plane** | *bai PLEIN*. |
| **taxi** | *TAK-si*. |
| **bicycle** | *BAI-si-kel*. |
| **take the bus** | une: *teik-dha-BAS*. |
| **every day** | *EV-ri dei*. |

Practica: *by bus → by train → by plane → take the bus → take the train*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** How do you go to work?  
> **B:** I go by bus. And you?  
> **A:** I take the train.

> **A:** Do you travel by plane?  
> **B:** Yes, for holidays.  
> **A:** How do you go to the airport?  
> **B:** By taxi.

> **A:** How does your brother go to school?  
> **B:** By bicycle — it's fast and cheap.

Cambia solo el medio: fijas ***by…*** o ***take the…***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. I go to work by \_\_\_\_.  
2. She takes the \_\_\_\_ to London.  
3. We travel by \_\_\_\_ for holidays.  
4. How do you go to \_\_\_\_?  
5. Last week I went to the airport by \_\_\_\_.  
6. He goes to school by bicycle.

### Más frases para memorizar

> I go to work by bus every day.  
> She travels by train to London.  
> We take the bus every day.  
> She takes the train every Monday.  
> We travel by plane to Spain.  
> He goes by car to the office.  
> I went to the airport by taxi.  
> My brother goes to school by bicycle.  
> How do you go to work?  
> I take the bus.  
> I go by car.  
> She travels by train to London.  
> Do you ever go by plane?  
> Yes, for holidays.  
> It is fast and cheap.  
> We sometimes travel by plane for holidays.  
> My sister takes the train to London.  
> Last week I went to the airport by taxi.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe **cómo vas** tú al trabajo o al colegio.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 4 frases *by + transport*.  
2. Di 3 con *take the + transport*.  
3. Pregunta *How do you go to work?* y responde.  
4. Añade *for holidays* / *every day*.

### Combinar U41 + U42

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U41 | aeropuerto | You must show your passport. |
| **U42** | cómo llegas | I go to the airport **by taxi**. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> I go to work by bus every day. My sister takes the train to London. We sometimes travel by plane for holidays. Last week I went to the airport by taxi. My brother goes to school by bicycle.

Cambia personas y medios; mantén *by* / *take the*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> I go to work by bus every day. My sister takes the train to London. We sometimes travel by plane for holidays. Last week I went to the airport by taxi. My brother goes to school by bicycle. He likes it because it is fast and cheap.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tus** medios reales.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> How do you go to work?  
> I take the bus.  
> I go by car.  
> She travels by train.  
> We travel by plane for holidays.  
> He goes by bicycle.  
> I went by taxi.

Personaliza destinos reales (*school, work, airport, London*).

### Checklist mental

- *by + transport* (sin *the*)  
- *take the + transport* (con *the*)  
- Vocab: bus · train · plane · taxi · bicycle · car  
- Pregunta: *How do you go…?*  
- Contextos: *every day* · *for holidays*

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U41 | At the Airport — must/should |
| **U42** | Transport — by / take the |
| U43 | Travel Verbs — arrive, depart, visit… |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa *by* o *take*

1. I go to work \_\_\_\_ bus.  
2. We \_\_\_\_ the bus every day.  
3. She travels \_\_\_\_ train to London.  
4. They \_\_\_\_ the train to Paris.  
5. We travel \_\_\_\_ plane for holidays.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by**  
2. **take**  
3. **by**  
4. **take**  
5. **by**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el transporte

1. flies in the air → \_\_\_\_  
2. on rails → \_\_\_\_  
3. many people on the road → \_\_\_\_  
4. two wheels, you pedal → \_\_\_\_  
5. car you pay for → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **plane**  
2. **train**  
3. **bus**  
4. **bicycle**  
5. **taxi**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. Voy al trabajo en autobús.  
2. Ella coge el tren a Londres.  
3. Viajamos en avión para vacaciones.  
4. Fui al aeropuerto en taxi.  
5. ¿Cómo vas al trabajo?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I go to work by bus.**  
2. **She takes the train to London.**  
3. **We travel by plane for holidays.**  
4. **I went to the airport by taxi.**  
5. **How do you go to work?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. bus / by / work / to / go / I  
2. the / takes / train / She  
3. plane / by / travel / We  
4. bicycle / by / school / to / goes / He

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I go to work by bus.**  
2. **She takes the train.**  
3. **We travel by plane.**  
4. **He goes to school by bicycle.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. How does the writer go to work?  
2. How does the sister travel to London?  
3. When do they travel by plane?  
4. How did the writer go to the airport last week?  
5. How does the brother go to school?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **By bus**  
2. **By train / takes the train**  
3. **For holidays**  
4. **By taxi**  
5. **By bicycle**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. I go by the bus.  
2. She takes train.  
3. We travel by a plane.  
4. He goes in bicycle.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **I go by bus.**  
2. **She takes the train.**  
3. **We travel by plane.**  
4. **He goes by bicycle.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tus viajes

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *by* (3 veces) y *take the* (2 veces)  
- al menos 4 medios (*bus, train, plane, taxi, bicycle, car*)  
- *How do you go…?*  
- *every day* o *for holidays*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. I go \_\_\_\_ bus. (by / by the / take)  
2. She \_\_\_\_ the train every Monday. (takes / by / take)  
3. We travel \_\_\_\_ plane. (by / the / take)  
4. How \_\_\_\_ you go to work? (do / does / are)  
5. He goes to school \_\_\_\_ bicycle. (by / by the / take)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **by**  
2. **takes**  
3. **by**  
4. **do**  
5. **by**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 frases *by + transport*.  
2. **3 min** — Di 5 con *take the + transport*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu familia.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *How do you go…?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *by* sin artículo  
- [ ] Uso *take the* con *the*  
- [ ] Conozco bus / train / plane / taxi / bicycle / car  
- [ ] Pregunto *How do you go…?*  
- [ ] Hablo de trabajo y vacaciones

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Agenda real:** anota durante un día *by bus / by car / by bicycle*.  
2. **Pareja:** pregunta *How do you go to work/school?* y responde con las dos estructuras.  
3. **Combina** U41: *I went to the airport by taxi. I must show my passport.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 43](/curso-a1/unit-43): *Travel Verbs* (*arrive, depart, visit, stay*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 42](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 42 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-42).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| by + transport | sin artículo (*by bus*) |
| take the + transport | con *the* (*take the bus*) |
| Vocab | bus · train · plane · taxi · bicycle · car |
| Pregunta | How do you go to…? |
| Tip | no mezcles: *by the bus* / *take bus* |
| Contextos | every day · for holidays |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 42 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 42 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-42)

En la **Unidad 43** practicas **verbos de viaje**: *arrive, depart, visit, stay, explore* con Present Simple de horarios.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs (horarios)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios)
- [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/curso-a1/unit-43)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe un párrafo de 6–8 frases sobre cómo viaja tu familia (*by* + *take the*).

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés en trenes y metro](/blog/viajes/ingles-trenes-metro-transporte)
- [Hostels y transporte público](/blog/viajes/mochileros-ingles-hostels-transporte-publico)
- [Inglés para alquiler de coche](/blog/viajes/ingles-alquiler-coche)
- [Phrasal verbs with take](/blog/gramatica/phrasal-verbs-with-take)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Transport vocabulary: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary
- British Council — Prepositions: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar

title: Verbos de Viaje en Inglés A1: Leave, Arrive y Más
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 43 del curso A1: verbos de viaje y Present Simple para horarios, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende verbos de viaje en inglés A1 con Present Simple de horarios: leave, arrive, depart, visit, stay y explore, con ejemplos y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema Present Simple para horarios de viaje en inglés A1

faqs.question: ¿Qué tiempo uso para horarios de tren o avión en A1?
faqs.answer: Present Simple: The train leaves at nine. The plane arrives at three. Aunque el viaje sea futuro, el horario se expresa en Present Simple.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre leave, depart y arrive?
faqs.answer: Leave y depart significan salir/partir. Arrive significa llegar. Ejemplo: The train leaves at 8 and arrives in London at 10:30.

faqs.question: ¿Se dice arrive in o arrive at?
faqs.answer: En A1: arrive in + ciudad (arrive in London) y arrive at + hora (arrives at half past ten). También arrive at + lugar concreto (arrive at the station).

faqs.question: ¿Qué verbos de viaje practico en la Unidad 43?
faqs.answer: Leave, depart, arrive, visit, stay y explore. Frases: stay at a hotel, visit museums, explore the city.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 43 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 43 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y speaking.

content:
En la [Unidad 42](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the) hablaste de *by bus / take the train*. En la **Unidad 43 del curso A1** (*Travel Verbs*) usas el **Present Simple para horarios** y verbos como ***leave, arrive, visit, stay, explore***.

Conecta con el aeropuerto de la [Unidad 41](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should) y el Present Simple de la [Unidad 5](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-5-present-simple-rutinas). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/curso-a1/unit-43)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 42 — Transport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-42-transporte-by-take-the) · [Unidad 41 — At the Airport](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 43 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***Present Simple*** para horarios (*The train leaves at…*).
- Decir ***leave / depart*** (salir) y ***arrive*** (llegar).
- Usar ***visit, stay, explore*** en planes de viaje.
- Preguntar: ***When does your train leave?*** / ***What time does it arrive?***
- Describir un viaje: salida → llegada → hotel → museos → vuelo de vuelta.

---

## 1. Present Simple para horarios

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| The train **leaves** at… | The train **leaves** at nine o'clock. |
| The bus **departs** at… | The bus **departs** at half past seven. |
| The plane **arrives** at… | The plane **arrives** at three o'clock. |
| It **arrives in** London at… | It **arrives in** London at half past ten. |

![Horarios Present Simple A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/a1-unit43-schedules.png)

```
Present Simple (schedules)
→ The train leaves / arrives / departs at + time
→ 3.ª persona: leaves, arrives, departs (con -s)
```

### Tip

Aunque hables de **mañana** o la **próxima semana**, el horario fijo va en Present Simple: *My train leaves at eight tomorrow.* No digas *is leaving* para el horario tipográfico del billete (en A1 priorizamos Present Simple).

### Tercera persona

| Sujeto | Verbo |
| :--- | :--- |
| the train / the bus / the plane / it | leave**s**, arrive**s**, depart**s** |
| I / you / we / they | leave, arrive, depart |

---

## 2. Verbos de viaje

| Verbo | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **leave** | salir | The train **leaves** at eight. |
| **depart** | partir/salir | My flight **departs** on Sunday. |
| **arrive** | llegar | It **arrives** in London at 10:30. |
| **visit** | visitar | I want to **visit** the museums. |
| **stay** | quedarse | I **stay** at a hotel for three nights. |
| **explore** | explorar | I want to **explore** the city. |

![Verbos de viaje A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/a1-unit43-travel-verbs.png)

### arrive in / arrive at

| Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| arrive **in** + ciudad | arrive **in** London |
| arrive **at** + hora | arrives **at** half past ten |
| arrive **at** + lugar | arrive **at** the station |

### stay at

> I **stay at** a hotel for two nights.  
> She **stays at** a hotel near the museum.

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> The train **leaves** at nine o'clock.  
> The bus **departs** at half past seven.  
> My flight **leaves** at ten in the morning.  
> The plane **arrives** at three o'clock.  
> The train **arrives in** London at noon.  
> I **stay** at a hotel for three nights.  
> I want to **visit** the museums.  
> I want to **explore** the city.  
> My flight **departs** on Sunday at five.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/train-leaves-nine.mp3" title="🔊 The train leaves at nine o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/bus-departs.mp3" title="🔊 The bus departs at half past seven"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/flight-leaves-ten.mp3" title="🔊 My flight leaves at ten in the morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/plane-arrives-three.mp3" title="🔊 The plane arrives at three o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/arrives-in-london.mp3" title="🔊 The train arrives in London at noon"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/stay-hotel-three.mp3" title="🔊 I stay at a hotel for three nights"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/visit-museums.mp3" title="🔊 I want to visit the museums"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/explore-city.mp3" title="🔊 I want to explore the city"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/flight-departs-sunday.mp3" title="🔊 My flight departs on Sunday at five"></audio>

---

## 4. Un día de viaje (flujo)

![Día de viaje A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/a1-unit43-travel-day.png)

| Paso | Inglés | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | **Leaves** | My train leaves at eight. |
| 2 | **Arrives** | It arrives in London at half past ten. |
| 3 | **Stay / visit / explore** | I stay at a hotel. I visit museums and explore the city. |
| 4 | **Departs** | My flight departs on Sunday at five. |

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **When does your train leave?**  
> **It leaves at nine o'clock.**

> **What time does it arrive in London?**  
> **At half past eleven.**

> **Do you visit museums?**  
> **Yes — I want to explore the city.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/when-does-train-leave.mp3" title="🔊 When does your train leave?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/it-leaves-at-nine.mp3" title="🔊 It leaves at nine o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/what-time-arrive.mp3" title="🔊 What time does it arrive in London?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/half-past-eleven.mp3" title="🔊 At half past eleven"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| When does your train leave? | It leaves at nine. |
| What time does it arrive? | At half past ten. |
| Where do you stay? | At a hotel. |
| Do you visit museums? | Yes, I do. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: viaje a Londres

> **I am going to London next week.** My train **leaves** at eight o'clock in the morning. It **arrives** in London at half past ten. I **stay** at a hotel for three nights. I want to **visit** the museums and **explore** the city. My flight **departs** on Sunday at five o'clock.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-going-london.mp3" title="🔊 I am going to London next week"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-train-leaves.mp3" title="🔊 My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-arrives-london.mp3" title="🔊 It arrives in London at half past ten"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-stay-hotel.mp3" title="🔊 I stay at a hotel for three nights"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/reading-visit-explore.mp3" title="🔊 I want to visit the museums and explore the city"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Adónde va? → **London**.  
2. ¿A qué hora sale el tren? → **At eight**.  
3. ¿A qué hora llega? → **At half past ten**.  
4. ¿Cuántas noches en hotel? → **Three**.  
5. ¿Qué quiere hacer? → **Visit museums and explore the city**.  
6. ¿Cuándo sale el vuelo? → **Sunday at five**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** When does your train leave?  
> **B:** It leaves at nine o'clock.  
> **A:** What time does it arrive in London?  
> **B:** At half past eleven. I stay at a hotel for two nights.  
> **A:** Do you visit museums?  
> **B:** Yes, I want to explore the city. My flight departs on Monday at six in the evening.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-when-leave.mp3" title="🔊 When does your train leave?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-leaves-nine.mp3" title="🔊 It leaves at nine o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-arrive-london.mp3" title="🔊 What time does it arrive in London?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-43/dialogue-explore-flight.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, I want to explore the city. My flight departs on Monday at six"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *The train **leave** at nine* | *The train **leaves** at nine* | 3.ª persona *-s* |
| *The train **is leave** at nine* | *The train **leaves** at nine* | Present Simple |
| *arrive **to** London* | *arrive **in** London* | *in* + ciudad |
| *stay **in** a hotel* (A1 tip) | *stay **at** a hotel* | *at* + hotel (muy frecuente) |
| *My flight **depart** on Sunday* | *My flight **departs** on Sunday* | *-s* |
| *I want **visit** museums* | *I want **to** visit museums* | *want to* + verbo |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **leaves** | *liivz*. |
| **arrives** | *a-RAIVZ*. |
| **departs** | *di-PARTS*. |
| **visit** | *VI-zit*. |
| **stay** | *stei*. |
| **explore** | *ik-SPLOR*. |
| **half past** | *haaf paast* / *haf past*. |
| **o'clock** | *a-KLOK*. |

Practica: *leaves → arrives → departs → visit → stay → explore*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** When does your train leave?  
> **B:** It leaves at eight.  
> **A:** What time does it arrive?  
> **B:** At half past ten.

> **A:** Where do you stay?  
> **B:** At a hotel for three nights.  
> **A:** Do you visit museums?  
> **B:** Yes — I explore the city.

> **A:** When does your flight depart?  
> **B:** On Sunday at five o'clock.

Cambia solo horas y ciudad: fijas ***leaves / arrives / stay / visit / explore***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. The train leaves at \_\_\_\_.  
2. It arrives in \_\_\_\_ at \_\_\_\_.  
3. I stay at a hotel for \_\_\_\_ nights.  
4. I want to visit \_\_\_\_.  
5. I want to explore \_\_\_\_.  
6. My flight departs on \_\_\_\_ at \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> The train leaves at nine o'clock.  
> The bus departs at half past seven.  
> My flight leaves at ten in the morning.  
> The plane arrives at three o'clock.  
> The train arrives in London at noon.  
> I stay at a hotel for three nights.  
> I want to visit the museums.  
> I want to explore the city.  
> My flight departs on Sunday at five.  
> When does your train leave?  
> It leaves at nine o'clock.  
> What time does it arrive in London?  
> At half past eleven.  
> I stay at a hotel for two nights.  
> Do you visit museums?  
> Yes, I want to explore the city.  
> My flight departs on Monday at six in the evening.  
> I am going to London next week.  
> My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning.  
> It arrives in London at half past ten.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe **tu** viaje con horarios reales o inventados.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 3 frases *leaves/departs at…*.  
2. Di 2 con *arrives in… at…*.  
3. Añade *stay at a hotel* + *visit* + *explore*.  
4. Pregunta *When does your train leave?*

### Combinar U42 + U43

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U42 | medio | I go **by train**. |
| **U43** | horario y verbos | The train **leaves** at eight. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> I am going to London next week. My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning. It arrives in London at half past ten. I stay at a hotel for three nights. I want to visit the museums and explore the city. My flight departs on Sunday at five o'clock.

Cambia ciudad, horas y noches; mantén los verbos.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> I am going to London next week. My train leaves at eight o'clock in the morning. It arrives in London at half past ten. I stay at a hotel for three nights. I want to visit the museums and explore the city. My flight departs on Sunday at five o'clock.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con **tu** destino.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> When does your train leave?  
> It leaves at nine.  
> What time does it arrive?  
> At half past eleven.  
> I stay at a hotel.  
> I visit museums.  
> I explore the city.  
> My flight departs on Monday.

Personaliza ciudad y horas.

### Checklist mental

- Present Simple para horarios (*leaves / arrives / departs*)  
- *-s* en 3.ª persona  
- *arrive in* + ciudad · *arrive at* + hora  
- *stay at a hotel* · *visit* · *explore*  
- Preguntas: *When does… leave?* / *What time does it arrive?*

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U42 | Transport — by / take the |
| **U43** | Travel Verbs — schedules |
| U44 | The Weather — *It is…* |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa el verbo (3.ª persona)

1. The train \_\_\_\_ at nine o'clock. (leave)  
2. The plane \_\_\_\_ at three o'clock. (arrive)  
3. The bus \_\_\_\_ at half past seven. (depart)  
4. My flight \_\_\_\_ on Sunday at five. (depart)  
5. It \_\_\_\_ in London at noon. (arrive)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves**  
2. **arrives**  
3. **departs**  
4. **departs**  
5. **arrives**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el verbo

1. reach a place → \_\_\_\_  
2. leave / go away → \_\_\_\_ / \_\_\_\_  
3. go to see a place → \_\_\_\_  
4. remain in a place → \_\_\_\_  
5. discover / look around → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **arrive**  
2. **leave** / **depart**  
3. **visit**  
4. **stay**  
5. **explore**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. El tren sale a las ocho.  
2. Llega a Londres a las diez y media.  
3. Me quedo en un hotel tres noches.  
4. Quiero visitar los museos.  
5. ¿Cuándo sale tu tren?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **The train leaves at eight.**  
2. **It arrives in London at half past ten.**  
3. **I stay at a hotel for three nights.**  
4. **I want to visit the museums.**  
5. **When does your train leave?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. leaves / The / at / train / nine  
2. in / arrives / London / It  
3. at / stay / a / I / hotel  
4. explore / to / want / I / the city

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **The train leaves at nine.**  
2. **It arrives in London.**  
3. **I stay at a hotel.**  
4. **I want to explore the city.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. Where is the writer going?  
2. What time does the train leave?  
3. What time does it arrive in London?  
4. How many nights does the writer stay?  
5. When does the flight depart?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **London**  
2. **At eight o'clock**  
3. **At half past ten**  
4. **Three**  
5. **On Sunday at five**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. The train leave at nine.  
2. It arrives to London at ten.  
3. I stay in a hotel for two nights. (usa la forma A1 del curso)  
4. I want visit museums.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **The train leaves at nine.**  
2. **It arrives in London at ten.**  
3. **I stay at a hotel for two nights.**  
4. **I want to visit museums.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe tu viaje

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *leaves* / *arrives* / *departs*  
- *stay at a hotel*  
- *visit* y *explore*  
- al menos 2 horas (*at eight*, *at half past ten*…)  
- 1 pregunta *When does…?*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. The train \_\_\_\_ at eight. (leaves / leave / leaving)  
2. It arrives \_\_\_\_ London at 10:30. (in / to / at)  
3. I stay \_\_\_\_ a hotel. (at / to / on)  
4. When \_\_\_\_ your train leave? (does / do / is)  
5. My flight \_\_\_\_ on Sunday. (departs / depart / departing)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **leaves**  
2. **in**  
3. **at**  
4. **does**  
5. **departs**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di 5 frases de horarios (*leaves / arrives / departs*).  
2. **3 min** — Practica *visit / stay / explore*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu ciudad.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *When does… leave?* / *What time does it arrive?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso Present Simple para horarios  
- [ ] Pongo *-s* en 3.ª persona  
- [ ] Distingo leave/depart vs arrive  
- [ ] Uso *stay at*, *visit*, *explore*  
- [ ] Pregunto horarios con *When/What time does…?*

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Mira un horario real** (tren/avión) y di 5 frases *leaves/arrives at…*.  
2. **Pareja:** uno pregunta horarios; el otro responde + *stay/visit/explore*.  
3. **Combina** U42: *I go by train. The train leaves at eight.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 44](/curso-a1/unit-44): *The Weather* (*It is sunny / rainy…*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 43](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 43 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-43).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Horarios | Present Simple (*leaves / arrives*) |
| Salida | leave · depart |
| Llegada | arrive in + city · arrive at + time |
| En destino | stay · visit · explore |
| Pregunta | When does… leave? What time does it arrive? |
| Tip | 3.ª persona con *-s* |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 43 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 43 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-43)

En la **Unidad 44** hablas del **tiempo atmosférico**: *It is sunny / cloudy / rainy / cold / hot*.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 44 — The Weather (It is…)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico)
- [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a1/unit-44)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe un párrafo de 6–8 frases con un viaje completo (salida, llegada, hotel, visita, vuelo).

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-viajar)
- [Inglés en trenes y metro](/blog/viajes/ingles-trenes-metro-transporte)
- [Curso de inglés para viajar](/blog/viajes/curso-de-ingles-para-viajar)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Present simple: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/present-simple
- British Council — Travel vocabulary: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary

title: El Tiempo en Inglés A1: Sunny, Rainy, Hot y Cold
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 44 del curso A1: el tiempo atmosférico con It is sunny / rainy y It is raining, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende a hablar del tiempo en inglés A1 con sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot y cold, vocabulario, ejemplos y ejercicios para practicar.
alt: Esquema It is + tiempo atmosférico en inglés A1

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto por el tiempo en inglés A1?
faqs.answer: La pregunta clave es What is the weather like today? Respuesta típica: It is sunny. / It is rainy and cold.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre rainy e It is raining?
faqs.answer: Rainy es adjetivo (It is rainy). It is raining describe la acción ahora (está lloviendo). En A1 practicas las dos.

faqs.question: ¿Se dice It is sun o It is sunny?
faqs.answer: It is sunny. Usamos el adjetivo (sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, hot, cold), no el nombre solo (sun, rain).

faqs.question: ¿Cómo hablo del tiempo de ayer?
faqs.answer: Con was: Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. It was raining in the afternoon.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 44 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 44 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y speaking.

content:
En la [Unidad 43](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios) hablaste de horarios de viaje. En la **Unidad 44 del curso A1** (*The Weather*) describes el **tiempo atmosférico**: ***It is sunny***, ***It is raining***, ***hot / cold***.

Repasas *It is…* del verbo *to be* y conectas con viajes del Módulo 5. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 44 — The Weather](/curso-a1/unit-44)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 43 — Travel Verbs](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-43-verbos-viaje-horarios) · [Unidad 3 — To be](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-3-to-be-negativa-preguntas)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 44 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***It is + adjetivo***: *sunny, rainy, cloudy, snowy, hot, cold*.
- Usar ***It is raining / It is snowing*** para la acción ahora.
- Preguntar: ***What is the weather like today?***
- Contrastar ***today (is)*** y ***yesterday (was)***.
- Decir qué tiempo prefieres (*I prefer sunny weather*).

---

## 1. It is + adjetivo de tiempo

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| It **is sunny** | It is sunny today. |
| It **is rainy** | It is rainy this morning. |
| It **is cloudy** | It is cloudy. |
| It **is snowy** | It is snowy in winter. |
| It **is hot** | It is hot in summer. |
| It **is cold** | It is cold today. |

![It is + weather A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/a1-unit44-it-is-weather.png)

```
It is + weather adjective
→ sunny · rainy · cloudy · snowy · hot · cold

It is + -ing (now)
→ It is raining · It is snowing
```

### Tip

Sujeto fijo: ***It***. No digas *The weather is sunny* al principio (también existe, pero en A1 priorizamos *It is sunny*).

### Adjetivo vs -ing

| Adjetivo | Acción ahora |
| :--- | :--- |
| It is **rainy**. | It is **raining**. |
| It is **snowy**. | It is **snowing**. |
| It is **sunny**. | — (no *It is sunning*) |

---

## 2. Vocabulario del tiempo

![Vocabulario weather A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/a1-unit44-weather-vocab.png)

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| sunny | soleado | It is sunny. |
| rainy | lluvioso | It is rainy. |
| cloudy | nublado | It is cloudy. |
| snowy | con nieve | It is snowy. |
| hot | calor / caluroso | It is hot. |
| cold | frío | It is cold. |
| raining | lloviendo | It is raining. |
| snowing | nevando | It is snowing. |
| weather | tiempo (atmosférico) | the weather |
| umbrella | paraguas | I had an umbrella. |
| outside | fuera | go outside |
| prefer | preferir | I prefer sunny weather. |

---

## 3. Ejemplos con audio

> It **is sunny** today.  
> It **is raining** now.  
> It **is cloudy** this morning.  
> It **is snowing** in winter.  
> It **is hot** in summer.  
> It **is cold** today.  
> What **is the weather like** today?  
> It is sunny and hot.  
> I prefer sunny weather.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 It is sunny today"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-raining.mp3" title="🔊 It is raining now"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-cloudy.mp3" title="🔊 It is cloudy this morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-snowing.mp3" title="🔊 It is snowing in winter"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-hot.mp3" title="🔊 It is hot in summer"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/it-is-cold.mp3" title="🔊 It is cold today"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/what-weather-like.mp3" title="🔊 What is the weather like today?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/sunny-and-hot.mp3" title="🔊 It is sunny and hot"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/prefer-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer sunny weather"></audio>

---

## 4. Today vs yesterday

![Today vs yesterday A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/a1-unit44-today-yesterday.png)

| Tiempo | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Hoy | It **is**… | Today it is sunny and hot. |
| Ayer | It **was**… | Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. |
| Acción ayer | It **was raining** | It was raining in the afternoon. |

### Tip

*Is* = ahora / hoy. *Was* = ayer. Misma estructura: *It + is/was + adjetivo* o *It + is/was + raining/snowing*.

---

## 5. Preguntas y respuestas

> **What is the weather like today?**  
> **It is sunny and hot.**

> **Was it rainy yesterday?**  
> **Yes — it was cloudy and it was raining.**

> **Do you prefer sunny weather?**  
> **Yes, I do. I can go outside.**

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/was-cloudy-rainy.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/had-umbrella.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, I had an umbrella"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/me-too.mp3" title="🔊 Me too"></audio>

### Tabla de preguntas

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| What is the weather like today? | It is sunny. / It is cold. |
| Is it raining? | Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. |
| Was it cloudy yesterday? | Yes, it was. |
| Do you prefer hot weather? | Yes, I do. / No, I don't. |

---

## 6. Reading modelo: el tiempo

> **Today it is sunny and hot.** I like this weather. Yesterday it **was cloudy and rainy**. It **was raining** in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it **is snowing**. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-today-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 Today it is sunny and hot"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-yesterday.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-winter.mp3" title="🔊 In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-summer.mp3" title="🔊 In summer it is hot and sunny"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/reading-prefer.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside"></audio>

### Comprueba

1. ¿Cómo está el tiempo hoy? → **Sunny and hot**.  
2. ¿Y ayer? → **Cloudy and rainy**.  
3. ¿Qué pasaba por la tarde? → **It was raining**.  
4. ¿Invierno? → **Cold / sometimes snowing**.  
5. ¿Verano? → **Hot and sunny**.  
6. ¿Qué prefiere? → **Sunny weather**.

---

## 7. Diálogo modelo

> **A:** What is the weather like today?  
> **B:** It is sunny and hot.  
> **A:** Great. Yesterday it was cloudy and it was raining.  
> **B:** Yes, I had an umbrella. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing.  
> **A:** I prefer sunny weather.  
> **B:** Me too.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-what-weather.mp3" title="🔊 What is the weather like today?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-sunny-hot.mp3" title="🔊 It is sunny and hot"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-yesterday-raining.mp3" title="🔊 Yesterday it was cloudy and it was raining"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-44/dialogue-prefer-sunny.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer sunny weather"></audio>

---

## 8. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *It **are** sunny* | *It **is** sunny* | sujeto *It* |
| *It is **sun*** | *It is **sunny*** | adjetivo |
| *It is **rain*** | *It is **rainy*** / *It is **raining*** | adjetivo o *-ing* |
| *The day is sunny* (menos A1) | *It is sunny* | fórmula estándar |
| *Yesterday it **is** rainy* | *Yesterday it **was** rainy* | pasado |
| *What weather is today?* | *What **is the weather like** today?* | pregunta fija |

---

## 9. Pronunciación útil

| Palabra / frase | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **sunny** | *SA-ni*. |
| **rainy** | *REI-ni*. |
| **cloudy** | *CLAU-di*. |
| **snowy** | *SNOU-i*. |
| **raining** | *REI-ning*. |
| **weather** | *WE-dher*. |
| **What is the weather like?** | une: *wots-dha-WE-dher-laik*. |

Practica: *sunny → rainy → cloudy → snowy → hot → cold*.

---

## 10. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** What is the weather like today?  
> **B:** It is sunny. And yesterday?  
> **A:** It was rainy.

> **A:** Is it raining?  
> **B:** Yes, it is. Take an umbrella.  
> **A:** Thanks — it's cold too.

> **A:** Do you prefer hot weather?  
> **B:** I prefer sunny weather. I can go outside.

Cambia solo el adjetivo: fijas ***It is… / It was…***.

---

## 10b. Plantillas para copiar

1. It is \_\_\_\_ today.  
2. It is \_\_\_\_ now. (raining / snowing)  
3. Yesterday it was \_\_\_\_.  
4. What is the weather like today?  
5. In winter it is \_\_\_\_.  
6. I prefer \_\_\_\_ weather.

### Más frases para memorizar

> It is sunny today.  
> It is raining now.  
> It is cloudy this morning.  
> It is snowing in winter.  
> It is hot in summer.  
> It is cold today.  
> What is the weather like today?  
> It is sunny and hot.  
> Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy.  
> It was raining in the afternoon.  
> In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing.  
> In summer it is hot and sunny.  
> I prefer sunny weather.  
> I like this weather.  
> I can go outside.  
> I had an umbrella.  
> Me too.  
> Is it raining?  
> Yes, it is.  
> No, it isn't — it is sunny.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego describe **hoy** y **ayer** en 6 frases.

### Rutina de 2 minutos

1. Di 4 adjetivos con *It is…*.  
2. Di *It is raining* y *It is snowing*.  
3. Contrasta *Today it is…* / *Yesterday it was…*.  
4. Pregunta *What is the weather like today?*

### Combinar U43 + U44

| Unidad | Aporta | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| U43 | viaje | I arrive in London at ten. |
| **U44** | tiempo | It is sunny in London today. |

### Mini-historia para reescribir

> Today it is sunny and hot. I like this weather. Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. It was raining in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

Cambia estaciones y adjetivos; mantén *It is / It was*.

### Tour guiado (modelo)

> Today it is sunny and hot. I like this weather. Yesterday it was cloudy and rainy. It was raining in the afternoon. In winter it is cold and sometimes it is snowing. In summer it is hot and sunny. I prefer sunny weather because I can go outside.

Grábate leyéndolo. Luego improvisa con el tiempo **real** de tu ciudad.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> What is the weather like today?  
> It is sunny.  
> It is cold.  
> It is raining.  
> Yesterday it was cloudy.  
> I prefer sunny weather.  
> Take an umbrella.

Personaliza con el tiempo de hoy.

### Checklist mental

- *It is + adjective*  
- *It is raining / snowing*  
- Pregunta: *What is the weather like…?*  
- Hoy *is* · ayer *was*  
- Vocab: sunny · rainy · cloudy · snowy · hot · cold

### Mapa rápido

| Unidad | Enfoque |
| :--- | :--- |
| U43 | Travel Verbs — schedules |
| **U44** | The Weather — It is… |
| U45 | Seasons — *in* + season |

---

## 11. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa *is / was*

1. Today it \_\_\_\_ sunny.  
2. Yesterday it \_\_\_\_ rainy.  
3. It \_\_\_\_ raining now.  
4. Yesterday it \_\_\_\_ raining in the afternoon.  
5. In summer it \_\_\_\_ hot.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **was**  
3. **is**  
4. **was**  
5. **is**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige el adjetivo

1. the sun is shining → \_\_\_\_  
2. clouds in the sky → \_\_\_\_  
3. wet weather / rain → \_\_\_\_  
4. very low temperature → \_\_\_\_  
5. very high temperature → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **sunny**  
2. **cloudy**  
3. **rainy**  
4. **cold**  
5. **hot**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce

1. Hoy hace sol.  
2. Está lloviendo ahora.  
3. Ayer estaba nublado.  
4. ¿Qué tiempo hace hoy?  
5. Prefiero el tiempo soleado.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is sunny today.** / **Today it is sunny.**  
2. **It is raining now.**  
3. **Yesterday it was cloudy.**  
4. **What is the weather like today?**  
5. **I prefer sunny weather.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Ordena

1. sunny / is / It / today  
2. raining / is / It / now  
3. weather / the / What / like / is  
4. prefer / sunny / I / weather

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is sunny today.**  
2. **It is raining now.**  
3. **What is the weather like?**  
4. **I prefer sunny weather.**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Reading corto

Lee el texto de la sección 6. Contesta:

1. What is the weather like today?  
2. What was the weather like yesterday?  
3. What was happening in the afternoon?  
4. What is winter like?  
5. Why does the writer prefer sunny weather?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Sunny and hot**  
2. **Cloudy and rainy**  
3. **It was raining**  
4. **Cold / sometimes snowing**  
5. **Because he/she can go outside**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige el error

1. It are sunny today.  
2. It is sun.  
3. Yesterday it is rainy.  
4. What weather like today?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **It is sunny today.**  
2. **It is sunny.**  
3. **Yesterday it was rainy.**  
4. **What is the weather like today?**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe sobre el tiempo

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- *It is…* (hoy) y *It was…* (ayer)  
- al menos 4 adjetivos (*sunny, rainy, cloudy, hot, cold…*)  
- *It is raining* o *It is snowing*  
- *What is the weather like…?*  
- *I prefer…*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 6.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. It \_\_\_\_ sunny today. (is / are / am)  
2. It is \_\_\_\_ now. (raining / rainying / rain)  
3. Yesterday it \_\_\_\_ cloudy. (was / is / were)  
4. What \_\_\_\_ the weather like? (is / are / does)  
5. I prefer \_\_\_\_ weather. (sunny / sun / sunning)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **raining**  
3. **was**  
4. **is**  
5. **sunny**
</details>

---

## 12. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di los 6 adjetivos con *It is…*.  
2. **3 min** — Practica *raining / snowing* y *was*.  
3. **4 min** — Reescribe el reading con tu ciudad.  
4. **5 min** — Mini-entrevista *What is the weather like…?*

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *It is + adjective*  
- [ ] Distingo *rainy* e *It is raining*  
- [ ] Contraste *is* (hoy) / *was* (ayer)  
- [ ] Pregunto *What is the weather like…?*  
- [ ] Digo qué tiempo prefiero

---

## 13. Consejos para practicar

1. **Cada mañana:** una frase *Today it is…* mirando por la ventana.  
2. **Pareja:** pregunta el tiempo de hoy y de ayer.  
3. **Combina** U43: *I arrive in London at ten. It is cold and rainy.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 45](/curso-a1/unit-45): *Seasons* (*in spring / summer / autumn / winter*).  
5. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 44](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-44-tiempo-atmosferico-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 44 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-44).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Forma | It is + adjective |
| Ahora | It is raining / snowing |
| Ayer | It was… |
| Pregunta | What is the weather like…? |
| Vocab | sunny · rainy · cloudy · snowy · hot · cold |
| Tip | adjetivo (*sunny*), no *sun* |

---

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 45 — Seasons (in spring…)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-45-estaciones-in-spring)
- [Unidad 45 — Seasons](/curso-a1/unit-45)

Antes de pasar de unidad, escribe un párrafo de 6–8 frases sobre el tiempo de hoy, ayer y tu estación favorita.

Guías relacionadas:
