faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 57 del curso A1 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 56](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-56-restaurante-pedidos) pediste en el restaurante. En la **Unidad 57 del curso A1** (*Cooking & Recipes*) cocinas tú: ***First, Then, Finally*** + ***cut, mix, fry, boil, bake***.

Conecta con secuenciadores de rutina de la [Unidad 13](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-13-rutina-diaria). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 57 — Cooking & Recipes](/curso-a1/unit-57)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 56 — Restaurante](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-56-restaurante-pedidos) · [Unidad 17 — Comidas](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-17-comidas-breakfast-lunch-dinner)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 57 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Ordenar pasos con ***First / Then / Finally***.
- Dar instrucciones con **imperativo**: *Cut… Mix… Boil…*
- Usar verbos: ***cut, mix, fry, boil, bake***.
- Nombrar ***recipe, ingredients, pan, pot, oven***.
- Entender y contar una **receta simple** (pasta, huevos revueltos…).

---

## 1. *First, Then, Finally*

| Secuenciador | Significado | Uso |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **First** | primero | primer paso |
| **Then** | luego / después | pasos siguientes |
| **Finally** | finalmente | último paso |

> **First** cut the vegetables.  
> **Then** mix the ingredients.  
> **Finally** bake for twenty minutes.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/first-cut.mp3" title="🔊 First cut the vegetables"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/then-mix.mp3" title="🔊 Then mix the ingredients"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/finally-bake.mp3" title="🔊 Finally bake for twenty minutes"></audio>

Orden correcto típico: **First → Then → Finally** (puedes repetir *Then* si hay más pasos intermedios).

![First Then Finally A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/a1-unit57-first-then-finally.png)

---

## 2. Imperativos en recetas

En instrucciones usamos el **verbo base** (sin *to*, sin sujeto):

| Correcto | Incorrecto típico |
| :--- | :--- |
| Cut the onions. | *You cut the onions.* (menos típico en receta) |
| Mix well. | *To mix well.* |
| Boil the water. | *Boiling the water.* |

> First boil the water.  
> Then fry the onion.  
> Finally add the salt.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/first-boil.mp3" title="🔊 First boil the water"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/then-fry.mp3" title="🔊 Then fry the onion"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/finally-add-salt.mp3" title="🔊 Finally add the salt"></audio>

---

## 3. Verbos de cocina: *cut, mix, fry, boil, bake*

| Verbo | Significado | Contexto |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **cut** | cortar | with a knife |
| **mix** | mezclar | combine ingredients |
| **fry** | freír | oil + pan |
| **boil** | hervir | hot water + pot |
| **bake** | hornear | oven (bread, cake) |

> First cut the onions with a knife.  
> Then mix the eggs and flour.  
> To make pasta you boil the water.  
> For bread or cake you bake.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/cut-onions.mp3" title="🔊 First cut the onions with a knife"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/mix-eggs-flour.mp3" title="🔊 Then mix the eggs and flour"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/boil-water-pasta.mp3" title="🔊 To make pasta you boil the water"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/bake-bread.mp3" title="🔊 For bread or cake you bake"></audio>

![Cooking verbs A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/a1-unit57-cooking-verbs.png)

---

## 4. Vocabulario de cocina

| Palabra | Significado |
| :--- | :--- |
| **recipe** | receta |
| **ingredients** | ingredientes |
| **pan** | sartén (para *fry*) |
| **pot** | olla (para *boil*) |
| **oven** | horno (para *bake*) |
| **bowl** | bol |
| **oil / butter / salt** | aceite / mantequilla / sal |
| **serve** | servir |

> A recipe is a list of steps.  
> Ingredients are what you need.  
> Fry in a pan. Boil in a pot. Bake in the oven.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/recipe-steps.mp3" title="🔊 A recipe is a list of steps"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/fry-pan-boil-pot.mp3" title="🔊 Fry in a pan. Boil in a pot. Bake in the oven"></audio>

---

## 5. Receta modelo 1: pasta simple

![Recipe card A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/a1-unit57-recipe-card.png)

> Simple pasta recipe. First boil water in a pot. Then add salt and the pasta. Cook for ten minutes. Cut the tomatoes and the basil. Mix them with oil. Finally add the pasta to the sauce and serve. Easy and delicious.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/reading-pasta.mp3" title="🔊 Simple pasta recipe…"></audio>

Marca: *First boil → Then add → Cut → Mix → Finally add… and serve*.

---

## 6. Receta modelo 2: huevos revueltos (listening)

> How to make scrambled eggs. First break the eggs into a bowl. Then add a little milk and salt. Mix well. Then put butter in a pan and fry the mixture for two minutes. Finally serve on a plate with toast. Enjoy.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/dialogue-eggs.mp3" title="🔊 How to make scrambled eggs…"></audio>

Aquí ves *Then* dos veces: es natural cuando hay varios pasos medios.

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Finally cut, First bake | **First** cut… **Finally** bake | orden lógico |
| Then first mix | **First** mix / **Then** mix | no combines mal |
| To cut the vegetables. | **Cut** the vegetables. | imperativo en receta |
| Bake in a pan (pan) | **Fry** in a pan / **Bake** in the oven | herramienta distinta |
| Boil in the oven | **Bake** in the oven / **Boil** in a pot | verbo + lugar |

---

## 8. Mini prácticas orales

1. Di 3 pasos de una receta con *First / Then / Finally*.  
2. Usa al menos 3 verbos: *cut, mix, fry, boil, bake*.  
3. Nombra *pan / pot / oven* según el verbo.  
4. Cuenta cómo haces un plato fácil (tostada, pasta, huevos…).

> First cut the vegetables.  
> Then mix the ingredients.  
> Finally bake for twenty minutes.  
> First boil water. Then cook the pasta.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/practice-sequence.mp3" title="🔊 First cut… Then mix… Finally bake…"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-57/practice-pasta.mp3" title="🔊 First boil water. Then cook the pasta"></audio>

---

## 9. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *First / Then / Finally*

1. ____ cut the vegetables.  
2. First cut. ____ mix the ingredients.  
3. Then fry the onion. ____ add the salt.  
4. ____ boil the water.  
5. First mix. ____ bake for twenty minutes.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **First** · 2. **Then** · 3. **Finally** · 4. **First** · 5. **Then**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Verbos de cocina

1. Use a knife → \_\_\_\_  
2. Combine ingredients → \_\_\_\_  
3. Cook in hot oil in a pan → \_\_\_\_  
4. Cook in very hot water → \_\_\_\_  
5. Cook in the oven → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **cut** · 2. **mix** · 3. **fry** · 4. **boil** · 5. **bake**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa

1. First \_\_\_\_ the onions with a knife.  
2. Then \_\_\_\_ the eggs and flour.  
3. To make pasta you \_\_\_\_ the water.  
4. For bread you \_\_\_\_ in the oven.  
5. Finally \_\_\_\_ for twenty minutes.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **cut** · 2. **mix** · 3. **boil** · 4. **bake** · 5. **bake**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Empareja

1. pan  
2. pot  
3. oven  
4. recipe  
5. ingredients  
6. First  

a) olla · b) horno · c) sartén · d) primer paso · e) lista de pasos · f) lo que necesitas

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **b** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **f** · 6 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *Finally cut the vegetables. First bake.* (ordena bien)  
2. *To mix the eggs.* (imperativo)  
3. *Bake the onion in a pan.* (verbo)  
4. *Boil the cake in the oven.*  
5. *Then first add salt.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **First** cut the vegetables. **Finally** bake.  
2. **Mix** the eggs.  
3. **Fry** the onion in a pan.  
4. **Bake** the cake in the oven.  
5. **Then** add salt. / **First** add salt.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa la receta de pasta

____ boil water in a pot. ____ add salt and the pasta. Cook for ten minutes. ____ the tomatoes and the basil. ____ them with oil. ____ add the pasta to the sauce and serve.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**First** · **Then** · **Cut** · **Mix** · **Finally**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa los huevos revueltos

How to make scrambled eggs. First \_\_\_\_ the eggs into a bowl. Then add a little milk and salt. \_\_\_\_ well. Then put butter in a \_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_ the mixture for two minutes. Finally \_\_\_\_ on a plate with toast.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**break** · **Mix** · **pan** · **fry** · **serve**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la correcta

1. First means ____  
   a) last step · b) step one · c) never  
2. You fry with ____  
   a) oven · b) oil and pan · c) only water  
3. Correct order: ____  
   a) Finally, Then, First · b) First, Then, Finally · c) Then, First, Finally  
4. Bake = ____  
   a) cook in oven · b) cut · c) mix

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **b** · 3. **b** · 4. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Primero corta las verduras.  
2. Luego mezcla los ingredientes.  
3. Finalmente hornea durante veinte minutos.  
4. Primero hierve el agua.  
5. Luego fríe la cebolla.  
6. Añade sal.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. First cut the vegetables.  
2. Then mix the ingredients.  
3. Finally bake for twenty minutes.  
4. First boil the water.  
5. Then fry the onion.  
6. Add the salt. / Finally add the salt.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu receta

Escribe una receta de 6–10 frases. Incluye:

- *First / Then / Finally* (al menos una vez cada uno)  
- 3 verbos de *cut, mix, fry, boil, bake*  
- *ingredients* o 2 ingredientes concretos  
- *pan* o *pot* o *oven*  
- *serve* al final (opcional)

**Modelos:** pasta (sección 5) o huevos revueltos (sección 6).

---

## 10. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa secuenciadores y la tabla de verbos.  
2. **8 min** — Haz los ejercicios 1–5.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha las dos recetas y repite en voz alta.  
4. **5–8 min** — Escribe y lee tu receta personal.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *First / Then / Finally* en orden  
- [ ] Doy instrucciones con imperativo  
- [ ] Distingo *fry / boil / bake*  
- [ ] Uso *cut* y *mix*  
- [ ] Relaciono *pan / pot / oven* con el verbo

---

## 11. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Empieza siempre con ***First*** y cierra con ***Finally***.  
2. Un verbo = una acción clara (*Cut the tomatoes*).  
3. Practica recetas reales de 4–6 pasos.  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 57](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-57-cocina-recetas-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 57 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-57).

La **Unidad 58** cambia de tema: **Health & Illness** (*should / shouldn't*, *headache, fever, cold*).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Secuencia | First · Then · Finally |
| Forma | imperativo (verbo base) |
| Verbos | cut · mix · fry · boil · bake |
| Herramientas | pan · pot · oven · knife · bowl |
| Texto | recipe · ingredients · serve |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 58** estudiarás **Health & Illness**: *should / shouldn't*, síntomas y farmacia.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 58 — Health & Illness](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should)
- [Unidad 58 — Health & Illness](/curso-a1/unit-58)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 57 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-57-cocina-recetas-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 57 — Cooking & Recipes](/curso-a1/unit-57)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés en la cocina](/blog/viajes/ingles-en-la-cocina)
- [Inglés en restaurantes y bares](/blog/viajes/ingles-restaurantes-bares-viaje)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Food and cooking: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary
- British Council — Sequencing words: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar

title: Health & Illness A1: should / shouldn't y síntomas
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 58 del curso A1: should / shouldn't para consejos de salud, con síntomas, farmacia, audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende a dar consejos de salud en inglés A1 con should / shouldn't, headache, fever, cold, medicine y pharmacy. Guía Unidad 58 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Esquema should y shouldn't para consejos de salud A1

faqs.question: ¿Cuándo uso should y shouldn't en A1?
faqs.answer: Should = consejo o recomendación (You should rest). Shouldn't = consejo negativo (You shouldn't go to work if you are ill). Ambos + verbo base.

faqs.question: ¿Should lleva to?
faqs.answer: No. Should + verbo base: You should see a doctor. No digas *should to see*.

faqs.question: ¿Qué vocabulario de salud practico?
faqs.answer: Headache, fever, cold, medicine, pharmacy, doctor, rest, pill, ill/sick.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo «tengo dolor de cabeza»?
faqs.answer: I have a headache. También: I have a fever / I have a cold / I feel ill.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 58 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 58 del curso A1 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 57](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-57-cocina-recetas) cocinaste. En la **Unidad 58 del curso A1** (*Health & Illness*) das consejos: ***should / shouldn't*** + ***headache, fever, cold, medicine, pharmacy***.

Conecta con *should* del aeropuerto en la [Unidad 41](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 58 — Health & Illness](/curso-a1/unit-58)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 57 — Cocina](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-57-cocina-recetas) · [Unidad 41 — must/should](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-41-aeropuerto-must-should)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 58 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Dar consejos con ***should + verbo base***.
- Dar consejos negativos con ***shouldn't***.
- Nombrar síntomas: ***headache, fever, cold***.
- Hablar de ***medicine, pharmacy, doctor, rest***.
- Decir qué hacer (y qué no) cuando estás ***ill / sick***.

---

## 1. *Should / shouldn't* + verbo base

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **should** | consejo | You **should** see a doctor. |
| **shouldn't** | consejo negativo | You **shouldn't** go to work. |
| should + **base verb** | sin *to* | You should **rest**. |

> You should see a doctor if you have a fever.  
> You should take medicine for a headache.  
> You should drink a lot of water when you have a cold.  
> You shouldn't go to work if you are very ill.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/should-see-doctor.mp3" title="🔊 You should see a doctor if you have a fever"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/should-take-medicine.mp3" title="🔊 You should take medicine for a headache"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/should-drink-water.mp3" title="🔊 You should drink a lot of water when you have a cold"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/shouldnt-go-work.mp3" title="🔊 You shouldn't go to work if you are very ill"></audio>

![should shouldn't A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/a1-unit58-should-shouldnt.png)

*Should* = consejo (no es tan fuerte como *must*). Misma forma para *I/you/he/she/we/they*.

---

## 2. Vocabulario: síntomas y lugares

| Palabra | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **headache** | dolor de cabeza | I have a headache. |
| **fever** | fiebre | I have a slight fever. |
| **cold** | resfriado | I think I have a cold. |
| **medicine** | medicina | Take some medicine. |
| **pharmacy** | farmacia | Go to the pharmacy. |
| **doctor** | médico/a | See a doctor. |
| **rest** | descansar | You should rest. |
| **ill / sick** | enfermo/a | I feel ill today. |
| **pill** | pastilla | Take a pill. |

> I have a headache — my head hurts.  
> You need medicine from the pharmacy.  
> When you have a cold you should rest and drink water.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/have-headache.mp3" title="🔊 I have a headache — my head hurts"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/medicine-pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 You need medicine from the pharmacy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/cold-rest-water.mp3" title="🔊 When you have a cold you should rest and drink water"></audio>

![Health vocabulary A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/a1-unit58-health-vocab.png)

---

## 3. Consejos típicos por síntoma

| Situación | Consejo |
| :--- | :--- |
| headache | You should take medicine or rest. |
| fever | You should see a doctor. / You should rest. |
| cold | You should drink water and rest. |
| very ill | You shouldn't go to work. |
| fever gets worse | You should see a doctor. |

> He should go to the pharmacy for medicine.  
> Go to the pharmacy for medicine.  
> You shouldn't go to work when you are ill.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/go-pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 He should go to the pharmacy for medicine"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/go-to-pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 Go to the pharmacy for medicine"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/shouldnt-when-ill.mp3" title="🔊 You shouldn't go to work when you are ill"></audio>

---

## 4. Texto modelo: me siento mal

![At the pharmacy A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/a1-unit58-pharmacy.png)

> I feel ill today. I have a headache and a slight fever. I think I have a cold. I should rest at home and drink a lot of water. I should take some medicine from the pharmacy. I shouldn't go to work today. If the fever gets worse I should see a doctor.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/reading-ill.mp3" title="🔊 I feel ill today…"></audio>

Marca: síntomas (*headache, fever, cold*) + *should* / *shouldn't*.

---

## 5. Diálogo de listening

> **A:** I have a bad headache.  
> **B:** You should take some medicine.  
> **A:** Where can I get it?  
> **B:** At the pharmacy. Or if you have a fever you should see a doctor.  
> **A:** I don't have a fever. Just a headache.  
> **B:** Then you should rest and drink water. You shouldn't work on the computer all day.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/dialogue-full.mp3" title="🔊 I have a bad headache…"></audio>

---

## 6. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| You should to rest. | You should **rest**. | sin *to* |
| He shoulds see a doctor. | He **should** see… | sin *-s* |
| You shouldn't to go. | You shouldn't **go**. | verbo base |
| I have headache. | I have **a** headache. | artículo *a* |
| I have fever. | I have **a** fever. | artículo *a* |
| Go to pharmacy. | Go to **the** pharmacy. | *the* + pharmacy |

---

## 7. Mini prácticas orales

1. Di 3 síntomas que conoces.  
2. Da 3 consejos con *should*.  
3. Da 2 con *shouldn't*.  
4. Pregunta/responde: *Where can I get medicine?*

> I have a bad headache.  
> You should take some medicine.  
> You should rest and drink water.  
> You shouldn't work on the computer all day.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/bad-headache.mp3" title="🔊 I have a bad headache"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/take-some-medicine.mp3" title="🔊 You should take some medicine"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-58/shouldnt-computer.mp3" title="🔊 You shouldn't work on the computer all day"></audio>

---

## 8. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *should* / *shouldn't*

1. You \_\_\_\_ see a doctor if you have a fever.  
2. You \_\_\_\_ take medicine for a headache.  
3. You \_\_\_\_ go to work if you are very ill.  
4. He \_\_\_\_ go to the pharmacy for medicine.  
5. You \_\_\_\_ drink a lot of water when you have a cold.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **should** · 2. **should** · 3. **shouldn't** · 4. **should** · 5. **should**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Vocabulario

1. Pain in your head = \_\_\_\_  
2. High body temperature = \_\_\_\_  
3. Illness with cough / runny nose = \_\_\_\_  
4. Place to buy medicine = \_\_\_\_  
5. Something you take when ill = \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **headache** · 2. **fever** · 3. **cold** · 4. **pharmacy** · 5. **medicine**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa

1. I have \_\_\_\_ headache.  
2. You should \_\_\_\_ at home. (descansar)  
3. Go to \_\_\_\_ pharmacy for medicine.  
4. You shouldn't \_\_\_\_ to work when you are ill.  
5. If the fever gets worse I should see a \_\_\_\_.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **rest** · 3. **the** · 4. **go** · 5. **doctor**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Empareja

1. should  
2. shouldn't  
3. pharmacy  
4. headache  
5. fever  
6. cold  

a) consejo negativo · b) farmacia · c) consejo · d) resfriado · e) dolor de cabeza · f) fiebre

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **b** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **f** · 6 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *You should to rest.*  
2. *He shoulds see a doctor.*  
3. *I have headache.*  
4. *You shouldn't to go to work.*  
5. *Go to pharmacy.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. You should **rest**.  
2. He **should** see a doctor.  
3. I have **a** headache.  
4. You shouldn't **go** to work.  
5. Go to **the** pharmacy.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

A: I have a bad \_\_\_\_.  
B: You \_\_\_\_ take some medicine.  
A: Where can I get it?  
B: At the \_\_\_\_. Or if you have a \_\_\_\_ you should see a \_\_\_\_.  
A: I don't have a fever. Just a headache.  
B: Then you should \_\_\_\_ and drink water. You \_\_\_\_ work on the computer all day.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**headache** · **should** · **pharmacy** · **fever** · **doctor** · **rest** · **shouldn't**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el texto

I feel \_\_\_\_ today. I have a headache and a slight \_\_\_\_. I think I have a \_\_\_\_. I should \_\_\_\_ at home and drink a lot of water. I should take some \_\_\_\_ from the pharmacy. I \_\_\_\_ go to work today.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**ill** · **fever** · **cold** · **rest** · **medicine** · **shouldn't**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la correcta

1. After should we use ____  
   a) to + verb · b) base verb · c) -ing  
2. Shouldn't = ____  
   a) should not · b) must · c) can not  
3. Where do you buy medicine? ____  
   a) hospital only · b) pharmacy · c) restaurant  
4. For a headache you ____  
   a) should take medicine or rest · b) shouldn't drink water · c) must fly

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **b** · 2. **a** · 3. **b** · 4. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Deberías ver a un médico.  
2. No deberías ir a trabajar.  
3. Tengo dolor de cabeza.  
4. Deberías tomar medicina.  
5. Ve a la farmacia.  
6. Deberías descansar y beber agua.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. You should see a doctor.  
2. You shouldn't go to work.  
3. I have a headache.  
4. You should take medicine.  
5. Go to the pharmacy.  
6. You should rest and drink water.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu consejo

Escribe 8–10 frases. Incluye:

- 2 síntomas (*headache / fever / cold*)  
- 3 × *should*  
- 2 × *shouldn't*  
- *medicine* o *pharmacy*  
- *doctor* o *rest*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 4.

---

## 9. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa *should/shouldn't* y la tabla de síntomas.  
2. **8 min** — Haz los ejercicios 1–5.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha y repite el diálogo.  
4. **5–8 min** — Dale consejos a un amigo “enfermo” en voz alta.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *should* + verbo base  
- [ ] Uso *shouldn't* sin *to*  
- [ ] Nombró *headache, fever, cold*  
- [ ] Relaciono *medicine* con *pharmacy*  
- [ ] Doy 3 consejos de salud

---

## 10. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Recuerda: *should* ≠ *must* (consejo vs obligación fuerte).  
2. Practica *I have a…* con artículo *a*.  
3. Une síntoma + consejo en una frase.  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 58](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 58 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-58).

La **Unidad 59** habla de dinero: ***pay for / spend on***, *cash, credit card, change, receipt*.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Consejo | should + base verb |
| Negativo | shouldn't + base verb |
| Síntomas | headache · fever · cold |
| Ayuda | medicine · pharmacy · doctor · rest |
| Estado | ill / sick |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 59** estudiarás **Money & Currency**: *pay for*, *spend on*, *cash*, *credit card*, *change*, *receipt*.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 59 — Money & Currency](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-59-dinero-pay-for-spend-on)
- [Unidad 59 — Money & Currency](/curso-a1/unit-59)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 58 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 58 — Health & Illness](/curso-a1/unit-58)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Should / Would en inglés](/blog/gramatica/should-would-ingles)
- [Inglés para salud](/blog/trabajo/ingles-para-salud)
- [Vocabulario médico y enfermería](/blog/trabajo/vocabulario-ingles-medico-enfermeria)
- [Frases de emergencias en viajes](/blog/viajes/frases-ingles-emergencias-viajes)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Should / shouldn't: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar

title: Money en Inglés A1: Pay For, Spend On y Vocabulario
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 59 del curso A1: pay for, spend on, cash, credit card, change y receipt, con audios y ejercicios.
description: Aprende dinero en inglés A1: pay for, spend on, cash, credit card, change y receipt, con audio y ejercicios de la Unidad 59.
alt: Esquema pay for y spend on para dinero en inglés A1
keywords: Can I pay with credit card

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre pay for y spend on?
faqs.answer: Pay for = pagar por algo concreto (I paid for the dinner). Spend on = gastar dinero en una categoría (She spends money on clothes).

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es el pasado de pay y spend?
faqs.answer: Pay → paid. Spend → spent. Ejemplos: I paid for the book. We spent too much on food last month.

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa change en una tienda?
faqs.answer: Change = el dinero que te devuelven cuando pagas de más con efectivo. Here is your change — ten pounds.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pido el recibo?
faqs.answer: Can I have the receipt please? / Can I have a receipt please?

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 59 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 59 del curso A1 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
En la [Unidad 58](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should) diste consejos de salud. En la **Unidad 59 del curso A1** (*Money & Currency*) pagas y gastas: ***pay for / spend on*** + ***cash, credit card, change, receipt***.

Conecta con precios de la [Unidad 54](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-54-how-much-how-many). Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 59 — Money & Currency](/curso-a1/unit-59)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 58 — Salud](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should) · [Unidad 54 — How much/many](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-54-how-much-how-many)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 59 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Usar ***pay for*** + cosa (*pay for the dinner / the bill*).
- Usar ***spend on*** + cosa (*spend money on clothes / food*).
- Formar pasados: ***paid*** / ***spent***.
- Nombrar ***cash, credit card, change, receipt, currency***.
- Preguntar: ***Can I pay for this with credit card?***

---

## 1. *Pay for* vs *spend on*

| Expresión | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **pay for** + thing | pagar por algo concreto | I **paid for** the dinner with cash. |
| **spend** (money) **on** + thing | gastar en… | She **spends** a lot of money **on** clothes. |

> I paid for the dinner with cash.  
> Can I pay for this with credit card?  
> She spends a lot of money on clothes.  
> We spent too much on food last month.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/paid-for-dinner.mp3" title="🔊 I paid for the dinner with cash"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/pay-credit-card.mp3" title="🔊 Can I pay for this with credit card?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/spends-on-clothes.mp3" title="🔊 She spends a lot of money on clothes"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/spent-on-food.mp3" title="🔊 We spent too much on food last month"></audio>

![pay for spend on A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/a1-unit59-pay-spend.png)

### Preposiciones (no las mezcles)

| Correcto | Incorrecto típico |
| :--- | :--- |
| pay **for** the coffee | *pay on the coffee* |
| spend money **on** books | *spend money for books* |
| I paid **for** the bill | *I paid on the bill* |

---

## 2. Pasados irregulares: *paid* / *spent*

| Presente | Pasado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| pay | **paid** | I **paid** for the book yesterday. |
| spend | **spent** | We **spent** too much last month. |

> I paid for the bill yesterday.  
> She spends money on books.  
> I spent money on books.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/paid-for-bill.mp3" title="🔊 I paid for the bill yesterday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/spends-on-food.mp3" title="🔊 She spends a lot of money on food"></audio>

No digas *\*payed* ni *\*spended*.

---

## 3. Vocabulario: cash, card, change, receipt

| Palabra | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **cash** | efectivo | I paid with cash. |
| **credit card** | tarjeta de crédito | Do you take credit card? |
| **change** | cambio (vuelta) | Here is your change. |
| **receipt** | recibo | Can I have the receipt please? |
| **currency** | moneda (de un país) | pounds, euros, dollars |
| **bill** | cuenta | I paid for the bill. |
| **note** | billete | a twenty-pound note |

> I paid with cash — no credit card.  
> Can I have the receipt please?  
> Here is your change — five pounds back.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/paid-with-cash.mp3" title="🔊 I paid with cash — no credit card"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/receipt-please.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have the receipt please?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/your-change.mp3" title="🔊 Here is your change — five pounds back"></audio>

![Money vocabulary A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/a1-unit59-money-vocab.png)

---

## 4. En la caja: frases útiles

| Situación | Frase |
| :--- | :--- |
| Preguntar forma de pago | Can I pay for this with credit card? |
| Ofrecer opciones | Cash or card? |
| Preferir efectivo | I prefer to pay with cash. |
| Dar el cambio | Here is your change — ten pounds. |
| Pedir recibo | Can I have the receipt please? |
| Aceptar tarjeta | Yes, of course. / Do you take credit card? |

> That is twenty pounds please.  
> Can I pay for this with credit card?  
> I prefer to pay with cash. Here you are.  
> Here is your change — ten pounds — and your receipt.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/twenty-pounds.mp3" title="🔊 That is twenty pounds please"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/prefer-cash.mp3" title="🔊 I prefer to pay with cash"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/change-and-receipt.mp3" title="🔊 Here is your change and your receipt"></audio>

![Checkout dialogue A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/a1-unit59-checkout.png)

---

## 5. Texto modelo: de compras

> When I go shopping I usually take both cash and my credit card. Yesterday I bought a book for ten pounds. I paid for it with cash. The total was ten pounds so I gave a twenty-pound note. The shop assistant gave me my change — ten pounds back — and a receipt. I spend a lot of money on books every month.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/reading-shopping.mp3" title="🔊 When I go shopping…"></audio>

Marca: *paid for* / *spend on* / *cash* / *change* / *receipt*.

---

## 6. Diálogo de listening

> **Shop assistant:** That is twenty pounds please.  
> **Customer:** Can I pay for this with credit card?  
> **Shop assistant:** Yes of course.  
> **Customer:** I prefer to pay with cash. Here you are.  
> **Shop assistant:** You gave me thirty pounds. Here is your change — ten pounds — and your receipt.  
> **Customer:** Thank you.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/dialogue-full.mp3" title="🔊 That is twenty pounds please…"></audio>

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I paid on the coffee. | I paid **for** the coffee. | *pay for* |
| She spends money for books. | She spends money **on** books. | *spend on* |
| I payed for dinner. | I **paid** for dinner. | pasado irregular |
| We spended too much. | We **spent** too much. | pasado irregular |
| Can I to pay with card? | Can I **pay** with card? | *can* + base |
| Here is your receipt change. | Here is your **change** / your **receipt**. | son cosas distintas |

---

## 8. Mini prácticas orales

1. Di cómo pagaste algo ayer (*I paid for… with…*).  
2. Di en qué gastas dinero (*I spend money on…*).  
3. Representa la caja: *Cash or card?* / *Can I have the receipt?*  
4. Explica un cambio: *I gave twenty… Here is my change…*

> I paid for the dinner with cash.  
> Can I pay for this with credit card?  
> She spends a lot of money on food.  
> Can I have the receipt please?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/practice-paid.mp3" title="🔊 I paid for the dinner with cash"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-59/practice-receipt.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have the receipt please?"></audio>

---

## 9. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *for* / *on* / verbo

1. I paid \_\_\_\_ the dinner with cash.  
2. She spends a lot of money \_\_\_\_ clothes.  
3. Can I \_\_\_\_ for this with credit card?  
4. We \_\_\_\_ too much on food last month.  
5. I paid \_\_\_\_ the bill yesterday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **for** · 2. **on** · 3. **pay** · 4. **spent** · 5. **for**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Vocabulario

1. Coins and notes = \_\_\_\_  
2. Card to pay without cash = \_\_\_\_ \_\_\_\_  
3. Money you get back = \_\_\_\_  
4. Paper that shows what you paid = \_\_\_\_  
5. Money used in a country = \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **cash** · 2. **credit card** · 3. **change** · 4. **receipt** · 5. **currency**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa

1. I paid with \_\_\_\_ — no credit card.  
2. Can I have \_\_\_\_ receipt please?  
3. Here is your \_\_\_\_ — five pounds back.  
4. Past of pay = \_\_\_\_  
5. Past of spend = \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **cash** · 2. **the** / **a** · 3. **change** · 4. **paid** · 5. **spent**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Empareja

1. pay for  
2. spend on  
3. cash  
4. change  
5. receipt  
6. credit card  

a) efectivo · b) pagar por · c) tarjeta · d) gastar en · e) vuelta · f) recibo

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **d** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **f** · 6 → **c**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *I paid on the coffee.*  
2. *She spends money for books.*  
3. *I payed for dinner.*  
4. *We spended too much.*  
5. *Can I to pay with card?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I paid **for** the coffee.  
2. She spends money **on** books.  
3. I **paid** for dinner.  
4. We **spent** too much.  
5. Can I **pay** with card?
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Completa el diálogo

Assistant: That is twenty pounds please.  
Customer: Can I \_\_\_\_ for this with credit card?  
Assistant: Yes of course.  
Customer: I prefer to pay with \_\_\_\_. Here you are.  
Assistant: You gave me thirty pounds. Here is your \_\_\_\_ — ten pounds — and your \_\_\_\_.  
Customer: Thank you.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**pay** · **cash** · **change** · **receipt**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el texto

When I go shopping I usually take both \_\_\_\_ and my credit card. Yesterday I bought a book for ten pounds. I \_\_\_\_ for it with cash. I gave a twenty-pound note. The shop assistant gave me my \_\_\_\_ — ten pounds back — and a \_\_\_\_. I \_\_\_\_ a lot of money on books every month.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**cash** · **paid** · **change** · **receipt** · **spend**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la correcta

1. ____  
   a) I paid for the coffee · b) I paid on the coffee · c) I payed for the coffee  
2. ____  
   a) spend money for books · b) spend money on books · c) spend money at books  
3. Past of spend = ____  
   a) spend · b) spent · c) spended  
4. Money you get back = ____  
   a) receipt · b) change · c) currency

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **a** · 2. **b** · 3. **b** · 4. **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Pagué la cena en efectivo.  
2. ¿Puedo pagar esto con tarjeta de crédito?  
3. Ella gasta mucho dinero en ropa.  
4. Gastamos demasiado en comida el mes pasado.  
5. Aquí está tu cambio.  
6. ¿Puedo tener el recibo, por favor?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I paid for the dinner with cash.  
2. Can I pay for this with credit card?  
3. She spends a lot of money on clothes.  
4. We spent too much on food last month.  
5. Here is your change.  
6. Can I have the receipt please?
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu compra

Escribe 8–10 frases sobre una compra. Incluye:

- 2 × *pay for* (presente o pasado)  
- 2 × *spend/spends/spent on*  
- *cash* o *credit card*  
- *change*  
- *receipt*

**Modelo:** el texto de la sección 5.

---

## 10. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa *pay for / spend on* y *paid / spent*.  
2. **8 min** — Haz los ejercicios 1–5.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha y repite el diálogo de la caja.  
4. **5–8 min** — Representa una compra en voz alta.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *pay for* (no *pay on*)  
- [ ] Uso *spend on* (no *spend for*)  
- [ ] Recuerdo *paid* / *spent*  
- [ ] Distingo *cash / credit card / change / receipt*  
- [ ] Pido recibo y entiendo el cambio

---

## 11. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. Memoriza el par: ***pay for*** / ***spend on***.  
2. Practica números de dinero en voz alta (*twenty pounds*).  
3. En la caja, une: precio → pago → change → receipt.  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 59](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-59-dinero-pay-for-spend-on-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 59 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-59).

La **Unidad 60** es el **Module 6 Review**: contables, *some/any*, *much/many*, *too/enough*, *should* y recetas.

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pagar | pay for + thing |
| Gastar | spend (money) on + thing |
| Pasados | paid · spent |
| Pago | cash · credit card |
| Después de pagar | change · receipt |
| Moneda | pounds · euros · dollars |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 60** harás el **repaso del Módulo 6** (*Shopping & Food*): contables/incontables, *some/any*, *much/many*, *too/enough*, *should* y secuencia de recetas.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 60 — Repaso Módulo 6](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-60-repaso-modulo-6)
- [Unidad 60 — Module 6 Review](/curso-a1/unit-60)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 59 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-59-dinero-pay-for-spend-on-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 59 — Money & Currency](/curso-a1/unit-59)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés para compras](/blog/viajes/ingles-para-compras)
- [Inglés en mercados y regateo](/blog/viajes/ingles-mercados-regateo-viaje)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages

content:
En la [Unidad 59](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-59-dinero-pay-for-spend-on) pagaste y pediste el recibo. La **Unidad 60 del curso A1** (*Module 6 Review*) consolida todo el **Módulo 6: Shopping & Food**. No introduce gramática nueva: **repasa** las unidades 51–59 para que puedas comprar, cocinar, pedir en un restaurante, dar un consejo de salud y pagar en inglés A1.

Esta guía es un **mapa de repaso** con tablas, checklist, audios y ejercicios. Úsala para detectar huecos y volver a la [unidad concreta](/blog/curso-a1) si algo falla.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 60 — Module 6 Review](/curso-a1/unit-60)  
> **Guías del módulo:** [U51](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-51-supermercado-plurales) · [U52](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-52-contables-incontables) · [U53](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-53-some-any) · [U54](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-54-how-much-how-many) · [U55](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-55-tienda-ropa-too-enough) · [U56](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-56-restaurante-pedidos) · [U57](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-57-cocina-recetas) · [U58](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should) · [U59](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-59-dinero-pay-for-spend-on)

---

## Qué deberías poder hacer al terminar el Módulo 6

- Nombrar comida del **supermercado** y plurales frecuentes (*tomatoes, potatoes, fish*).
- Distinguir **contables** e **incontables** (*apples* vs *milk*).
- Usar ***some*** en afirmativas y ***any*** en negativas/preguntas.
- Preguntar cantidades y precios: ***How much…?*** / ***How many…?***.
- Hablar de talla y cantidad con ***too*** / ***enough***.
- Pedir en un **restaurante**: ***I would like…*** / ***Can I have…?***.
- Seguir una **receta** con ***First, Then, Finally***.
- Dar consejos de **salud** con ***should / shouldn't***.
- **Pagar**: ***pay for*** / ***spend on***, *cash, credit card, change, receipt*.

---

## Mapa rápido del Módulo 6 (U51–U59)

| U | Tema | Idea clave |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 51 | At the Supermarket | plurales · fruit · vegetables · aisle |
| 52 | Countable & Uncountable | apples vs milk · a lot of |
| 53 | Some & Any | **some** afirmativa · **any** negativa/pregunta |
| 54 | How Much & How Many | precios y cantidades |
| 55 | Clothing Store | **too** small · big **enough** |
| 56 | At the Restaurant | I would like… · the bill |
| 57 | Cooking & Recipes | **First, Then, Finally** · cut/mix/boil |
| 58 | Health & Illness | **should / shouldn't** · pharmacy |
| 59 | Money & Currency | **pay for** · **spend on** · receipt |

![Mapa Module 6 Review A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/a1-unit60-module-map.png)

---

## 1. Supermercado y plurales (U51)

Vocabulario: *fruit, vegetables, meat, fish, trolley, aisle, checkout*.

Plurales útiles del curso: *tomatoes, potatoes*; *fish* suele ser igual en plural (*two fish*).

> I need two tomatoes for the salad.  
> Where are the vegetables? — In aisle two.  
> Meat and fish are at the back.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/two-tomatoes.mp3" title="🔊 I need two tomatoes for the salad"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/where-vegetables.mp3" title="🔊 Where are the vegetables?"></audio>

Guía: [U51 — At the Supermarket](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-51-supermercado-plurales)

---

## 2. Contables e incontables (U52)

| Tipo | Ejemplo | Idea |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Countable** | apple, egg, tomato | tienen plural: *two apples* |
| **Uncountable** | milk, water, bread, rice | sin plural: *some milk* |

Con ambos puedes usar *a lot of*: *a lot of apples* / *a lot of milk*.

> Apples and eggs are countable.  
> Milk, water, bread and rice are uncountable.  
> I need some milk and two eggs.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/apples-countable.mp3" title="🔊 Apples and eggs are countable"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/milk-uncountable.mp3" title="🔊 Milk, water, bread and rice are uncountable"></audio>

Guía: [U52 — Countable & Uncountable](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-52-contables-incontables)

---

## 3. *Some* y *any* (U53)

| Forma | Cuándo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **some** | afirmativa | I bought **some** apples. |
| **any** | negativa | There isn't **any** milk. |
| **any** | pregunta | Do you have **any** bread? |

> We need some eggs for the cake.  
> There isn't any milk in the fridge.  
> I didn't buy any dessert.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/some-eggs.mp3" title="🔊 We need some eggs for the cake"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/any-milk.mp3" title="🔊 There isn't any milk in the fridge"></audio>

Guía: [U53 — Some & Any](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-53-some-any)

---

## 4. *How much* y *How many* (U54)

| Pregunta | Con | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **How much…?** | incontable / precio | How **much** water do you want? / How much is this? |
| **How many…?** | contable plural | How **many** apples do you need? |

> How much water do you want?  
> How many apples do you need?  
> I don't have much money this month.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/how-much-water.mp3" title="🔊 How much water do you want?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/how-many-apples.mp3" title="🔊 How many apples do you need?"></audio>

Guía: [U54 — How Much & How Many](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-54-how-much-how-many)

---

## 5. Tienda de ropa: *too* / *enough* (U55)

| Forma | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **too** + adj. | demasiado | This shirt is **too** small. |
| adj. + **enough** | lo bastante | This shirt is big **enough**. |

Recuerda: *too small* ≈ *not big enough*.

> This shirt is too small for me.  
> These shoes are big enough.  
> It is not cheap enough.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/too-small.mp3" title="🔊 This shirt is too small for me"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/big-enough.mp3" title="🔊 These shoes are big enough"></audio>

Guía: [U55 — Clothing Store](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-55-tienda-ropa-too-enough)

---

## 6. Restaurante: pedir y la cuenta (U56)

| Situación | Frase |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pedido educado | **I would like** the chicken please. |
| Petición | **Can I have** the soup please? |
| Platos | starter · main course · dessert |
| Pagar | Can I have **the bill** please? |

> I would like the chicken for main course please.  
> Can I have the bill please?  
> For starter I would like soup.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/would-like-chicken.mp3" title="🔊 I would like the chicken for main course please"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/the-bill.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have the bill please?"></audio>

Guía: [U56 — At the Restaurant](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-56-restaurante-pedidos)

---

## 7. Cocina y recetas: *First, Then, Finally* (U57)

Orden de pasos + imperativo (verbo base):

| Secuencia | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **First** | First boil the water. |
| **Then** | Then add the pasta. |
| **Finally** | Finally serve with sauce. |

Verbos: *cut, mix, fry, boil, bake*. Herramientas: *pan, pot, oven, knife, bowl*.

> First boil the water. Then add the pasta. Finally serve with sauce.  
> First cut the onions. Then mix the eggs and flour.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/first-boil.mp3" title="🔊 First boil the water"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/then-add-pasta.mp3" title="🔊 Then add the pasta"></audio>

Guía: [U57 — Cooking & Recipes](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-57-cocina-recetas)

---

## 8. Salud: *should / shouldn't* (U58)

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **should** + base | consejo | You **should** rest. |
| **shouldn't** + base | consejo negativo | You **shouldn't** go to work. |

Vocabulario: *headache, fever, cold, medicine, pharmacy, ill / sick*.

> You should rest when you are ill.  
> You should take some medicine.  
> You shouldn't go to work if you have a fever.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/should-rest.mp3" title="🔊 You should rest when you are ill"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/shouldnt-work.mp3" title="🔊 You shouldn't go to work if you have a fever"></audio>

Guía: [U58 — Health & Illness](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should)

---

## 9. Dinero: *pay for* / *spend on* (U59)

| Expresión | Idea | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **pay for** + thing | pagar por algo | I **paid for** dinner with cash. |
| **spend** (money) **on** | gastar en… | I **spend** money **on** food. |

Vocabulario: *cash, credit card, change, receipt, currency, bill*.

> I paid for the dinner with cash.  
> Can I pay for this with credit card?  
> Here is your change and your receipt.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/paid-for-dinner.mp3" title="🔊 I paid for the dinner with cash"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/change-receipt.mp3" title="🔊 Here is your change and your receipt"></audio>

Guía: [U59 — Money & Currency](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-59-dinero-pay-for-spend-on)

---

## 10. Grammar check del módulo

![Grammar check Module 6 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/a1-unit60-grammar-check.png)

| Estructura | Recuerda |
| :--- | :--- |
| countable / uncountable | plural vs sin plural |
| some / any | some afirmativa; any negativa/pregunta |
| much / many | much + incontable; many + contable |
| too / enough | too + adj.; adj. + enough |
| I would like… | pedido educado |
| First, Then, Finally | orden en recetas |
| should / shouldn't | consejo (+ verbo base) |
| pay for / spend on | pagar por / gastar en |

Errores típicos a evitar:

1. *\*I have any milk* (afirmativa) → **I have some milk**.  
2. *\*How many water?* → **How much water?**  
3. *\*This shirt is enough small* → **This shirt is too small** / **not big enough**.  
4. *\*You should to rest* → **You should rest**.  
5. *\*I paid on the coffee* → **I paid for the coffee**.  
6. *\*I spend money for books* → **I spend money on books**.

---

## 11. Un día de compras (todo junto)

Une el módulo en un solo relato —como hace el reading del curso:

> Last week I went to the supermarket and bought some apples, some milk and bread. I don't have much money this month so I didn't buy any dessert. On Saturday I cooked pasta. First I boiled the water. Then I added the pasta. Finally I served it with sauce. I feel a bit ill today — I have a headache. I should rest and take some medicine.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/shopping-day-story.mp3" title="🔊 Last week I went to the supermarket…"></audio>

![Shopping day Module 6 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/a1-unit60-shopping-day.png)

### Diálogo de repaso

> **A:** I would like the chicken for main course please.  
> **B:** Anything else?  
> **A:** Can I have the bill please? I paid for dinner with cash yesterday but today I only have credit card.  
> **B:** No problem. Here is your receipt.  
> **A:** I feel a bit ill — headache.  
> **B:** You should rest and take medicine.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/dialogue-review.mp3" title="🔊 I would like the chicken…"></audio>

---

## 12. Vocabulario esencial del módulo (checklist)

| Bloque | Palabras |
| :--- | :--- |
| Supermercado | trolley, aisle, checkout, fruit, vegetables, meat, fish |
| Cantidades | some, any, much, many, a lot of |
| Ropa | size, too small, big enough, changing room |
| Restaurante | menu, starter, main course, dessert, bill |
| Cocina | cut, mix, fry, boil, bake, pan, pot, oven |
| Salud | headache, fever, cold, medicine, pharmacy, ill |
| Dinero | cash, credit card, change, receipt, currency |

---

## 13. Mini diálogos por escenario

### Supermercado

> Where are the vegetables?  
> In aisle two. Get a trolley if you have many things.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/aisle-two.mp3" title="🔊 Where are the vegetables? In aisle two"></audio>

### Ropa

> This shirt is too small.  
> Do you have a bigger size?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/bigger-size.mp3" title="🔊 Do you have a bigger size?"></audio>

### Cocina

> First cut the vegetables.  
> Then mix the ingredients. Finally bake for twenty minutes.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/recipe-steps.mp3" title="🔊 First cut the vegetables…"></audio>

### Salud + dinero

> You should see a doctor if you have a fever.  
> I paid for the medicine with cash.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-60/medicine-cash.mp3" title="🔊 I paid for the medicine with cash"></audio>

---

## 14. Errores frecuentes del Módulo 6

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I have any apples | I have **some** apples | *some* en afirmativa |
| How many milk? | How **much** milk? | *milk* incontable |
| This is enough big | This is big **enough** | *adj. + enough* |
| You should to rest | You should **rest** | *should* + base |
| First you boiling water | First **boil** the water | imperativo |
| I paid on dinner | I paid **for** dinner | *pay for* |
| I spend money for food | I spend money **on** food | *spend on* |
| Can I to have the bill? | Can I **have** the bill? | *can* + base |

---

## 15. Ejercicios de repaso

### Ejercicio 1 — *some / any*

1. We need \_\_\_\_ eggs for the cake.  
2. There isn't \_\_\_\_ milk in the fridge.  
3. Do you have \_\_\_\_ bread?  
4. I didn't buy \_\_\_\_ dessert.  
5. I bought \_\_\_\_ apples yesterday.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **some** · 2. **any** · 3. **any** · 4. **any** · 5. **some**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *much / many* y contables

1. How \_\_\_\_ water do you want?  
2. How \_\_\_\_ apples do you need?  
3. I don't have \_\_\_\_ money this month.  
4. There are \_\_\_\_ tomatoes in the fridge. (*many / much*)  
5. Milk is \_\_\_\_. (*countable / uncountable*)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **much** · 2. **many** · 3. **much** · 4. **many** · 5. **uncountable**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *too / enough*

1. This shirt is \_\_\_\_ small for me.  
2. These shoes are big \_\_\_\_.  
3. It is not cheap \_\_\_\_.  
4. The coffee is \_\_\_\_ hot.  
5. Too small = not big \_\_\_\_.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **too** · 2. **enough** · 3. **enough** · 4. **too** · 5. **enough**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Restaurante y recetas

1. I \_\_\_\_ like the soup please.  
2. Can I have the \_\_\_\_ please? (cuenta)  
3. \_\_\_\_ boil the water.  
4. \_\_\_\_ add the pasta.  
5. \_\_\_\_ serve with sauce.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **would** · 2. **bill** · 3. **First** · 4. **Then** · 5. **Finally**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — *should* y dinero

1. You \_\_\_\_ rest when you are ill.  
2. You \_\_\_\_ go to work if you have a fever.  
3. I paid \_\_\_\_ dinner with cash.  
4. I spend money \_\_\_\_ food.  
5. Can I have the \_\_\_\_ please? (recibo)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **should** · 2. **shouldn't** · 3. **for** · 4. **on** · 5. **receipt**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *I have any milk.*  
2. *How many water do you want?*  
3. *You should to rest.*  
4. *I paid on the coffee.*  
5. *I spend money for books.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I have **some** milk.  
2. How **much** water do you want?  
3. You should **rest**.  
4. I paid **for** the coffee.  
5. I spend money **on** books.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Empareja unidad y tema

1. U52  
2. U53  
3. U54  
4. U55  
5. U57  
6. U58  
7. U59  

a) First, Then, Finally  
b) pay for / spend on  
c) countable / uncountable  
d) should / shouldn't  
e) some / any  
f) too / enough  
g) how much / how many

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **e** · 3 → **g** · 4 → **f** · 5 → **a** · 6 → **d** · 7 → **b**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Completa el texto

Last week I went to the supermarket and bought \_\_\_\_ apples, \_\_\_\_ milk and bread. I don't have \_\_\_\_ money this month so I didn't buy \_\_\_\_ dessert. On Saturday I cooked pasta. \_\_\_\_ I boiled the water. \_\_\_\_ I added the pasta. \_\_\_\_ I served it with sauce. I feel a bit ill — I have a headache. I \_\_\_\_ rest and take some medicine.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**some** · **some** · **much** · **any** · **First** · **Then** · **Finally** · **should**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Necesitamos algunos huevos.  
2. No hay leche en la nevera.  
3. ¿Cuánta agua quieres?  
4. Esta camisa es demasiado pequeña.  
5. Quisiera el pollo, por favor.  
6. Primero hierve el agua.  
7. Deberías descansar.  
8. Pagué la cena en efectivo.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. We need some eggs.  
2. There isn't any milk in the fridge.  
3. How much water do you want?  
4. This shirt is too small.  
5. I would like the chicken please.  
6. First boil the water.  
7. You should rest.  
8. I paid for the dinner with cash.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu repaso personal

Escribe 10–12 frases que incluyan:

- 2 × *some / any*  
- 1 × *how much* o *how many*  
- 1 × *too* o *enough*  
- 1 × *I would like…*  
- 1 × *First / Then / Finally*  
- 1 × *should / shouldn't*  
- 1 × *pay for* y 1 × *spend on*  
- *cash* o *credit card* + *receipt* o *change*

**Modelo:** el texto de “Last week I went to the supermarket…” (sección 11).

---

## 16. Plan de repaso (30–40 minutos)

1. **8 min** — Relee el mapa U51–U59 y marca 2 unidades débiles.  
2. **10 min** — Haz los ejercicios 1–6 de esta guía.  
3. **8 min** — Escucha y repite 10 audios de esta página (incluye la historia del día).  
4. **8–10 min** — Escribe tu párrafo personalizado y grábate.

### Checklist final

- [ ] Distingo contables e incontables  
- [ ] Uso *some/any* correctamente  
- [ ] Pregunto con *how much / how many*  
- [ ] Uso *too / enough* en ropa  
- [ ] Pido en restaurante y la cuenta  
- [ ] Sigo una receta con *First, Then, Finally*  
- [ ] Doy consejos con *should / shouldn't*  
- [ ] Pago con *pay for / spend on* y pido *receipt*

---

## 17. Consejos al cerrar el Módulo 6 (y el A1)

1. No memorices listas sueltas: **cuenta un día** (supermercado → cocina → restaurante → salud → pago).  
2. Si fallas en *some/any*, vuelve a [U53](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-53-some-any).  
3. Si fallas en *much/many*, vuelve a [U54](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-54-how-much-how-many).  
4. Si fallas en *too/enough*, vuelve a [U55](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-55-tienda-ropa-too-enough).  
5. Si fallas en recetas, vuelve a [U57](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-57-cocina-recetas).  
6. Si fallas en *should*, vuelve a [U58](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-58-salud-should).  
7. Si fallas en *pay for / spend on*, vuelve a [U59](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-59-dinero-pay-for-spend-on).  
8. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 60](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-60-repaso-modulo-6-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 60 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-60).

Con el Módulo 6 cierras el bloque de **compras y comida** del curso A1. Si dominas este repaso, puedes narrar situaciones cotidianas de compra, cocina, restaurante, salud y dinero con estructuras A1 sólidas.

title: Saludos e introducciones A2: presentarte con hometown, hobby y neighbourhood
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 1 del curso A2: presentarte con hometown, neighbourhood, hobby y favourite, repasando to be y Present Simple con audios y ejercicios.
description: Repasa saludos e introducciones en inglés A2: to be, Present Simple, hometown, neighbourhood, hobby y favourite. Guía Unidad 1 con audios y ejercicios.
alt: Fórmula de presentación extendida en inglés nivel A2
keywords: I live in a quiet neighbourhood

faqs.question: ¿En qué se diferencia la presentación A2 de la de A1?
faqs.answer: En A1 dices nombre, origen y profesión. En A2 añades detalle y fluidez: edad, hometown, neighbourhood, favourite hobby y una frase de cierre (Nice to meet you / I am happy to be here).

faqs.question: ¿Qué significa hometown y neighbourhood?
faqs.answer: Hometown = la ciudad donde naciste o creciste. Neighbourhood (también neighborhood) = el barrio o zona donde vives ahora.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo mi hobby favorito en inglés?
faqs.answer: My favourite hobby is + -ing / noun: My favourite hobby is reading books / playing football / swimming / cooking.

faqs.question: ¿Repaso to be y Present Simple en esta unidad?
faqs.answer: Sí. Consolidas I am / you are / he-she is y Present Simple (I live / she lives) dentro de presentaciones reales, no como lista aislada.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 1 del curso A2?
faqs.answer: En el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones y en la Unidad 1 del curso A2 de Linguafly: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening, speaking y writing.

content:
Si ya terminaste A1, no empiezas de cero: **amplías**. La **Unidad 1 del curso A2** (*Greetings & Introductions — repaso*) te pide presentarte en **1–2 minutos** con más detalle y fluidez: no solo *My name is…* y *I am from…*, sino también ***hometown***, ***neighbourhood***, ***hobby*** y ***favourite***.

Esta guía consolida el **verbo *to be*** y el **Present Simple** dentro de presentaciones reales (como Maria y Carlos en el curso), con **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 1 — Saludos e introducciones (repaso)](/curso-a2/unit-1)  
> **Puente desde A1:** [Unidad 1 A1 — Saludos y presentarse](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-1-saludos-presentarse) · [Inglés A1 vs A2](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1-vs-a2)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 1 (A2)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Presentarte en **1–2 minutos** con nombre, edad, origen, barrio, hobby y ocupación.
- Usar ***hometown***, ***neighbourhood***, ***hobby*** y ***favourite*** con naturalidad.
- Repasar ***to be*** (*I am / you are / he-she is*) en contexto.
- Usar **Present Simple** (*I live / she lives / I teach / he studies*).
- Cerrar con ***Nice to meet you!*** o ***I am happy to be here!***.

---

## 1. De A1 a A2: la presentación crece

| Nivel | Qué suele incluir |
| :--- | :--- |
| **A1** | Hello + name + from + job/student |
| **A2** | + age + **hometown** + **neighbourhood** + **favourite hobby** + cierre |

Fórmula A2 (orden útil):

1. Hello / Hi  
2. My name is…  
3. I am … years old.  
4. My hometown is… / I am from…  
5. I live in a … neighbourhood.  
6. My favourite hobby is…  
7. I am a student / teacher.  
8. Nice to meet you!

![Fórmula de presentación extendida A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/a2-unit1-intro-formula.png)

> My name is Ana. I am from Madrid.  
> Nice to meet you!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/my-name-is-ana.mp3" title="🔊 My name is Ana. I am from Madrid."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/nice-to-meet-you.mp3" title="🔊 Nice to meet you!"></audio>

---

## 2. Vocabulario clave: hometown, neighbourhood, hobby, favourite

| Palabra | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **hometown** | ciudad natal / donde creciste | My **hometown** is Madrid. |
| **neighbourhood** | barrio / zona | I live in a quiet **neighbourhood**. |
| **hobby** | pasatiempo | My favourite **hobby** is reading. |
| **favourite** | favorito/a | My **favourite** colour is blue. |

Ortografía: *neighbourhood* (BrE) / *neighborhood* (AmE); *favourite* / *favorite*. En el curso A2 verás la forma británica con frecuencia.

![Vocabulario hometown neighbourhood hobbies A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/a2-unit1-vocab-hometown.png)

### Hometown

> My hometown is Madrid.  
> My hometown is Barcelona.  
> Where is your hometown?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/hometown-madrid.mp3" title="🔊 My hometown is Madrid."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/where-hometown.mp3" title="🔊 Where is your hometown?"></audio>

### Neighbourhood

Describe **cómo** es tu barrio: *quiet, nice, near the beach, with many parks and cafes*.

> I live in a quiet neighbourhood with many parks and cafes.  
> I live in a nice neighbourhood near the beach.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/quiet-neighbourhood.mp3" title="🔊 I live in a quiet neighbourhood…"></audio>

### Hobby y favourite

| Hobby | Frase |
| :--- | :--- |
| reading | My favourite hobby is **reading books**. |
| swimming | My favourite hobby is **swimming**. |
| cooking | My favourite hobby is **cooking**. |
| football | My favourite hobby is **playing football**. |
| music | My favourite hobby is **music**. |

> My favourite hobby is reading books.  
> My favourite hobby is playing football.  
> What is your favourite hobby?  
> My favourite colour is blue.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/favourite-hobby-reading.mp3" title="🔊 My favourite hobby is reading books."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/playing-football.mp3" title="🔊 My favourite hobby is playing football."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/what-favourite-hobby.mp3" title="🔊 What is your favourite hobby?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/favourite-colour.mp3" title="🔊 My favourite colour is blue."></audio>

---

## 3. Gramática de repaso: *to be* + Present Simple

![Grammar review to be and Present Simple A2](/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/a2-unit1-grammar-review.png)

### *To be* (afirmativa)

| Sujeto | Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I | **am** | I **am** a teacher. |
| you | **are** | You **are** a student. |
| he / she / it | **is** | She **is** from Spain. |

Contracciones: *I'm*, *you're*, *he's / she's*.

Errores típicos: *\*You am* → **You are**; *\*I is* → **I am**.

> I am a teacher. I teach English at a small school.  
> I am happy to be here.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/i-am-a-teacher.mp3" title="🔊 I am a teacher…"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/i-am-happy.mp3" title="🔊 I am happy to be here."></audio>

### Present Simple en presentaciones

| Sujeto | Verbo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I / you / we / they | base | I **live** in Madrid. |
| he / she / it | base + **-s** | She **lives** in a small flat. |

Otros del curso: *I teach* / *he teaches*; *I study* / *she studies*; *I love walking*.

> She lives in a small flat.  
> He lives in London.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/she-lives-flat.mp3" title="🔊 She lives in a small flat."></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/he-lives-london.mp3" title="🔊 He lives in London."></audio>

---

## 4. Texto modelo: Maria

> Hello! My name is Maria. I am twenty-eight years old. My hometown is Madrid, Spain. I live in a quiet neighbourhood with many parks and cafes. My favourite hobby is reading books. I also love walking in my neighbourhood. I am a teacher. I teach English at a small school. Nice to meet you!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/reading-maria.mp3" title="🔊 Hello! My name is Maria…"></audio>

Marca: *hometown* · *neighbourhood* · *favourite hobby* · *I am a teacher* · *I teach* · *Nice to meet you*.

---

## 5. Diálogo / listening: Carlos

> Hi! My name is Carlos. I am from Barcelona, Spain. I am twenty-five years old. My hometown is Barcelona. I live in a nice neighbourhood near the beach. My favourite hobby is playing football. I am a student. I study at the university. I am happy to be here. Nice to meet you!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/dialogue-carlos.mp3" title="🔊 Hi! My name is Carlos…"></audio>

Compara con Maria: **teacher** vs **student**; **parks and cafes** vs **near the beach**; **reading** vs **playing football**.

---

## 6. Cortesía y cierre

| Frase | Uso |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Nice to meet you!** | primera vez que conoces a alguien |
| **I am happy to be here.** | presentación en clase, curso o foro |
| Hello! / Hi! | apertura (Hi más informal) |

No digas *Nice to meet you* cada vez que ves a un amigo: es para **conocer** a alguien.

---

## 7. Errores frecuentes

| Incorrecto | Correcto | Por qué |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| You am a student. | You **are** a student. | *you* + *are* |
| She live in Madrid. | She **lives** in Madrid. | *-s* en 3.ª persona |
| My hometown are Barcelona. | My hometown **is** Barcelona. | sujeto singular |
| I live in quiet neighbourhood. | I live in **a** quiet neighbourhood. | artículo *a* |
| My favourite hobby is play football. | … is **playing** football. | *hobby is* + *-ing* / noun |
| Nice to meet you (cada día) | Hello again / Hi | *Nice to meet you* = primera vez |

---

## 8. Mini prácticas orales

1. Di tu nombre, edad y *hometown*.  
2. Describe tu *neighbourhood* en una frase.  
3. Di tu *favourite hobby*.  
4. Di si eres *student* o tu trabajo (*I am a…*).  
5. Une todo en 6–8 frases y cierra con *Nice to meet you!*

> Hello! My name is Ana. I am twenty-two years old. My hometown is Valencia. I live in a quiet neighbourhood. My favourite hobby is swimming. I am a student. Nice to meet you!

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a2/unit-1/practice-intro.mp3" title="🔊 Hello! My name is Ana…"></audio>

---

## 9. Ejercicios

### Ejercicio 1 — *to be*

1. I \_\_\_\_ from Spain.  
2. You \_\_\_\_ a student.  
3. She \_\_\_\_ twenty-eight years old.  
4. My hometown \_\_\_\_ Madrid.  
5. I \_\_\_\_ happy to be here.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **am** · 2. **are** · 3. **is** · 4. **is** · 5. **am**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Present Simple (*live / lives*)

1. I \_\_\_\_ in a quiet neighbourhood.  
2. She \_\_\_\_ in a small flat.  
3. He \_\_\_\_ in London.  
4. They \_\_\_\_ near the beach.  
5. Maria \_\_\_\_ English at a small school. (*teach / teaches*)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **live** · 2. **lives** · 3. **lives** · 4. **live** · 5. **teaches**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Vocabulario

1. The place where you were born = \_\_\_\_  
2. The area around your home = \_\_\_\_  
3. A free-time activity = \_\_\_\_  
4. The one you like most = \_\_\_\_  
5. First-time greeting = Nice to \_\_\_\_ you!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **hometown** · 2. **neighbourhood** · 3. **hobby** · 4. **favourite** · 5. **meet**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Completa

1. My \_\_\_\_ hobby is reading books.  
2. I live in a quiet \_\_\_\_ with many parks.  
3. My \_\_\_\_ is Barcelona.  
4. I am a \_\_\_\_. I study at the university.  
5. I am \_\_\_\_ to be here.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **favourite** · 2. **neighbourhood** · 3. **hometown** · 4. **student** · 5. **happy**
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Empareja

1. hometown  
2. neighbourhood  
3. hobby  
4. favourite  
5. Nice to meet you  

a) pasatiempo · b) favorito · c) ciudad natal · d) primera vez · e) barrio

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **c** · 2 → **e** · 3 → **a** · 4 → **b** · 5 → **d**
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Corrige

1. *You am a teacher.*  
2. *She live near the beach.*  
3. *My hometown are Madrid.*  
4. *My favourite hobby is play football.*  
5. *I live in quiet neighbourhood.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. You **are** a teacher.  
2. She **lives** near the beach.  
3. My hometown **is** Madrid.  
4. My favourite hobby is **playing** football.  
5. I live in **a** quiet neighbourhood.
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa el texto de Maria

Hello! My name is Maria. I \_\_\_\_ twenty-eight years old. My \_\_\_\_ is Madrid, Spain. I live in a quiet \_\_\_\_ with many parks and cafes. My \_\_\_\_ hobby is reading books. I \_\_\_\_ a teacher. I \_\_\_\_ English at a small school. Nice to meet you!

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**am** · **hometown** · **neighbourhood** · **favourite** · **am** · **teach**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Completa el texto de Carlos

Hi! My name is Carlos. I am from Barcelona. My hometown \_\_\_\_ Barcelona. I live in a nice neighbourhood near the \_\_\_\_. My favourite hobby is \_\_\_\_ football. I am a \_\_\_\_. I study at the \_\_\_\_. I am happy to be here.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

**is** · **beach** · **playing** · **student** · **university**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce

1. Mi ciudad natal es Madrid.  
2. Vivo en un barrio tranquilo.  
3. Mi hobby favorito es leer libros.  
4. Soy profesor/a. Enseño inglés.  
5. Encantado/a de conocerte.  
6. Estoy feliz de estar aquí.  
7. Ella vive en un piso pequeño.  
8. ¿Cuál es tu hobby favorito?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. My hometown is Madrid.  
2. I live in a quiet neighbourhood.  
3. My favourite hobby is reading books.  
4. I am a teacher. I teach English.  
5. Nice to meet you.  
6. I am happy to be here.  
7. She lives in a small flat.  
8. What is your favourite hobby?
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Escribe tu presentación A2

Escribe 8–12 frases. Incluye:

- saludo + nombre + edad  
- *hometown*  
- *neighbourhood* (con adjetivo: *quiet / nice / near…*)  
- *favourite hobby*  
- *I am a student / I am a…*  
- cierre: *Nice to meet you!* o *I am happy to be here!*

**Modelo:** el texto de Maria (sección 4) o el audio de práctica (sección 8).

---

## 10. Plan de estudio (25–30 minutos)

1. **5 min** — Repasa la fórmula A2 y el vocabulario de la tabla.  
2. **8 min** — Haz los ejercicios 1–6.  
3. **7 min** — Escucha Maria y Carlos; repite en voz alta.  
4. **5–8 min** — Graba tu presentación de 1 minuto.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *I am / you are / he-she is* sin error  
- [ ] Uso *live / lives* y *teach / teaches*  
- [ ] Digo *hometown* y *neighbourhood* con sentido  
- [ ] Digo *My favourite hobby is…*  
- [ ] Cierro con *Nice to meet you!* o *I am happy to be here!*

---

## 11. Consejos y siguiente paso

1. No memorices listas: **cuenta tu historia** (nombre → ciudad → barrio → hobby → trabajo).  
2. Practica en voz alta: la Unidad 1 A2 es sobre **fluidez**, no solo formas.  
3. Si *to be* aún falla, vuelve un momento a [Saludos A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-1-saludos-presentarse).  
4. Practica en el [cuaderno de ejercicios de la Unidad 1](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-1-saludos-introducciones-repaso-ejercicios-soluciones) y en la [Unidad 1 del curso A2](/curso-a2/unit-1).

La **Unidad 2** entra en el **Past Simple** con verbos regulares (*walked, visited, played*) y marcas de tiempo (*yesterday, last week, ago*).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Fórmula | name · age · hometown · neighbourhood · hobby · job |
| *to be* | I am · you are · he/she is |
| Present Simple | I live · she lives · I teach |
| Vocabulario | hometown · neighbourhood · hobby · favourite |
| Cierre | Nice to meet you! · I am happy to be here! |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A2

En la **Unidad 2** estudiarás **Past Simple: Regular Verbs**: afirmativa, negativa y preguntas con *-ed*, y expresiones como *yesterday*, *last week*, *ago*.

Guía dedicada y curso:

- [Unidad 2 — Past Simple: verbos regulares](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-2-past-simple-verbos-regulares)
- [Unidad 2 — Past Simple: verbos regulares](/curso-a2/unit-2)

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 1 A2 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-1-saludos-introducciones-repaso-ejercicios-soluciones)
- [Unidad 1 — Saludos e introducciones](/curso-a2/unit-1)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés A2: guía del nivel](/blog/metodos/ingles-a2)
- [Inglés A1 vs A2](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1-vs-a2)

---
