faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto a qué hora haces algo en inglés?
faqs.answer: What time do you…? Por ejemplo: What time do you get up? What time do you have breakfast? Con he/she: What time does she go to work?

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo la hora en inglés A1?
faqs.answer: Usa at + hora: at seven o'clock (a las siete en punto), at half past seven (a las siete y media). O'clock = en punto; half past = y media.

faqs.question: ¿Qué preposición uso con la hora?
faqs.answer: At con horas concretas: at seven, at half past nine. In con partes del día: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo conjugan get up / have breakfast en Present Simple?
faqs.answer: I/you/we/they get up / have breakfast. He/she/it gets up / has breakfast. En 3.ª persona añade -s (gets, has, goes, finishes).

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 10 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 10 del curso A1 de Linguafly practicarás rutinas diarias y la hora con ejercicios de gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y speaking.

content:
Ya sabes hablar de profesiones y dónde trabajas. En la **Unidad 10 del curso A1** (*Daily Routines & Time*) aprendes a **describir tu día** con horarios: a qué hora te levantas, desayunas, vas al trabajo y te acuestas.

Esta guía cubre el **vocabulario de rutinas**, ***What time do you…?***, ***at + hora***, ***o'clock*** y ***half past***, y el Present Simple con *he/she*. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 10 — Rutinas diarias y la hora](/curso-a1/unit-10)  
> **Cuaderno de ejercicios (con soluciones):** [Ejercicios Unidad 10 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-10-rutinas-hora-ejercicios-soluciones)  
> **Repaso previo:** [Unidad 9 — Profesiones y ocupaciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-9-profesiones-ocupaciones)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 10 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Nombrar **acciones de la rutina diaria**.
- Preguntar y decir **a qué hora** haces algo.
- Usar ***at + hora*** y ***in the morning/afternoon/evening***.
- Construir frases con Present Simple (*I get up* / *She gets up*).

---

## 1. Vocabulario de rutinas diarias

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **get up** | levantarse | I get up at seven. |
| **have breakfast** | desayunar | I have breakfast at half past seven. |
| **go to work** | ir al trabajo | I go to work at nine. |
| **go to school** | ir al colegio | She goes to school at eight. |
| **have lunch** | comer / almorzar | He has lunch at one. |
| **finish work** | terminar de trabajar | I finish work at half past five. |
| **have dinner** | cenar | I have dinner at eight. |
| **go to bed** | acostarse | I go to bed at ten. |
| **read** | leer | I always read a book before sleep. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/get-up.mp3" title="🔊 Get up"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/have-breakfast.mp3" title="🔊 Have breakfast"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/go-to-work.mp3" title="🔊 Go to work"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/have-lunch.mp3" title="🔊 Have lunch"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/have-dinner.mp3" title="🔊 Have dinner"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/go-to-bed.mp3" title="🔊 Go to bed"></audio>

![Tabla de rutinas diarias en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/a1-unit10-routines.png)

### Más verbos de rutina útiles

| Inglés | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **wake up** | despertarse | I wake up at half past six. |
| **have a shower** | ducharse | I have a shower at seven. |
| **get dressed** | vestirse | She gets dressed after breakfast. |
| **start work** | empezar a trabajar | I start work at nine. |
| **go home** | ir a casa | He goes home at six. |
| **watch TV** | ver la tele | We watch TV in the evening. |
| **do homework** | hacer deberes | She does homework at half past five. |

**Orden típico de la mañana:**

1. I **wake up** at half past six.
2. I **get up** at seven o'clock.
3. I **have a shower** and **get dressed**.
4. I **have breakfast** at half past seven.
5. I **go to work** at nine o'clock.

### Consejos de pronunciación (rutinas y hora)

| Expresión | Tip |
| :--- | :--- |
| **get up** | /ɡet ʌp/ — la *u* de *up* suena /ʌ/ (como “uh”), no /u/ |
| **breakfast** | /ˈbrekfəst/ — acento en **break**; la segunda sílaba es débil |
| **o'clock** | /əˈklɒk/ — la *o'* suena /ə/ (schwa), no “oh” fuerte |
| **half past** | /hɑːf pɑːst/ (GB) — *half* suena “haaf”; no digas “jalp” |
| **evening** | /ˈiːvnɪŋ/ — empieza con /iː/, no con /e/ |

**Mini-práctica oral:** *I get up at seven o'clock. I have breakfast at half past seven. I go to bed at ten o'clock.*

### Partes del día

| Inglés | Español | Uso |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **in the morning** | por la mañana | I get up in the morning. |
| **in the afternoon** | por la tarde | I finish work in the afternoon. |
| **in the evening** | por la noche (temprano) | I have dinner in the evening. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/in-the-morning.mp3" title="🔊 In the morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/in-the-afternoon.mp3" title="🔊 In the afternoon"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/in-the-evening.mp3" title="🔊 In the evening"></audio>

**Regla rápida:** *in* + parte del día; *at* + hora concreta; *at night* (excepción: *at night*, no *in the night*).

| Preposición | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **in** the morning | I have breakfast **in** the morning. |
| **in** the afternoon | I finish work **in** the afternoon. |
| **in** the evening | I have dinner **in** the evening. |
| **at** night | I go to bed **at** night. |
| **at** seven o'clock | I get up **at** seven o'clock. |

---

## 2. Decir la hora: *o'clock* y *half past*

| Hora | Inglés | Español |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **7:00** | seven **o'clock** | las siete en punto |
| **7:30** | **half past** seven | las siete y media |
| **9:00** | nine o'clock | las nueve en punto |
| **1:00** | one o'clock | la una en punto |
| **5:30** | half past five | las cinco y media |
| **10:00** | ten o'clock | las diez en punto |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/o-clock.mp3" title="🔊 O'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/half-past.mp3" title="🔊 Half past"></audio>

![Esquema para decir la hora en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/a1-unit10-telling-time.png)

### Preposición *at* + hora

```
at + hora
```

| Ejemplo | Traducción |
| :--- | :--- |
| I get up **at** seven o'clock. | Me levanto a las siete en punto. |
| I have breakfast **at** half past seven. | Desayuno a las siete y media. |
| I go to bed **at** ten o'clock. | Me acuesto a las diez en punto. |

### Más ejemplos de *half past* y *o'clock*

| Reloj | Di en inglés | En una frase |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 6:00 | six o'clock | I get up at **six o'clock**. |
| 6:30 | half past six | I have a shower at **half past six**. |
| 8:00 | eight o'clock | She goes to school at **eight o'clock**. |
| 8:30 | half past eight | He starts work at **half past eight**. |
| 12:00 | twelve o'clock | We have lunch at **twelve o'clock**. |
| 12:30 | half past twelve | They finish lunch at **half past twelve**. |

**Recuerda el orden en *half past*:** primero *half past*, después la hora (*half past seven* = 7:30). No digas *seven half past*.

En niveles superiores verás *quarter past* (y cuarto) y *quarter to* (menos cuarto). En esta unidad A1 domina **o'clock** y **half past**.

---

## 3. *What time do you…?*

Para preguntar a qué hora:

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| **What time do you get up?** | I get up at seven o'clock. |
| **What time do you have breakfast?** | I have breakfast at half past seven. |
| **What time do you go to work?** | I go to work at nine o'clock. |
| **What time does she get up?** | She gets up at six o'clock. |

![Esquema de What time en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/a1-unit10-what-time.png)

### Estructura

```
What time + do/does + sujeto + verbo…?
Sujeto + verbo(+s) + at + hora.
```

| I / you / we / they | he / she / it |
| :--- | :--- |
| What time **do** you get up? | What time **does** she get up? |
| I **get** up at seven. | She **gets** up at six. |
| I **have** breakfast… | He **has** lunch… |
| I **go** to work… | She **goes** to school… |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/what-time-do-you-get-up.mp3" title="🔊 What time do you get up?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/i-get-up-at-seven.mp3" title="🔊 I get up at seven o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/i-have-breakfast-half-past.mp3" title="🔊 I have breakfast at half past seven"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/what-time-do-you-go-to-work.mp3" title="🔊 What time do you go to work?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/i-go-to-work-at-nine.mp3" title="🔊 I go to work at nine o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/i-go-to-bed-at-ten.mp3" title="🔊 I go to bed at ten o'clock"></audio>

---

## 4. Present Simple con rutinas (*he/she*)

En 3.ª persona singular el verbo lleva **-s**:

| I / you / we / they | he / she / it |
| :--- | :--- |
| get up | get**s** up |
| have | ha**s** |
| go | goe**s** |
| finish | finishe**s** |

| Ejemplo | Traducción |
| :--- | :--- |
| She **gets** up at six o'clock. | Ella se levanta a las seis. |
| He **has** lunch at one o'clock. | Él come a la una. |
| She **goes** to school at eight. | Ella va al colegio a las ocho. |
| He **finishes** work at half past five. | Él termina a las cinco y media. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/she-gets-up-at-six.mp3" title="🔊 She gets up at six o'clock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-10/he-has-lunch-at-one.mp3" title="🔊 He has lunch at one o'clock"></audio>

### Ortografía de la -s en 3.ª persona

| Regla | Verbos | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Añade **-s** | get → gets, start → starts | She **gets** up early. |
| Añade **-es** (tras -o, -sh, -ch, -ss, -x) | go → goes, finish → finishes | He **goes** to work. / She **finishes** work. |
| **have → has** (irregular) | have → has | He **has** breakfast. |
| **do → does** (en preguntas/negativas) | do → does | What time **does** she get up? |

### Mini-texto: el día de Sara

> Sara **gets** up at six o'clock. She **has** breakfast at half past six. She **goes** to school at eight. She **has** lunch at one o'clock. In the afternoon she **does** homework. She **has** dinner at eight in the evening. She **goes** to bed at half past ten.

Compara con Mark (sección 5): Mark usa *I get / I have / I go*; Sara usa *She gets / She has / She goes*.

---

## 5. Texto modelo (del curso)

### El día de Mark

> My name is Mark. I **get up at seven o'clock** in the morning. I **have breakfast at half past seven**. I **go to work at nine o'clock**. I work in an office. I **have lunch at one o'clock**. In the afternoon I **finish work at half past five**. I **have dinner at eight o'clock** in the evening. I **go to bed at ten o'clock**. I always read a book before sleep.

### Tu plantilla en 7 frases

1. I get up at \_\_\_\_.
2. I have breakfast at \_\_\_\_.
3. I go to work / school at \_\_\_\_.
4. I have lunch at \_\_\_\_.
5. I finish work at \_\_\_\_. / In the afternoon I…
6. I have dinner at \_\_\_\_.
7. I go to bed at \_\_\_\_.

---

## 6. Preguntas útiles

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| What time do you get up? | I get up at seven o'clock. |
| What time do you have breakfast? | I have breakfast at half past seven. |
| What time do you go to work? | I go to work at nine o'clock. |
| What time do you go to bed? | I go to bed at ten o'clock. |
| What time does she get up? | She gets up at six o'clock. |
| Do you get up early? | Yes, I do. / No, I don't. |

---

## 7. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *I get up in seven* | *I get up **at** seven* | Hora → **at** |
| *at the morning* | ***in** the morning* | Parte del día → **in** |
| *She get up at six* | *She **gets** up at six* | 3.ª persona: -s |
| *What time you get up?* | *What time **do** you get up?* | Falta auxiliar *do* |
| *half past of seven* | ***half past** seven* | Sin *of* |
| *I have the breakfast* | *I **have breakfast*** | Sin *the* en comidas habituales |
| *She go to bed at ten* | *She **goes** to bed at ten* | *go → goes* |
| *I get up at the seven* | *I get up at seven* | Sin *the* delante de la hora |
| *What time does she gets up?* | *What time does she **get** up?* | Tras *does*: verbo en forma base |
| *in half past seven* | ***at** half past seven* | Hora → *at* |

### Truco *at* vs *in*

- **at** + hora: *at seven, at half past nine*
- **in** + parte del día: *in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening*
- **at night** (excepción)
- Comidas habituales **sin** *the*: *have breakfast / lunch / dinner*

---

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa con *at* o *in*

1. I get up \_\_\_\_ seven o'clock.  
2. I have breakfast \_\_\_\_ the morning.  
3. She finishes work \_\_\_\_ half past five.  
4. We have dinner \_\_\_\_ the evening.  
5. He goes to bed \_\_\_\_ ten.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **at**  
2. **in**  
3. **at**  
4. **in**  
5. **at**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Escribe la hora en inglés

1. 7:00 → \_\_\_\_  
2. 7:30 → \_\_\_\_  
3. 9:00 → \_\_\_\_  
4. 5:30 → \_\_\_\_  
5. 10:00 → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **seven o'clock**  
2. **half past seven**  
3. **nine o'clock**  
4. **half past five**  
5. **ten o'clock**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa con la forma correcta del verbo

1. I \_\_\_\_ up at seven. (get)  
2. She \_\_\_\_ up at six. (get)  
3. He \_\_\_\_ lunch at one. (have)  
4. They \_\_\_\_ to work at nine. (go)  
5. She \_\_\_\_ to school at eight. (go)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **get**  
2. **gets**  
3. **has**  
4. **go**  
5. **goes**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce al inglés

1. ¿A qué hora te levantas?  
2. Me levanto a las siete en punto.  
3. Desayuno a las siete y media.  
4. Ella se acuesta a las diez.  
5. Él come a la una.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. What time do you get up?  
2. I get up at seven o'clock.  
3. I have breakfast at half past seven.  
4. She goes to bed at ten (o'clock).  
5. He has lunch at one (o'clock).
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. *I get up in seven o'clock.*  
2. *She get up at six.*  
3. *What time you go to work?*  
4. *I have the dinner at eight.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I get up **at** seven o'clock.  
2. She **gets** up at six.  
3. What time **do** you go to work?  
4. I have dinner at eight.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Describe tu día

Escribe 6–7 frases sobre tu rutina diaria con horarios. Usa *at*, *o'clock* o *half past*, y al menos una frase con *in the morning/afternoon/evening*.

**Modelo:**

> I get up at seven o'clock in the morning. I have breakfast at half past seven. I go to work at nine o'clock. I have lunch at one. I finish work at half past five. I have dinner at eight in the evening. I go to bed at ten o'clock.

### Ejercicio 7 — Reescribe en 3.ª persona

Cambia *I* por *She* y ajusta el verbo:

1. I get up at seven. → \_\_\_\_  
2. I have breakfast at half past seven. → \_\_\_\_  
3. I go to work at nine. → \_\_\_\_  
4. I finish work at half past five. → \_\_\_\_  
5. I go to bed at ten. → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She **gets** up at seven.  
2. She **has** breakfast at half past seven.  
3. She **goes** to work at nine.  
4. She **finishes** work at half past five.  
5. She **goes** to bed at ten.
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Pregunta y respuesta

Escribe la pregunta con *What time…?* para cada respuesta:

1. \_\_\_\_? — I get up at six o'clock.  
2. \_\_\_\_? — She has lunch at one.  
3. \_\_\_\_? — He goes to bed at eleven.  
4. \_\_\_\_? — They finish work at half past five.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. What time do you get up?  
2. What time does she have lunch?  
3. What time does he go to bed?  
4. What time do they finish work?
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Completa el párrafo

Completa con *at, in, gets, has, goes*:

> Maria \_\_\_\_ up \_\_\_\_ six o'clock \_\_\_\_ the morning. She \_\_\_\_ breakfast \_\_\_\_ half past six. She \_\_\_\_ to school \_\_\_\_ eight. She \_\_\_\_ lunch \_\_\_\_ one o'clock. \_\_\_\_ the evening she \_\_\_\_ dinner \_\_\_\_ eight. She \_\_\_\_ to bed \_\_\_\_ ten.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

> Maria **gets** up **at** six o'clock **in** the morning. She **has** breakfast **at** half past six. She **goes** to school **at** eight. She **has** lunch **at** one o'clock. **In** the evening she **has** dinner **at** eight. She **goes** to bed **at** ten.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Speaking: entrevista de rutina

Haz estas 6 preguntas (a un compañero o en voz alta contigo mismo) y responde con horario real:

1. What time do you get up?  
2. What time do you have breakfast?  
3. What time do you go to work / school?  
4. What time do you have lunch?  
5. What time do you have dinner?  
6. What time do you go to bed?

**Extra:** describe el día de otra persona usando *he/she* + *-s*.

---

## 9. Diálogo modelo

> **Anna:** What time do you get up?  
> **Mark:** I get up at seven o'clock in the morning.  
> **Anna:** And what time do you have breakfast?  
> **Mark:** At half past seven. Then I go to work at nine o'clock.  
> **Anna:** What time do you finish work?  
> **Mark:** At half past five in the afternoon.  
> **Anna:** And what time do you go to bed?  
> **Mark:** I go to bed at ten o'clock. I always read a book before sleep.

---

## 10. Consejos para practicar

1. **Escribe tu horario real** del día en inglés.
2. **Practica *o'clock* / *half past*** con el reloj del móvil.
3. **Pregunta a alguien**: *What time do you…?*
4. **Escucha los audios** y repite con la misma entonación.
5. Haz los ejercicios de la [Unidad 10 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-10).
6. **Conecta con profesiones** (Unidad 9): *I am a teacher. I go to work at eight o'clock.*
7. **Cambia I → he/she** cada día durante una semana para fijar la *-s*.
8. **Repasa Present Simple** en la [Unidad 5](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-5-present-simple-rutinas) si necesitas más práctica de hábitos.
9. **Di en voz alta** cinco horas al azar del móvil usando solo *o'clock* o *half past*.
10. **Graba tu rutina** en 45–60 segundos y comprueba *at/in* y la conjugación.

### Mini-rutina de 10 minutos

| Minuto | Actividad |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1–2 | Repite 8 verbos de rutina |
| 3–4 | Di 6 horas: 3 *o'clock* + 3 *half past* |
| 5–6 | Escribe tu mañana con *at* e *in the morning* |
| 7–8 | Transforma el texto a *he/she* |
| 9–10 | Escucha 2 audios y responde *What time…?* |

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Rutinas | get up, have breakfast, go to work, have lunch, go to bed |
| Hora | **at** seven o'clock / **at** half past seven |
| Partes del día | **in** the morning / afternoon / evening |
| Pregunta | What time **do/does** + sujeto + verbo? |
| 3.ª persona | She **gets** up / He **has** lunch / She **goes** to bed |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 11** aprendes **lugares de la ciudad** (*Places in Town*): *There is/are*, *Where is…?* y preposiciones de lugar.

Antes, practica con el cuaderno completo:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 10 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-10-rutinas-hora-ejercicios-soluciones)

→ [Unidad 11 — Lugares en la ciudad](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Daily routines: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary/daily-routines
- British Council — Telling the time: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary/telling-the-time

title: Lugares de la Ciudad en Inglés A1: There Is y There Are
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 11 del curso A1: lugares en la ciudad (bank, library, park…), There is/are, Where is…?, Is there a…? y preposiciones next to, opposite, between. Con audios, esquemas y ejercicios con soluciones.
description: Aprende lugares de la ciudad en inglés A1: vocabulario, There is/are, Where is…?, Is there a…? y preposiciones, con ejemplos y ejercicios.

there is y there are explicado
cómo preguntar where is the bank
next to opposite between en inglés
places in town English vocabulary A1
cómo preguntar is there a pharmacy
vocabulario de edificios y lugares en inglés
describir una ciudad en inglés básico

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre There is y There are?
faqs.answer: There is se usa con singular: There is a bank near here. There are se usa con plural: There are two parks in my town.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto si hay un lugar cerca?
faqs.answer: Is there a…? — Is there a pharmacy near here? Respuestas: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. En plural: Are there any shops?

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto dónde está un lugar?
faqs.answer: Where is the…? — Where is the post office? Respuesta: It is next to / opposite / between… the library.

faqs.question: ¿Qué significan next to, opposite y between?
faqs.answer: Next to = al lado de. Opposite = enfrente de. Between = entre (dos cosas): The pharmacy is between the bank and the post office.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 11 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 11 del curso A1 de Linguafly practicarás lugares de la ciudad, There is/are y preposiciones de lugar con ejercicios interactivos.

content:
Ya sabes describir tu rutina y decir la hora. En la **Unidad 11 del curso A1** (*Places in Town*) aprendes a hablar de **lugares en la ciudad** y a decir **dónde están**.

Esta guía cubre el **vocabulario de lugares**, ***There is / There are***, ***Where is…?***, ***Is there a…?*** y las preposiciones ***next to, opposite, between, near***. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 11 — Lugares en la ciudad](/curso-a1/unit-11)  
> **Cuaderno de ejercicios (con soluciones):** [Ejercicios Unidad 11 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad-ejercicios-soluciones)  
> **Repaso previo:** [Unidad 10 — Rutinas diarias y la hora](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-10-rutinas-diarias-hora)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 11 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Nombrar **lugares** de la ciudad en inglés.
- Usar ***There is / There are*** para decir qué hay.
- Preguntar ***Where is…?*** e ***Is there a…?***.
- Ubicar sitios con ***next to, opposite, between, near***.

---

## 1. Vocabulario: lugares en la ciudad

| Inglés | Español | Uso |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **bank** | banco | get money |
| **supermarket** | supermercado | buy food |
| **library** | biblioteca | read books |
| **post office** | correos | send letters |
| **pharmacy** | farmacia | buy medicine |
| **park** | parque | walk / play |
| **café** | café | drink coffee |
| **street** | calle | in my street |
| **shop** | tienda | buy things |
| **town** | pueblo / ciudad pequeña | my town |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/bank.mp3" title="🔊 Bank"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/supermarket.mp3" title="🔊 Supermarket"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/library.mp3" title="🔊 Library"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/post-office.mp3" title="🔊 Post office"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 Pharmacy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/park.mp3" title="🔊 Park"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/cafe.mp3" title="🔊 Café"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/street.mp3" title="🔊 Street"></audio>

![Tabla de lugares en la ciudad en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/a1-unit11-places.png)

### Más lugares útiles (A1)

| Inglés | Español | Para qué vas |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **hospital** | hospital | see a doctor |
| **school** | colegio / escuela | study / teach |
| **restaurant** | restaurante | have lunch / dinner |
| **hotel** | hotel | stay the night |
| **station** | estación | take a train / bus |
| **museum** | museo | see art / history |
| **cinema** | cine | watch a film |
| **gym** | gimnasio | do sport |

**Ejemplos:**

- There is a **museum** in the centre.
- There are two **restaurants** in my street.
- The **station** is near the supermarket.
- Is there a **gym** near here?

### Consejos de pronunciación (lugares)

| Palabra | Tip |
| :--- | :--- |
| **library** | /ˈlaɪbrəri/ — 3 sílabas: **LI**-bra-ry; no digas “libreri” |
| **pharmacy** | /ˈfɑːməsi/ — acento en **phar**; la *ph* = /f/ |
| **supermarket** | /ˈsuːpəmɑːkɪt/ — acento al inicio |
| **café** | /ˈkæfeɪ/ — la *é* final suena /eɪ/ |
| **opposite** | /ˈɒpəzɪt/ — acento en **op**; 3 sílabas |
| **between** | /bɪˈtwiːn/ — acento en **-tween** |

**Mini-práctica oral:** *bank, library, pharmacy, supermarket, post office* — luego: *There is a bank next to the library.*

---

## 2. There is / There are

Para decir **qué hay** en un lugar:

| Forma | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **There is** | singular | There **is** a bank near here. |
| **There are** | plural | There **are** two parks in my town. |

![Esquema de There is / There are en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/a1-unit11-there-is-are.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/there-is-a-bank.mp3" title="🔊 There is a bank near here"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/there-are-two-parks.mp3" title="🔊 There are two parks in my town"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/there-are-two-supermarkets.mp3" title="🔊 There are two supermarkets in my street"></audio>

### Preguntas: *Is there a…?*

| Pregunta | Respuestas cortas |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Is there a** pharmacy near here? | Yes, **there is**. / No, **there isn't**. |
| **Are there** any shops? | Yes, **there are**. / No, **there aren't**. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/is-there-a-pharmacy.mp3" title="🔊 Is there a pharmacy near here?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/yes-there-is.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, there is"></audio>

### Formas negativas

| Singular | Plural |
| :--- | :--- |
| There **isn't** a cinema near here. | There **aren't** any hotels in my street. |
| There **is not** a gym. | There **are not** any museums. |

**Ejemplos en contexto:**

- There isn't a post office in my village.
- There aren't any parks near my house.
- Is there a station? — No, there isn't.
- Are there any cafés? — No, there aren't.

### *a/an* y *any* con *There is/are*

| Situación | Estructura | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Singular afirmativo | There is **a/an** + lugar | There is **a** bank. |
| Plural afirmativo | There are + número / some | There are **two** parks. / There are **some** shops. |
| Pregunta plural | Are there **any**…? | Are there **any** cafés? |
| Negativa plural | There aren't **any**… | There aren't **any** hotels. |

**No digas:** *There is the bank near here* (salvo que sea un banco concreto ya conocido). En presentaciones generales usa *a/an*.

### Más mini-diálogos con *Is there…?*

> **A:** Excuse me. Is there a supermarket near here?  
> **B:** Yes, there is. It's in the main street.  
> **A:** And are there any cafés?  
> **B:** Yes, there are. There's a nice café next to the bank.

---

## 3. Where is…?

Para preguntar **dónde está** un lugar:

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Where is** the post office? | It **is** next to the library. |
| **Where is** the supermarket? | It **is** in the main street. |
| **Where are** the shops? | They **are** in the centre. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/where-is-the-post-office.mp3" title="🔊 Where is the post office?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/where-is-the-library.mp3" title="🔊 Where is the library? It is next to the supermarket"></audio>

---

## 4. Preposiciones de lugar

| Preposición | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **next to** | al lado de | The bank is **next to** the library. |
| **opposite** | enfrente de | The park is **opposite** the library. |
| **between** | entre | The pharmacy is **between** the bank and the post office. |
| **near** | cerca de | There is a café **near** here. |
| **in** | en | in my street / in the centre |

![Esquema de preposiciones de lugar en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/a1-unit11-prepositions.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/the-bank-is-next-to.mp3" title="🔊 The bank is next to the library"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/the-park-is-opposite.mp3" title="🔊 The park is opposite the library"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-11/the-pharmacy-is-between.mp3" title="🔊 The pharmacy is between the bank and the post office"></audio>

### Estructura

```
The + lugar + is + preposición + the + lugar
```

### Cómo visualizar las preposiciones

Imagina una calle con estos edificios en fila:

`[ bank ] [ pharmacy ] [ post office ]`  
`          ↑ park enfrente`

| Frase | Significado visual |
| :--- | :--- |
| The pharmacy is **between** the bank and the post office. | En el medio de los dos |
| The bank is **next to** the pharmacy. | Tocándose / al lado |
| The park is **opposite** the pharmacy. | Al otro lado de la calle |
| The café is **near** the station. | Cerca, no necesariamente al lado |

### Más ejemplos con cada preposición

**next to**

- The library is next to the school.
- My house is next to a park.
- There is a café next to the hotel.

**opposite**

- The supermarket is opposite the bank.
- The cinema is opposite the museum.
- Is the gym opposite the station? — Yes, it is.

**between**

- The shop is between the café and the pharmacy.
- My school is between the park and the library.
- Remember: *between A **and** B* (siempre *and*).

**near / in**

- There is a hospital near here.
- The post office is in the main street.
- There are many shops in the centre.

### Combinar *There is* + preposición

> There is a pharmacy **between** the bank and the post office.  
> There is a park **opposite** the library.  
> There is a café **next to** the supermarket.  
> There are two hotels **near** the station.

---

## 5. Texto modelo (del curso)

### My town

> My town is small but there are many interesting places. **There is a supermarket** in the main street. **Next to** the supermarket is the library. The library is open from nine to five. **Opposite** the library there is a park. **There is a pharmacy between** the bank and the post office. I like my town.

### Tu plantilla en 6 frases

1. My town / street is \_\_\_\_ (small / big).
2. There is a \_\_\_\_ in \_\_\_\_.
3. There are \_\_\_\_ \_\_\_\_ in my town.
4. The \_\_\_\_ is next to the \_\_\_\_.
5. The \_\_\_\_ is opposite the \_\_\_\_.
6. The \_\_\_\_ is between the \_\_\_\_ and the \_\_\_\_.

---

## 6. Preguntas útiles

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| Is there a bank near here? | Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. |
| Where is the post office? | It is next to the library. |
| Where is the supermarket? | It is in the main street. |
| Are there any parks? | Yes, there are two parks. |
| Is the café opposite the bank? | Yes, it is. / No, it isn't. |

---

## 7. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *There are a bank* | *There **is** a bank* | Singular → is |
| *There is two parks* | *There **are** two parks* | Plural → are |
| *Where is the shops?* | *Where **are** the shops?* | Plural → are |
| *Is there pharmacy?* | *Is there **a** pharmacy?* | Falta *a/an* |
| *next the bank* | ***next to** the bank* | Completa: next **to** |
| *between the bank the post office* | *between the bank **and** the post office* | between A **and** B |
| *There is the supermarket in my street* | *There is **a** supermarket in my street* | Presentación → *a* |
| *Opposite of the bank* | ***Opposite** the bank* | Sin *of* en esta estructura A1 |
| *Are there a parks?* | *Are there **any** parks?* / *Is there **a** park?* | Plural → *any* o *are* + plural |
| *Where the bank is?* | *Where **is** the bank?* | Auxiliar *is* delante del sujeto |

### Por qué ocurren

1. **There is/are** se traduce mentalmente como “hay”; no olvides concordar singular/plural.
2. **next to** es una expresión fija: siempre *to*.
3. **between** necesita dos puntos unidos con *and*.
4. En preguntas, el verbo (*is/are*) va **antes** del sujeto: *Where **is** the bank?*

---

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa con *is* o *are*

1. There \_\_\_\_ a bank near here.  
2. There \_\_\_\_ two parks in my town.  
3. Where \_\_\_\_ the supermarket?  
4. Where \_\_\_\_ the shops?  
5. Is there \_\_\_\_ pharmacy near here? (a / an)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **are**  
3. **is**  
4. **are**  
5. **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Elige la preposición correcta

1. The bank is (next to / between) the library.  
2. The park is (opposite / between) the library.  
3. The pharmacy is (next to / between) the bank and the post office.  
4. There is a café (near / between) here.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **next to**  
2. **opposite**  
3. **between**  
4. **near**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce al inglés

1. Hay un banco cerca de aquí.  
2. ¿Dónde está correos?  
3. ¿Hay una farmacia cerca?  
4. El parque está enfrente de la biblioteca.  
5. Hay dos supermercados en mi calle.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There is a bank near here.  
2. Where is the post office?  
3. Is there a pharmacy near here?  
4. The park is opposite the library.  
5. There are two supermarkets in my street.
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. *There are a supermarket in my street.*  
2. *Where is the shops?*  
3. *Is there pharmacy near here?*  
4. *The bank is next the library.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There **is** a supermarket in my street.  
2. Where **are** the shops?  
3. Is there **a** pharmacy near here?  
4. The bank is next **to** the library.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Ordena las palabras

1. is / There / a / bank / here / near  
2. the / Where / post office / is  
3. next to / is / The / library / supermarket / the

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There is a bank near here.  
2. Where is the post office?  
3. The library is next to the supermarket. / The supermarket is next to the library.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Describe tu barrio

Escribe 5–6 frases sobre tu calle o pueblo. Usa *There is/are*, al menos **dos** lugares y **dos** preposiciones (*next to, opposite, between, near*).

**Modelo:**

> My street is small. There is a supermarket and a café. The café is next to the bank. There is a park opposite the library. The pharmacy is between the bank and the post office. I like my town.

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa con *There is / There are / There isn't / There aren't*

1. \_\_\_\_ a bank in my street. (afirmativa, singular)  
2. \_\_\_\_ two parks near my house.  
3. \_\_\_\_ a cinema here. (negativa)  
4. \_\_\_\_ any hotels in this village. (negativa)  
5. \_\_\_\_ a pharmacy between the shop and the café?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **There is**  
2. **There are**  
3. **There isn't**  
4. **There aren't**  
5. **Is there**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Mira el mapa mental y escribe

Imagina: *bank — café — library* en una fila; *park* enfrente del café.

1. The café is \_\_\_\_ the bank and the library.  
2. The bank is \_\_\_\_ the café.  
3. The park is \_\_\_\_ the café.  
4. \_\_\_\_ a library next to the café. (usa There is)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **between**  
2. **next to**  
3. **opposite**  
4. **There is**
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce al inglés

1. No hay un museo cerca de aquí.  
2. ¿Hay tiendas en el centro?  
3. La estación está al lado del hotel.  
4. El cine está enfrente del parque.  
5. Hay un restaurante entre el banco y la farmacia.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. There isn't a museum near here.  
2. Are there any shops in the centre?  
3. The station is next to the hotel.  
4. The cinema is opposite the park.  
5. There is a restaurant between the bank and the pharmacy.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Speaking: guía turística de 1 minuto

Describe tu barrio en voz alta (6–8 frases). Debe incluir:

- 2× *There is* / *There are*
- 1× *Is there…?* (y respóndela)
- *next to*, *opposite* o *between* (al menos dos)
- 4 lugares diferentes

**Modelo oral:**

> My town is small. There is a supermarket in the main street. Next to the supermarket there is a café. Is there a park? Yes, there is. The park is opposite the library. The pharmacy is between the bank and the post office.

---

## 9. Diálogo modelo

> **Tourist:** Excuse me. Is there a pharmacy near here?  
> **Local:** Yes, there is. It's between the bank and the post office.  
> **Tourist:** And where is the library?  
> **Local:** The library is next to the supermarket, in the main street.  
> **Tourist:** Is there a park opposite the library?  
> **Local:** Yes! There is a small park opposite the library.  
> **Tourist:** Perfect. Thank you!  
> **Local:** You're welcome.

---

## 10. Consejos para practicar

1. **Dibuja un mapa simple** de tu barrio y descríbelo en inglés.
2. **Practica *There is/are*** mirando por la ventana.
3. **Pregunta en voz alta**: *Where is the…? Is there a…?*
4. **Escucha los audios** y repite con la misma entonación.
5. Haz los ejercicios de la [Unidad 11 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-11) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad-ejercicios-soluciones).
6. **Etiqueta fotos** de Google Maps o de tu móvil: *This is a bank. It is next to…*
7. **Juego de 60 segundos:** nombra 10 lugares sin repetir.
8. **Conecta con rutinas** (Unidad 10): *I go to the supermarket at half past five.*
9. **Repasa *a/an*** (Unidad 4 / 9): *Is there **a** pharmacy?*
10. **Graba un “tour”** de tu calle: 45 segundos con *There is* + 2 preposiciones.

### Mini-rutina de 10 minutos

| Minuto | Actividad |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1–2 | Repite 10 lugares en voz alta |
| 3–4 | 5 frases *There is / There are* |
| 5–6 | Practica *next to / opposite / between* con objetos en tu mesa |
| 7–8 | Preguntas: *Where is…? Is there a…?* |
| 9–10 | Escucha 2 audios y describe tu mapa |

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Lugares | bank, supermarket, library, post office, pharmacy, park, café |
| Hay… | There **is** (singular) / There **are** (plural) |
| Preguntas | Where is…? / Is there a…? |
| Posición | next to, opposite, between, near, in |
| Respuestas | Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. |

---

title: Días de la Semana en Inglés (A1): on Monday, Weekend y Hábitos
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 12 del curso A1: días de la semana, on Monday/Tuesdays, weekend, weekdays, What do you do on…? y hábitos en Present Simple. Con audios, esquemas y ejercicios con soluciones.
description: Aprende los días de la semana en inglés A1, la preposición on con días, weekend, weekdays y What do you do on…?. Guía Unidad 12 con ejemplos, audios y ejercicios.
alt: Tabla de los días de la semana en inglés nivel A1

faqs.question: ¿Cuáles son los días de la semana en inglés?
faqs.answer: Monday (lunes), Tuesday (martes), Wednesday (miércoles), Thursday (jueves), Friday (viernes), Saturday (sábado) y Sunday (domingo). Empiezan con mayúscula.

faqs.question: ¿Qué preposición uso con los días?
faqs.answer: On: on Monday, on Tuesdays, on Friday. No uses at ni in con días. Con el fin de semana: on the weekend (o at the weekend en británico).

faqs.question: ¿Qué es weekend y weekdays?
faqs.answer: Weekdays = Monday to Friday (días laborables). Weekend = Saturday and Sunday (fin de semana).

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto qué haces un día concreto?
faqs.answer: What do you do on Sunday? / What do you do on Fridays? Respuesta: I rest at home. / I meet my friends.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 12 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 12 del curso A1 de Linguafly practicarás días de la semana, on + día y hábitos con ejercicios interactivos.

content:
Ya sabes hablar de lugares en la ciudad. En la **Unidad 12 del curso A1** (*Days of the Week*) aprendes los **días de la semana** y a decir **qué haces cada día**.

Esta guía cubre los **siete días**, la preposición ***on***, ***weekend*** y ***weekdays***, y la pregunta ***What do you do on…?***. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 12 — Días de la semana](/curso-a1/unit-12)  
> **Cuaderno de ejercicios (con soluciones):** [Ejercicios Unidad 12 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana-ejercicios-soluciones)  
> **Repaso previo:** [Unidad 11 — Lugares en la ciudad](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 12 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Nombrar los **días de la semana** en inglés.
- Usar ***on*** con días (*on Monday*, *on Tuesdays*).
- Distinguir ***weekdays*** y ***weekend***.
- Preguntar y decir **qué haces** cada día.

---

## 1. Los días de la semana

| Inglés | Español |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Monday** | lunes |
| **Tuesday** | martes |
| **Wednesday** | miércoles |
| **Thursday** | jueves |
| **Friday** | viernes |
| **Saturday** | sábado |
| **Sunday** | domingo |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/monday.mp3" title="🔊 Monday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/tuesday.mp3" title="🔊 Tuesday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/wednesday.mp3" title="🔊 Wednesday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/thursday.mp3" title="🔊 Thursday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/friday.mp3" title="🔊 Friday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/saturday.mp3" title="🔊 Saturday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/sunday.mp3" title="🔊 Sunday"></audio>

![Tabla de los días de la semana en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/a1-unit12-days.png)

### Cómo memorizar el orden

Una cadena útil para practicar en voz alta:

> **Mon**day → **Tues**day → **Wednes**day → **Thurs**day → **Fri**day → **Satur**day → **Sun**day

**Truco de chunks:**

1. *Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday* (inicio de semana)
2. *Thursday, Friday* (mitad / casi finde)
3. *Saturday, Sunday* (weekend)

### Consejos de pronunciación (días)

| Día | Tip de pronunciación |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Monday** | /ˈmʌndeɪ/ — *Mon* suena /mʌn/ (como “man” corta), no “mon” con /o/ |
| **Tuesday** | /ˈtjuːzdeɪ/ (GB) o /ˈtuːzdeɪ/ (US) — acento en **Tues** |
| **Wednesday** | /ˈwenzdeɪ/ — ¡solo **2** sílabas en la práctica! “Wenz-day”, la *d* del medio casi desaparece |
| **Thursday** | /ˈθɜːzdeɪ/ — *Th* = /θ/ (como en *think*); no /t/ |
| **Friday** | /ˈfraɪdeɪ/ — *i* = /aɪ/ (como *my*) |
| **Saturday** | /ˈsætədeɪ/ — 3 sílabas: **Sa**-tur-day |
| **Sunday** | /ˈsʌndeɪ/ — *Sun* = /sʌn/ (como *sun* = sol) |

**Mini-práctica oral:** di los 7 días dos veces seguidas; luego solo *Wednesday* y *Thursday* cinco veces (son los más difíciles).

### Abreviaturas frecuentes

| Día | Abreviatura |
| :--- | :--- |
| Monday | Mon. |
| Tuesday | Tue. / Tues. |
| Wednesday | Wed. |
| Thursday | Thu. / Thur. |
| Friday | Fri. |
| Saturday | Sat. |
| Sunday | Sun. |

### Reglas importantes

- Los días **siempre van con mayúscula**: *Monday*, no *monday*.
- El orden habitual (en muchos países de habla inglesa) empieza en **Monday**.

### Weekdays y weekend

| Inglés | Significado | Días |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **weekdays** | días laborables | Monday → Friday |
| **weekend** | fin de semana | Saturday + Sunday |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/weekdays.mp3" title="🔊 Weekdays"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/weekend.mp3" title="🔊 Weekend"></audio>

**Ejemplos:**

- On **weekdays** I go to work.
- At / On the **weekend** I rest.
- Weekdays are busy. The weekend is quiet.

---

## 2. Preposición *on* + día

Con los días de la semana usamos ***on***:

| Ejemplo | Traducción |
| :--- | :--- |
| I work **on Monday**. | Trabajo el lunes. |
| I work **on Mondays**. | Trabajo los lunes (hábito). |
| She has class **on Tuesdays**. | Ella tiene clase los martes. |
| I go shopping **on Saturday**. | Voy de compras el sábado. |
| **On the weekend** I don't work. | El fin de semana no trabajo. |

![Esquema de on + día en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/a1-unit12-on-day.png)

### Singular vs plural del día

| Forma | Uso |
| :--- | :--- |
| **on Monday** | un lunes concreto / en general |
| **on Mondays** | todos los lunes (hábito) |

### from… to…

| Ejemplo | Traducción |
| :--- | :--- |
| **From Monday to Friday** I go to work. | De lunes a viernes voy al trabajo. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/i-work-on-mondays.mp3" title="🔊 I work on Mondays"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/she-has-class-on-tuesdays.mp3" title="🔊 She has class on Tuesdays"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/i-go-shopping-on-saturday.mp3" title="🔊 I go shopping on Saturday"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/on-the-weekend-i-dont-work.mp3" title="🔊 On the weekend I don't work"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/from-monday-to-friday.mp3" title="🔊 From Monday to Friday I go to work"></audio>

### Atención: no mezcles preposiciones

| ✅ Correcto | ❌ Incorrecto |
| :--- | :--- |
| **on** Monday | *in Monday* / *at Monday* |
| **on** the weekend | *in the weekend* |
| **at** seven o'clock | (hora → at, no on) |
| **in** the morning | (parte del día → in) |

### Más ejemplos: *on* + día + rutina

Combina esta unidad con la hora (Unidad 10):

| Día | Frase completa |
| :--- | :--- |
| Monday | On Monday I get up at seven o'clock. |
| Tuesday | On Tuesdays I have English class at six. |
| Friday | On Friday I finish work at half past three. |
| Saturday | On Saturday I go shopping in the morning. |
| Sunday | On Sunday I rest at home. |

### *on the weekend* vs *at the weekend*

| Variedad | Forma habitual |
| :--- | :--- |
| Americano (US) | **on** the weekend / **on** weekends |
| Británico (GB) | **at** the weekend / **at** weekends |

Ambas son correctas. En esta guía usamos sobre todo **on the weekend**, pero acepta *at the weekend* si estudias inglés británico.

---

## 3. What do you do on…?

Para preguntar por hábitos de un día:

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **What do you do on Sunday?** | I rest at home. |
| **What do you do on Fridays?** | I meet my friends. |
| **Do you work on Saturday?** | No, I don't. / Yes, I do. |
| **What does she do on Tuesdays?** | She has English class. |

![Esquema de What do you do on en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/a1-unit12-what-do-you-do.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/what-do-you-do-on-sunday.mp3" title="🔊 What do you do on Sunday?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/i-meet-my-friends.mp3" title="🔊 What do you do on Fridays? I meet my friends"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/do-you-work-on-saturday.mp3" title="🔊 Do you work on Saturday? No, I don't"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-12/on-sunday-i-rest.mp3" title="🔊 On Sunday I rest at home"></audio>

### Present Simple con hábitos

| I / you / we / they | he / she / it |
| :--- | :--- |
| I **work** on Mondays. | She **works** on Mondays. |
| I **don't work** on Sunday. | He **doesn't work** on Sunday. |
| What **do** you do…? | What **does** she do…? |

### Vocabulario de hábitos por día

| Actividad | Español | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **work** | trabajar | I work on Mondays. |
| **have class** | tener clase | She has class on Tuesdays. |
| **meet friends** | quedar con amigos | I meet my friends on Fridays. |
| **go shopping** | ir de compras | We go shopping on Saturday. |
| **rest** | descansar | I rest on Sunday. |
| **do sport / exercise** | hacer deporte | He does sport on Wednesdays. |
| **stay at home** | quedarse en casa | On Sundays I stay at home. |
| **visit family** | visitar a la familia | They visit family on Sunday. |

### Mini-diálogos

**Diálogo A**

> **A:** What do you do on Mondays?  
> **B:** I work from nine to five.  
> **A:** And on the weekend?  
> **B:** On Saturday I go shopping. On Sunday I rest.

**Diálogo B**

> **A:** Do you have English class on Wednesday?  
> **B:** No, I don't. I have class on Tuesday and Thursday.  
> **A:** What do you do on Friday evening?  
> **B:** I meet my friends.

---

## 4. Texto modelo (del curso)

### Paul's week

> My name is Paul. **On Monday and Wednesday** I work from nine to five. **On Tuesday and Thursday** I have English class in the evening. **On Friday** I finish early and meet my friends. **On the weekend** I don't work. **On Saturday** I go shopping or run. **On Sunday** I rest at home. I like my week.

### Tu plantilla en 7 frases

1. On Monday I \_\_\_\_.
2. On Tuesday I \_\_\_\_.
3. On Wednesday / Thursday I \_\_\_\_.
4. On Friday I \_\_\_\_.
5. On Saturday I \_\_\_\_.
6. On Sunday I \_\_\_\_.
7. On the weekend I \_\_\_\_. / I don't \_\_\_\_ on Sundays.

---

## 5. Preguntas útiles

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| What do you do on Mondays? | I work from nine to five. |
| What do you do on Sunday? | I rest at home. |
| Do you work on Saturday? | No, I don't. |
| Do you have class on Tuesday? | Yes, I do. |
| What does she do on Fridays? | She meets her friends. |

---

## 6. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *in Monday* | ***on** Monday* | Días → **on** |
| *at Friday* | ***on** Friday* | Días → **on** |
| *monday* (minúscula) | ***Monday*** | Siempre mayúscula |
| *I no work on Sunday* | *I **don't** work on Sunday* | Negativa con *don't* |
| *She work on Mondays* | *She **works** on Mondays* | 3.ª persona: -s |
| *What you do on Sunday?* | *What **do** you do on Sunday?* | Falta auxiliar *do* |
| *I work the Monday* | *I work **on** Monday* | Falta *on*; no uses *the* así |
| *On monday I rest* | *On **Monday** I rest* | Mayúscula obligatoria |
| *She doesn't works on Sunday* | *She doesn't **work** on Sunday* | Tras *doesn't*: forma base |
| *from Monday until Friday* | *from Monday **to** Friday* | En A1: *from… to…* |

### Mapa mental de preposiciones de tiempo (A1)

| Usa… | Con… | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **on** | días | on Monday, on Fridays |
| **at** | horas | at seven o'clock |
| **in** | partes del día | in the morning |
| **at** | night / the weekend (GB) | at night / at the weekend |

---

## 7. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Escribe el día en inglés

1. lunes → \_\_\_\_  
2. miércoles → \_\_\_\_  
3. viernes → \_\_\_\_  
4. sábado → \_\_\_\_  
5. domingo → \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Monday**  
2. **Wednesday**  
3. **Friday**  
4. **Saturday**  
5. **Sunday**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con *on / in / at*

1. I work \_\_\_\_ Monday.  
2. I get up \_\_\_\_ seven o'clock.  
3. I have breakfast \_\_\_\_ the morning.  
4. She has class \_\_\_\_ Tuesdays.  
5. We rest \_\_\_\_ the weekend.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **on**  
2. **at**  
3. **in**  
4. **on**  
5. **on** (o *at* en británico: *at the weekend*)
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce al inglés

1. Trabajo los lunes.  
2. ¿Qué haces el domingo?  
3. El fin de semana no trabajo.  
4. Ella tiene clase los martes.  
5. De lunes a viernes voy al trabajo.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I work on Mondays.  
2. What do you do on Sunday?  
3. On the weekend I don't work.  
4. She has class on Tuesdays.  
5. From Monday to Friday I go to work.
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. *I work in Monday.*  
2. *She have class on Tuesday.*  
3. *What you do on Friday?*  
4. *I no work on Sunday.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I work **on** Monday.  
2. She **has** class on Tuesday.  
3. What **do** you do on Friday?  
4. I **don't** work on Sunday.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Ordena las palabras

1. on / work / I / Mondays  
2. do / What / on / you / Sunday / do  
3. weekend / don't / the / On / work / I

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I work on Mondays.  
2. What do you do on Sunday?  
3. On the weekend I don't work.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Describe tu semana

Escribe 6 frases sobre tu semana. Usa al menos **cuatro días** diferentes y *on the weekend* o *weekdays*.

**Modelo:**

> On Mondays I work. On Tuesdays I have English class. On Friday I meet my friends. On Saturday I go shopping. On Sunday I rest at home. On the weekend I don't work.

### Ejercicio 7 — Completa con el día correcto (en inglés)

1. The day after Monday is \_\_\_\_.  
2. The day before Friday is \_\_\_\_.  
3. The first day of the weekend is \_\_\_\_.  
4. Weekdays end on \_\_\_\_.  
5. The day between Tuesday and Thursday is \_\_\_\_.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Tuesday**  
2. **Thursday**  
3. **Saturday**  
4. **Friday**  
5. **Wednesday**
</details>

### Ejercicio 8 — Reescribe con *he/she*

1. I work on Mondays. → She \_\_\_\_  
2. I don't work on Sunday. → He \_\_\_\_  
3. What do you do on Friday? → What \_\_\_\_ she \_\_\_\_ on Friday?  
4. I meet my friends on Saturdays. → He \_\_\_\_

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. She **works** on Mondays.  
2. He **doesn't work** on Sunday.  
3. What **does** she **do** on Friday?  
4. He **meets** his friends on Saturdays.
</details>

### Ejercicio 9 — Traduce al inglés

1. Los miércoles hago deporte.  
2. ¿Trabajas el sábado?  
3. El viernes por la tarde quedo con mis amigos.  
4. De lunes a viernes me levanto a las siete.  
5. Ella no trabaja los fines de semana.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. On Wednesdays I do sport. / I do sport on Wednesdays.  
2. Do you work on Saturday?  
3. On Friday evening I meet my friends.  
4. From Monday to Friday I get up at seven.  
5. She doesn't work on the weekend. / She doesn't work at the weekend.
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Speaking: tu semana en 1 minuto

Habla durante 60–90 segundos:

1. Di qué haces de lunes a viernes (*from Monday to Friday…*).
2. Di dos hábitos con días en plural (*on Tuesdays, on Fridays*).
3. Di qué haces el fin de semana.
4. Hazte una pregunta y respóndela: *Do you work on Sunday?*

**Checklist:** mayúsculas en los días · *on* (no *in/at*) · *-s* con *he/she* · *don't/doesn't* en negativas.

---

## 8. Diálogo modelo

> **Sara:** What do you do on Mondays?  
> **Paul:** I work from nine to five.  
> **Sara:** And on Tuesdays?  
> **Paul:** On Tuesday and Thursday I have English class in the evening.  
> **Sara:** Do you work on Saturday?  
> **Paul:** No, I don't. On the weekend I don't work.  
> **Sara:** Nice! What do you do on Sunday?  
> **Paul:** I rest at home. And you?  
> **Sara:** On Fridays I meet my friends. On Sunday I go to the park.

---

## 9. Consejos para practicar

1. **Escribe tu agenda semanal** en inglés día por día.
2. **Memoriza los días en orden** en voz alta.
3. **Practica *on***: *on Monday*, *on Fridays*, *on the weekend*.
4. **Escucha los audios** y repite con la misma entonación.
5. Haz los ejercicios de la [Unidad 12 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-12) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana-ejercicios-soluciones).
6. **Combina con la hora:** *On Monday I get up at seven o'clock* ([Unidad 10](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-10-rutinas-diarias-hora)).
7. **Etiqueta tu calendario** del móvil en inglés (Mon, Tue, Wed…).
8. **Pregunta a tres personas:** *What do you do on Sundays?*
9. **Repasa Present Simple** en la [Unidad 5](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-5-present-simple-rutinas).
10. **Graba tu semana** en 1 minuto y corrige mayúsculas y preposiciones.

### Mini-rutina de 10 minutos

| Minuto | Actividad |
| :--- | :--- |
| 1–2 | Di los 7 días en orden (×2) |
| 3–4 | Pronuncia *Wednesday* y *Thursday* con cuidado |
| 5–6 | Escribe 5 frases *On + day + actividad* |
| 7–8 | Transforma 3 frases a *he/she* |
| 9–10 | Escucha 2 audios y describe tu weekend |

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Días | Monday → Sunday (con mayúscula) |
| Preposición | **on** Monday / on Tuesdays |
| Weekdays | Monday to Friday |
| Weekend | Saturday + Sunday |
| Pregunta | What do you do on…? |
| Negativa | I don't work on Sunday. |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 13** profundizarás en la **rutina diaria** con secuenciadores (*First, Then, After that*) y Present Simple.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 12 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana-ejercicios-soluciones)

→ [Unidad 13 — Rutina diaria](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-13-rutina-diaria)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [A2 U8 — Preposiciones de tiempo (at/on/in)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

- British Council — Days of the week: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary/days-months-seasons
- British Council — Present Simple: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/present-simple

title: Rutina Diaria en Inglés A1: First, Then y Present Simple

excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 13 del curso A1: rutina diaria con First, Then, After that, wake up, brush my teeth, have a shower, go to bed y Present Simple. Con audios, esquemas y ejercicios con soluciones.
description: Aprende a describir tu rutina diaria en inglés A1 con First, Then, After that, wake up, brush my teeth y go to bed, con ejemplos y ejercicios.

conectores first then after that en inglés
wake up y brush your teeth vocabulario
go to bed y have breakfast ejemplos
secuenciadores para contar rutinas en inglés

verbos de actividades diarias en inglés

faqs.question: ¿Cómo ordeno las acciones de mi día en inglés?
faqs.answer: Usa secuenciadores: First (primero), Then (luego) y After that (después de eso). Ejemplo: First I wake up. Then I brush my teeth. After that I have breakfast.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre wake up y get up?
faqs.answer: Wake up = despertarse. Get up = levantarse de la cama. En A1 a menudo se usan de forma cercana: First I wake up at seven. Then I get up.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo lavarme los dientes y ducharme?
faqs.answer: Brush my teeth = lavarme los dientes. Have a shower (o take a shower) = ducharme. Get dressed = vestirme.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo conjugan estos verbos en Present Simple?
faqs.answer: I wake up / She wakes up. I go to bed / She goes to bed. I have breakfast / He has breakfast. En 3.ª persona añade -s/-es.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 13 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 13 del curso A1 de Linguafly practicarás rutina diaria con First, Then, After that y vocabulario del día con ejercicios interactivos.

content:
Ya sabes los días de la semana y a qué hora haces las cosas. En la **Unidad 13 del curso A1** (*Daily Routine*) aprendes a **contar tu día en orden**: primero te despiertas, luego te lavas los dientes, después desayunas…

Esta guía cubre el **vocabulario de la rutina**, los secuenciadores ***First, Then, After that***, y cómo combinarlos con **Present Simple** y horarios. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 13 — Rutina diaria](/curso-a1/unit-13)  
> **Cuaderno de ejercicios (con soluciones):** [Ejercicios Unidad 13 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-13-rutina-diaria-ejercicios-soluciones)  
> **Repaso previo:** [Unidad 12 — Días de la semana](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana) · [Unidad 10 — Rutinas y la hora](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-10-rutinas-diarias-hora)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 13 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Nombrar las **acciones típicas** de un día (*wake up, brush my teeth, go to bed*…).
- Ordenar tu día con ***First, Then, After that***.
- Describir la rutina de **otra persona** (*She wakes up… She goes to bed…*).
- Contar tu día en **5–8 frases** claras y ordenadas.

---

## 1. Vocabulario de la rutina diaria

Estas son las acciones centrales de la Unidad 13:

| Inglés | Español | Momento típico |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **wake up** | despertarse | morning |
| **get up** | levantarse | morning |
| **brush my teeth** | lavarme los dientes | morning / night |
| **have a shower** | ducharme | morning |
| **get dressed** | vestirme | morning |
| **have breakfast** | desayunar | morning |
| **go to work / school** | ir al trabajo / colegio | morning |
| **have lunch** | comer | midday |
| **go home** | ir a casa | afternoon |
| **have dinner** | cenar | evening |
| **go to bed** | acostarse | night |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/wake-up.mp3" title="🔊 Wake up"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/brush-my-teeth.mp3" title="🔊 Brush my teeth"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/have-a-shower.mp3" title="🔊 Have a shower"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/get-dressed.mp3" title="🔊 Get dressed"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/have-breakfast.mp3" title="🔊 Have breakfast"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/go-to-work.mp3" title="🔊 Go to work"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/have-lunch.mp3" title="🔊 Have lunch"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/go-home.mp3" title="🔊 Go home"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/have-dinner.mp3" title="🔊 Have dinner"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/go-to-bed.mp3" title="🔊 Go to bed"></audio>

![Tabla de acciones de la rutina diaria en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/a1-unit13-routine.png)

### Tips de pronunciación (A1)

| Expresión | Tip |
| :--- | :--- |
| **wake up** | Dos palabras claras: *wake* + *up*. |
| **brush my teeth** | *teeth* rima con *see* + *th* suave. |
| **have a shower** | En británico es muy común; en americano también *take a shower*. |
| **get dressed** | *dressed* termina en /t/. |
| **go to bed** | No digas *go to the bed* en este sentido habitual. |

### Collocations útiles

En inglés estas acciones suelen ir fijas:

- **have** breakfast / lunch / dinner / a shower  
- **brush** my teeth  
- **get** dressed / get up  
- **go** to work / go home / go to bed  

No digas *make breakfast* (en A1; *make* se usa más adelante en otros contextos) ni *take breakfast*.

---

## 2. First, Then, After that

Para **ordenar** tu día usamos secuenciadores:

| Secuenciador | Español | Uso |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **First** | Primero | Empieza la secuencia |
| **Then** | Luego | Siguiente paso |
| **After that** | Después (de eso) | Paso siguiente |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/first.mp3" title="🔊 First"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/then.mp3" title="🔊 Then"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/after-that.mp3" title="🔊 After that"></audio>

![Esquema de First, Then, After that en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/a1-unit13-sequencers.png)

### Modelo básico (mañana)

> **First** I wake up at seven.  
> **Then** I brush my teeth.  
> **After that** I have breakfast.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/first-i-wake-up.mp3" title="🔊 First I wake up at seven"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/then-i-brush-my-teeth.mp3" title="🔊 Then I brush my teeth"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/after-that-i-have-breakfast.mp3" title="🔊 After that I have breakfast"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/first-then-after-that.mp3" title="🔊 First I wake up. Then I have breakfast. After that I go to work"></audio>

### Estructura

```
First / Then / After that + sujeto + verbo (+ complemento)
```

Puedes repetir **Then** o **After that** varias veces si tu día tiene más pasos. **First** suele ir solo al inicio.

### Más opciones (nivel A1+)

Cuando avances verás también *Next*, *Later* o *Finally*. En esta unidad céntrate en **First / Then / After that**.

---

## 3. Present Simple en la rutina

La rutina usa **Present Simple** porque son hábitos:

| I / you / we / they | he / she / it |
| :--- | :--- |
| I **wake** up | She **wakes** up |
| I **brush** my teeth | He **brushes** his teeth |
| I **have** breakfast | She **has** breakfast |
| I **go** to work | He **goes** to work |
| I **go** to bed | She **goes** to bed |

| Ejemplo | Traducción |
| :--- | :--- |
| First I wake up at seven. | Primero me despierto a las siete. |
| Then she brushes her teeth. | Luego ella se lava los dientes. |
| After that he goes to work. | Después él va al trabajo. |
| She goes to bed at ten. | Ella se acuesta a las diez. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/she-goes-to-bed-at-ten.mp3" title="🔊 She goes to bed at ten"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/i-have-a-shower-every-morning.mp3" title="🔊 I have a shower every morning"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/i-go-to-bed-at-ten.mp3" title="🔊 I go to bed at ten o'clock"></audio>

### Combina con la Unidad 10 (hora)

| Secuenciador + rutina + hora |
| :--- |
| First I wake up **at seven o'clock**. |
| Then I have breakfast **at half past seven**. |
| After that I go to work **at nine**. |
| I go to bed **at ten o'clock**. |

### Combina con la Unidad 12 (días)

| on + día + rutina |
| :--- |
| **On Mondays** I wake up at six. |
| **On Sundays** I don't go to work. |
| First I wake up. Then I have breakfast. **On weekdays** I go to work after that. |

---

## 4. Texto modelo (del curso)

### Emma's day

> My name is Emma. This is my day. **First** I wake up at seven o'clock. **Then** I brush my teeth and have a shower. **After that** I have breakfast at half past seven. I go to work at nine. At one I have lunch. I finish work at six. **Then** I go home. At night I have dinner and **go to bed at ten**.

![Esquema de un día completo en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-13/a1-unit13-my-day.png)

### Tu plantilla en 8 frases

1. First I wake up at \_\_\_\_.
2. Then I \_\_\_\_ (brush my teeth / have a shower).
3. After that I have breakfast at \_\_\_\_.
4. I get dressed and go to \_\_\_\_ at \_\_\_\_.
5. At \_\_\_\_ I have lunch.
6. I finish work / school at \_\_\_\_. Then I go home.
7. In the evening I have dinner at \_\_\_\_.
8. Finally / At night I go to bed at \_\_\_\_.

---

## 5. Preguntas útiles

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| What do you do first in the morning? | First I wake up. Then I brush my teeth. |
| What time do you wake up? | I wake up at seven o'clock. |
| What do you do after breakfast? | After that I go to work. |
| What time do you go to bed? | I go to bed at ten. |
| Does she have a shower in the morning? | Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't. |

---

## 6. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *First I waking up* | *First I **wake** up* | Present Simple, no -ing |
| *Then I brush the teeth* | *Then I brush **my** teeth* | posesivo: my/his/her |
| *After I have breakfast* (solo) | ***After that** I have breakfast* | En esta unidad: *After that* |
| *She go to bed at ten* | *She **goes** to bed at ten* | 3.ª persona: goes |
| *I have the shower* | *I **have a** shower* | *a shower* |
| *I go to the bed* | *I **go to bed*** | expresión fija sin *the* |
| *Firstly I wake up* (A1) | ***First** I wake up* | En A1 usa *First* |

---

## 7. Más ejemplos por momentos del día

### Por la mañana

> First I wake up at seven.  
> Then I have a shower.  
> After that I get dressed.  
> Then I have breakfast.  
> After that I go to work.

### Al mediodía y por la tarde

> At one I have lunch.  
> After that I go back to work.  
> I finish work at six.  
> Then I go home.

### Por la noche

> In the evening I have dinner.  
> Then I watch TV or read a book.  
> After that I brush my teeth.  
> I go to bed at ten o'clock.

---

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa con *First / Then / After that*

1. \_\_\_\_ I wake up at seven.  
2. \_\_\_\_ I brush my teeth.  
3. \_\_\_\_ I have breakfast.  
4. \_\_\_\_ I go to work.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **First**  
2. **Then** (o After that)  
3. **After that** (o Then)  
4. **Then** / **After that**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con la forma correcta del verbo

1. First I \_\_\_\_ up at seven. (wake)  
2. Then she \_\_\_\_ her teeth. (brush)  
3. After that he \_\_\_\_ breakfast. (have)  
4. She \_\_\_\_ to bed at ten. (go)  
5. They \_\_\_\_ to work at nine. (go)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **wake**  
2. **brushes**  
3. **has**  
4. **goes**  
5. **go**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Traduce al inglés

1. Primero me despierto a las siete.  
2. Luego me lavo los dientes.  
3. Después desayuno.  
4. Ella se acuesta a las diez.  
5. Me ducho todas las mañanas.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. First I wake up at seven.  
2. Then I brush my teeth.  
3. After that I have breakfast.  
4. She goes to bed at ten.  
5. I have a shower every morning.
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Corrige el error

1. *First I waking up at seven.*  
2. *Then I brush the teeth.*  
3. *She go to bed at ten.*  
4. *I have the shower every morning.*  
5. *After I go to work.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. First I **wake** up at seven.  
2. Then I brush **my** teeth.  
3. She **goes** to bed at ten.  
4. I have **a** shower every morning.  
5. **After that** I go to work.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Ordena las palabras

1. wake / First / I / up / seven / at  
2. brush / Then / teeth / I / my  
3. breakfast / After / have / that / I  
4. bed / goes / She / to / ten / at

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. First I wake up at seven.  
2. Then I brush my teeth.  
3. After that I have breakfast.  
4. She goes to bed at ten.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Elige la opción correcta

1. (First / Then) I wake up — es el inicio.  
2. I (have / has) a shower every morning.  
3. She (go / goes) to work at nine.  
4. I go (to bed / to the bed) at ten.  
5. (After / After that) I have lunch.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **First**  
2. **have**  
3. **goes**  
4. **to bed**  
5. **After that**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Describe tu mañana

Escribe 5 frases con *First, Then, After that* sobre tu mañana real.

**Modelo:**

> First I wake up at seven. Then I have a shower. After that I brush my teeth. Then I get dressed. After that I have breakfast at half past seven.

### Ejercicio 8 — Describe el día de otra persona

Escribe 5 frases sobre un amigo o familiar. Usa *he/she* y al menos un secuenciador.

**Modelo:**

> First she wakes up at six. Then she has a shower. After that she has breakfast. She goes to work at eight. She goes to bed at ten.

### Ejercicio 9 — Une las mitades

1. First I wake up…  
2. Then I brush…  
3. After that I have…  
4. I go to bed…

a) …my teeth.  
b) …at seven o'clock.  
c) …at ten.  
d) …breakfast.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1-b · 2-a · 3-d · 4-c
</details>

### Ejercicio 10 — Mini redacción (80–100 palabras)

Describe tu día completo (mañana, tarde y noche) con secuenciadores y al menos **tres** horas (*at seven*, *at half past seven*…).

**Modelo:**

> First I wake up at seven o'clock. Then I have a shower and brush my teeth. After that I have breakfast at half past seven. I go to work at nine. At one I have lunch. I finish work at six. Then I go home. In the evening I have dinner. After that I read a book. I go to bed at ten o'clock.

---

## 9. Diálogo modelo

> **Leo:** What do you do first in the morning?  
> **Emma:** First I wake up at seven. Then I brush my teeth and have a shower.  
> **Leo:** And after that?  
> **Emma:** After that I have breakfast at half past seven. Then I go to work at nine.  
> **Leo:** What time do you go to bed?  
> **Emma:** I go to bed at ten o'clock.  
> **Leo:** Nice routine! On Sundays I wake up at nine.  
> **Emma:** Lucky you!

---

## 10. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di en voz alta: *wake up, brush my teeth, have a shower, get dressed, have breakfast, go to work, go to bed*.  
2. **4 min** — Cuenta tu mañana con *First / Then / After that*.  
3. **4 min** — Escucha los audios y repite con la misma entonación.  
4. **4 min** — Escribe 6 frases sobre el día de un amigo (*he/she* + secuenciadores).

### Checklist rápido

- [ ] Sé decir 8 acciones de la rutina.  
- [ ] Uso *First, Then, After that* sin pensar.  
- [ ] Conjugo bien *wakes / goes / has* en 3.ª persona.  
- [ ] Combino rutina + hora (*at seven o'clock*).

---

## 11. Consejos para practicar

1. **Graba un audio** de 30–40 segundos contando tu día completo.  
2. **Pega post-its** en el baño: *brush my teeth*, *have a shower*.  
3. **Cambia un detalle cada día**: *First I wake up at 6:30…*  
4. **Combina** con [Unidad 10](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-10-rutinas-diarias-hora) (horas) y [Unidad 12](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana) (días).  
5. Haz los 90 ejercicios de la [Unidad 13 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-13) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-13-rutina-diaria-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Acciones | wake up, brush my teeth, have a shower, have breakfast, go to bed |
| Orden | **First** → **Then** → **After that** |
| Hábitos | Present Simple (*I wake* / *She wakes*) |
| Hora | at seven o'clock / at half past seven |
| Expresiones | have a shower · go to bed · brush **my** teeth |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 14** trabajarás el Present Simple con ***I, you, we, they*** en negativa y preguntas (*don't*, *Do you…?*).

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 13 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-13-rutina-diaria-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 14 — Present Simple: don't y Do you…?](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-14-present-simple-dont-do-you)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [Phrasal verbs para principiantes](/blog/gramatica/phrasal-verbs-principiantes)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

## Fuentes
