<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/dancing.mp3" title="🔊 Dancing"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/cooking.mp3" title="🔊 Cooking"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/running.mp3" title="🔊 Running"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/watching-films.mp3" title="🔊 Watching films"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/listening-to-music.mp3" title="🔊 Listening to music"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/playing-football.mp3" title="🔊 Playing football"></audio>

### Música

| Inglés | Tip |
| :--- | :--- |
| **pop** | popular |
| **rock** | guitarras y batería |
| **jazz** | improvisación |
| **classical** | orquesta |
| **reggae** | de Jamaica |

### Películas

| Inglés | Tip |
| :--- | :--- |
| **comedy** | funny |
| **action** | fights, chases |
| **romance** | love story |
| **horror** | scary |
| **documentary** | real facts |

### Adjetivos útiles para *Because…*

| Inglés | Español |
| :--- | :--- |
| **fun** | divertido |
| **relaxing** | relajante |
| **funny** | gracioso |
| **interesting** | interesante |
| **hard / boring** | difícil / aburrido |
| **scary** | de miedo |

![Vocabulario hobbies música y películas inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/a1-unit18-vocab.png)

### Tips

- *listen **to** music* (hace falta *to*).  
- *play football* (deporte) vs *play **the** guitar* (instrumento).  
- *films* (BrE) ≈ *movies* (AmE); en el curso usamos *films*.

---

## 2. *Like + -ing*

```
sujeto + like(s) / don't like / doesn't like + verbo-ing
```

| Afirmativa | Negativa |
| :--- | :--- |
| I **like reading**. | I **don't like** running. |
| She **likes watching** films. | She **doesn't like** cooking. |
| We **like swimming**. | They **don't like** dancing. |
| He **likes playing** football. | He **doesn't like** cooking. |

**Regla:** tras *like* → forma **-ing**, no infinitivo bare (*read*).  
En A1 priorizamos *like + -ing* para actividades. (Más adelante verás también *like to…*.)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/i-like-reading.mp3" title="🔊 I like reading"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/she-likes-watching.mp3" title="🔊 She likes watching films"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/they-dont-like-dancing.mp3" title="🔊 They don't like dancing"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/he-doesnt-like-cooking.mp3" title="🔊 He doesn't like cooking"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/i-like-listening.mp3" title="🔊 I like listening to music"></audio>

![Esquema like + -ing en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/a1-unit18-like-ing.png)

### Cómo se forma la *-ing* (A1)

| Regla | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| + **-ing** | read → reading, watch → watching |
| *-e* final → quita *e* + *-ing* | dance → dancing, like → liking |
| CVC corto → dobla consonante (común) | swim → swimming, run → running |

No hace falta memorizar todas las excepciones aún: imita las formas del vocabulario de la unidad.

### *Like* + nombre (U17) vs *like* + *-ing* (U18)

| U17 | U18 |
| :--- | :--- |
| I like **cheese**. | I like **reading**. |
| She loves **pasta**. | She likes **watching** films. |
| Do you like **milk**? | Do you like **swimming**? |

---

## 3. Preguntas con *like + -ing*

| Pregunta | Respuesta corta |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Do** you like reading? | Yes, I do. / No, I don't. |
| **Does** she like cooking? | Yes, she does. / No, she doesn't. |
| **Do** they like dancing? | Yes, they do. / No, they don't. |
| What **do** you like doing? | I like swimming. |
| What kind of music **do** you like? | I like pop and rock. |
| Do you like comedy films? | Yes, I do. They're funny. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/what-kind-of-music.mp3" title="🔊 What kind of music do you like?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/i-like-pop-and-rock.mp3" title="🔊 I like pop and rock"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/do-you-like-comedy.mp3" title="🔊 Do you like comedy films?"></audio>

---

## 4. *Why?* y *Because…*

```
Why do you like it? / Why don't you like it?
Because + razón.
```

| Pregunta | Respuesta |
| :--- | :--- |
| Why do you like reading? | **Because** it's relaxing. |
| Why do you like swimming? | **Because** it's fun. |
| Why don't you like running? | **Because** it's hard. |
| Why does she like comedy films? | **Because** they're funny. |

También puedes unir en una sola frase:

> I like swimming **because** it's fun.  
> I don't like cooking **because** it's hard.  
> She likes reading **because** it's relaxing.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/why-do-you-like.mp3" title="🔊 Why do you like it?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/because-its-fun.mp3" title="🔊 Because it's fun"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/because-its-relaxing.mp3" title="🔊 Because it's relaxing"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/i-like-swimming-because.mp3" title="🔊 I like swimming because it's fun"></audio>

![Esquema Why Because en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-18/a1-unit18-why-because.png)

### Mini-mapa de razones

| Actividad | Because… |
| :--- | :--- |
| reading | it's relaxing / interesting |
| swimming / dancing | it's fun |
| comedy films | they're funny |
| horror films | they're scary (I don't like…) |
| cooking | it's interesting / hard |
| running | it's hard / boring (para algunos) |

---

## 5. Más ejemplos en contexto

> I **like reading** books in the evening. Why? **Because** it's relaxing.  
> My sister **likes watching** films. She loves comedy films **because** they're funny.  
> We **like listening to** music. I like pop and rock.  
> Tom **doesn't like cooking**. Why? **Because** it's hard. He likes eating, though!  
> Do you like **playing** football? — Yes, I do. **Because** it's fun.

### Diálogo modelo

> **Ana:** What do you like doing at the weekend?  
> **Luis:** I like reading and listening to music. And you?  
> **Ana:** I like watching films.  
> **Luis:** Why do you like it?  
> **Ana:** Because it's relaxing. Do you like comedy films?  
> **Luis:** Yes, I do. They're funny. I don't like horror films because they're scary.  
> **Ana:** What kind of music do you like?  
> **Luis:** I like pop and rock.  
> **Ana:** Nice! I like dancing too. Why? Because it's fun!

---

## 6. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *I like read* | *I like **reading*** | *like* + *-ing* |
| *She like watching films* | *She **likes** watching films* | 3.ª persona *-s* |
| *I like listen music* | *I like **listening to** music* | *-ing* + *to* |
| *Why you like it?* | *Why **do** you like it?* | Auxiliar *do* |
| *Because fun* | *Because **it's** fun* | Hace falta *it's / they're* |
| *I like play football* | *I like **playing** football* | *-ing* |
| *He don't like cooking* | *He **doesn't** like cooking* | he → *doesn't* |

---

## 7. Pronunciación útil

| Forma | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **-ing** | Termina en /ɪŋ/. No digas solo *-in* al practicar despacio. |
| **because** | A menudo *bi-KOZ* / *bɪˈkɒz*. |
| **why** | Empieza con /w/. |
| **watching / cooking** | *ch* / *ck* claras. |
| **films** | *filmz*. |

Escucha los audios y repite pares: *I like reading* → *Why?* → *Because it's relaxing.*

### Ortografía rápida de *-ing* (para no dudar)

Escribe y di estas cinco formas hasta que salgan solas: *reading, watching, listening, swimming, dancing*. Si una actividad nueva no la conoces, parte del infinitivo (*cook → cooking*, *play → playing*) y comprueba en el diccionario solo si suena raro.

Recuerda: tras *don't like / doesn't like* también va *-ing*: *I don't like running* (no *I don't like run*).

---

## 7b. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Do you like reading?  
> **B:** Yes, I do.  
> **A:** Why do you like it?  
> **B:** Because it's relaxing.

> **A:** Does she like cooking?  
> **B:** No, she doesn't.  
> **A:** Why?  
> **B:** Because it's hard.

> **A:** What kind of music do you like?  
> **B:** I like jazz. I like listening to music because it's fun.

Cambia solo el hobby y el adjetivo: fijas la estructura sin diálogos eternos.

---

## 7c. Plantillas para copiar

1. I like \_\_\_\_ing.  
2. I don't like \_\_\_\_ing because it's \_\_\_\_.  
3. She likes \_\_\_\_ing. Why? Because it's \_\_\_\_.  
4. Do you like \_\_\_\_ing? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.  
5. What kind of music / films do you like? — I like \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> I like reading because it's relaxing.  
> I like swimming because it's fun.  
> She likes watching films. She loves comedy films.  
> They don't like dancing.  
> He doesn't like cooking because it's hard.  
> What kind of music do you like? — I like pop and rock.  
> Do you like comedy films? — Yes, I do. They're funny.

Lee la lista dos veces en voz alta. Luego tapa el inglés y traduce desde el español. Si puedes, grábate y comprueba la *-ing* y *Because it's…*.

### Mapa U14–U18 (gustos)

| Unidad | Aporte |
| :--- | :--- |
| U14–15 | *Do/Does … like…?* + respuestas cortas |
| U17 | *like* + comida; *love/hate* |
| U18 | *like* + *-ing*; *Why? Because…*; hobbies/música/cine |

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> I like playing football because it's fun.  
> She likes listening to classical music because it's relaxing.  
> They don't like watching horror films because they're scary.  
> Why do you like dancing? — Because it's fun.  
> Why doesn't he like cooking? — Because it's hard.  
> What kind of films do you like? — I like action and comedy.

Haz el “triple salto” con un hobby: afirmativa → negativa → pregunta con *Why?*. Ejemplo: *I like swimming.* → *I don't like swimming.* → *Why do you like swimming? Because it's fun.*

Otra rutina de dos minutos: elige tres hobbies reales tuyos y escribe para cada uno *I like …ing because…*. Luego cambia uno a negativa (*I don't like …ing because…*). Así practicas forma y significado a la vez, no solo la lista de verbos. Si estudias con alguien, intercambiad las listas y preguntad *Why?* para forzar la respuesta con *Because*. Repite el intercambio una segunda vez con hobbies distintos.

---

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Completa con el verbo en *-ing*

1. I like \_\_\_\_ (read).  
2. She likes \_\_\_\_ films (watch).  
3. They don't like \_\_\_\_ (dance).  
4. I like \_\_\_\_ to music (listen).  
5. He doesn't like \_\_\_\_ (cook).

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **reading**  
2. **watching**  
3. **dancing**  
4. **listening**  
5. **cooking**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *like / likes / don't like / doesn't like*

1. I \_\_\_\_ reading.  
2. She \_\_\_\_ watching films.  
3. They \_\_\_\_ dancing.  
4. He \_\_\_\_ cooking.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **like**  
2. **likes**  
3. **don't like**  
4. **doesn't like**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — *Why / Because*

1. \_\_\_\_ do you like swimming? — \_\_\_\_ it's fun.  
2. I like reading \_\_\_\_ it's relaxing.  
3. \_\_\_\_ don't you like running? — \_\_\_\_ it's hard.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Why** / **Because**  
2. **because**  
3. **Why** / **Because**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce al inglés

1. Me gusta leer.  
2. A ella le gusta ver películas.  
3. No les gusta bailar.  
4. ¿Por qué te gusta? — Porque es divertido.  
5. ¿Qué tipo de música te gusta? — Me gusta el pop y el rock.  
6. Él no cocina / no le gusta cocinar porque es difícil.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I like reading.  
2. She likes watching films.  
3. They don't like dancing.  
4. Why do you like it? — Because it's fun.  
5. What kind of music do you like? — I like pop and rock.  
6. He doesn't like cooking because it's hard.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. *I like read books.*  
2. *She like watching films.*  
3. *I like listen music.*  
4. *Why you like it?*  
5. *Because fun.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I like **reading** books.  
2. She **likes** watching films.  
3. I like **listening to** music.  
4. Why **do** you like it?  
5. Because **it's** fun.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja

1. comedy  
2. horror  
3. reading  
4. pop / rock  

a) music genres  
b) funny films  
c) scary films  
d) a relaxing hobby

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe sobre ti

Escribe 6–8 frases: 3 hobbies que te gustan (con *because*), 2 que no, y 1 pregunta que harías a un amigo.

**Modelo:**

> I like reading because it's relaxing. I like listening to music because it's fun. I like watching comedy films because they're funny. I don't like running because it's hard. I don't like horror films because they're scary. What kind of music do you like?

---

## 9. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Repite: *I like …ing / I don't like …ing.*  
2. **4 min** — Haz 5 pares *Why? — Because…* en voz alta.  
3. **4 min** — Escucha los audios y actúa el diálogo.  
4. **4 min** — Escribe tu lista de hobbies + géneros favoritos.

### Checklist

- [ ] Uso *like + -ing* (no *like read*)  
- [ ] Formo *She likes / He doesn't like*  
- [ ] Pregunto *Why?* y respondo *Because…*  
- [ ] Sé vocabulario de hobbies, música y cine  
- [ ] Pregunto *What kind of… do you like?*

---

## 10. Consejos para practicar

1. **Haz una tabla** de 8 actividades: 👍 / 👎 + razón en inglés.  
2. **Entrevista** a alguien: *Do you like…? Why?*  
3. **Combina** con U17: comida (*I like cheese*) + hobby (*I like cooking*).  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 19](/curso-a1/unit-19): meses y fechas.  
5. Practica en la [Unidad 18 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-18) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-18-gustos-like-ing-because-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Gustos (actividad) | like / don't like + **-ing** |
| 3.ª persona | She **likes** / He **doesn't** like |
| Razón | **Why?** → **Because** it's fun/relaxing |
| Música | pop, rock, jazz, classical |
| Cine | comedy, action, romance, horror |
| Pregunta | What kind of music/films do you like? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 19** trabajarás **Months & Dates**: meses, ordinales y cumpleaños.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 18 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-18-gustos-like-ing-because-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 19 — Meses y fechas: When is your birthday?](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés para deportes](/blog/metodos/ingles-para-deportes)
- [Inglés en playas y deportes acuáticos](/blog/viajes/ingles-playas-deportes-acuaticos)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Hobbies: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary/hobbies
- British Council — Verb patterns: like + -ing: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/verbs-followed-ing-or-infinitive-1

title: Meses y fechas (A1): in, on y When is your birthday?
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 19 del curso A1: meses del año, ordinales, in + mes, on + fecha, When is your birthday? y I was born…. Con audios, esquemas y ejercicios.
description: Aprende los meses del año, ordinales (1st–31st) y preposiciones in/on para fechas en inglés A1. Guía Unidad 19 con cumpleaños, audios y ejercicios.
alt: Meses del año en inglés nivel A1

faqs.question: ¿Se dice in January o on January?
faqs.answer: Con el mes usamos in: in January, in August. Con la fecha concreta usamos on: on the 15th of March, on the 5th of April. También on + día: on Monday.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo se dice la fecha en inglés A1?
faqs.answer: Formas comunes: the 15th of May / May 15th. Ejemplo: My birthday is on the 5th of April. Los días del mes van en ordinal: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th…

faqs.question: ¿Cómo pregunto el cumpleaños?
faqs.answer: When is your birthday? Respuestas: It's in May. / It's on the 21st of May. También: I was born in February. / I was born on the 15th of March.

faqs.question: ¿Qué vocabulario practico en la Unidad 19?
faqs.answer: Los 12 meses, ordinales 1st–31st, birthday, was born, y fiestas como Christmas, Valentine's Day, Halloween, New Year.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 19 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 19 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

content:
Tras hablar de hobbies en la [Unidad 18](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-18-gustos-like-ing-because), en la **Unidad 19 del curso A1** (*Months & Dates*) aprendes a situar eventos en el **calendario**: meses, **ordinales**, *in* / *on* y la pregunta clave ***When is your birthday?***.

Esta guía cubre los **12 meses**, los **ordinales 1st–31st**, las preposiciones ***in* (mes)** y ***on* (fecha/día)**, y frases de **cumpleaños** y fiestas. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**. Combina bien con los [días de la semana](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana) y los [números](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-8-numeros-edad-precios).

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 19 — Months & Dates](/curso-a1/unit-19)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 12 — Días](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana) · [Unidad 18 — Gustos](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-18-gustos-like-ing-because)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 19 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Nombrar los **12 meses** del año.
- Usar **ordinales** (*first, second, third… 31st*).
- Decir fechas con ***in* + mes** y ***on* + fecha**.
- Preguntar y responder ***When is your birthday?***.
- Usar ***I was born in/on…*** y situar fiestas (*Christmas, Halloween…*).

---

## 1. Vocabulario: los meses del año

| # | Inglés | Español |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | **January** | enero |
| 2 | **February** | febrero |
| 3 | **March** | marzo |
| 4 | **April** | abril |
| 5 | **May** | mayo |
| 6 | **June** | junio |
| 7 | **July** | julio |
| 8 | **August** | agosto |
| 9 | **September** | septiembre |
| 10 | **October** | octubre |
| 11 | **November** | noviembre |
| 12 | **December** | diciembre |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/january.mp3" title="🔊 January"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/february.mp3" title="🔊 February"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/march.mp3" title="🔊 March"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/april.mp3" title="🔊 April"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/may.mp3" title="🔊 May"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/june.mp3" title="🔊 June"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/july.mp3" title="🔊 July"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/august.mp3" title="🔊 August"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/september.mp3" title="🔊 September"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/october.mp3" title="🔊 October"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/november.mp3" title="🔊 November"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/december.mp3" title="🔊 December"></audio>

![Meses del año en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/a1-unit19-months.png)

### Tips de escritura y mayúsculas

- Los meses van con **mayúscula**: *January*, no *january*.  
- No llevan artículo: *in May* (no *in the May*).  
- Abreviaturas comunes: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec.

### Fiestas útiles (mes)

| Fiesta | Mes típico |
| :--- | :--- |
| **New Year** | January |
| **Valentine's Day** | February |
| **Easter** | March or April |
| **Halloween** | October (31st) |
| **Christmas** | December |

---

## 2. Ordinales: 1st–31st

Los días del mes se dicen con **ordinales** (1.º, 2.º, 3.º…).

| Número | Ordinal | Se escribe |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | first | **1st** |
| 2 | second | **2nd** |
| 3 | third | **3rd** |
| 4 | fourth | **4th** |
| 5 | fifth | **5th** |
| 6 | sixth | **6th** |
| 7 | seventh | **7th** |
| 8 | eighth | **8th** |
| 9 | ninth | **9th** |
| 10 | tenth | **10th** |
| 11 | eleventh | **11th** |
| 12 | twelfth | **12th** |
| 13 | thirteenth | **13th** |
| 20 | twentieth | **20th** |
| 21 | twenty-first | **21st** |
| 22 | twenty-second | **22nd** |
| 23 | twenty-third | **23rd** |
| 30 | thirtieth | **30th** |
| 31 | thirty-first | **31st** |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/first.mp3" title="🔊 First"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/second.mp3" title="🔊 Second"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/third.mp3" title="🔊 Third"></audio>

![Ordinales 1st a 31st en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/a1-unit19-ordinals.png)

### Regla práctica

- **1 / 21 / 31** → *-st* (*first / twenty-first / thirty-first*)  
- **2 / 22** → *-nd* (*second / twenty-second*)  
- **3 / 23** → *-rd* (*third / twenty-third*)  
- **El resto** → *-th* (*fourth, fifth, twentieth…*)

En fechas suele ir con **the**: *the 15th of May*.

---

## 3. *In* + mes · *On* + fecha (y día)

| Preposición | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **in** | mes / año | in January · in 2010 |
| **on** | fecha / día de la semana | on the 15th of March · on Monday |

![Esquema in mes y on fecha en inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/a1-unit19-in-on.png)

### Ejemplos con *in*

> My birthday is **in** May.  
> Christmas is **in** December.  
> We have holiday **in** August.  
> New Year is **in** January.  
> I was born **in** February.

### Ejemplos con *on*

> My birthday is **on** the 5th of April.  
> I was born **on** the 15th of March.  
> It's **on** the 3rd of July.  
> Her birthday is **on** the 21st of May.  
> The meeting is **on** Monday.  
> Halloween is **on** the 31st of October.

### Dos formas de decir la fecha (A1)

| Forma | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **the + ordinal + of + month** | the 15th of May |
| **month + ordinal** | May 15th |

Ambas se entienden. En el curso practicas mucho *the 15th of May*.

---

## 4. *When is your birthday?*

```
When is your birthday?
It's in + mes.
It's on the + ordinal + of + mes.
```

| Pregunta / respuesta | Significado |
| :--- | :--- |
| **When is your birthday?** | ¿Cuándo es tu cumpleaños? |
| It's **in** June. | Es en junio. |
| It's **on** the 1st of June. | Es el 1 de junio. |
| When is **his** birthday? | ¿Cuándo es su cumpleaños? |
| It's on the 20th of May. | Es el 20 de mayo. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/when-is-your-birthday.mp3" title="🔊 When is your birthday?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/my-birthday-is-in-may.mp3" title="🔊 My birthday is in May"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/on-the-fifth-of-april.mp3" title="🔊 My birthday is on the fifth of April"></audio>

### *I was born…*

> I **was born** in February.  
> I **was born** on the 15th of March.  
> She was born in July.  
> He was born on the 3rd of December.

*Was born* = nací / nació. En A1 lo usamos como expresión fija con *in/on*.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/i-was-born-in-february.mp3" title="🔊 I was born in February"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-19/christmas-is-in-december.mp3" title="🔊 Christmas is in December"></audio>

---

## 5. Más ejemplos en contexto

> **Ana:** When is your birthday?  
> **Luis:** It's on the 10th of March. And yours?  
> **Ana:** Mine is in August — on the 31st of August.  
> **Luis:** Nice! I was born in February.  
> **Ana:** Christmas is in December. Do you like December?  
> **Luis:** Yes. And Halloween is on the 31st of October. It's fun!

### Calendario mental rápido

> January → New Year  
> February → Valentine's Day  
> March / April → Easter (often)  
> October → Halloween (31st)  
> December → Christmas

### Conectar con otras unidades

> On Monday I have class. (*U12: on + día*)  
> My birthday is on the 5th of April. (*U19: on + fecha*)  
> In May I like swimming. (*U18 + U19*)  
> I was born in 2010. (*in + año*; los números de U8 ayudan)

---

## 6. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *on January* | ***in** January* | Mes → *in* |
| *in the 15th of March* | ***on** the 15th of March* | Fecha → *on* |
| *in Monday* | ***on** Monday* | Día → *on* |
| *My birthday is the May* | *My birthday is **in** May* | Sin *the* con mes |
| *15 March* (solo número cardinal al hablar) | *the **15th** of March* | Ordinal |
| *When your birthday?* | *When **is** your birthday?* | Falta *is* |
| *I born in February* | *I **was** born in February* | *was born* |

---

## 7. Pronunciación útil

| Forma | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **January / February** | *Jan-yu-eri* / *Feb-ru-eri* (a veces se “come” una sílaba). |
| **February** | Practica despacio: *Feb-ru-ary*. |
| **first / third** | *-st / -rd* claras. |
| **birthday** | *BERTH-day*. |
| **the 15th** | Di *the fifteenth*. |

Escucha los 12 meses en orden y repítelos dos veces. Luego di tu cumpleaños completo en voz alta.

### Truco de memoria para ordinales

Memoriza primero el “núcleo raro”: *first, second, third, fifth, eighth, ninth, twelfth*. El resto suele ser número + *-th* (*sixth, tenth, fourteenth*). Para el 21–23 y el 31, repite la misma lógica del 1–3: *twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third, thirty-first*.

Practica en voz alta cinco fechas reales de tu vida (cumpleaños, fiestas, inicio de curso). Si las dices cada día durante una semana, *in/on* deja de confundirse.

---

## 7b. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** When is your birthday?  
> **B:** It's in May.  
> **A:** What date?  
> **B:** On the 21st of May.

> **A:** When were you born? / When is your birthday?  
> **B:** I was born on the 3rd of July.  
> **A:** Nice! I was born in December.

> **A:** When is Christmas?  
> **B:** It's in December.  
> **A:** And Halloween?  
> **B:** On the 31st of October.

Cambia solo el mes y el ordinal: fijas *in/on* sin memorizar diálogos largos.

---

## 7c. Plantillas para copiar

1. My birthday is in \_\_\_\_.  
2. My birthday is on the \_\_\_\_ of \_\_\_\_.  
3. I was born in \_\_\_\_. / I was born on the \_\_\_\_ of \_\_\_\_.  
4. When is your birthday? — It's on the \_\_\_\_ of \_\_\_\_.  
5. Christmas is in \_\_\_\_. Halloween is on the \_\_\_\_ of \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> January is the first month. December is the twelfth month.  
> My birthday is in June.  
> My birthday is on the first of June.  
> She was born on the 15th of March.  
> We have holiday in August.  
> The meeting is on Monday.  
> Valentine's Day is in February.  
> When is your birthday? — It's on the 20th of May.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego tapa el inglés y traduce desde el español. Grábate diciendo **tu** fecha real: es la frase más útil de la unidad.

### Mapa *in / on / at* (A1, versión corta)

| Preposición | Tiempo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **in** | meses, años, partes del día (*in the morning*) |
| **on** | fechas, días de la semana |
| **at** | horas (*at eight*) — de U10 |

No mezcles: *in May* / *on May 5th* / *at 5 o'clock*.

### Rutina rápida de 2 minutos

1. Di los meses 1–6.  
2. Di los meses 7–12.  
3. Di: *My birthday is in …* y *My birthday is on the … of …*.  
4. Pregunta en voz alta: *When is your birthday?* y responde por 3 personas (tú, un amigo, un familiar).

Si puedes, escribe esas cuatro líneas en una nota del móvil y léelas mañana otra vez.

---

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — *in* o *on*

1. My birthday is \_\_\_\_ May.  
2. My birthday is \_\_\_\_ the 5th of April.  
3. Christmas is \_\_\_\_ December.  
4. The meeting is \_\_\_\_ Monday.  
5. I was born \_\_\_\_ February.  
6. Halloween is \_\_\_\_ the 31st of October.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **in**  
2. **on**  
3. **in**  
4. **on**  
5. **in**  
6. **on**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Ordinales

Escribe el ordinal: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 21, 22, 23, 31.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 21st, 22nd, 23rd, 31st
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa

1. \_\_\_\_ is your birthday?  
2. It's on the \_\_\_\_ of March. (10)  
3. I was \_\_\_\_ in July.  
4. November is the \_\_\_\_ month. (11)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **When**  
2. **10th** / **tenth**  
3. **born**  
4. **11th** / **eleventh**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce al inglés

1. ¿Cuándo es tu cumpleaños?  
2. Es en mayo.  
3. Es el 5 de abril.  
4. Nací en febrero.  
5. La Navidad es en diciembre.  
6. Halloween es el 31 de octubre.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. When is your birthday?  
2. It's in May.  
3. It's on the 5th of April.  
4. I was born in February.  
5. Christmas is in December.  
6. Halloween is on the 31st of October.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. *My birthday is on January.*  
2. *I was born in the 15th of March.*  
3. *When your birthday?*  
4. *Christmas is on December.*  
5. *The meeting is in Monday.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. My birthday is **in** January.  
2. I was born **on** the 15th of March.  
3. When **is** your birthday?  
4. Christmas is **in** December.  
5. The meeting is **on** Monday.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja mes y fiesta / dato

1. January  
2. February  
3. October  
4. December  

a) Christmas  
b) New Year  
c) Valentine's Day  
d) Halloween

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **c** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **a**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe sobre ti y tu familia

Escribe 6–8 frases: tu cumpleaños (mes y fecha), cuándo naciste, y el cumpleaños de 2 personas. Añade una fiesta.

**Modelo:**

> My birthday is in May. It's on the 12th of May. I was born on the 12th of May. My sister's birthday is in August — on the 3rd of August. My dad was born in January. Christmas is in December. Halloween is on the 31st of October. When is your birthday?

---

## 9. Diálogo modelo

> **Tom:** When is your birthday?  
> **Sara:** It's on the 7th of April. And yours?  
> **Tom:** Mine is in September. I was born on the 22nd of September.  
> **Sara:** Nice! Do you like September?  
> **Tom:** Yes. And I like December because Christmas is in December.  
> **Sara:** True. Valentine's Day is in February.  
> **Tom:** And Halloween is on the 31st of October — fun!  
> **Sara:** When is your mum's birthday?  
> **Tom:** It's on the 1st of June.

---

## 10. Plan de práctica (15 minutos)

1. **3 min** — Di los 12 meses en orden (con audio).  
2. **4 min** — Practica ordinales: 1st–10th y 21st–23rd, 31st.  
3. **4 min** — Di 6 frases *in* / *on* (meses vs fechas).  
4. **4 min** — Pregunta y responde *When is your birthday?* con 3 personas inventadas.

### Checklist

- [ ] Sé los 12 meses (con mayúscula)  
- [ ] Sé 1st, 2nd, 3rd y el patrón *-th*  
- [ ] Uso *in* + mes y *on* + fecha/día  
- [ ] Pregunto *When is your birthday?*  
- [ ] Uso *I was born in/on…*

---

## 11. Consejos para practicar

1. **Escribe** en el calendario del móvil 5 fechas en inglés (*the 3rd of July*).  
2. **Pregunta** a amigos: *When is your birthday?* y anota respuestas.  
3. **Combina** con U12: *On Saturday the 5th of April…*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 20](/curso-a1/unit-20): repaso del Módulo 2.  
5. Practica en la [Unidad 19 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-19) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Meses | January… December (mayúscula) |
| Ordinales | 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th… 31st |
| Mes | **in** May |
| Fecha / día | **on** the 5th of April / **on** Monday |
| Cumpleaños | When is your birthday? |
| Nacer | I was born in/on… |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 20** harás el **Module 2 Review**: repaso de rutinas, Present Simple, cafetería, comidas, gustos y fechas.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 19 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 20 — Repaso Módulo 2](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-20-repaso-modulo-2)

Guías relacionadas:

- [Gramática inglesa: guía por niveles](/blog/gramatica/gramatica-inglesa-guia)
- [A2 U8 — Preposiciones de tiempo (at/on/in)](/blog/curso-a2/unidad-8-preposiciones-tiempo-at-on-in)
- [Inglés A1: guía para empezar](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---

## Fuentes

- CEFR/MCER — Nivel A1: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages
- British Council — Months: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary/months-of-the-year
- British Council — Ordinal numbers: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/vocabulary/a1-a2-vocabulary/ordinal-numbers
- British Council — Prepositions of time: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/a1-a2-grammar/prepositions-time

title: Repaso Módulo 2 (A1): rutinas, gustos, cafetería y fechas
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 20 del curso A1: repaso del Módulo 2 (rutinas, Present Simple, cafetería, comidas, gustos y fechas) con checklist, audios, esquemas y ejercicios.
description: Repasa el Módulo 2 del curso A1: Present Simple, hora, días, cafetería, comidas, like + -ing y fechas. Guía Unidad 20 con checklist, audios y ejercicios.
alt: Mapa de repaso del Módulo 2 del curso A1
keywords: can I have I'd like review

faqs.question: ¿Qué repasa la Unidad 20 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: Es el Module 2 Review: Present Simple (don't/doesn't, Do/Does), hora y días, pedir en la cafetería, comidas, like + -ing con Why? Because…, y fechas con in/on.

faqs.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre in, on y at en este módulo?
faqs.answer: in + mes/año (in May), on + día/fecha (on Monday, on the 5th of April), at + hora (at seven, at half past eight).

faqs.question: ¿Cómo elijo don't o doesn't / Do o Does?
faqs.answer: I/you/we/they → don't / Do. He/she/it → doesn't / Does. Tras don't/doesn't y Do/Does el verbo va en forma base.

faqs.question: ¿Qué guías del blog debo revisar antes del repaso?
faqs.answer: Unidades 11–19 del blog curso-a1: lugares, días, rutina, don't/doesn't, cafetería, comidas, like + -ing y meses/fechas.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 20 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 20 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

content:
La **Unidad 20 del curso A1** (*Module 2 Review*) cierra el Módulo 2: **vida diaria y rutinas**. No introduce gramática nueva: **consolida** lo de las unidades 11–19 para que puedas describir un día, pedir en un café, hablar de gustos y situar fechas sin dudar.

Esta guía es un **mapa de repaso** con tablas, checklist, audios y ejercicios. Úsala para detectar huecos y volver a la unidad concreta si algo falla.

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 20 — Module 2 Review](/curso-a1/unit-20)  
> **Última unidad del módulo:** [Unidad 19 — Meses y fechas](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos)

---

## Qué deberías poder hacer al terminar el Módulo 2

- Describir **lugares** (*There is/are*) y **días** (*on Monday*).  
- Contar una **rutina** (*First / Then / After that*) con hora (*at seven*).  
- Usar **Present Simple** completo: afirmativa, *don't/doesn't*, *Do/Does…?*.  
- Pedir en un café: *Can I have…? / I'd like…*.  
- Hablar de **comidas** y gustos: *have breakfast*, *like + -ing*, *Why? Because…*.  
- Decir **meses, fechas y cumpleaños** (*in May / on the 10th of May*).

![Mapa de repaso del Módulo 2 A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/a1-unit20-module-map.png)

---

## Mapa rápido del Módulo 2 (U11–U19)

| U | Tema | Idea clave | Guía |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 11 | Places in Town | There is/are | [Lugares](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad) |
| 12 | Days of the Week | on + día | [Días](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-12-dias-semana) |
| 13 | Daily Routine | First / Then / After that | [Rutina](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-13-rutina-diaria) |
| 14 | I/you/we/they | don't / Do you…? | [don't](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-14-present-simple-dont-do-you) |
| 15 | He/she/it | doesn't / Does…? | [doesn't](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-15-present-simple-doesnt-does) |
| 16 | At the Cafe | Can I have…? / I'd like… | [Cafetería](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-16-cafeteria-can-i-have-id-like) |
| 17 | Meals | have breakfast; contable/incontable | [Comidas](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-17-comidas-breakfast-lunch-dinner) |
| 18 | Likes | like + -ing; Why? Because… | [Gustos](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-18-gustos-like-ing-because) |
| 19 | Dates | in + mes; on + fecha | [Fechas](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos) |

---

## 1. Present Simple: el núcleo del módulo

| | I / you / we / they | he / she / it |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Afirmativa | I **get up** at seven. | She **gets up** at seven. |
| Negativa | I **don't** like cooking. | He **doesn't** like reading. |
| Pregunta | **Do** you like music? | **Does** she like music? |
| Sí / No | Yes, I **do**. / No, I **don't**. | Yes, she **does**. / No, she **doesn't**. |

![Repaso Present Simple don't doesn't Do Does A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/a1-unit20-present-simple.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/i-get-up-at-seven.mp3" title="🔊 I get up at seven"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/she-has-breakfast.mp3" title="🔊 She has breakfast at eight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/they-dont-like-cooking.mp3" title="🔊 They don't like cooking"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/he-doesnt-like-reading.mp3" title="🔊 He doesn't like reading"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/does-she-like-music.mp3" title="🔊 Does she like music?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/yes-i-do.mp3" title="🔊 Yes, I do"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/no-she-doesnt.mp3" title="🔊 No, she doesn't"></audio>

### Checklist Present Simple

- [ ] Tras *don't/doesn't* y *Do/Does* → verbo **sin -s**  
- [ ] No mezclo *don't* con *he/she/it*  
- [ ] Respuestas cortas con *do/does/don't/doesn't*

---

## 2. Tiempo: *in / on / at*

| Preposición | Uso | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **at** | hora | at seven · at half past eight |
| **on** | día / fecha | on Monday · on the 10th of May |
| **in** | mes / año / parte del día* | in May · in December · in the morning |

\* *in the morning / afternoon / evening* (pero *at night*).

![Repaso in on at tiempo inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/a1-unit20-in-on-at.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/we-have-dinner-at.mp3" title="🔊 We have dinner at half past eight"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/on-saturday-i-dont-work.mp3" title="🔊 On Saturday I don't work"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/my-birthday-is-on.mp3" title="🔊 My birthday is on the tenth of May"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/christmas-is-in-december.mp3" title="🔊 Christmas is in December"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/i-have-lunch-at-one.mp3" title="🔊 I have lunch at one o'clock"></audio>

### Mini-test mental

> I get up **at** seven.  
> I don't work **on** Saturday.  
> My birthday is **in** May / **on** the 10th of May.  
> Christmas is **in** December.

---

## 3. Rutina diaria + secuenciadores

> **First** I wake up. **Then** I have breakfast. **After that** I go to work.  
> I get up at seven. She has breakfast at eight. We have dinner at half past eight.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/first-then-after-that.mp3" title="🔊 First Then After that"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/what-do-you-do-on-monday.mp3" title="🔊 What do you do on Monday?"></audio>

### Lugares (repaso express U11)

> There is a bank near here.  
> There are two parks in my town.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/there-is-a-bank.mp3" title="🔊 There is a bank near here"></audio>

---

## 4. Cafetería: pedir con educación

| Pedido | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Can I have…, please?** | Can I have a coffee, please? |
| **I'd like…** | I'd like a sandwich. |
| Oferta | Would you like something to drink? |
| Precio / cuenta | How much is it? / Can I have the bill, please? |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/can-i-have-a-coffee.mp3" title="🔊 Can I have a coffee, please?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/id-like-a-sandwich.mp3" title="🔊 I'd like a sandwich"></audio>

---

## 5. Comidas y gustos

### Comidas del día

> I **have breakfast** at seven.  
> She **has lunch** at one.  
> We **have dinner** at half past eight.  
> I like cheese. She doesn't like meat. (*U17*)

### *Like + -ing* + *Why? Because…*

> I **like swimming because** it's fun.  
> I **like reading**. Why? **Because** it's relaxing.  
> They **don't like cooking**.  
> What kind of music do you like? — I like pop and rock.

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/i-like-swimming-because.mp3" title="🔊 I like swimming because it's fun"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/why-do-you-like-it.mp3" title="🔊 Why do you like it?"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-20/because-its-relaxing.mp3" title="🔊 Because it's relaxing"></audio>

---

## 6. Texto modelo de repaso (todo junto)

> I get up at seven o'clock. First I have breakfast — toast and milk. Then I go to work. On Saturday I don't work. I like reading because it's relaxing. I don't like running.  
> At the cafe I say: Can I have a coffee, please? I'd like a sandwich too.  
> My birthday is on the 10th of May. Christmas is in December.  
> There is a park near my house. What do you do on Monday?

Léelo en voz alta. Luego tapa el texto y reconstruye 6–8 frases con tu vida real.

### Cómo usar este repaso (método corto)

1. Haz el checklist del Present Simple.  
2. Completa las plantillas con datos tuyos.  
3. Escucha 8–10 audios y repite.  
4. Escribe tu “página de módulo” (ejercicio 6).  
5. Marca en la autoevaluación qué bloque falló y vuelve solo a esa guía.

No hace falta releer las nueve unidades enteras si solo fallas en *in/on* o en *doesn't*: el mapa del principio te lleva al artículo exacto.

---

## 7. Errores típicos del Módulo 2 (repaso)

| ❌ | ✅ |
| :--- | :--- |
| *He don't like reading* | He **doesn't** like reading |
| *Do she like music?* | **Does** she like music? |
| *I like swim* | I like **swimming** |
| *My birthday is in the 10th of May* | … **on** the 10th of May |
| *on January* | **in** January |
| *at Monday* | **on** Monday |
| *Give me a coffee* | **Can I have** a coffee, please? |
| *I eat breakfast* (único foco) | I **have** breakfast |

---

## 8. Diálogo modelo de cierre

> **Ana:** What do you do on Monday?  
> **Luis:** I get up at seven. I have breakfast at half past seven. Then I go to work.  
> **Ana:** Do you like your job?  
> **Luis:** Yes, I do. I like working with people because it's fun.  
> **Ana:** Nice! Would you like a coffee?  
> **Luis:** Yes — can I have a coffee and a sandwich, please?  
> **Ana:** When is your birthday?  
> **Luis:** On the 10th of May. And yours?  
> **Ana:** In August — on the 3rd of August.  
> **Luis:** Cool. On Saturday I don't work. I like reading and watching films.

---

## 9. Mini-diálogos por bloque

### Rutina

> **A:** What time do you get up?  
> **B:** At seven. First I have breakfast. After that I go to work.

### Gustos

> **A:** Do you like swimming?  
> **B:** Yes, I do. Why? Because it's fun.  
> **A:** Does she like cooking?  
> **B:** No, she doesn't.

### Café

> **A:** Can I have a tea, please?  
> **B:** Would you like something to eat?  
> **A:** I'd like a sandwich.

### Fechas

> **A:** When is your birthday?  
> **B:** It's on the 15th of March. Christmas is in December.

Practica un bloque al día durante cuatro días: rutina → gustos → café → fechas.

---

## 10. Plantillas para autocompletar

1. I get up at \_\_\_\_. I have breakfast at \_\_\_\_.  
2. On \_\_\_\_ I don't work.  
3. I like \_\_\_\_ing because it's \_\_\_\_.  
4. I don't like \_\_\_\_ing.  
5. Can I have a \_\_\_\_, please? / I'd like a \_\_\_\_.  
6. My birthday is in \_\_\_\_ / on the \_\_\_\_ of \_\_\_\_.  
7. There is a \_\_\_\_ near my house.

### Frases extra para memorizar

> I get up at seven o'clock.  
> She has lunch at one.  
> They don't like cooking.  
> Does he like reading? — No, he doesn't.  
> Can I have a coffee, please?  
> I'd like a sandwich.  
> I like swimming because it's fun.  
> My birthday is on the tenth of May.  
> On Saturday I don't work.  
> Christmas is in December.

Lee la lista dos veces. Luego escribe tu versión personal (mismas estructuras, tus datos). Si algo te cuesta, vuelve a la guía de esa unidad antes de seguir.

### Conexión U10–U19 (tiempo y hábitos)

Si ya viste horas en unidades anteriores, este módulo las une con días, meses y hábitos:

> at seven (hora) · on Monday (día) · in May (mes) · on the 10th of May (fecha)  
> I have breakfast at seven on Monday.  
> My birthday is on the 10th of May. In August we have holiday.

Esa “escalera” de preposiciones es una de las piezas más útiles para salir del Módulo 2 con seguridad.

---

## 11. Ejercicios de repaso (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — *don't / doesn't / Do / Does*

1. They \_\_\_\_ like cooking.  
2. He \_\_\_\_ like reading.  
3. \_\_\_\_ you like music?  
4. \_\_\_\_ she like music?

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **don't**  
2. **doesn't**  
3. **Do**  
4. **Does**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — *in / on / at*

1. I get up \_\_\_\_ seven.  
2. I don't work \_\_\_\_ Saturday.  
3. My birthday is \_\_\_\_ May.  
4. My birthday is \_\_\_\_ the 10th of May.  
5. Christmas is \_\_\_\_ December.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **at**  
2. **on**  
3. **in**  
4. **on**  
5. **in**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Completa

1. First I wake up. \_\_\_\_ I have breakfast. \_\_\_\_ that I go to work.  
2. Can I \_\_\_\_ a coffee, please?  
3. I \_\_\_\_ like swimming because it's fun.  
4. She \_\_\_\_ lunch at one.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **Then** / **After**  
2. **have**  
3. **like** (*I like swimming…*)  
4. **has**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce

1. Me levanto a las siete.  
2. Ella no lee / no le gusta leer.  
3. ¿Qué haces el lunes?  
4. Me gustaría un bocadillo.  
5. Mi cumpleaños es el 10 de mayo.  
6. Me gusta nadar porque es divertido.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. I get up at seven (o'clock).  
2. She doesn't like reading.  
3. What do you do on Monday?  
4. I'd like a sandwich.  
5. My birthday is on the 10th of May.  
6. I like swimming because it's fun.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige

1. *He don't like films.*  
2. *I like swim.*  
3. *My birthday is in the 5th of April.*  
4. *Give me a tea.*  
5. *Does you like music?*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. He **doesn't** like films.  
2. I like **swimming**.  
3. My birthday is **on** the 5th of April.  
4. **Can I have** a tea, please? / **I'd like** a tea.  
5. **Do** you like music?
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Escribe tu “página de módulo”

Escribe 10–12 frases que junten: rutina + un día de la semana + un pedido de café + 2 gustos con *because* + tu cumpleaños.

**Modelo breve:**

> I get up at seven. On Monday I go to work. I have lunch at one. I like reading because it's relaxing. I don't like running. At the cafe I say: Can I have a coffee, please? I'd like a cookie too. My birthday is on the 12th of May. In August we have holiday. There is a park near my house.

### Ejercicio 7 — Autoevaluación rápida

Marca ✅ o ❌:

1. Sé usar *don't* y *doesn't*.  
2. Sé preguntar con *Do/Does*.  
3. Distingo *in / on / at*.  
4. Puedo pedir en un café con *please*.  
5. Uso *like + -ing* y *Because…*.  
6. Sé decir mi cumpleaños en inglés.

Si marcas ❌ en alguno, vuelve a la guía de esa unidad (tabla del mapa) 10 minutos y rehaz solo ese bloque.

---

## 12. Plan de repaso (30–40 minutos)

1. **8 min** — Present Simple: 10 frases (afirmativa / negativa / pregunta).  
2. **6 min** — *in / on / at*: 8 frases de tiempo.  
3. **6 min** — Diálogo de cafetería en voz alta.  
4. **6 min** — Gustos: 5 *like + -ing* + *because*.  
5. **6 min** — Fechas y cumpleaños.  
6. **resto** — Escribe el texto modelo personalizado y léelo.

### Checklist final del Módulo 2

- [ ] Rutina con hora y secuenciadores  
- [ ] Present Simple completo (I… / he…)  
- [ ] Días (*on*) y fin de semana  
- [ ] Pedidos educados en el café  
- [ ] Comidas: *have breakfast/lunch/dinner*  
- [ ] *like + -ing* + *Why? Because…*  
- [ ] Meses, ordinales, *When is your birthday?*  
- [ ] *There is/are* básico

---

## 13. Consejos antes del Módulo 3

1. **No memorices todo el módulo de una vez**: repasa por bloques (tabla U11–U19).  
2. **Habla**: 2 minutos al día describiendo tu día en inglés.  
3. **Grábate** el diálogo de cafetería + tu cumpleaños.  
4. Si un error se repite, vuelve a la unidad madre (no solo a este repaso).  
5. Cuando estés listo, sigue a la [Unidad 21](/curso-a1/unit-21): *Rooms in a House* (Módulo 3), o practica el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-20-repaso-modulo-2-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Bloque | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Present Simple | don't/doesn't · Do/Does · -s en 3.ª |
| Tiempo | at hora · on día/fecha · in mes |
| Rutina | First / Then / After that |
| Café | Can I have…? / I'd like… |
| Gustos | like + -ing · Because… |
| Fechas | When is your birthday? |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

Empieza el **Módulo 3 — My World** con la **Unidad 21**: habitaciones de la casa.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 20 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-20-repaso-modulo-2-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 21 — Habitaciones de la casa](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-21-habitaciones-casa)

Guías del Módulo 2 para volver atrás:

- [Unidad 19 — Meses y fechas](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-19-meses-fechas-cumpleanos)
- [Unidad 18 — like + -ing](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-18-gustos-like-ing-because)
- [Unidad 16 — Cafetería](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-16-cafeteria-can-i-have-id-like)
- [Unidad 15 — doesn't](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-15-present-simple-doesnt-does)
- [Unidad 14 — don't](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-14-present-simple-dont-do-you)
- [Inglés A1: Guía para Empezar desde Cero](/blog/metodos/ingles-a1)

---


Guías relacionadas:

- [Inglés en restaurantes y bares](/blog/viajes/ingles-restaurantes-bares-viaje)

title: Habitaciones de la Casa en Inglés A1: Rooms y Vocabulario
author: linguafly-team
excerpt: Guía de la Unidad 21 del curso A1: rooms in a house, plurales (rooms, bedrooms), adjetivos (bright, cozy, small) y have/has para describir tu casa. Con audios, esquemas y ejercicios.
description: Aprende habitaciones de la casa en inglés A1: kitchen, living room, bedroom y bathroom, con vocabulario, plurales y ejercicios para practicar.
alt: Vocabulario de habitaciones de la casa en inglés A1
keywords: how many rooms does your flat have

faqs.question: ¿Cuáles son las habitaciones básicas en inglés A1?
faqs.answer: Kitchen (cocina), living room (salón), bedroom (dormitorio), bathroom (baño), dining room (comedor), hall (recibidor/pasillo), garden (jardín). También balcony, garage y stairs.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo describo una habitación con adjetivos?
faqs.answer: The + room + is + adjective: The kitchen is bright. The living room is cozy. The bathroom is small but clean. Adjetivos útiles: bright, small, cozy, modern, large, clean.

faqs.question: ¿Cómo digo cuántas habitaciones tengo?
faqs.answer: We have three bedrooms. My house has four rooms. There are two bathrooms upstairs. Pregunta: How many rooms does your flat have?

faqs.question: ¿House o flat?
faqs.answer: House = casa (a menudo con jardín). Flat (BrE) / apartment (AmE) = piso. En A1 ambas sirven: My flat has three rooms. / My house has a garden.

faqs.question: ¿Dónde practico la Unidad 21 del curso A1?
faqs.answer: En la Unidad 21 del curso A1 de Linguafly y en el cuaderno de ejercicios con soluciones del blog: gramática, vocabulario, reading, listening y writing.

content:
Tras el [repaso del Módulo 2](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-20-repaso-modulo-2), empieza el **Módulo 3 — My World**. En la **Unidad 21 del curso A1** (*Rooms in a House*) aprendes a **nombrar y describir** las habitaciones de una casa o piso.

Esta guía cubre el **vocabulario de rooms**, los **plurales** (*rooms, bedrooms*), los **adjetivos** (*bright, cozy, small…*) y frases con ***have / has*** y *There is/are*. Incluye **audios**, **esquemas** y **ejercicios**. Es la base para hablar de muebles (U22) y de *there is/are* con más detalle (U23).

> **Practica en el curso:** [Unidad 21 — Rooms in a House](/curso-a1/unit-21)  
> **Repaso útil:** [Unidad 11 — Lugares](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-11-lugares-ciudad) · [Unidad 4 — Plurales](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-4-articulos-plurales-demostrativos)

---

## Qué aprenderás en la Unidad 21 (A1)

Al terminar esta unidad serás capaz de:

- Nombrar las **habitaciones** principales de una casa.
- Usar **plurales**: *rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms*.
- Describir con adjetivos: ***bright, small, cozy, modern, large, clean***.
- Decir qué **tiene** tu casa: *We have… / My house has…*.
- Preguntar ***How many rooms does your flat have?***.

---

## 1. Vocabulario: habitaciones y espacios

| Inglés | Español | Uso típico |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **kitchen** | cocina | cook food |
| **living room** | salón | sofa, TV |
| **bedroom** | dormitorio | sleep / bed |
| **bathroom** | baño | shower, toilet |
| **dining room** | comedor | have dinner |
| **hall** | recibidor / pasillo | near the door |
| **garden** | jardín | plants, outside |
| **balcony** | balcón | small area outside |
| **garage** | garaje | for the car |
| **stairs** | escaleras | go up and down |
| **house** | casa | often with garden |
| **flat** | piso (BrE) | apartment (AmE) |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/kitchen.mp3" title="🔊 Kitchen"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/living-room.mp3" title="🔊 Living room"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/bedroom.mp3" title="🔊 Bedroom"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/bathroom.mp3" title="🔊 Bathroom"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/dining-room.mp3" title="🔊 Dining room"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/hall.mp3" title="🔊 Hall"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/garden.mp3" title="🔊 Garden"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/balcony.mp3" title="🔊 Balcony"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/garage.mp3" title="🔊 Garage"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/stairs.mp3" title="🔊 Stairs"></audio>

![Vocabulario rooms in a house inglés A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/a1-unit21-rooms.png)

### Tips

- *living room* = dos palabras (también *sitting room* en algunos sitios).  
- *bathroom* ≠ solo “baño con bañera”: incluye ducha y aseo.  
- *upstairs / downstairs* = arriba / abajo.  
- *flat* (UK) ≈ *apartment* (US).

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/i-sleep-in-the-bedroom.mp3" title="🔊 I sleep in the bedroom"></audio>

---

## 2. Plurales: *rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms*

| Singular | Plural |
| :--- | :--- |
| room | **rooms** |
| bedroom | **bedrooms** |
| bathroom | **bathrooms** |
| kitchen | kitchens |
| garden | gardens |

> We have **three bedrooms**.  
> There are **two bathrooms** upstairs.  
> How many **rooms** does your flat have?

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/we-have-three-bedrooms.mp3" title="🔊 We have three bedrooms"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/there-are-two-bathrooms.mp3" title="🔊 There are two bathrooms upstairs"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/how-many-rooms.mp3" title="🔊 How many rooms does your flat have?"></audio>

![Plurales rooms bedrooms y have has A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/a1-unit21-plurals.png)

### *Have / has* para describir la casa

| Sujeto | Verbo | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| I / you / we / they | **have** | We **have** a kitchen and a living room. |
| he / she / it / my house | **has** | My house **has** four rooms. |

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/we-have-a-kitchen.mp3" title="🔊 We have a kitchen and a living room"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/my-house-has-four-rooms.mp3" title="🔊 My house has four rooms"></audio>

También con *There is/are* (repaso U11):

> There **is** a kitchen downstairs.  
> There **are** two bedrooms upstairs.

---

## 3. Adjetivos para describir habitaciones

```
The + room + is + adjective
The + room + is + adjective + and + adjective
```

| Adjetivo | Significado | Ejemplo |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **bright** | luminoso/a | The kitchen is bright. |
| **small** | pequeño/a | The bathroom is small. |
| **cozy** | acogedor/a | The living room is cozy. |
| **modern** | moderno/a | The kitchen is modern. |
| **large / big** | grande | The garden is big. |
| **clean** | limpio/a | The bathroom is clean. |

![Adjetivos bright cozy small para rooms A1](/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/a1-unit21-adjectives.png)

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/the-kitchen-is-bright.mp3" title="🔊 The kitchen is bright and modern"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/the-living-room-is-cozy.mp3" title="🔊 The living room is very cozy"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/the-bathroom-is-small.mp3" title="🔊 The bathroom is small but clean"></audio>

<audio controls preload="none" src="/audio/blog/curso-a1/unit-21/the-garden-is-big.mp3" title="🔊 The garden is big"></audio>

### Combinaciones útiles

> The kitchen is **bright and modern**.  
> The bathroom is **small but clean**.  
> The living room is **very cozy**.  
> The garden is **large**.  
> My bedroom is **small but bright**.

En inglés el adjetivo **no cambia** con género ni número: *a small room / two small rooms* (*small*, no *smalls*).

---

## 4. Preguntas útiles

| Pregunta | Respuesta modelo |
| :--- | :--- |
| How many rooms does your flat have? | It has three rooms. |
| How many bedrooms do you have? | We have two bedrooms. |
| Is your kitchen big? | No, it's small but bright. |
| Do you have a garden? | Yes, we do. / No, we don't. |
| Where do you sleep? | In the bedroom. |
| Is the living room cozy? | Yes, it is. |

---

## 5. Más ejemplos en contexto

> My flat has four rooms. We have a kitchen, a living room, a bedroom and a bathroom. The kitchen is bright and modern. The living room is very cozy. The bathroom is small but clean. There isn't a garden, but there is a balcony.

> My house has five rooms. There are three bedrooms upstairs and two bathrooms. Downstairs there is a kitchen and a living room. The garden is big. The hall is small.

### Diálogo modelo

> **Ana:** How many rooms does your flat have?  
> **Luis:** It has four rooms. We have a kitchen, a living room, a bedroom and a bathroom.  
> **Ana:** Is the kitchen big?  
> **Luis:** No, it's small, but it's bright and modern.  
> **Ana:** And the living room?  
> **Luis:** It's very cozy. We have a sofa and a TV.  
> **Ana:** Do you have a garden?  
> **Luis:** No, we don't. We have a balcony.  
> **Ana:** Nice! My house has a big garden.

---

## 6. Errores típicos de hispanohablantes

| ❌ Incorrecto | ✅ Correcto | Explicación |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| *The kitchen is brights* | *The kitchen is **bright*** | Adjetivo sin -s |
| *We has three bedrooms* | *We **have** three bedrooms* | we → have |
| *My house have four rooms* | *My house **has** four rooms* | house → has |
| *There is two bathrooms* | *There **are** two bathrooms* | plural → are |
| *livingroom* (junto) | ***living room*** | Dos palabras |
| *How many rooms your flat have?* | *How many rooms **does** your flat have?* | Auxiliar *does* |
| *The rooms is small* | *The rooms **are** small* | plural → are |

---

## 7. Pronunciación útil

| Forma | Tip A1 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **kitchen** | *KICH-ən*. |
| **living room** | Acento en *liv-*. |
| **bedroom** | *BED-room* (dos partes claras). |
| **bathroom** | *BATH-room* (BrE /ɑː/ o AmE /æ/). |
| **cozy / cosy** | *CO-zi* (AmE *cozy*, BrE a menudo *cosy*). |
| **bright** | Diptongo /aɪ/. |

Escucha los nombres de las habitaciones y luego las frases completas. Repite: *The kitchen is bright and modern.*

### House vs flat (nota rápida)

Si vives en un **piso**, di *flat* (Reino Unido) o *apartment* (EE. UU.). Si es una **casa** con entradas propias y a menudo jardín, di *house*. Las habitaciones son las mismas; cambia el contenedor:

> My **flat** has three rooms. There isn't a garden.  
> My **house** has five rooms and a big garden.

En preguntas, *How many rooms does your flat/house have?* funciona igual.

---

## 7b. Mini-diálogos para memorizar

> **A:** Where do you cook?  
> **B:** In the kitchen. It's bright and modern.

> **A:** How many bedrooms do you have?  
> **B:** We have two bedrooms. There are two bathrooms upstairs.

> **A:** Is your living room big?  
> **B:** No, it's small, but it's very cozy.

Cambia solo el adjetivo y el número de habitaciones: fijas la estructura rápido.

---

## 7c. Plantillas para copiar

1. We have a \_\_\_\_ and a \_\_\_\_.  
2. My house / flat has \_\_\_\_ rooms.  
3. The \_\_\_\_ is \_\_\_\_ (and \_\_\_\_).  
4. There are \_\_\_\_ bedrooms upstairs.  
5. How many rooms does your flat have? — It has \_\_\_\_.

### Más frases para memorizar

> We have a kitchen and a living room.  
> My house has four rooms.  
> The kitchen is bright and modern.  
> The living room is very cozy.  
> The bathroom is small but clean.  
> There are two bathrooms upstairs.  
> The garden is big.  
> How many rooms does your flat have?  
> I sleep in the bedroom.  
> There is a hall near the door.

Lee la lista dos veces en voz alta. Luego describe **tu** casa real con las mismas plantillas. Si puedes, grábate 45 segundos: es el speaking típico de esta unidad.

### Mapa Módulo 3 (vista previa)

| Unidad | Tema |
| :--- | :--- |
| **21** | Rooms + adjetivos |
| 22 | Furniture (mueble) |
| 23 | There is / There are (más) |
| 24 | Preposiciones de lugar |

Esta unidad te da los nombres; la siguiente llena las habitaciones de objetos.

### Rutina de 2 minutos (todos los días)

1. Nombra en voz alta 8 rooms.  
2. Di tres frases *The … is …*.  
3. Di: *We have … bedrooms. My house/flat has … rooms.*  
4. Responde: *How many rooms does your flat have?*

Si lo haces pegado a la puerta de tu cocina durante una semana, el vocabulario se queda sin esfuerzo.

### Frases extra para practicar en voz alta

> The dining room is small.  
> There is a hall near the door.  
> The stairs are upstairs.  
> We have a garage for the car.  
> The balcony is small but bright.  
> My bedroom is cozy.  
> How many bathrooms do you have? — Two.  
> Is your kitchen modern? — Yes, it is.

Copia y personaliza. Cuanto más real sea la casa que describes, mejor recuerdas *have/has* y los adjetivos.

---



### Tour guiado de ejemplo (para imitar)

> Welcome to my flat. First, the hall is small. Then the kitchen is bright and modern. The living room is cozy. After that, the bedroom is quiet. The bathroom is small but clean. There is a balcony. There isn't a garage.

Traduce el tour a tu casa cambiando solo los adjetivos y el número de habitaciones. Es un excelente ejercicio de speaking de un minuto.

## 8. Ejercicios prácticos (con soluciones)

### Ejercicio 1 — Elige la habitación

1. Where do you cook? — In the \_\_\_\_.  
2. Where do you sleep? — In the \_\_\_\_.  
3. Where do you have a shower? — In the \_\_\_\_.  
4. Where is the sofa and TV? — In the \_\_\_\_.  
5. Outside with plants? — In the \_\_\_\_.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **kitchen**  
2. **bedroom**  
3. **bathroom**  
4. **living room**  
5. **garden**
</details>

### Ejercicio 2 — Completa con *have / has / is / are*

1. We \_\_\_\_ three bedrooms.  
2. My house \_\_\_\_ four rooms.  
3. The kitchen \_\_\_\_ bright.  
4. There \_\_\_\_ two bathrooms upstairs.  
5. The rooms \_\_\_\_ small.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **have**  
2. **has**  
3. **is**  
4. **are**  
5. **are**
</details>

### Ejercicio 3 — Adjetivos

1. The kitchen is \_\_\_\_ and modern. (luminosa)  
2. The living room is very \_\_\_\_. (acogedor)  
3. The bathroom is \_\_\_\_ but clean. (pequeño)  
4. The garden is \_\_\_\_. (grande)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **bright**  
2. **cozy**  
3. **small**  
4. **big** / **large**
</details>

### Ejercicio 4 — Traduce al inglés

1. Tenemos tres dormitorios.  
2. Mi casa tiene cuatro habitaciones.  
3. La cocina es luminosa y moderna.  
4. El salón es muy acogedor.  
5. ¿Cuántas habitaciones tiene tu piso?  
6. Hay dos baños arriba.

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. We have three bedrooms.  
2. My house has four rooms.  
3. The kitchen is bright and modern.  
4. The living room is very cozy.  
5. How many rooms does your flat have?  
6. There are two bathrooms upstairs.
</details>

### Ejercicio 5 — Corrige el error

1. *We has a kitchen.*  
2. *The kitchen is brights.*  
3. *There is two bedrooms.*  
4. *How many rooms your flat have?*  
5. *My house have a garden.*

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. We **have** a kitchen.  
2. The kitchen is **bright**.  
3. There **are** two bedrooms.  
4. How many rooms **does** your flat have?  
5. My house **has** a garden.
</details>

### Ejercicio 6 — Empareja

1. kitchen  
2. bedroom  
3. bathroom  
4. garden  
5. garage  

a) sleep  
b) cook  
c) car  
d) shower  
e) plants, outside

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1 → **b** · 2 → **a** · 3 → **d** · 4 → **e** · 5 → **c**
</details>

### Ejercicio 7 — Escribe sobre tu casa

Escribe 6–8 frases: cuántas habitaciones, cuáles son, y 3 adjetivos.

**Modelo:**

> My flat has four rooms. We have a kitchen, a living room, a bedroom and a bathroom. The kitchen is bright and modern. The living room is cozy. The bathroom is small but clean. There isn't a garden, but there is a balcony. I sleep in the bedroom.

### Ejercicio 8 — Elige la opción correcta

1. The living room \_\_\_\_ cozy. (is / are)  
2. We \_\_\_\_ two bathrooms. (have / has)  
3. There \_\_\_\_ a garden. (is / are)  
4. How many rooms \_\_\_\_ your house have? (do / does)  
5. The kitchen is bright \_\_\_\_ modern. (and / but)

<details>
<summary>Ver solución</summary>

1. **is**  
2. **have**  
3. **is**  
4. **does**  
5. **and** (también posible *but* si contrastas; aquí lo natural es *and*)
</details>

1. **3 min** — Repite los 10 nombres de rooms con audio.  
2. **4 min** — Di 6 frases *The … is …*.  
3. **4 min** — Practica *We have / My house has / There are…*.  
4. **4 min** — Escribe y lee tu descripción personal.

### Checklist

- [ ] Sé kitchen, living room, bedroom, bathroom…  
- [ ] Formo plurales (*rooms, bedrooms*)  
- [ ] Uso *have/has* correctamente  
- [ ] Describo con *bright / small / cozy / modern*  
- [ ] Pregunto *How many rooms…?*

---

## 10. Consejos para practicar

1. **Etiqueta** puertas en casa con post-its en inglés (*kitchen, bathroom…*).  
2. **Describe** una foto de un piso online en 5 frases.  
3. **Combina** con U11: *There is a kitchen. There are two bedrooms.*  
4. Prepárate para la [Unidad 22](/curso-a1/unit-22): muebles (*sofa, table, bed…*).  
5. Practica en la [Unidad 21 del curso A1](/curso-a1/unit-21) o el [cuaderno con soluciones](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-21-habitaciones-casa-ejercicios-soluciones).

---

## Resumen rápido

| Tema | Lo esencial |
| :--- | :--- |
| Rooms | kitchen, living room, bedroom, bathroom… |
| Plural | room → rooms |
| Descripción | The kitchen is bright. |
| Poseer | We have… / My house has… |
| Pregunta | How many rooms does your flat have? |
| Extra | upstairs, downstairs, balcony, garden |

---

## Siguiente paso en el curso A1

En la **Unidad 22** llenarás estas habitaciones de **muebles** (*Furniture & Household Items*) y practicarás *mine / yours*.

Practica ahora:

- [Ejercicios Unidad 21 A1 (con soluciones)](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-21-habitaciones-casa-ejercicios-soluciones)

Guía dedicada:

- [Unidad 22 — Muebles y posesivos: mine, yours](/blog/curso-a1/unidad-22-muebles-posesivos-mine-yours)
